31387.s: The bill consolidates the legal status and pay rules of the vice-president and members of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, the National Ombudsman and deputy ombudsmen into one law, tying their salaries to minister pay and setting allowances, leave and substitution rules. It delegates detailed facilities, reimbursement and allowance rules to a general administrative order (AMvB) and amends the Raad van State and Ombudsman laws on incompatibility and exemption.
31387.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegation as needed to consolidate and modernise scattered facilities rules into one instrument, and the exemption power by practical need for leave arrangements at the Raad van State.
q: On the basis of a delegation provision in this law, secondary entitlements will be further elaborated in a single general administrative order.
Op grond van een delegatiebepaling in deze wet zullen secundaire aanspraken in één algemene maatregel van bestuur verder worden uitgewerkt.
d: facilities and cost allowances for senior officials
Artikel 1, derde lid (via Art. 11 Ministerial regulation)
adjustment of fixed pay amounts to civil service pay changes
p: Allows the vice-president to grant a staatsraad temporary exemption from duties at the member's request, with pay suspended.

parties: Asks why pay for Hoge Colleges members is linked to ministers' pay while ministers have no working-time scheme, and how pay will track civil service increases.
If a forty-hour week is not possible for ministers, why was the forty-hour week for civil servants used as an argument for a 10% pay increase?
Indien er geen veertig-urige werkweek mogelijk is voor bewindspersonen, waarom is de veertigurige werkweek voor ambtenaren dan wel als argument gebruikt voor een 10% salaris-verhoging?
Supports ending the fragmented legal status of these office holders.
They endorse the importance of ending the fragmented legal status of the members of the Council of State, the Court of Audit and the National Ombudsman.
Zij onderschrijven het belang dat er een einde gemaakt moet worden aan de verbrokkelde rechtspositie van de leden van de Raad van State, de leden van de Algemene Rekenkamer en de Nationale ombudsman.
Asks what the government means by modernising the legal status of these officials.
These members would welcome further explanation of what the government means by the possibility to 'modernise' the legal status of these officials.
Deze leden ontvangen graag een nadere toelichting wat de regering bedoelt met de mogelijkheid om de rechtspo-sitie van bedoelde functionarissen te «moderniseren».
Welcomes a single law and a single general administrative order; asks about timing of the related pay decisions for the judiciary and Hoge Colleges.
They consider it a good thing that an end is made to the fragmented regulation of the legal status of the members of the Council of State, the Court of Audit and the National Ombudsman.

Zij vinden het een goede zaak dat er een einde wordt gemaakt aan de verbrokkelde regeling van de rechtspositie van de leden van de Raad van State, de leden van de Algemene Rekenkamer en de Nationale ombudsman.
Asks what the added value of regulating everything in one law is, instead of in each institution's own statute.
What is the added value of regulating this in one law?
Wat is de toegevoegde waarde van het regelen in één wet?

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the explanatory memorandum should make clear that differences in legal status among the Hoge Colleges (Council of State, Court of Audit, Ombudsman) may be introduced in future, and it raised no substantive objections to the pay provisions. The government adopted the advice by adding the clarification and aligned pay with the ministers' salary structure, with the Council of State's advice accepted in the nader rapport.
concerns: The Council advised that the explanatory memorandum should explicitly state that future differentiation in legal status among the three colleges remains possible, and the government supplemented the memorandum accordingly.

31459.s: The bill extends the income tax and wage tax rules on excessive pay components: it treats returns from shares, loans, rights and debts linked to work as income from work, and introduces a 30% pseudo-final wage tax on excessive severance pay and a 15% charge on pension accrual from large salary increases. It also amends transitional rules, the Belastingplan 2008, and the Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen.
31459.j: The memorandum justifies the measures as a more balanced tax burden on excessive pay components and argues that tax incentives are more effective than company or labour law in discouraging such behaviour.
q: to arrive at a more balanced tax levy on excessive pay components
om te komen tot een meer evenwichtige belastingheffing bij excessieve beloningsbestanddelen
d: annual adjustment of the €500,000 threshold amount
Artikel III, Artikel 32bc, lid 4 (Wet op de loonbelasting 1964)
annual adjustment of the €500,000 pensionable salary threshold
adjustment of the threshold amount from 1 January 2009

parties: Wants shareholder meetings to be able to effectively control remuneration policy, including in takeover situations, and asks for publication of severance and change-of-control clauses as the Frijns commission recommended.
The CDA members believe the shareholders' meeting must be able to effectively control remuneration policy, including in a takeover situation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie menen wel dat de aandeelhoudersvergadering effectief het beloningsbeleid moet kunnen controleren, ook in situatie van overname.
Asks whether the exemption for employees is legally sustainable and whether the government will evaluate the law after some years, and how far avoidance constructions are feared.
Does the government think the exception for employees built into the law is legally sustainable?
Denkt de regering dat de in de wet gemaakte uitzondering voor werknemers juridisch houdbaar is?
Worries the carried-interest rule is too broad, that the tax authority will struggle to prove the link to the lucrative interest, and that courts may strike the rule down under the ECHR.

Criticises the bill as symbolic policy lacking a problem analysis, calls the Council of State's criticism devastating, objects to economic double taxation, retroactive effect without transitional rules, and rising administrative burdens.
All in all they consider this bill not the government's finest hour: technically unclear and incomplete.
Al met al vinden zij dit wetsvoorstel geen beste beurt van de regering: technisch onduidelijk en onvolkomen.
Is disappointed by the weak reasoning and the sharp criticism from the Council of State, and suspects the budget yield drove the proposal rather than careful deliberation.
These members think it seems more like a quick job in which the budget yield was the priority.
Deze leden menen dat het er eerder op lijkt dat het wetsvoorstel een vluggertje was waarbij de budgettaire opbrengst voorop stond.

Agrees with the Council of State that the employer levy is inadequately justified and does not fit the wage tax structure, and asks for a counter-proof rule for employers; also flags possible overkill and unclear rules.
The D66 members advocate amending the proposed scheme in this sense if it is maintained, to allow employers to show a high wage is unrelated to dismissal.
De leden van de fractie van D66 pleiten er voor om als de voorgestelde regeling wordt gehandhaafd, de regeling in deze zin aan te passen.
Asks the government to differentiate the factor 4 to avoid large gaps between actual and fictitious base, and raises retroactivity questions.
The CDA members ask the government to still differentiate the factor 4 so that no excessively large differences arise between the actual and fictitious base.

De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering alsnog de factor 4 te differentiëren ten einde ervoor te zorgen dat er geen al te grote verschillen ontstaan tussen de feitelijke en de fictieve grondslag.
Asks how lucrative interests are currently taxed and whether differences between direct and indirect holdings can be eliminated.
These members ask whether it is possible to eliminate the difference between an indirectly and directly held lucrative interest so both are taxed the same way?
Deze leden vragen of het mogelijk is het verschil tussen een middellijk en een onmiddellijk gehouden lucratief belang op te heffen, zodat beide op dezelfde wijze worden belast?
Worries that complexity and reliance on case-by-case facts invite juridification and undermine the regime's effectiveness, and asks for guidance.
These members also point to the burden of proof on the inspector, the dependence on facts and circumstances, and the resulting risk of juridification that could undermine the regime's effectiveness.

Deze leden wijzen in dat verband ook op de bewijslast die bij de inspecteur ligt, de afhankelijkheid van feiten en omstandigheden en de daarmee op de loer liggende juridisering die mogelijk de effectiviteit van de regeling te niet kunnen doen.
Objects to vague statutory criteria for lucrative interests and undefined notions of normal return, and argues shareholders should set pay.
The VVD members are concerned about the broadly formulated statutory text and especially the wide interpretive room the explanatory memorandum gives to it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie maken zich zorgen over de ruim geformuleerde wettekst en met name over de brede interpretatiemogelijkheden die daaraan in de toelichting wordt gegeven.
Questions the vague lucrative-interest regime and asks why it is not treated in box 1 or 2, and whether the regime is applied unequally.
The government has chosen to frame the lucrative-interest regime in great detail on one hand, while remaining extraordinarily vague on the other.
De regering heeft er voor gekozen het lucratief belangregime aan de ene kant zeer gedetailleerd te omkaderen en aan de andere kant buitengewoon vaag te blijven.
Asks about the number of venture investors likely to leave and implications for innovation policy.
These members ask whether the government can give insight into the number of venture investors who will leave as a result of this bill.
Deze leden vragen of de regering inzicht kan geven in het aantal durfinvesteerders dat zal vertrekken naar aanleiding van dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks for clarity on whether leaver clauses and restricted stock fall within the bill's scope.
The aim is to be able to unambiguously answer the question to what extent these cases fall within the scope of the bill.
Doel is om de vraag in hoeverre deze gevallen binnen de reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel vallen eenduidig te kunnen beantwoorden.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the draft bill introducing a 30% employer levy on excessive severance payments, a 15% levy on flat-rate backservice pension premiums above €500,000, and clarifications on carried interest taxation, raising concerns about the lack of problem definition, instrument choice, equality, and the punitive character of the levy. The government's nader rapport replies point by point, largely rejecting the objections while adding some explanatory notes to the memorie van toelichting.
concerns: The Council found no clear problem definition or quantification of excessive remuneration; the government added definitions and financial indications to the explanatory memorandum.
The Council argued the levies lacked a motivated tariff and a testing framework for tax burdens; the government declined to develop a new framework and maintained its tariffs.
The Council considered the levy a punitive sanction requiring testing under Article 6 ECHR; the government disagreed, arguing it is not punitive.
Objections on the instrument choice and whether labour or company law could serve the aim were answered by the government with reasons for choosing tax law.
The Council saw a risk of violating the equality principle because the €500,000 threshold and the forfait lacked objective justification; the government maintained the threshold and forfait.
The Council criticised the vague carried interest rules and the lack of analysis on the income concept; the government added explanations but did not split the bill.
The Council raised disproportionate administrative burden for employers; the government explained centralisation at the Belastingdienst and supplemented the memorandum.
Redactional comments on the wording of the articles were adopted in the amended text.

31468.s: This bill repairs technical defects, wrong cross-references and omissions in the Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft) and several other laws, mostly redrafting provisions on market access, passporting and takeover bids. It also writes into statute several temporary arrangements previously set by ministerial regulation under the transitional law.
31468.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as correcting drafting errors and omissions made when the Wft was enacted, and aligning exemptions and powers with prior law and EU directives.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel TT / 1:29 lid 3 Wft
general binding rules adopted by the supervisor (AFM/DNB) under the Wft
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel SS / 2:30 onderdeel b Wft
further rules on market access requirements
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel RRRRRR / 5:33 lid 3 Wft
definition of option in substantial participation rules
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel BBBBBBB / 5:76 lid 2 Wft
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel YYYY / 3:57 lid 2 en 6 Wft
prudential requirements on balance sheet items for investment firms and banks
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel GGGGGG / 4:60 lid 1 Wft
financial instruments in which collective investment schemes may invest
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel O, P, R / 1:58, 1:58a, 1:58c Wft

Supervisor may prohibit foreign financial firms from concluding new contracts in the Netherlands after notifying the home-state supervisor, including where home-state measures are insufficient or absent.
DNB must promptly inform the Minister and other authorities of emergencies affecting financial stability in other member states.
Technical changes to criteria for consolidated supervision of financial holdings.

parties: Asks whether the appeal restriction against AFM prospectus approval is justified and whether supervisor fines and orders can be made public, touching on judicial review and transparency of enforcement.
Under the current Wft there is a restriction on the possibility to appeal against the decision of the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) approving a prospectus.

In de huidige Wft is momenteel sprake van een beperking wat betreft de mogelijkheid om in beroep te gaan tegen het besluit van de goedkeuring van een prospectus door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM).

Asks the government to report omissions found after the reporting point closed, to reopen the reporting point, and to send amended AMvBs to parliament before adoption, giving parliament oversight of lower-level rules.
The VVD members ask the government to state which omissions were reported (or came to light) after the reporting point closed and how they are addressed in this bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie verzoeken de regering aan te geven welke omissies er na sluiting van het meldpunt zijn gemeld (of gebleken) en hoe die in dit wetsvoorstel zijn geadresseerd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Reparatiewet Wft draft bill, which aims to repair technical defects in the Wft without policy changes, is not yet mature and should be reviewed as a whole for correctness, consistency and completeness. The Minister of Finance replied by accepting most points, amending the bill integrally, and moving substantive issues (such as art. 1:5 and the 2:8/2:10 tension) to a later Wijzigingswet Wft.
concerns: The bill contains numerous technical errors, wrong cross-references and omissions, and the Raad asks that the whole bill be reviewed for correctness, consistency and completeness; the Minister did an integral check and corrected them.

Art. 1:58(2) Wft incompletely implements art. 30(3) of Directive 2006/48/EC because the duty to notify the home supervisor was omitted; the Minister restored it but moved the related art. 1:5 issue to the later amendment act.
Articles 1:58a(2) and 1:58c(3) contain the same omission and should be amended in the same way as art. 1:58(2); the Minister adopted this.
Deleting the definition of 'cliënt' removes a basis for the clarification about business clients; the explanatory memorandum should address this, and the Minister amended the explanation.
Art. 1:105(1)(c) refers to art. 5:81(3), which is a grant of exemption power rather than a prohibition; the Minister replaced the reference with arts. 5:74 and 5:79.
Art. 2:27(4) Wft appears to have no clear purpose given the existing exemptions in art. 3:6; the Minister agreed to delete it.

Exemption possibilities at licensing differ from those during ongoing supervision (art. 2:31 vs 3:53 and 3:57); the Minister harmonised them across the Wft, affecting arts. 2:37, 2:41, 2:49, 2:51, 2:67, 2:68 and 2:99.

The Raad noted a tension between art. 2:8(2) exempting clearing institutions from a duty in art. 2:8(1) and the new duty in art. 2:10, and a similar tension between arts. 2:54 and 2:52; the Minister deferred these substantive issues to the Wijzigingswet Wft.

31549.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to add a national visa framework for stays longer than three months (machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf and terugkeervisum), covering interdepartmental competence between the Ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs, fees, conditions, annulment, and refusal grounds. It also relaxes Awb procedural requirements for these visa applications (rejection without hearing, no reasons or appeal notice when granting as requested) and extends the reference-procedure and decision deadlines.
31549.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for a national legal framework for visa policy, the practical volume of visa cases, and the need to align competences and procedures with the Vreemdelingenwet and the Awb, while preserving the right to appeal against decisions.
q: Article 2f introduces, departing from Article 4:5(1) and (4) of the Awb, the possibility of simply declaring deficient applications inadmissible.
Artikel 2f introduceert in afwijking van artikel 4:5, eerste en vierde lid, van de Awb de mogelijkheid tot een eenvoudige buitenbehandelingstelling van ongenoegzame aanvragen.
d: rules on interdepartmental coordination of visa decisions
fees for visa applications and changes
rules on grounds for refusing return visa
procedures for applications, notification and representatives
exemptions from visa conditions and return-visa rules by category
p: Allows the minister to reject visa applications without giving the applicant a chance to supplement them and to omit the right-to-object notice and reasons when granting, while removing the duty to be heard before rejection on information not supplied by the applicant.

Lets the minister attach restrictions, conditions, or withdraw and annul an issued visa on broad grounds including public order, national security and international relations, and for relevant changes in circumstances.
Gives the minister open discretion to grant a visa outside the normal conditions, and to refuse one where international relations so require, with no criteria specified in the statute.
Adds grounds to refuse residence permits where there is reason to believe obligations will not be kept, including prior non-compliance or incorrect data.
Shortens a decision deadline and allows extension of the decision period by up to three months for long-term residents' family members.
Sets a nineteen-week decision period for objections against visa, residence permit and undesirability decisions, with a possible extension of up to thirteen weeks.

parties: Asks whether fraud refusal grounds respect proportionality, individual assessment and EU/ECHR obligations, and seeks clarity on the consultation between Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers.
It is stated that rules on applying these refusal grounds will be set by or under a general administrative order, taking into account applicable human rights treaties.

Gesteld wordt dat bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur regels zullen worden gesteld over de toepassing van deze afwijzingsgronden, waarbij rekening zal worden gehouden met de toepasselijke mensenrechtenverdragen.
Questions the proportionality of new refusal grounds and whether they comply with EU law and Article 8 ECHR, fearing minor errors could bar lawful residence.
These members also believe that action against fraud and abuse must be proportionate and meet international obligations.
Deze leden vinden echter ook dat het optreden tegen fraude en misbruik proportioneel moet zijn en moet voldoen aan internationale verplichtingen.
Objects that the proposal sets aside several General Administrative Law Act protections, such as notice, right to remedy and hearing, leaving applicants open to arbitrary decisions.
No fewer than three provisions of the General Administrative Law Act, which protect the applicant against arbitrariness, are set aside here.
Niet minder dan drie bepalingen van de Awb, die de aanvrager bescherming bieden tegen willekeur, worden hier buiten toepassing gesteld.
Asks whether the new refusal grounds conflict with several EU directives and related case law.
The VVD members ask whether the new refusal grounds in this amendment create tension with Article 35 of Directive 2004/38/EC.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de in de onderhavige wijziging opgenomen nieuwe weigeringgronden, spanning opleveren met artikel 35 van richtlijn 2004/38/EG.
Supports tougher action against fraud, proposing that fraudulent referents be barred permanently and no return visas for convicted offenders.
The PVV members believe that not only the fraudulent alien but also, where relevant, a fraudulent referent should be dealt with.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn van mening dat niet enkel de frauderende vreemdeling, maar in voorkomende gevallen ook een frauduleuze referent aangepakt dient te worden.
Regrets the continued mvv requirement and argues the measures weaken the legal position of foreigners seeking residence.
According to these members, the measures in this bill appear to undermine the legal position of foreigners who wish to stay in the Netherlands on several points.
Het lijkt er, volgens deze leden, op alsof de in dit wetsvoorstel geformuleerde maatregelen op meerdere punten afbreuk doen aan de rechtspositie van vreemdelingen die verblijf in Nederland wensen.
Asks how the proposals fit EU law and requests justification of the new grounds on proportionality grounds.
They therefore ask the government to further justify the bill from the standpoint of proportionality.
Zij vragen de regering het wetsvoorstel dan ook nader te onderbouwen vanuit het oogpunt van proportionaliteit.
Welcomes a statutory basis for visas but objects to deviations from the General Administrative Law Act, to referents bearing responsibility for applicants' errors, and to disproportionate refusals.

31567.s: The bill creates a single participation budget (participatiebudget) that bundles the WWB work-component funds, integration (inburgering) provisions and adult education funds, distributed to municipalities by formulas set in general administrative orders. It amends the WWB, WEB and WI accordingly, phases out earmarking for adult education with a transitional requirement that some funds go to regional training centres, and requires a review within four years.
31567.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the general administrative orders as needed to set distribution formulas and phase out the earmark gradually, and says the power will not be used to create fixed compartments within the budget.
d: distribution keys for participation budget grant
rules on payment of the grant
further conditions for costs chargeable to the grant
rules on clawback and allocation of recovered funds
rules on provision of data and implementation report
allowing educational funds for other participation provisions and lowering the regional centre spending obligation
rules on determining the 2009 inburgering rijksbijdrage
p: The minister may set recovery amounts lower than the full unspent amount and an order in council may exempt part of unspent funds from clawback, giving the executive discretion over municipal accountability.

A general administrative order may lower or remove the mandatory spending on regional training centres from 2011, shifting the allocation of adult education funds away from a statutory earmark without parliamentary approval.

parties: Supports a fully unified budget but asks for clear, output-based accountability and justification for keeping three ministries feeding the budget.
Moreover, it may be asked that it is clear in advance which performances will be delivered for an amount of around 2 billion euros.
Bovendien mag worden gevraagd dat vooraf duidelijk is welke prestaties geleverd worden voor een bedrag van circa 2 miljard euro.
Asks for measurable indicators, how the Chamber is involved in output allocation and sanctions if municipalities fall behind agreements, and how evaluations involve parliament.
Does the government have steering instruments at its disposal if municipal performance lags behind the administrative agreements, these members ask.
Heeft de regering sturingsmiddelen tot haar beschikking indien de prestaties van gemeenten achterblijven bij de bestuurlijke afspraken, zo vragen deze leden.
Worries that municipal discretion and lack of ring-fencing could shift funds away from re-integration and weaken quality; asks how municipal use of discretion will be supervised.
In what way is insight obtained and supervision exercised over the way municipalities give shape to the greater policy freedom.
Op welke wijze wordt er inzicht verkregen en toezicht gehouden over de wijze waarop gemeente invulling geven aan de grotere beleidsvrijheid
Asks whether annual integration spending remains traceable after the budgets are merged.
ask whether the government can commit that after the entry into force of the proposed de-ring-fencing it remains traceable exactly how much is spent annually on integration.
vragen of de regering kan toezeggen dat na de inwerkingtreding van de voorgenomen ontschotting traceerbaar blijft welk bedrag er jaarlijks exact aan inburgering wordt besteed.
Supports de-earmarking and efficiency but questions whether earmarking for ROCs until 2011 and output allocation keys undermine municipal freedom of choice and measurable targets.
Is it the government's intention to allow market forces in the training and education market for re-integration?
Is het de bedoeling van de regering om marktwerking toe te laten op de opleiding en educatiemarkt voor re-integratie?
Asks whether steering on means alongside output creates perverse incentives and conflicts with decentralised implementation.
Why was it chosen to also steer on means, ask the members of the ChristenUnie faction.
Waarom is gekozen voor het ook sturen op middelen, zo vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Wet participatiebudget, which pools WWB work budgets, integration budgets and adult education funds, and broadly supports it but objects to the transitional rules for education funds and the phased phase-out of the obligation to spend through regional training centres (ROCs). The government's nader rapport accepts several points, such as adding justification and a clearer timetable, while rejecting the claim that the earmarking creates barriers to market entry.
concerns: The Raad asked why earmarking of education funds remains necessary given output-based steering, and the government justified it by uncertainty about achieving national performance agreements and amended the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad asked for explicit criteria, timetable and end date for phasing out the ROC spending obligation, and the government added explanation while stating the end date cannot yet be fixed.

The Raad warned a prolonged transitional arrangement could disproportionately restrict free movement of services, which the government rejected by arguing ROC education falls outside free provision of services case law.

The Raad argued that allowing the ROC obligation to cover integration and re-integration funds creates market entry barriers, which the government disputed since municipalities are not obliged to buy from ROCs.

31585.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the 2008 treaty revising the 1958 Benelux Economic Union treaty, after the Staten-Generaal consent required by article 91 of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Treaty revising the Benelux Economic Union treaty of 3 February 1958, concluded at The Hague on 17 June 2008, requires approval by the States General under article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it.

Het op 17 juni 2008 te ’s-Gravenhage tot stand gekomen Verdrag tot herziening van het op 3 februari 1958 gesloten Verdrag tot instelling van de Benelux Economische Unie ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft

parties: Asks what added value the Benelux will have, the expected costs, and whether the institutional structure will be scrutinised critically given a less detailed framework treaty.
If this added value is judged smaller than in the past, and since the treaty is less detailed (being a framework treaty), will the institutional structure's content and size be critically examined?

Indien deze meerwaarde kleiner wordt geschat dan in het verleden en aangezien het verdrag een minder gedetailleerd karakter heeft (en een kaderverdrag betreft), zal er dan ook kritisch worden gekeken naar de invulling en grootte van de institutionele structuur?
Welcomes the amendments as allowing the Benelux countries to pursue collective interests more effectively.
The changes make it possible to better utilise the strength of the Benelux.
De wijzigingen maken het mogelijk de kracht van de Benelux beter te benutten.

Doubts that continued Benelux cooperation in this institutional form is effective and necessary, and questions the justification for institutionalising it with committees, a secretary-general and an interparliamentary council.
However, the reasons for cooperation in the Benelux are too thin to institutionalise them.
Echter de redenen voor samenwerking in de Benelux zijn te mager om die te institutionaliseren.

31792-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statute of the States General (the Dutch parliament) by adjusting appropriations and receipts across articles on Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer, member allowances and joint activities, with a net reduction in expenditure of EUR 2.3 million. It is a purely budgetary amendment that splits the combined budget into separate statutes for the States General and for oversight bodies such as the Raad van State and Algemene Rekenkamer.

31819.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Moordrecht, Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel and Zevenhuizen-Moerkapelle into a new municipality called Zuidplas, with the transitional arrangements for elections, judicial and police districts and safety regions set out in its articles. It is a voluntary municipal merger with no substantive delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: With effect from the date of reorganisation, the municipalities of Moordrecht, Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel and Zevenhuizen-Moerkapelle are abolished.
Met ingang van de datum van herindeling worden de gemeenten Moordrecht, Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel en Zevenhuizen-Moerkapelle opgeheven.

parties: Wants clearer evidence of local support for the merger and asks about alternatives considered.
These members nonetheless attach importance to more insight being given into the support for this merger.
Deze leden hechten er evenwel aan, dat meer inzicht wordt gegeven in het draagvlak voor deze herindeling.
Stresses that mergers must rest on popular support from below and questions whether decentralisation drives them, asking how service levels will be guaranteed.
These members ask the government whether it shares their analysis that greater decentralisation of national tasks leads to more municipal mergers.
Beleidskader De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of zij de analyse van deze leden deelt dat meer decentralisatie van rijkstaken aanleiding is voor meer gemeentelijke herindelingen.
Questions the durability of the chosen solution and its consequences for Gouda and the geographic coherence of the three villages.
They question to what extent this solution is durable and will hold up in the long term.
Zij vragen zich af in hoeverre deze oplossing duurzaam is en stand zal houden op de lange termijn.
Doubts that the merger is truly bottom-up, suspects provincial pressure on small municipalities, and asks for justification against alternatives.
These members cannot fully shake the impression that the Zuid-Holland provincial executive is putting pressure on many small municipalities to start a merger.
Deze leden kunnen zich niet volledig aan de indruk onttrekken dat het college van de provincie Zuid-Holland op veel kleine gemeenten druk uitoefent om aan een herindeling te beginnen.

31828.s: The bill requires Dutch schools to meet minimum learning outcome standards in Dutch language and mathematics, with the Minister able to end funding or close a school for persistent poor quality. It separates school board and internal supervisory functions, adds a ministerial directive power to address governance misconduct, and creates a legal basis for sector governance codes.
31828.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by pointing to repeated cases of very weak schools and the state's constitutional duty for minimum quality under Article 23 of the Constitution.
q: The bill gives the minister, in addition to the existing funding sanction, the power to issue a directive where there is governance misconduct.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de minister in aanvulling op de bestaande mogelijkheid van een bekostigingssanctie, de mogelijkheid een aanwijzing te geven in het geval er sprake is van bestuurlijk wanbeheer.
d: measurement of learning outcomes and norms for minimum results
measurement of learning outcomes and norms in secondary education
designation of a governance code for schools
further annual report requirements and content
p: The Minister may issue directives to school governing bodies for defined governance misconduct, with a four-week right to respond and judicial review afterwards.
The Minister may end funding or close a school or school type for persistently poor learning outcomes, subject only to a four-week response period.

parties: Supports the government's constitutional duty to guarantee quality education and wants effective intervention instruments, while stressing that parents and professionals should primarily hold schools accountable.
This is regulated in this bill, which the members of this group very much welcome.
Dat wordt geregeld in dit wetsvoorstel, hetgeen de leden van deze fractie zeer toejuichen.

Supports giving the minister more power to intervene in seriously failing schools and questions whether a bewindvoering (administration) step should be added, and asks about the use of the learning-outcome indicators.

They recognise the need for the government to better fulfil its constitutional task of continuous care for education, and therefore attach importance to the minister receiving more powers to intervene.

Zij onderkennen de noodzaak dat de overheid zijn grondwettelijke taak van aanhoudende zorg voor het onderwijs, beter moet kunnen waarmaken en daarom hechten zij eraan dat de minister meer mogelijkheden krijgt om in te grijpen.
Asks whether clear and transparent quality norms can be set and whether learning-outcome assessments unfairly penalise schools with weighted or special-needs pupils.
The question these members raise is whether clear, transparent education quality norms can be set that also enjoy sufficient support among schools and education organisations.

De vraag die deze leden daarbij stellen, is of er heldere, transparante onderwijsnormen voor kwaliteit kunnen worden opgesteld, die ook op voldoende draagvlak bij de scholen en bij de onderwijsorganisaties kan rekenen.
Finds the sanctions insufficient, wants very weak schools closed faster, and asks why value-added measurement was not included despite the Council of State's advice.
In addition, these members find that the sanctions the minister will be able to impose on schools through this bill do not go far enough.
Daarnaast vinden deze leden dat de sancties die de minister door middel van dit wetsvoorstel aan scholen zal kunnen opleggen nog niet ver genoeg gaan.

Supports the bill as a way to raise education quality and asks whether the instruments allow proportionate intervention against poor governance and enforcement of a motion limiting 'very weak' status to one year.
The large number of weak and very weak schools and the large number of pupils who suffer as a result provide the members with more than sufficient reason for this amendment.
De grote hoeveelheid zwakke en zeer zwakke scholen en het grote aantal leerlingen dat hiervan de dupe is, vormen voor de leden meer dan voldoende aanleiding tot deze wijziging.

Questions whether turning minimum learning outcomes into funding conditions is compatible with Article 23 of the Constitution, criticises the shift from prior judicial review to ex post review, and warns of centralisation.
Why does the government propose a measure that leads to a strengthening of centralism, they ask.
Waarom stelt de regering een maatregel voor die leidt tot een versterking van centralisme, zo vragen zij.

Accepts the government's need to intervene in exceptional cases but finds the funding condition a heavy instrument, asks whether alternatives and existing powers were considered, and asks for proportionality justification.
At the same time, these members consider enshrining minimum learning outcomes as a funding condition in law a heavy instrument for tackling incidental situations.
Tegelijk achten deze leden het vastleggen van minimumleerresultaten als bekostigingsvoorwaarde in de wet een zwaar middel om incidentele situaties te bestrijden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised negatively on a bill introducing a duty of care for good education and good governance in primary, special and secondary education, plus extra ministerial intervention powers, citing insufficient problem analysis, doubts on constitutional fit (Article 23 Grondwet), and weak necessity for new interventions. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely accepted the criticisms, dropped the general zorgplicht and quality-care requirement, narrowed the governance rules and intervention powers, and kept the core minimum-learning-results funding condition.
concerns: The Raad found no analysis of the problems justifying the measures and advised a substantive motivation of their necessity and effectiveness; the government added a fuller problem analysis in the explanatory memorandum but kept the measures.

The Raad argued that the new deugdelijkheidseisen (adequate learning outcomes and quality care) must be fixed in law under Article 23 Grondwet rather than left to an AMvB, and that the inspection's aandachtspunten cannot become funding conditions without justification; the government dropped quality care and narrowed the outcome norm but kept learning outcomes as a funding condition.

The Raad doubted that a relative national-average norm for learning outcomes is objective and workable and that the zorgplicht fits the deregulatory aims; the government defended the norm with comparison groups and limited sanctions to a small number of very weak schools.

The Raad questioned the need for new intervention powers given existing article 164 WPO and Awb options; the government reframed the payment-termination and direction powers and dropped the reduction-of-funding and opheffing parts in part.

The Raad required the principle of pas toe of leg uit to apply to governance rules and the code to be set by AMvB; the government reworked article 17a, kept only separation of supervision and management as a funding condition, and adopted the AMvB route.
The Raad objected to defining bevoegd gezag of a bijzondere school as an organ rather than the legal person; the government deleted the provision.
The Raad gave a list of redactional corrections in an annex, which the government incorporated.

31855.s: The bill amends the Youth Care Act to create a national electronic referral index in which professionals can report young people (under 23) facing specified risks to their development, so that help can be coordinated early. It sets out who may report, how data is stored, retained, protected and accessed, and how municipalities organise cooperation, with the detailed rules largely left to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
31855.j: The memorandum justifies the reporting powers and delegations as necessary to prevent fragmented help for young people, relying on a balance between privacy and child welfare and on detailed rules to follow.
q: The bill strictly regulates what is necessary: a power to make a report using the citizen service number.
Het wetsvoorstel regelt strikt hetgeen daarvoor nodig is: een bevoegdheid om een melding te mogen doen aan de hand van het BSN.
d: conditions for designating reporting bodies and officials
age categories of young people for proper implementation
rules on organisation and management of the index, including data security
designation of additional facilities added to the index
rules on management and compliance with cooperation agreements
rules on use and organisation of access to the index
further rules on submitting reports to the index
identifying number and data for children without a citizen service number
municipal rules on notifying young people of registration
p: Allows professionals to report a young person without consent and to breach confidentiality on a reasonable suspicion of listed risks, widening state access to personal information about minors.
Places the national index under the Minister for Youth and Family, who is responsible for it as data controller, with purpose limited to early coordination of help.'

parties: Asks about the relation between the index, the EKD and other systems, and about privacy safeguards against hacking and misuse of youth data.
Are the privacy aspects sufficiently safeguarded, since use is made of an internet website?
Zijn de privacy-aspecten voldoende geborgd, aangezien gebruik wordt gemaakt van een internetwebsite?
Asks how municipalities will ensure participation and coordination of care after reports are made, given the need for strong local regulation.
It is of great importance that the coordination of care within the municipalities is well arranged.
Het is van groot belang dat de coördinatie van zorg binnen de gemeenten goed geregeld is.
Asks how parents and young people will be informed, how objections can be lodged, and under what criteria information may be withheld from them.
How and to whom can parents and/or the young person lodge an objection if they believe the young person's data were wrongly included in the referral index?
Hoe en bij wie kunnen ouders en/of jeugdige bezwaar aantekenen als zij vinden dat gegevens van de jeugdige onterecht zijn opgenomen in de verwijsindex.

Supports the index as preventive help but warns that reports must be limited to genuinely risky situations and criticises the vague definition of 'bijsturing' that allows data sharing on arbitrary grounds.
Can the government explain how the more precise definition of 'bijsturing' actually helps prevent data being provided on arbitrary grounds?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe de nadere definitie van het begrip «bijsturing» precies bijdraagt aan het voorkomen van gegevensverstrekking op willekeurige gronden?
Supports early signalling but opposes registering ethnicity and questions whether the wide scope and long retention could stigmatise young people.
For these members it is of great importance that ethnicity will not be registered in the referral index.
Het is daarbij voor deze leden van groot belang dat etniciteit niet zal worden geregistreerd in de verwijsindex.
Warns against putting labels on children and parents, questions the broad reporting criteria, the lack of consent requirement and the parental access to records.
They are not unwilling towards the idea of a referral index for at-risk youth, but believe children and parents should not be unnecessarily stigmatised.
Zij staan niet onwelwillend tegenover het idee van een verwijsindex voor risicojeugd, maar zijn van mening dat kinderen en ouders niet onnodig een stempel mogen krijgen opgedrukt.

Raises the Raad van State concern that a comprehensive risk-recording system may encourage a society intolerant of risk and asks whether the criteria meet the necessity test for interference with privacy.
They ask whether the abstract, widely shared wish to combat youth development problems as far as possible is sufficient to meet the strict test of a pressing social need.

Zij vragen of de abstracte, breed gedeelde en moeilijk af te wijzen wens dat problemen in de ontwikkeling van jongeren zoveel mogelijk moeten worden bestreden afdoende is om te beantwoorden aan het strenge criterium van een dringende maatschappelijke behoefte.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against proceeding with the bill introducing a national referral index for at-risk young people, citing doubts about necessity, proportionality under Article 8 ECHR, the broad notification framework, data retention and processing of special personal data. The government's reply accepted several points (narrowed purpose clause, removed catch-all, shortened retention and clarified roles) but rejected others, such as not registering ethnicity and keeping the retention periods.
concerns: The Raad doubts the necessity of a comprehensive index covering all risks for all young people and questions whether the problem's scale justifies it; the government defends the index as a necessary and effective tool while narrowing the notification grounds.

The Raad finds the interference with private life under Article 8 ECHR disproportionate because the aims are not legitimate for all risk categories and the scope is too broad; the government argues the balance is adequate and clarifies the health-based aim.

The Raad warns that registration may stigmatise young people as potential dangers and conflicts with the right to privacy; the government responds that the index is positive in purpose and limits content to the citizen service number.
The open-ended notification criteria with a catch-all provision lack clarity on when registration is permitted, so the government replaced the half-open system with a limitative list of grounds.
The Raad notes that a notification duty may arise in practice and that the index could shift professionals' responsibility, a concern the government addresses by revising the explanatory memorandum.

The Raad considers registering ethnicity in the index unlawful under the Data Protection Act, Constitution and treaties, and advises against it; the government followed this advice and dropped the passage.

The Raad objects to the purpose and scope of the index, the 7-year retention period and the processing of special personal data without a sufficiently weighty public interest; the government shortened some periods and adjusted the purpose clause.

The Raad flags that information exchange between police and doctors may be blocked by confidentiality rules, and that the municipal coordinating role may duplicate other reporting systems; the government points to implementation tracks and a later bill.

31891.s: The bill amends the Wft, Pensioenwet and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling to introduce premiepensioeninstellingen (PPIs), defined-contribution pension institutions that may administer contribution-based pension schemes without bearing insurance risk. It sets licensing, prudential, investment, custody, information and waarde-overdracht rules for PPIs, assigning supervision to De Nederlandsche Bank and conduct oversight to the AFM.
31891.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical detail needed to implement the PPI regime and to align it with existing Wft and pension supervision frameworks.
d: content of agreements between PPI and employer and between PPI and custodian
investment rules for PPIs and pension schemes under non-EU law
details of transfer value calculation and information obligations
temporary measures to repair unintended effects of the act, possibly departing from the Wft, Pensioenwet or Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling
DNB may grant exemptions from certain licensing requirements
rules on conversion of pension funds
p: Allows temporary ministerial regulations to depart from statute to correct unintended effects, with a duty to submit a bill to parliament afterwards and withdrawal if parliament rejects it.
DNB may restrict or prohibit a PPI from disposing of its assets, with notification to foreign supervisors.

parties: Asks whether the lighter supervisory regime and creditor protection are adequate, and how DNB cooperates with foreign supervisors when conflicts arise.
Can the government explain what it means by this precisely? Why almost always?
Kan de regering aangeven wat zij hiermee precies bedoelt? Waarom vrijwel altijd?
Asks in which cases the obligation to place assets with a pension custodian applies and how pension participants are actually protected.
The PvdA members would like to know in which specific cases this obligation arises and how pension participants are actually protected.
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA vernemen graag in welke bepaalde gevallen deze verplichting ontstaat en op welke wijze de pensioendeelnemers nu eigenlijk worden beschermd.
Opposes defined-contribution schemes that shift risk to employees and asks for better transparency and protection of participants, including clear rules on mortality gains.
The SP members ask whether it would not be wiser, for transparency, to require this statement be handed to all pension participants and beneficiaries.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het niet verstandiger is om in het kader van transparantie deze verklaring verplicht aan alle pensioendeelnemers en pensioengerechtigden te overhandigen.
Supports making the Netherlands attractive for international pensions and urges speed in introducing the wider API, while asking about vague notions like 'reëel risico' in the text.
Can the government guarantee that the highest urgency will be applied in realising the API?
Kan de regering garanderen dat de hoogste spoed wordt betracht bij het realiseren van API’s?
Asks about the cost to the Netherlands, the government's plan to prevent foreign states plundering Dutch pension assets, and how PPI board members are chosen.
What is the cabinet's action plan to prevent member states with a less funded pension pillar from plundering Dutch pension assets?
Wat is het actieplan van het kabinet om te voorkomen dat lidstaten met een minder kapitaalgedekte pensioenpijler, de Nederlandse pensioenvermogens plunderen?

Asks the government to guarantee no state guarantee schemes or financial risk for the state, to disclose costs transparently, consider capping costs, and clarify member and retiree influence over investment policy.
Can the government guarantee that no guarantee schemes and no financial risk for the state arise from the proposed bill?
Kan de regering garanderen dat er geen garantiestelsels en geen enkel financieel risico voor de staat voortvloeien uit het voorliggende wetsvoorstel?
Asks for an analysis of the effects of the PPI on the Dutch pension system before introduction and whether a domain restriction limiting PPIs to foreign company pension schemes should be added.
An analysis of the possible consequences of introducing the PPI for the Dutch pension system is not yet available.
Een analyse van de mogelijke gevolgen van de introductie van de PPI op het Nederlandse pensioenstelsel is (nog) niet voorhanden.
Seeks clarification on how users will recognise the type of institution, the unanswered question on cross-border execution via an API, and creditor and priority arrangements in bankruptcy.
Could the government clarify this point further?
Zou dit punt door de regering nog verduidelijkt kunnen worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft law introducing premiepensioeninstellingen (PPI), a defined-contribution pension vehicle, raising doubts about its rationale, weaker member protection, unclear split between system rules and social/labour law, its competitiveness, and its international classification, and advised revision or adaptation. The government's nader rapport responds point by point, largely accepting the advice on drafting and legal technique (e.g., replacing article 98a, the pension trustee rules, and the exemption wording) while defending the PPI's design and rationale.
concerns: The Raad advised replacing the vague article 98a Pw with a proper statutory regime clearly separating system rules from social and labour law, which the government adopted.

The Raad flagged the weak position of PPI members, lacking influence and guarantees, and asked for convincing justification; the government added explanation but kept the design, stating the investment risk stems from the DC nature of the scheme.

The Raad doubted the PPI's added value and competitiveness given its prohibition on insuring risk or giving guarantees; the government argued the limited scope is its strength targeting the international DC market.

The Raad questioned whether the PPI qualifies as an IORP under the directive and whether other states would recognise it, and advised consulting the Commission; the government argued it fits the IORP definition and expanded the explanation.
The Raad flagged possible tax treatment problems abroad and the government clarified how other states treat the VPB exemption and residence statements.
The Raad advised that the pension trustee be subject to the same organisational requirements as investment fund custodians, which the government adopted.
The Raad asked that the exemptions in article 2:54h Wft be expressly named and that the choice of legal form be better justified, both of which were incorporated.
The Raad asked for a fuller explanation of the phased approach toward a general pension institution, which the government added to the general part of the explanatory memorandum.

31924-V.s: This bill adopts the supplementary budget (slotwet) amendments to the 2008 budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, altering appropriations across policy articles and the CBI operating-unit figures. It also allows the 2008 departmental annual report to deviate from certain information requirements of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as part of a pilot.
31924-V.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the deviation from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as necessary for a reporting pilot.
q: For the purposes of the pilot it is necessary to deviate for those years from several provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 concerning the structure of the departmental annual report.
Ten behoeve van de pilot is het noodzakelijk voor die jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen in de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 met betrekking tot de inrichting van het departementale jaarverslag.

31927.s: The bill folds the benefit payments under the IOAW, IOAZ and WWIK into the municipalities' integrated budget (I-deel) and a participation budget, so that municipalities receive a single unearmarked budget for benefits. It replaces mandatory sanctions, reviews, recovery and reporting duties in those laws with discretionary municipal powers and moves the detailed rules on sanctions and fraud into municipal ordinances.
31927.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the municipalities' full financial responsibility, the wish for local tailoring and administrative burden reduction, and alignment with the WWB powers.
q: Municipalities then receive a single unearmarked budget for the provision of all benefits.
Gemeenten ontvangen vervolgens één ontschot budget voor de verstrekking van alle uitkeringen.
d: data and documents required for benefit claims; other administrations designated
municipal ordinance on refusal and reduction of benefits and fraud control
municipal ordinance on sanctions and fraud control under WWIK
p: Artikel I, E (art. 17 IOAW); Artikel IV, C-D (WWIK)
Mandatory suspension, review and withdrawal of benefit decisions become discretionary municipal powers, reducing legal protection of benefit recipients.
Artikel I, G (art. 20 IOAW); Artikel II, E (art. 20 IOAZ)
Sanctions for non-compliance and refusal of benefits become discretionary, with the detailed rules left to municipal ordinance.
Recovery of wrongly paid benefits becomes optional rather than mandatory.
Administrative fines, reporting obligations and the rules on reliable administration are removed from the IOAW and IOAZ.

parties: Questions whether budget cuts are realistic during the recession and asks how large the expected administrative burden reduction will be.
Has sufficient account been taken of this in the budget allocation?
Is bij de budgettoekenning hiermee voldoende rekening gehouden?
Asks how municipalities will account to the national government for spending the bundled specific grants and whether realisation data will still be reported per scheme.

Will the annual information that municipalities must provide to the national government on relevant realisation data still be supplied to the national government individually per scheme after this bill is introduced?
Wordt de jaarlijkse informatie, die gemeenten aan het Rijk moeten verschaffen over relevante realisatiegegevens, met invoering van dit wetsvoorstel individueel per regeling aan het Rijk verstrekt?
Worries that simplification and lower administrative burden come at the expense of control, and asks who will oversee lawful spending once municipalities need not account for the budget.
Simplification and reduction of administrative burden is fine, but does this not come at the expense of control?
Vereenvoudiging en vermindering administratieve lasten is prima, maar gaat dit niet ten koste van de controle?

31945.s: The bill amends the Meststoffenwet to differentiate phosphate and nitrogen manure-use standards by soil phosphate status and crop yield, and to add a power to lower or zero the animal manure standard by general administrative order. It also allows charging derogation farms a fee to fund monitoring and fixes the 2010 start date.
31945.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the Nitrates Directive and the 2014 timing, saying general administrative order is needed for the high-phosphate standard given its binding nature and advice from the Raad van State.
q: It concerns a far-reaching measure burdensome for the farms involved, with a more structural character.
Het gaat immers om een ingrijpende, voor de betrokken landbouwbedrijven bezwarende voorziening, met een meer structureel karakter.
d: lower or zero animal manure use standard
phosphate use standards for neutral soils from 2014, differentiated by crop and yield
phosphate use standard for high-phosphate soils
higher phosphate standard for low-phosphate soils
effect coefficients for manure, differentiated by practice and soil type
fee on farms using more manure under derogation to fund monitoring
rules on soil phosphate status and crop yield determination
p: Allows an order-in-council to cut or zero the animal manure standard where the minister judges it necessary to reduce water pollution, with conditions set in the same decree.
Lets the minister set by regulation higher phosphate standards for low-phosphate soils under conditions the regulation itself determines.
Allows the minister to make derogation farms pay a fee and to condition registration of their notification on payment.

parties: Asks whether phosphate standards are justified, how differentiation research involves industry, and whether the Landelijk Meetnet (LMM) should have more say over monitoring.
The CDA members miss attention in the bill for manure processing.
De leden van de CDA-fractie missen in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel de aandacht voor mestbe- en verwerking.
Argues the government shows no own conviction for the measures, follows Brussels only, and fails to tackle the manure surplus or the advice of the Raad van State.
The government thereby gives the impression of proposing the amendment solely because Brussels requires it.
De regering geeft daarmee de indruk de voorgestelde wetswijziging louter en alleen voor te stellen omdat «Brussel» dat vraagt.
Asks whether the Commission has approved the derogation before amending the law, whether the sector may co-decide on monitoring, and what the economic effects are.
The VVD members therefore believe the European Commission must first give green light for derogation approval before the Meststoffenwet is amended.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn dan ook van mening dat er eerst groen licht van de Europese Commissie ten behoeve van de goedkeuring van derogatie moet zijn, alvorens er een wijziging van de meststoffenwet plaats zal vinden.
Supports phasing and flexibility but warns that norms must not become negotiable and asks for monitoring of progress and clarity on costs and the complexity of the system.
It is important that businesses are given time to make the necessary adjustments.
Het is belangrijk dat bedrijven de tijd krijgen om benodigde aanpassingen te doen.
Asks about the status of area-based policy research, the added value of the Nitrates Directive over the Water Framework Directive, and the burden of monitoring costs on derogation farms.
The SGP members wonder what the added value of the Nitrates Directive is over the Water Framework Directive and the Groundwater Directive.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich hierbij af wat de meerwaarde is van de Nitraatrichtlijn boven de Kaderrichtlijn Water en de Grondwaterrichtlijn?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on two occasions (19 February 2009 and 17 April 2009) on a bill amending the Meststoffenwet to tighten phosphate use standards and differentiate them by soil phosphate status, with the government's nader rapport of 27 April 2009 replying to the points raised. The Council supported the bill's aim but raised concerns about the pace of tightening, its interaction with milk quota abolition, the proportionality and basis of charging monitoring costs, the feasibility of innovative measures, and drafting issues, which the government largely addressed by amending the text.
concerns: The Council asked for the cost recovery of monitoring to be proportionate to the individual benefit and to fix an area-based criterion in the law, which the government adopted in the new second paragraph of article 13.

The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to address how the pace of annual tightening relates to the sector's adaptation capacity and to the effects of milk quota abolition on manure volumes; the government added clarifications but maintained its gradual trajectory.

The Council flagged feasibility risks of substituting manure with fertiliser and of innovative feed measures, and asked for coordination with ammonia and greenhouse gas policy; the government responded with added explanation in the memorie van toelichting.
The Council asked that definitions of the Pw and PAL numbers and an explicit statutory basis for changing them, and for gewasopbrengst rules, be included in the bill, which was done.

The Council advised that the monitoring obligation be concretely referenced if the European Commission's new derogation decision imposes it, but the government said the Commission would not issue the decision during the legislative procedure.
The Council made redactional remarks on articles 11 and 13 and on the entry-into-force provision, which the government incorporated, except one remark on article 11 subsection 5.

31954.s: The bill establishes the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba within the Dutch state and sets out the composition, powers and oversight of their island councils, executive colleges and island governors. It also regulates the relationship with the Kingdom government, including the Rijksvertegenwoordiger and supervision by the Crown.
31954.j: The memorandum justifies central supervision and ministerial powers by the small scale of the islands, their distance from the Netherlands and the lack of a provincial tier.
d: island council may raise number of members by island ordinance
island ordinance on incompatible official posts requiring Rijksvertegenwoordiger approval
model form for declaration of financial interests by island executive members
remuneration and expense rules for island executive members
further procedure for appointing the island governor
rules on appointment, suspension and dismissal of island governor
p: The Minister appoints and dismisses the island governor by royal decree, with the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's recommendation and only consultation of the island council.
The island governor may be suspended by royal decree, and the Minister may order him not to exercise his functions pending a decision.

parties: Questions whether the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's powers and the reduced island autonomy go too far, and asks for a constitutional basis to be secured sooner.
The elaborated model of the Dutch municipality is, for these small islands far from the Netherlands, not really usable.
Het uitgewerkte model van de Nederlandse gemeente is voor deze kleine, kleinschalige eilanden, op grote afstand van Nederland gelegen, niet wel bruikbaar.
Asks whether a constitutional amendment is needed now, the scope of Dutch law and treaties applying to the islands, and the legal basis for the administrative law arrangements.
Yet these members ask whether there are other reasons why a constitutional amendment could already be necessary now.
Toch vragen deze leden of er andere redenen zijn waarom een Grondwetswijziging nu al nodig zou kunnen zijn.
Worries about political culture on Bonaire, the risk of the islands' status prejudging the Netherlands Antilles future, and the tax-haven character of the economic zones.
Life on Bonaire is strongly politicised; personal, family and party-political interests too often take precedence over the general interest.
Het leven op Bonaire is sterk gepolitiseerd; persoonlijke, familie en partijpolitieke belangen hebben te vaak voorrang boven algemeen belang.

Argues the temporary status conflicts with the Constitution and calls for a constitutional amendment, questions the basis for island council voting rights for the Eerste Kamer, and asks for stronger integrity rules and sanctions.
These members already consider it questionable that a choice conflicting with the Constitution is being made.
Deze leden achten het al aanvechtbaar dat er een met de Grondwet in strijd zijnde keuze wordt gemaakt.
Asks for a clear constitutional timetable, a horizon clause to make the law temporary, and clarity on the ombudsman and legal protection for citizens under two legal systems.
These members ask for a response to their view that pressure is wrongly being taken off the process.
Deze leden vragen te reageren op hun visie dat hiermee ten onrechte druk van de ketel wordt gehaald.
Asks why the constitutional structure is not fixed now, what the nationality consequences are, and whether the quorum and closed-meeting rules for the island council are adequate.
They ask why the government does not choose this.
Zij vragen waarom de regering hier niet voor kiest.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba, raising concerns about the temporary character of the bill, the constitutional anchoring of the islands, the position of the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, the application of the Awb, and the incompatibility rules for eilandsraad members. The government's nader rapport accepted some remarks (explanatory memorandum, the Awb/Wet administratieve rechtspraak BES choice on appeal, the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's accountability) while rejecting others (constitutional amendment in first reading, the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's mandate structure, the incompatibility decision and the open-meetings procedure).
concerns: The Raad urged starting a constitutional amendment in first reading now to give the islands a definitive constitutional basis; the government declined, citing the planned five-year evaluation.

The Raad objected that the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, as an independent zbo, exercises supervision without direct democratic accountability; the government added accountability to the minister and ministerial instruction powers but kept the constructie.
The Raad found that Awb and Wet administratieve rechtspraak BES applying in parallel would burden citizens and split judicial review; the government adjusted the regime so the WAR BES applies.
The Raad advised that the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's supervisory powers be exercised by the minister in mandate; the government did not follow this.

The Raad advised that eilandsraad meetings be open and that the gezaghebber's power to override closed sessions be reconsidered; the government kept the override as justified by local culture and the composition of the councils.

The Raad held that only the eilandsraad should decide on incompatibility of membership with civil-servant status; the government changed the regime so an eilandsverordening sets compatible functions, subject to approval by the Rijksvertegenwoordiger.
Redactional remarks were largely adopted, but the government declined to write out the parliamentary history of several Gemeentewet provisions in the memorie van toelichting.

31963.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act, the Aviation Act and the Economic Offences Act to implement EU Directive 2008/101/EC, extending the EU greenhouse gas emissions trading scheme to aviation activities. It sets out the monitoring, verification, allocation, surrender and enforcement rules for aircraft operators, with many technical details left to ministerial regulations and the Commission's guidelines.
31963.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed because the EU implementing rules are not yet known and short-term implementing regulation may be required.
q: This may mean that implementing regulations must be adopted at short notice while the delegation bases already provided for in the Act offer insufficient basis for them.
Dit kan met zich meebrengen dat er op korte termijn implementatieregelgeving vastgesteld moet worden terwijl reeds in de wet voorziene delegatiegrondslagen daarvoor onvoldoende basis bieden.
d: interpretation of aviation activities under Annex I
determining and reporting annual tonne-kilometres, monitoring plans and emissions reports
calculation and registration of tonne-kilometre data and allocation applications
rules on requests to the Commission for an operating ban
directly binding implementing rules under the EU directive
p: The emissions authority may ask the European Commission to impose an operating ban on an aircraft operator, a sanction that stops flights, when other enforcement measures are insufficient.
Makes it a statutory offence for an airline to fly while a Commission operating ban applies, enforceable by the Minister of Transport through administrative fines and orders.
Allocation decisions are largely bound by EU benchmarks and the Commission's calculations, leaving little discretion to the executive.

parties: Asks for justification of the eight-year allocation periods, the 3% reserve for newcomers, exemptions, and enforcement and sanctions consistency across member states.
Is the government assured that precisely on these points the implementation is shaped so that a level playing field within the EU is guaranteed?
Is de regering ervan verzekerd dat juist ook op deze punten de implementatie zodanig wordt vorm gegeven dat een gelijk speelveld binnen de EU wordt geborgd?
Criticises the 82% free allocation of allowances as too high and asks why exemptions for military and government flights and small aircraft were granted, and about verifiability of emissions data.
The SP members also find the 82% free allocation of allowances extremely high.](Hm)
De Leden van de SP-fractie vinden ook de 82% gratis uitgifte van rechten extreem hoog.
Asks how other member states will implement the directive, its effect on competitiveness of Schiphol and on non-European carriers, and whether timing is right given the economic crisis.
Finally, these members wonder whether, given the current crisis, this is the right moment to introduce this regulation in the short term.
Tot slot vragen deze leden zich af of dit, gezien de huidige crisis, wel het juiste moment is om op korte termijn deze regelgeving in te voeren.
Asks for justification of the eight-year periods and the cap for 2012 and 2020 in light of the recession, and the treatment of newcomers.
The ChristenUnie members ask for further justification of the choice to work with eight-year periods.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen om een nadere onderbouwing van de keuze voor het werken met achtjaarsperiodes.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill implementing Directive 2008/101/EC, bringing aviation into the EU emissions trading scheme, be adapted: it raised questions about consistency with the Kyoto Protocol and the Chicago Convention, the effects of the reserve for new entrants and fast growers on market competition, the retroactive transitional provision, and the level of regulation of delegated rules. The minister's reply largely accepted these points by adding explanatory text, adjusting the delegation to a general administrative order (AMvB), and extending a basis for measurement-body rules, but kept the retroactive transitional article IV with a reasoned justification.
concerns: The Council asked for explanation of how the aviation ETS relates to ICAO obligations and the Kyoto Protocol, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.
The Council asked for explanation of how the reserve for new entrants and fast growers affects market relations in aviation, which the government added as a reflection.

The Council objected that retroactive effect for approving monitoring plans lacks a legal basis before entry into force; the government kept the transitional provision, citing practical and administrative reasons.
The Council held that delegation of rule-making to the minister for matters in article 18.16r should be regulated at least by a general administrative order, which the government adopted.

31981.s: The bill amends the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 to replace the paper student travel card with an OV-chipkaart-based travel right that is activated and deactivated electronically, and adjusts related rules on the use of the citizen service number, compensation, fees and review. It shifts the detailed rules on how travel rights are obtained, their scope, deactivation and choice between week and weekend rights to ministerial regulation.
31981.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the ministerial regulations as needed to set detailed operational matters such as the precise scope of rights, holiday periods and procedures for obtaining and changing travel rights.
q: By ministerial regulation, rules are laid down on how the travel right is obtained and on the scope of the rights attached to the types of travel right.

Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de wijze van verkrijgen van het reisrecht en de omvang van de aan de soorten reisrecht, bedoeld in het tweede lid, verbonden rechten.
d: manner of application and granting of travel allowance in cash and related rules
manner of obtaining travel right, scope of week and weekend rights, choice and revision of right
manner of ending the travel right through deactivation
rules on proof of non-attributability of late deactivation
p: Allows the executive body to use students' citizen service numbers in contacts with the travel card administrator, within a limited purpose clause.
Imposes a fixed charge of 68 euro per half month for wrongly held activated travel rights, regardless of use, with an exemption where non-timely deactivation is not attributable to the student.
Conditions compensation for missing travel rights on prior application and timing requirements, and excludes compensation for non-use or lost, stolen or damaged cards.
Extends objection and appeal grounds to refusal of changed travel right choices, charges and decisions on requested travel rights, while removing the separate article 7.2.

parties: Asks on what criteria the IB-Groep may reject a student's request to switch to weekend travel rights, and questions the need for administrative steps.
On what criteria can the IB-Groep reject that request, the members want to know.
Op grond van welke criteria kan de IB-Groep dat verzoek afwijzen, zo willen de leden weten.
Asks whether the merger of the IB-Groep and CFI will cause organisational problems and whether transport companies will deliver cards on time.
Can the government sufficiently guarantee that no large-scale organisational problems will arise from the merger and the IB-Group tasks arising from this bill?

Kan de regering in voldoende mate garanderen dat er geen grootschalige organisatorische problemen zullen optreden als gevolg van de fusie en de taken van de IB-Groep die voortkomen uit dit wetsvoorstel?
Questions the grounds for refusal by the IB-Groep, whether students are compensated for harm during processing, and who is ultimately responsible and where complaints go.
Who is ultimately responsible for the proper issuing of the OV-chipkaart?
Wie is er eindverantwoordelijk voor de goede uitgifte van de OV-chipkaart?
Questions the legal basis and accountability of the RSR and the ministers' powers over it, and asks about alternatives to the BSN and consent for recording travel data after the CBP's comments.
What does the governance structure of the RSR look like?
Hoe ziet de bestuursstructuur van de RSR eruit?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill introducing the OV-chipkaart as the student travel document should clarify that the IB-Groep uses the citizen service number only with the RSR, and should address students without a BSN, including possible discrimination of EU students. The government's nader rapport accepted the points, defined RSR separately, added a paragraph on students without a BSN, and implemented the editorial remarks.
concerns: Students without a BSN may be unable to obtain a travel entitlement equivalent in value, raising possible discrimination especially for EU students, which the government addressed by explaining the two categories and compensation arrangements.
The definition of vervoerbedrijf was too broad, so the use of the BSN was not clearly limited to the RSR, and the government introduced a separate definition and named RSR in article 3.23.
Multiple editorial remarks on terminology, cross-references and wording were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.
