31990.s: The bill amends the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, the Invorderingswet 1990 and the Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen to repair tax treatment of pension and annuity claims following Supreme Court rulings, extending conservatory assessments and revision interest rules to new cases. It applies retroactively to 29 June 2009 and authorises the minister to set further rules by ministerial regulation on determining the amount of premiums and claims.
31990.j: The memorandum justifies the seventh paragraph as a delegation allowing the minister to set detailed rules on determining premium amounts and claims.
q: The proposed new seventh paragraph contains a delegation provision under which further rules may be set by ministerial regulation to determine the amount of premiums, respectively claims and contributions.

Het voorgestelde nieuwe zevende lid bevat een delegatiebepaling, op grond waarvan bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels kunnen worden gesteld om de omvang van de premies, onderscheidenlijk aanspraken en bijdragen, te bepalen.
d: determining amount of premiums, claims and contributions

parties: Questions the government's reasoning against the Council of State's advice on refunding premium deductions and the legality of the approach under treaty good faith; asks about implementation.
Supports the bill in principle and asks about budgetary impact and whether comparable foreign rules have been upheld by the EU Court of Justice.
They agree with the state secretary that accrued pension and annuity claims should not be settled abroad in an irregular way with no or low taxation at the expense of the Dutch state.

Zij zijn met de staatssecretaris van mening dat het niet zo kan zijn dat op een al te gemakkelijke wijze ten laste van de Nederlandse Staat opgebouwde pensioen- en lijfrente aanspraken in het buitenland op een irreguliere wijze en tegen geen of lage belastingheffing kunnen worden afgewikkeld.
Criticises the rushed passage before the summer recess with retroactive effect and questions why the state secretary did not inform parliament earlier about a prepared emergency law.
Now a law must be pushed through very quickly, although there was sufficient opportunity to discuss this in the House of Representatives.
Nu moet er heel snel een wet doorheen worden gejaagd, terwijl er toch voldoende gelegenheid was om dit te bespreken in de Tweede Kamer.
Asks for justification of the ad hoc press-release procedure and retroactive effect, and requests a commitment to explore a more generic regulation and inform the House.
They ask the government to commit to exploring in future whether a more generic arrangement is desirable and to inform the House about it.
Zij vragen de regering de bereidheid uit te spreken in de toekomst alsnog de wenselijkheid van het treffen van een meer generieke regeling te verkennen en daar de Kamer nader over te informeren.

Asks whether introducing a clawback of the pension premium deduction on emigration conflicts with good faith between treaty partners, given earlier unconditional exemption and treaty allocation to the residence state.
Why does the government think that introducing a scheme to reclaim the deduction for pension premiums on emigration is not contrary to the good faith between treaty partners?
Waarom denkt de regering dat het introduceren van een regeling tot terugneming van de aftrek voor pensioenpremies bij emigratie niet strijdig is met de goede trouw die tussen verdragspartners geldt

Objects to the rushed passage before the summer recess and asks why the Supreme Court was not asked for advice on feasibility; also presses for budgetary and affected-group figures the government has not given.
The SP members object to the hasty manner in which the government is trying to push the bill through parliament.
De leden van de fractie van de SP maken bezwaar tegen de haastige manier waarop de regering het wetsvoorstel door de het parlement heen probeert te jagen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the government's reasoning for retroactively reinstating tax claims on pension and annuity emigration is insufficiently motivated, and that the retroactivity from 19 June 2009 is not adequately knowable and should start only at tabling. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks, adding motivation, a time indication, and a debt-remission provision, but kept the specific regulation rather than a general one.
concerns: Retroactivity from 19 June 2009 is not sufficiently knowable and should only apply from the moment the full text was known; the government adopted this with a time indication.
The emigration-only levy may restrict free movement in the EU/EEA without objective justification; the government argued the package is compatible with EU law via a debt-remission provision.
The justification that the Hoge Raad rulings leave room for the specific levy is inadequately reasoned; the government kept the specific regulation instead of a general scheme.
The government's explanation of its treaty policy and renegotiation options should be added to the explanatory memorandum; this was done.
Several drafting remarks on the wording of Article 3.136 Wet IB 2001 were largely followed, except two that the government explained it would not adopt.

32188.s: The bill amends the Dutch extradition law, the mutual recognition of criminal sanctions law and the Code of Criminal Procedure to implement EU framework decision 2009/299/JHA on in-absentia judgments. It makes refusal of extradition or recognition for in-absentia decisions mandatory unless specified procedural safeguards were met, and adds a right for the person to obtain a copy of the judgment.
32188.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as required to implement the EU framework decision and to align the wording with existing terminology, based on European Court of Human Rights case law.
q: The starting point remains that recognition may be refused if the convicted person was not present during the proceedings that led to the decision.
Uitgangspunt blijft dat erkenning mag worden geweigerd, indien de veroordeelde niet aanwezig was tijdens de procedure die tot de beslissing heeft geleid.
p: Gives the requested person a right to request a copy of the in-absentia judgment, strengthening individual procedural protection.
Artikel II B (artikel 13a Wet wederzijdse erkenning)
Makes refusal of recognition of monetary sanctions mandatory where the convicted person was not properly informed or summoned, strengthening defence rights.

parties: Asks whether surrender after in-absentia judgments can pass the fair-trial test of Article 6 ECHR, given cases where the suspect could not appear through no fault of their own, and whether the new retrial procedure matches ECtHR case law.
Can this pass the test of Article 6 of the European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR)?
Kan dit de toets aan artikel 6 van het Europees Verdrag tot Bescherming van de Rechten voor de Mens en Fundamentele Vrijheden (EVRM) doorstaan?
Asks how much discretion member states retain when recognising foreign in-absentia judgments, whether courts may review how the judgment was reached, and whether surrender is mandatory or optional.
Is any room for judgment left to member states to make their own assessment of the extent to which they recognise in-absentia judgments from other member states?
Is daarbij enige beoordelingsruimte aan de lidstaten gelaten een eigen afweging te maken in hoeverre zij verstekvonnissen van andere lidstaten al dan niet erkennen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises in principle to proceed with the bill implementing framework decision 2009/299/JBZ on in-absentia trial decisions, but asks to remove the proposed exclusion of article 404(3) Sv (appeal rights for minor offences) because it is unnecessary and the notification of judgment cannot be seen as proof of knowledge of the hearing date, and to delete proposed article 24a(1)(b) of the Wet wederzijdse erkenning as not required by the framework decision. The government's nader rapport reports that both proposed changes were removed and the redactional remarks incorporated.
concerns: Removing the exclusion of article 404(3) Sv preserves the defendant's right to appeal in-absentia minor-offence judgments, since the judgment notification could otherwise block appeal.
Deleting proposed article 24a(1)(b) because the framework decision contains no such ground for non-recognition of confiscation decisions.
Redactional remarks on wording and cross-references were incorporated into the bill.

32197.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to align chapter 2 with the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies and to clarify and simplify the greenhouse gas and NOx emission allowance trading rules in chapter 16, including new rules for CO2 transport and monitoring. It removes several overlapping provisions and procedural steps, such as the preparatory procedure for permits, and adds a ministerial regulation power for changes to monitoring plans.
32197.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as following from the evaluation of the trading systems and the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies, aiming at simplification and reduced administrative burden.
q: For the NEa, removing the preparatory procedure of division 3.4 of the General Administrative Law Act means a considerable reduction in work and therefore in implementation costs for permit granting.
Voor de NEa betekent het schrappen van de voorbereidingsprocedure van afdeling 3.4 Awb een aanmerkelijke vermindering van de werkzaamheden en dus van de uitvoeringslasten voor de vergunningverlening.
d: requirements for monitoring, data recording and quality assurance
rules on reporting and approval of changes to monitoring plan
conditions for carrying over emission reduction units to next period
further rules on withdrawal of a permit
p: The emissions authority may attach, amend or withdraw permit conditions whenever it considers this necessary for the functioning of the trading system, without a stated standard beyond its own judgment.

The preparatory procedure of the General Administrative Law Act is removed for allowance allocation decisions, reducing the involvement of affected parties before decisions are taken, while a twelve-week decision period is set.
The emissions authority may refuse approval of planned changes to monitoring whenever it judges this necessary for the good functioning of the trading system.
Removal of an obsolete provision on the first allocation period.

parties: Welcomes the bill as practical and supports reducing duplicate legislation and faster procedures; asks no questions.
They also support the government's ambition to prevent duplicate provisions in legislation.
Zij steunen de regering tevens in de ambitie om dubbele bepalingen in wetgeving te voorkomen.
Asks why CCS coupling starts in 2013 and why the bill lacks conditions CCS must meet, and where those conditions will be set.
Why does this bill not provide conditions that CCS must meet to be linked to the emissions trading system?
Waarom voorziet dit wetsvoorstel niet in randvoorwaarden waaraan CCS moet voldoen wil het aan het emissiehandelssysteem worden gekoppeld?
Questions removal of the open preparation procedure for permits, the retained discretion to add permit conditions, and the enforcement of emissions trading.
Is it not possible, within the four-month period now set, to include the public procedure in parallel, including for review of the monitoring plan?
Is het niet mogelijk binnen de vier maandentermijn die nu wordt gesteld mede voor toetsing van het monitoringsplan de openbare procedure parallel op te nemen?
Argues emissions trading alone within the EU will distort competition and cause carbon leakage, and questions what happens in 2013 if CCS does not work.
What will happen in 2013 if the CCS technology does not work well yet?
Wat zal er in 2013 gebeuren als de CCS-techniek nog niet goed werkt?

32269.s: The bill amends the Primary Education Act to let the minister, at a school's request, keep a high-quality public or private primary school with fewer than 23 pupils open or funded for a set period where there is a prospect of growth, using a discretionary power. It also adds a transitional provision allowing certain schools already closed since 1 August 2008 to be reinstated.
32269.j: The memorandum justifies the discretion by the need for flexibility to serve rural communities, noting that a fixed rule would not allow case-by-case reasonableness and that the Inspectorate's quality assessment is taken into account.
q: The bill gives the minister a discretionary power to depart from the main rule of the Act and keep the school open.
Dit wetsvoorstel kent aan de minister een discretionaire bevoegdheid toe om dan in afwijking van de hoofdregel van de wet de school alsnog in stand te houden.
d: minister's discretion to keep small schools open for a period set by the minister
minister may extend the period once at the board's request
minister decides on reinstatement of schools closed since 2008
p: The minister gains a discretionary power to override the statutory closure norm for small schools, with only non-binding factors and an Inspectorate quality bar to guide the decision.
Retroactive application allows the minister to reverse closures of schools shut since 1 August 2008 under the discretionary rule.

parties: Asks whether the discretionary power will rest on the inspectorate's normal framework or a separate one, and how to prevent an informal lower limit emerging from case law.
Will that judgement be based on the inspectorate's normal assessment framework or will a separate framework be developed for it, the members ask.
Zal dat oordeel gebaseerd zijn op het normale toetsingskader van de onderwijsinspectie of zal hier een apart kader voor worden ontwikkeld, zo vragen de leden.

Asks whether the municipality will be heard before a discretionary decision, whether quality is adequately safeguarded by basic inspection, and how the minister will objectify the liveability criterion.
The PvdA members want to know whether a municipality will be heard in such a discretionary decision by the minister.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie willen weten of een gemeente gehoord zal worden bij zo een discretionaire beslissing van de minister.
Warns against fixation on numbers and asks how it is guaranteed that quantity does not become leading in the minister's decisions, and whether a de facto maximum term will arise through precedent.
How is it guaranteed that quantity does not become decisive in the minister's decision, the members ask.
Hoe blijft gegarandeerd dat kwantiteit niet leidend wordt in de beslissing van de minister, zo vragen de leden.
Welcomes keeping small schools open in exceptional cases and asks for a ten-year forecast of how often the discretionary power will be used.
Can the government give a forecast for the coming ten years; how often does it expect the minister will have to use his discretionary power?
Kan de regering een prognose geven van de komende tien jaar; hoe vaak verwacht de regering dat de minister zijn discretionaire bevoegdheid zal moeten gebruiken?
Asks for the basis of the 23-pupil threshold and whether it should be reconsidered given demographic decline, and why the average-size rule was not aligned with the closure rule.
They ask to what extent there is reason to reconsider this figure, also in view of phenomena such as population decline.
Zij vragen in hoeverre er aanleiding bestaat om dit getal te heroverwegen, mede met het oog op verschijnselen als bevolkingskrimp.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill giving the minister discretion to keep open qualitatively good primary schools below 23 pupils with prospects of growth, but advises justifying the unequal treatment versus schools not using the average school size instrument, adding a rationale for the open-ended duration, and aligning the explanatory memorandum with the text on school quality. The government reply accepts the scope limitation and the flexible duration, and amends the explanatory memorandum to align with the bill text and clarify the points raised.
concerns: The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to justify why schools using the average school size instrument get a longer or open-ended recovery period than other schools with growth prospects, and the government supplemented the memorandum but kept the scope limited to these schools.

The Council advises a justification for leaving the recovery period open-ended and suggests a statutory maximum; the government rejects a fixed legal term for flexibility but explains the duration will be given content in practice and may be reconsidered later.
The Council notes the explanatory memorandum's description of the school-quality criterion does not match the bill text, which the government corrected so the memorandum matches the text.
The Council gives various drafting suggestions in an annex, including wording of the considerans and references to article 153 and 157 of the WPO, which the government took into account.

32287.s: The bill amends the Dutch Foreign Workers Employment Act to make an employer's loss or suspension of referent status, or a fine or penalty under the Aliens Act in the past five years, grounds to refuse or withdraw a work permit. It also shortens the waiting period for seasonal workers from 28 to 14 weeks.
32287.j: The memorandum justifies the new grounds by the expanded responsibilities of referents under the new migration policy goals, and says the detailed grounds will be set in a ministerial regulation developed with UWV.
q: In consultation with UWV, policy will be developed on the new refusal and withdrawal grounds, which will be laid down in a ministerial regulation.
In overleg met UWV zal beleid ontwikkeld worden omtrent de nieuwe weigerings- en intrekkingsgronden, die zijn neerslag zal vinden in een ministeriële regeling
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 9, eerste lid, onderdelen j en k)
new refusal grounds for work permits; detailed weigerings- en intrekkingsgronden via ministerial regulation
p: Adds a withdrawal ground for work permits based on an employer's referent status or past penalties, giving the executive discretion to withdraw permits.

parties: Asks how UWV will weigh grounds for refusing or withdrawing work permits, whether recidivism counts, and how the five-year period was determined.
For these members it is among other things important whether there is recidivism.
Het is voor deze leden onder meer van belang of er sprake is van recidive.
Asks why the refusal grounds are optional rather than mandatory and how IND and UWV share information on revoked sponsor status.
What are the considerations of the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment for that choice?
Wat zijn de overwegingen van de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid bij die keuze?
Questions the discretionary, facultative character of UWV's power to withdraw permits and asks for clearer policy, examples and ECHR constraints.
Can the government provide more clarity on the exercise of this discretionary power by UWV under the proposed articles?
Kan de regering meer duidelijkheid verschaffen over de uitoefening van deze discretionaire bevoegdheid door UWV op grond van nu voorgestelde artikelen?
Asks for further information on the refusal and withdrawal criteria, on retroactive effect, and on safeguards for religious workers.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government to clarify whether this new provision also applies retroactively to work permits already issued.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering om toe te lichten of deze nieuwe bepaling ook met terugwerkende kracht geldt voor afgegeven tewerkstellingsvergunningen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill, which makes refusal or withdrawal of a work permit possible where a referent recognition request is refused, is supported in substance but the explanatory memorandum should clarify the discretionary grounds and a time limit for past fines. The minister's reply accepted the advice, adding that UWV will develop policy and that a five-year limit after a fine applies.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clarify in which cases a work permit may be refused or withdrawn, given the discretionary power under the proposed articles 9 and 12a Wav.
The memorandum should state how long after a fine or penalty an employer can be held to it as grounds for refusing or withdrawing a work permit.

32360-III.s: This bill (the 2009 supplementary budget and final budget act, slotwet) adjusts the 2009 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Queen's Cabinet, the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, and the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statements forming part of the national budget are each established and therefore also amended separately by law, under article 1, third paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel uitmaken van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 1, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 elk afzonderlijk bij wet vastgesteld en derhalve ook gewijzigd.

32368.s: The bill amends the Aanpassingswet and Invoeringswet for the Caribbean public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, adjusting identity card rules, business establishment permits, police data rules, civil status recognition, administrative appeal routes, language use in administrative dealings and transitional ministerial regulations. It mainly restructures legal status and procedures for these islands within the Dutch state rather than shifting powers to the executive.
32368.j: The memorandum justifies delegations as practical needs for detailed rules on identity card administration, transitional arrangements and recognition of judgments, and states that the Raad van State's advice shaped the bill.
q: The Council's advice prompted a review of the options for the streamlining the Council recommended.
Het advies van de Raad is aanleiding geweest de mogelijkheden voor de door de Raad aanbevolen versobering te bezien.
d: administration and issue of identity cards
language rules for written documents by island councils
language rules for Rijksvertegenwoordiger and central government staff
recognition and enforcement of foreign judgments and authentic acts
transitional rules, extending or modifying Antillean regulations
p: Allows a ministerial regulation to depart from statute and modify Antillean rules during a short transitional period, limited in time but without parliamentary approval.
Routes appeals against administrative decisions to the local Gerecht rather than standard Awb objection procedures, with exceptions for civil servants and tax matters.
Expands police data sharing with officials and ministers, with access to data on informants possibly refused by the Minister of Justice.
Lets the Minister of Justice decide not to comply with court orders to disclose information linked to informants in appeal procedures.

parties: Asks how the grounds for refusing a business establishment permit are assessed and by what criteria, and how the Centrale Raad van Beroep judges will be deployed in practice.
Can it be explained on the basis of which criteria it is assessed whether the permit is refused?
Kan worden uiteengezet aan de hand van welke criteria wordt beoordeeld of de vergunning wordt geweigerd?
Asks whether the Awb's material law applies on the BES islands and about differences in legal protection for parties regarding decisions on removal or shielding of police data.
For example, are practical differences in the legal protection of the person concerned regarding decisions on removal or shielding of police data to be expected?
Zijn er bijvoorbeeld praktische verschillen ten aanzien van de rechtsbescherming van de betrokkene met betrekking tot beslissingen over verwijdering of afscherming van politiegegevens te verwachten?
Worries that charging citizens for translations of council minutes undermines controllability and transparency, and asks that minutes always be drawn up in Dutch.
These members fear that as a result controllability and transparency come under pressure.
Deze leden vrezen dat hierdoor de controleerbaarheid en transparantie onder druk komen te staan.

Asks for clearer rules on language use before the court of first instance and whether the bill is consistent with the European Charter for regional languages, and raises inequality in legal treatment of same-sex married couples.

For the Court of First Instance on Bonaire, Saba and St. Eustatius, the CDA considers a regulation modelled on the Frisian Language in Legal Transactions Act desirable to provide clarity and legal certainty on the position of English and Papiamento as languages of proceedings.

Voor het Gerecht in eerste aanleg op Bonaire, Saba en St. Eustatius achten de leden van de CDA-fractie een regeling overeenkomstig de afgewogen regeling in de Wet gebruik Friese taal in het rechtsverkeer wenselijk om duidelijkheid en rechtszekerheid te verschaffen over de positie van het Engels en Papiaments als voertaal.
Asks whether language provisions could leave citizens able to participate in administration only in Dutch, and how equal treatment within the Kingdom is maintained given the new civil law provisions.
In what way will the government ensure that Dutch civil servants master Papiamento and English in dealings with citizens, ask the members of the ChristenUnie.
Op welke manier gaat de regering ervoor zorgen dat de Nederlandse ambtenaren de talen Papiaments en Engels machtig zijn in het verkeer met de burgers, zo vragen de leden van de fractie ChristenUnie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Tweede Aanpassingswet for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, raising objections on the Wet politiegegevens, the education bills, the Centrale Raad van Beroep jurisdiction and vergunningen. The government's nader rapport accepted several points (e.g. removing the transitional limit and the court jurisdiction change) while defending or partly adjusting others, notably the education approach which was split off.
concerns: The Centrale Raad van Beroep jurisdiction over BES cases would hollow out the court structure of the Caribbean part of the Kingdom; the government dropped that provision.
Vormvrije onderlinge regelingen on police data may restrict the national legislator's room; the government disputes this but the Raad asked for reconsideration.
Education laws copied from the Netherlands are ill-suited to small BES schools and impose unrealistic administrative duties; the education part was split off for separate treatment.
Police data exchange and the basis for passing police data to Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten require clearer legal grounding.
Transitional and time-limited provisions (e.g. the temporary wanbeheer power) and the twin statutes with identical titles create uncertainty; several were adjusted.
Structure, numbering and readability of the bill and explanatory memorandum were criticised and largely amended.

32377.s: The bill amends the Tracé Act to introduce a new startbeslissing and exploration phase, a structuurvisie that may be adopted before the route decision, and revised rules for the tracébesluit for motorways, rail and waterways. It also removes the right of decentral authorities to appeal route decisions and removes the power to remedy defects in research data, while adding consequential amendments to several other laws.
32377.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as speeding up decisions and avoiding premature solutions, and justifies removing decentral appeal rights by arguing that courts should not host disputes between public authorities and that decentral bodies are already involved in consultation.
q: It is therefore not necessary to anchor the taking of a funnelling decision in the law itself.
Het is dan ook niet nodig om het nemen van een trechteringsbeslissing in de wet zelf te verankeren.
d: methods and starting points for assessing effects of infrastructure projects
Artikel 2, derde lid, sub e and Artikel 4, eerste lid (Tracéwet)
deciding whether the route decision is taken by the minister alone or jointly
p: The minister may amend a route decision while an appeal against it is pending, and the amendment may be exempt from the usual procedural requirements for minor changes.
Decentral public bodies lose the right to bring an appeal against a route decision, which is a check on executive infrastructure decisions.

The startbeslissing, exploration and whether a structuurvisie is adopted are decided by the ministers largely at their discretion, with consultation of administrative bodies but no parliamentary approval.
Artikel 15 lid 1 and Artikel VIII-XII (removal of 'bevoegdheid tot herstel van gebreken')
The explicit power to remedy defects in research data is removed from several statutes, a technical change that reduces express statutory discretion though the duty to correct remains implied.

parties: Worries that the faster procedure depends on how officials and parties use the new law, and asks what the government will do to ensure proper implementation; also opposes requiring price policy as a first alternative to infrastructure.
They note that the improved functioning will largely depend on how those involved handle the amended law.
Zij constateren dat de verbeterde werking voor het overgrote deel af zal hangen van de wijze waarop betrokkenen met de aangepaste wet om zullen gaan.

Welcomes codification of Elverding recommendations but wants alternatives such as better use and road pricing explicitly included, and asks how decentralised authorities' role is secured without appeal rights.
The members would like to see anchored in the law that alternatives other than road or rail infrastructure must explicitly be considered in decision-making procedures.

Graag zouden de leden in de wet verankerd zien dat in de besluitvormingsprocedures omtrent de aanleg van infrastructuur andere dan weginfrastructurele of spoorinfrastructurele alternatieven expliciet moeten worden meegenomen.
Strongly welcomes simplification and acceleration of road-building procedures and removal of decentralised appeal rights.
In principle, the PVV members are always in favour of easing and speeding up current procedures.
In beginsel zijn de leden van de PVV altijd voor versoepeling en versnelling van de huidige procedures.

Supports removing decentralised appeal rights as strengthening their earlier role; asks whether all Elverding advice, including marginal review of studies, is addressed and clarifies scope of the Tracéwet.
They do ask whether all Elverding Commission recommendations have been addressed, such as the marginal review of studies and advice.
Wel vragen zij of hiermee alle adviezen van de Commissie Elverding zijn geadresseerd, zoals bijvoorbeeld de marginale toetsing van onderzoeken en adviezen.
Welcomes early involvement but argues that removing decentralised appeal rights without giving municipalities real rights sidelines them; the appeal right should remain as an emergency brake.
As long as this bill gives decentralised authorities insufficient means to defend residents' interests, the appeal right should remain as an emergency brake.
Zolang dit wetsvoorstel aan decentrale bestuursorganen onvoldoende middelen geeft om op te komen voor de belangen van de inwoners, dient het beroepsrecht als noodrem te blijven bestaan.

Argues the bill weakens residents' legal protection, careful process and environmental quality, that alternatives may be dropped too early, and that the opleveringstoets cannot be appealed, making it hollow.
This post-completion check was defended by the government on the argument that it allows corrective action afterwards.
Juist deze opleveringstoets is door de regering verdedigd met het argument dat daarmee achteraf corrigerend kan worden opgetreden.

Worries about removing appeal rights for decentralised authorities, the Raad van State's critique that time savings are unlikely, and whether the mobility ladder is respected when the shortened procedure skips a structuurvisie; asks for evidence from Crisis- en Herstelwet litigation.
The D66 members request the government to retain the appeal option for decentralised administrative bodies.
De leden van de D66-fractie verzoeken de regering de beroepsmogelijkheid van decentrale bestuursorganen te handhaven.

Asks whether an integrated assessment and the mobility ladder are guaranteed, whether the post-completion check is protected for citizens and why appeal is excluded, and how patstelling between municipality and state is avoided.
These members ask whether citizens' legal protection is sufficiently guaranteed under the proposed post-completion check.
Genoemde leden vragen of de rechtsbescherming van de burger bij de nu voorgestelde opleveringstoets wel voldoende is gewaarborgd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the proposed exclusion of appeal rights for decentralised public bodies against route decisions (tracébesluiten) must be independently justified, since the Crisis- en herstelwet rationale of temporariness does not apply to the permanent Tracéwet, and that the drafting of the exclusion should be corrected to cover bodies and to clarify its relation to the Awb. The minister's reply explains that the exclusion rests on the principle that courts should not serve as the arena for disputes between public authorities and on early involvement of decentralised bodies, and it accepts the drafting corrections.
concerns: The Raad found the exclusion of appeal rights for decentralised public bodies needs an independent justification and clarity on whether it covers bodies as well as legal persons; the minister redrafted it to align with the Crisis- en herstelwet and the Raad's remarks.
The Raad doubted that the exclusion yields substantial time savings and asked for this to be demonstrated; the minister responded that the rationale is principled rather than time-saving.
The Raad noted that public-law legal persons can still defend property interests such as land ownership in appeal, unlike private parties, questioning the rationale for excluding them.
The Raad listed several editorial remarks on articles 4, 5, 6, 10, 16 and 23 of the Tracéwet, which the minister largely adopted.

32395-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the States General (IIA) by adjusting spending and commitments across the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and general funds, in line with the Spring Memorandum. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the amended budget takes effect from 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement for the States General for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32458.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code on mergers and demergers, implementing EU Directive 2009/109/EC to reduce reporting and documentation burdens. It lets shareholders waive certain statutory requirements, allows the board of a wholly-owning company to approve a merger by board resolution, and removes some interim-statement and expert-report obligations.
32458.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementing EU Directive 2009/109/EC and reducing administrative costs for companies.
q: We, having heard the Council of State and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and understood as follows
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan
d: date of entry into force by royal decree
p: ARTIKEL I D and E (art. 331 lid 4, 333 lid 4 BW)
Allows a wholly-owning company's board to adopt a merger decision without a shareholder meeting unless the articles provide otherwise, reducing shareholder oversight in intra-group mergers.
ARTIKEL I B, G and I (art. 315, 334l, 334hh BW)
Lets shareholders or members waive creditor-protection and court-review requirements and narrows the grounds on which a court must refuse a request, reducing creditor safeguards."]}],

parties: Asks whether the requirement to have a court-appointed expert (Ondernemingskamer) could be dropped or the procedure reversed, and whether the court step delays mergers.
Worries that placing the burden of proof on creditors to show a merger endangers repayment is hard to prove and weakens creditor protection.
These members express the concern that it is difficult to prove whether there is reason for doubt and whether sufficient guarantees exist to satisfy the claim.</reasoning_effort>
Door deze leden wordt de zorg uitgesproken dat het lastig te bewijzen is of er reden tot twijfel is en of er voldoende waarborgen zijn ter voldoening van de vordering.
Asks whether the Dutch implementation of creditor protection and expert requirements is stricter than the directive and whether the wording departs from the cumulative criteria.
These members ask whether there is not a difference between the general provision of article 2:94a of the Civil Code and the provision in the directive.</reasoning_effort>
Deze leden vragen of er niet een verschil is tussen de algemene bepaling van artikel 2: 94a BW en de bepaling in de richtlijn.
Objects that removing reporting duties and the creditor burden of proof reduces transparency for stakeholders beyond shareholders and undermines legal equality.
In their view, under the guise of reducing administrative burdens, measures are being implemented that undermine the principle that law serves to promote legal equality.</reasoning_effort>
In hun ogen worden onder het mom van een verlichting van de administratieve lasten maatregelen doorgevoerd die het principe ondermijnen dat het recht ertoe dient om rechtsgelijkheid te bevorderen.

32467.s: The bill establishes a College voor de rechten van de mens (human rights institute) that takes over the equal-treatment functions of the Commissie gelijke behandeling and gains a broad mandate to investigate, advise and report on human rights in the Netherlands. It sets out its tasks, investigative powers, composition, appointment procedures and reporting duties, and amends several related statutes.
32467.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and independence arrangements by the Paris Principles and EU equal-treatment directives requiring an independent national human rights institution.
q: The College performs its task in independence.
Het College vervult zijn taak in onafhankelijkheid.
d: appointment of College members on ministerial proposal
detailed legal status rules for College members
exercise of employment powers over bureau staff
working procedures of the investigative chamber
reimbursement of costs for advisory council members
p: The ministers may not annul College decisions on investigations and opinions, and the College need not disclose ongoing investigation details to ministers, limiting ministerial oversight of the body.

parties: Worries the new college could become an overly broad bureaucracy and asks how self-discipline and the open-ended budget ('blanco cheque') will be controlled.
How is it prevented that a (too) broadly equipped and bureaucratic organisation emerges?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat er een (te) breed opgetuigde en bureaucratische organisatie ontstaat?

Welcomes the institute but questions the naming, the seat in Utrecht, the qualification requirements for the chair, lack of litigation power in all rights violations, and the independence implications of Raad van Advies membership.
These members note that the institute cannot go to court in all identified human rights violations.
Het valt deze leden op dat het instituut niet bij alle geconstateerde schendingen van mensenrechten de mogelijkheid heeft om zich tot de rechter te wenden.
Argues for a body to resolve conflicts between fundamental rights and asks why the college has no procedural power outside equal treatment, citing criticism from the CGB and NJCM.
the bill does not provide the College with procedural (litigation) powers in the field of human rights, except for violations of the General Equal Treatment Act.
het wetsvoorstel niet voorziet in een procesbevoegdheid van het College op het terrein van de mensenrechten, behalve wanneer het gaat om overtredingen van de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling
Fears the college is merely a formal upgrade of the existing CGB and asks why it cannot handle individual complaints or sit under the National Ombudsman.
The SP members ask why the proposed College for Human Rights will not be able to handle individual complaints.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom het voorgenomen College voor de rechten van de mens geen individuele klachten zal kunnen behandelen.
Asks whether litigation powers should extend to all human rights, how the appointment procedure safeguards independence, and how the advisory council's political membership is judged.
The D66 members ask the government to explain and justify how this appointment procedure relates to the independence of the institute.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering om te toe te lichten en te beargumenteren hoe deze benoemingsprocedure zich verhoudt tot de onafhankelijkheid van het instituut.
Regrets the long delay and shifting forms, wants a general procedural competence for all human rights violations, and worries the appointment procedure could become political.
The members are therefore surprised that the current bill in Article 13 does not provide for a general procedural competence regarding suspected non-compliance with human rights provisions.
Het bevreemdt de leden dan ook dat het huidige wetsvoorstel in artikel 13 niet voorziet in een algemene procesbevoegdheid ten aanzien van vermoedelijke niet-naleving van mensenrechtenbepalingen

Asks how the broad mandate will be resourced, why the mandate is not written into the law itself, why Article 13 excludes the courts for human rights, and how overlap with EU and Council of Europe bodies is avoided.
Why is that possibility not offered for the field of human rights?
Waarom wordt die mogelijkheid niet geboden voor het terrein van mensenrechten?
Objects that singling out equal treatment as the only named human right implies a hierarchy among fundamental rights, and asks whether equal-treatment disputes should return to the courts.
Nevertheless the government again chooses the same one-sidedness, because the College's purpose clause explicitly names equal treatment as the only human right.

Niettemin kiest de regering ook nu voor eenzelfde eenzijdigheid, omdat in de doelomschrijving van het College voor de rechten van de mens nadrukkelijk de gelijke behandeling als enige mensenrecht expliciet wordt genoemd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises against the proposed structure of the new College voor mensenrechten en gelijke behandeling, arguing the new human rights mandate is underweighted relative to the Commissie gelijke behandeling tasks and that the bill may not meet the Paris Principles. The government's nader rapport accepts many points (renaming, Raad van advies, appointment changes, independence clarifications) but keeps the core structure and rejects the call for a supervisory board.
concerns: The Raad doubts the chosen structure with the Cgb (nine-member commission) will let the new human rights tasks be effectively carried out and recognised; government retained the structure but strengthened the chair and added a Raad van advies.

The Raad objects to the name and the phrasing 'in het bijzonder' in the purpose clause, which suggests equal treatment is the core of human rights; government adopted the change and renamed the College.
Insufficient budget and staff for the new human rights tasks, with an evaluation only after three years; the Raad asks for earlier evaluation and government clarified the evaluation timing.

Appointment of members by the minister of Justice in a way that does not clearly ensure independence and broad civil society involvement under the Paris Principles; government moved to Koninklijk besluit with a Raad van advies, but rejected a supervisory board.

Independence concerns regarding financing, staff appointments, the bestuursreglement requiring ministerial approval, and the limited information duty; government removed several ministerial approval roles and clarified budget transparency.
Pluriformity of the College requires a formal advisory body; government adopted a Raad van advies anchored in law.
Delegation basis for legal position of members and interaction with article 14 of the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen needed clarification; government added clarification.
Technical and redactional comments on the bill and explanatory memorandum, including references to the BES islands, were adopted.

32500-IV.s: This bill sets the 2011 budget statement for Koninkrijksrelaties (Kingdom Relations, chapter IV), with appropriations for the guarantee function (rule of law, Kustwacht, judiciary support) and for strengthening autonomy of Kingdom partners. It enacts the budget figures in thousands of euros and sets the entry-into-force date of 1 January 2011 with retroactive effect where publication is late.
q: It demands much of the new countries to prepare their institutions for the new tasks and powers.
Het vergt veel van de nieuwe landen om de instituties gereed te maken voor de nieuwe taken en bevoegdheden.

32500-VI.s: The bill sets the 2011 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Justice (VI) and the budgets of six baten-lasten agencies including IND, DJI, CJIB, NFI, Justis and GDI, in thousands of euros. It also clarifies that the minister is not responsible for the efficiency of court administration but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Raad voor de rechtspraak.

32539.s: The bill amends the Scheepvaartverkeerswet and Binnenvaartwet to allow criminal courts to revoke boating licences (vaarbevoegdheid) for dangerous fast-motorboat conduct and, for commercial shipping, repeated drunk navigation, with temporary seizure of licences and a central register of revocations. It also lets the Minister keep and manage that register and sets out data-sharing with authorities at home and abroad.
32539.j: The memorandum justifies the new sanction by the gap in enforcement left by existing fines and by public dissatisfaction with dangerous boating, and justifies register rules by the need for enforcers to verify revocations on the spot.
q: For this reason, the revocation of boating competence is added to the existing criminal enforcement toolkit as a suitable response to irresponsible boating conduct.
Om deze reden wordt aan het bestaande strafrechtelijke instrumentarium de ontzegging van de vaarbevoegdheid toegevoegd als passend antwoord op onverantwoord vaargedrag.
d: rules on register of revoked boating licences
register structure, retention period and data safeguards
manner in which revocation data is provided to authorities
manner in which the Minister enters, changes or removes register data
designation of boating licences required for certain vessels
categories of boating licences exempt from administrative fines
p: Officers may seize a boating licence on first demand, with release only through a public prosecutor decision and a court-supervised complaint procedure.
Officers may take possession of a licence found in their hands and forward it to the prosecutor or issuing authority.

A central register of revoked licences is created and shared with enforcement bodies and foreign authorities, with the detailed rules left to general administrative order after consultation with the data protection board.

parties: Asks why other incidents are not specified and whether enforcers need action powers, and asks government to tighten enforcement on dangerous commercial navigation.
These members ask what causes the other incidents.
Deze leden vragen welke oorzaken de andere incidenten kennen.
Supports the sanction but is critical of the register's data sensitivity and asks about its effects on enforcement practice and costs.
these members are extremely critical of the system to be developed.
zijn de leden uiterst kritisch over het te ontwikkelen systeem.
Welcomes criminal judges being able to revoke boating authority and asks about enforcement feasibility and costs.
very pleased with the amendment allowing the criminal judge to revoke boating authority
zeer content met de aanpassing van de wet waardoor de strafrechter de vaarbevoegdheid kan ontzeggen
Expresses interest in the bill without raising specific concerns in this excerpt.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.

Asks about enforcement against foreign and Rhine-certificate skippers, legal inequality, proportionality of the ten-year ban, alcohol-addiction cases, supervision after bans, and capacity and detection rates of IVW.
These members ask whether the IVW has sufficient capacity to conduct regular checks with an acceptable chance of detection.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de IVW over afdoende capaciteit beschikt om te zorgen voor regelmatige controles met een acceptabele pakkans.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a draft bill introducing the disqualification from navigation (ontzegging van de vaarbevoegdheid) in inland shipping, supporting its aim but raising points on seizure of boat licences, application to commercial shipping, personal data registration and the split sanction regime. The minister's reply adopted most suggestions: it aligned seizure rules with road traffic law, clarified the commercial shipping exclusion via a 20-metre length limit, specified the data processing purpose, consulted the data protection college, and gave a justification for the dual sanction regime.
concerns: The Council advised aligning seizure and retention of boat licences closely with the Wegenverkeerswet regime and fixing inconsistencies in article 35a, which the government accepted by revising the text.
The Council noted that article 35a(3)(a) was redundant and that articles 35a and 35b did not align on the speeding condition, which the government addressed by rewording.
The Council flagged that the speed-boat definition did not clearly exclude commercial shipping, and the government added a 20-metre length criterion to the definition.
The Council held that the purpose limitation for processing criminal personal data in the register was insufficiently specific and recommended a concrete purpose, which the government adopted.

The Council considered the dual sanction regime for the same offence insufficiently justified by efficiency alone and asked for a substantive motivation; the government pointed to its general policy rationale rather than changing the regime.

32565-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the governors' offices of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba, with Curaçao and Sint Maarten lines added, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 10 October of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2010 to the budget statements of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, the National Ombudsman
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2010 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman

32575.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten to align it with a recent decree change, widening the criteria for the allowance, excluding deceased persons for the calendar year, and allowing foundations under the Algemene Wet Bijzondere Ziektekosten to share personal health data with indicating bodies. It also applies supervisory enforcement powers from the Wet op de jeugdzorg to those foundations and corrects a chapter numbering error.
32575.j: The memorandum justifies the supervisory instruction powers by pointing to the existing system in the Wet op de jeugdzorg, under which provincial executives can instruct foundations and the Minister can instruct provincial executives.
q: to enforce the provisions under or pursuant to article 5, paragraph 2 and paragraph 4, parts a and d, articles 16 and 17 of the Youth Care Act apply accordingly
ter handhaving van het bepaalde bij of krachtens artikel 5, tweede lid en vierde lid, onderdelen a en d, zijn de artikelen 16 en 17 van de Wet op de jeugdzorg van overeenkomstige toepassing
d: amended general administrative order setting allowance criteria
p: Applies supervisory instruction powers from the Wet op de jeugdzorg to foundations, with the Minister able to instruct provincial executives who fail to act.

parties: Asks by what yardstick the scheme will be evaluated and whether criteria will be adjusted before the formal evaluation.
By what yardstick does the government intend to measure the scheme in this evaluation?
Langs welke meetlat wil de regering de regeling leggen bij deze evaluatie?
Asks whether funds for municipalities and the options for clients are adequate, and whether retroactive effect applies to newly included groups.
They also want to know whether retroactive effect will be applied at least to the groups added to the eligibility criteria in 2011.</evidence_en>
Ook willen zij weten of terugwerkende kracht wordt toegepast in ieder geval voor de groepen die in 2011 aan de afbakening worden toegevoegd
Objects to broad delegation powers kept despite Raad van State advice and requests a voorhang (prior parliamentary submission) procedure on the whole decree.
these members request that the government carry out a prior submission procedure for the entire decree by means of an amendment note.</evidence_en>
verzoeken deze leden de regering een stuitende voorhangprocedure op het hele besluit bij nota van wijziging door te voeren
Argues the Wtcg criteria are opaque and bureaucratic, that the law is too complex for the CAK, and that the treatment of deceased beneficiaries' heirs is harsh.
These members regard it as a fundamentally wrong approach that opaque bureaucratic criteria, rather than people's actual care costs, decide entitlement to an allowance.</evidence_en>
Genoemde leden beschouwen het als een fundamenteel onjuiste benadering dat niet de daadwerkelijke zorgkosten van mensen, maar ondoorzichtige bureaucratische criteria de doorslag geven
Supports tighter criteria but asks for specification of affected claims and whether data sharing among care bodies complies with privacy law.

they ask whether the implementation of the decree by care providers, health insurers, assessment bodies and the CAK has fully complied with Article 9 of the Personal Data Protection Act.</evidence_en>

vragen of met de uitvoering van het besluit door de zorgaanbieders, de zorgverzekeraars, de indicatiestellingsorganen enerzijds en het CAK anderzijds, de gegevensverstrekking van chronisch zieken en gehandicapten in zijn geheel geschied conform artikel 9 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens
Asks about the total increase in beneficiaries, budget consequences, and how the amendment fits with the planned transfer of youth care to municipalities.
These members ask what the total increase in beneficiaries will be and whether the available financial resources will also increase.</evidence_en>
Deze leden vragen wat de totale toename zal zijn van aantal rechthebbenden en of de beschikbare financiële middelen ook zullen toenemen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten to embed new eligibility criteria in the Act, mainly objecting to the temporary delegation mechanism in article 2(4) that combined temporary and permanent delegation in one provision. The minister's reply adopted the advice by adding a new fifth paragraph separating the two forms of delegation, and also incorporated the drafting remarks.
concerns: Combining temporary and permanent delegation in one provision in article 2(4) is undesirable and should be split, since the two kinds of delegation must be treated differently.
Drafting remarks on the title citation and the wording of article 2b, including the rule on death in the calendar year, should be adopted.

32665.s: The bill creates a statutory basis for controlling strategic services, including non-physical transfer of software or technology, technical assistance and brokering services, for goods of dual use and military goods, in the European Netherlands and in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. It sets licensing, notification, supervision, criminal and appeal rules for these services, largely implementing EU regulation 428/2009 and international non-proliferation commitments.
32665.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need to implement EU regulation 428/2009, the Wassenaar and other non-proliferation regimes, and UN Security Council resolution 1540 on proliferation of weapons of mass destruction.
q: The Joint Action, for example, obliges a licensing requirement or prohibition regime for providing technical assistance for weapons of mass destruction or their delivery systems.

het Gemeenschappelijk Optreden) kent bijvoorbeeld de verplichting een vergunningplicht of een verbodstelsel in het leven te roepen voor het verlenen van technische bijstand ten behoeve van massavernietigingswapens of hun overbrengingsmiddelen.
d: exemption from military brokering licence requirement
implementing EU and international rules by general administrative order
licence application procedure, licence type and conditions
notification rules for brokering in Caribbean part
licence application procedure and conditions in Caribbean part
p: The Minister may by decision prohibit non-physical transfer of specified software or technology without licence, based on intelligence information that is not publicly reviewable.
The Minister may impose ad hoc licence requirements on brokering services where the Minister has informed the broker of possible prohibited end use.</description_en
Licences are not granted by operation of law after the statutory decision period, departing from the general administrative law default.</description_en
Supervisory officials may enter dwellings without the occupant's consent when authorised by the supervisor.</description_en
Appeal against a refusal to decide in time is excluded and the Haarlem court is the sole competent court, narrowing legal protection.</description_en

parties: Asks why only a notification duty rather than a full licensing requirement applies when end-use changes, and how ex-post end-use controls will be improved.
The PvdA members ask why only a notification duty was chosen and not a full licensing requirement in these cases.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom er slechts is gekozen voor een meldplicht en niet voor een volledige vergunningsplicht in deze gevallen.
Asks for clearer statutory definitions so the law can be understood without consulting EU regulations, and how the government will enforce the law and inform firms.
The CDA members are of the view that definitions used in Dutch legislation should in principle be clear on the basis of that legislation itself.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn van mening dat definities gehanteerd in Nederlandse wetgeving in beginsel ook op basis van die wetgeving duidelijk moeten zijn.

32782.s: The bill amends the Bankwet 1998 and the Wft to strengthen internal governance of De Nederlandsche Bank and the AFM, including a supervisory-director structure, a broader remit for supervisory boards, limits on reappointments, and suitability and reliability tests with profile sketches. It also grants the Minister of Finance a power to issue general policy rules on supervisors' tasks under chapters 1.2 and 1.3 of the Wft.
32782.j: The memorandum justifies the policy-rule power as filling a gap in the intervention pyramid for supervision at a distance, and says it is strongly qualified to respect the international context and supervisors' independence.
q: It was later considered desirable to include a strongly qualified power for the Minister of Finance to set policy rules.
Nadien is echter overwogen dat het wenselijk is om een – sterk geclausuleerde – bevoegdheid op te nemen voor de minister van Financiën om beleidsregels vast te stellen.
d: assigning directors' tasks by statute to supervisory directors who may act for the bank
directorate authorising supervisory directors to exercise powers needed for their tasks
Minister's general policy rules on supervisors' application of chapters 1.2 and 1.3 Wft
p: Gives the Minister of Finance power to issue general policy rules guiding supervisors, limited to general matters and excluding individual cases.
Makes suspension or dismissal of the president and directors by royal decree statutory and allows appeal to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.

parties: Asks how the DNB board and the new toezicht director share responsibility and how conflicts between the central bank president and the supervisory director are resolved.

How, for example, is the coherence of policy ensured between banking supervision and monetary policy, and who makes the final judgment in case of conflicting views between the central bank president and the supervisory director?

Hoe wordt bijvoorbeeld de samenhang van beleid geborgd tussen het bankentoezicht en monetair beleid en wie velt het eindoordeel in geval van conflicterende inzichten tussen de centralebankpresident en de directeur toezicht?
Argues the supervisory director should be accountable to the minister and parliament, and asks whether parliament can hold hearings with the voorzitter Toezicht.
The director in charge of supervising financial institutions must however be accountable to the minister and to parliament.
De directeur belast met het toezicht op de financiële instellingen moet echter verantwoording afleggen aan de minister en aan het parlement.
Questions the added value of the new voorzitter Toezicht and how responsibilities are divided within the DNB board and with collegiality.
The CDA members therefore ask what the added value is of the new function of voorzitter Toezicht.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen daarom dan ook wat de toegevoegde waarde is van de nieuwe functie van voorzitter Toezicht.
Asks whether the new provision adds anything given collegiality, and whether problems in supervision will still reflect on the DNB president.
Does the government share the view that due to that collegiality, any problems in supervision will inevitably also reflect on the DNB president, since he remains chair of the board?

Deelt de regering de mening dat door die collegialiteit eventuele problemen bij het toezicht onvermijdelijk ook zullen afstralen op de president van DNB, aangezien hij nog steeds voorzitter van de directie blijft?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill strengthening governance of DNB and AFM, raising major concerns about delegation of powers to supervisory directors, the scope of the supervisory boards' tasks, and new ministerial policy-rule powers. The government's reply largely accepted the remarks, clarified the legal form of delegation, and dropped the budget-criteria provision from this bill.
concerns: The Council questioned whether giving supervisory directors authority to decide independently on behalf of DNB would undermine collegial decision-making and how the three-tier structure fits the board.
The Council asked for unambiguous clarity whether the statutory provision creates mandate or delegation of public-law powers, and the government clarified it is a mandate under the Awb.
The Council found insufficient motivation of the need for the governance change and for the new ministerial policy-rule power, given earlier rejection of such powers.
The Council noted the scope of the supervisory boards' broadened tasks and their access to confidential information needed clarification against the closed information regime.
The Council asked whether the national policy-rule power is compatible with new European supervisory authorities, and the government limited it to generic national matters.
The Council made redactional comments on appeal routes and wording, which were incorporated.

32818.s: The bill introduces a transitional rule in the Corporate Income Tax Act 1969 that denies the participation exemption for positive currency results on participations where negative currency results were previously deducted from profit, with retroactive effect to 8 April 2011. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum text is available.
q: Having considered that, for the sake of balanced taxation and partly for budgetary reasons, it is desirable to introduce an interim arrangement for positive currency results on participations.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het omwille van een evenwichtige belastingheffing en mede om budgettaire redenen wenselijk is een tussenregeling in te voeren voor positieve valutaresultaten op deelnemingen.

parties: Sees the imbalance created without additional legislation and thanks the government for the clear explanation; asks a technical question about the meaning of 'opkomen' in the article on currency gains.

These members see that without additional legislation an unbalanced situation can arise in which currency losses are deducted while, under Supreme Court case law, currency gains fall under the participation exemption.

Deze leden zien in dat zonder aanvullende wetgeving een onevenwichtige situatie kan ontstaan waarbij valutaverliezen in aftrek worden gebracht terwijl krachtens jurisprudentie van de Hoge Raad valutawinsten onder de deelnemingsvrijstelling vallen.

Doubts the government's reasons for choosing an interim rule over structural alternatives such as abolishing the currency exemption, and questions the claimed harm to the investment climate and budget risk.
Accepts the regulation as a balance between regulation and overkill but asks whether the rule should be abolished if court rulings find it overshoots and how taxpayers relying on it would be treated.
If court rulings show that this interim rule goes too far, will this rule then be abolished?
Indien er rechtelijke uitspraken komen waaruit blijkt dat deze tussenregeling te ver doorschiet, wordt deze regeling dan afgeschaft?
Supports the idea behind the bill but raises EU-law compatibility doubts, the effect of the Gielen ruling, legal certainty for taxpayers who must litigate, and retroactivity not clearly announced.
These members also see some objections regarding the EU-law sustainability of the bill.
Ook zien deze leden enige bezwaren op het punt van de Europeesrechtelijke houdbaarheid van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether other solutions to close the gap are possible, how often the current option is used, and questions the choice of an option scheme in light of the Gielen judgment.
The SP members also ask whether another solution to close the gap in the legislation is conceivable.
Ook de leden van de SP-fractie vragen of er geen andere oplossing om het gat in de wetgeving te dichten denkbaar is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises revising the draft Tussenregeling valutaresultaten op deelnemingen, which taxes currency gains on participations only when a currency loss is actually deducted and upheld by the courts, citing legal uncertainty, unclear wording, and retroactivity concerns. The government's reply largely accepts the drafting points (art. 28b Wet Vpb 1969), explains that the scheme covers all participations and that legal uncertainty exists regardless of retroactivity, and justifies retroactivity by anticipatory behaviour and budgetary interests.
concerns: The scheme leaves considerable legal uncertainty until the definitive court ruling on which currency losses are deductible, and the government's reply only argues this uncertainty exists regardless of retroactivity.

The wording of art. 28b(1) suggests currency losses already fall within the profit before court confirmation, which the Afdeling asks to align with the scheme's intent; the government amended the article.

Retroactivity of a tax burden increase requires special circumstances, which the Afdeling finds in anticipatory behaviour; the government justifies retroactivity on that basis and on budgetary interests.

The Afdeling asks for better motivation of why this interim scheme was chosen over alternatives and how other member states handled comparable problems; the government expanded the memorie van toelichting.
Clarification is requested on whether the scheme applies when a taxpayer first complies with the participation regime and then objects to the assessment; the government confirms it applies.

32854.s: The bill establishes temporary rules for ambulance care, designating one Regional Ambulance Facility per region (appointed by the minister) responsible for a control room and ambulance services. It sets requirements by ministerial regulation, allows the minister to replace a non-compliant facility, and sunsets after five years.
32854.j: The memorandum justifies the minister's powers by the need to guarantee continuity of care and to avoid the minister being both responsible for executing care and for supervising it, limiting his involvement to what is strictly necessary.
q: It is considered undesirable for the minister, once continuity of care is guaranteed, to bear executive responsibility for the provision of ambulance care by the entity for longer than necessary.

Het wordt onwenselijk geacht de minister, nadat de continuïteit van zorg gewaarborgd is, langer dan noodzakelijk uitvoerende verantwoordelijkheid te laten dragen voor de verlening van ambulancezorg door de rechtspersoon.
d: areas where ambulance standby posts should be located
further requirements for designating Regional Ambulance Facilities
requirements Regional Ambulance Facilities must meet
additional data requirements and submission methods
exemptions from provisions of the act for designated ambulance care
p: The minister designates the Regional Ambulance Facility and may himself establish a legal entity, deviating from the standard Comptabiliteitswet procedure after consulting the Court of Audit and informing parliament afterwards.

The minister may withdraw an existing designation and appoint a replacement facility or a newly created entity, after seeking advice from insurers and the safety region, with objection and appeal open under the General Administrative Law Act.
The minister may by regulation exempt designated ambulance care from provisions of the act, under conditions set by that regulation.

parties: Asks how the government will ensure the 'white column' in the Meldkamer model is safeguarded, and questions the transparency and non-discrimination of the minister's designation criteria for a regional ambulance provider.
On the basis of exactly which criteria would the minister make the choice for option 1 (choosing one of the permit holders in the region)?
Op basis van exact welke criteria zou de minister de keuze voor optie 1 (keuze voor één van de vergunninghouders uit de regio) invullen?
Doubts the government's claim that indefinite permits are not EU-proof, arguing the comparison with the gambling ruling is incomplete and asking for the legal basis of that conclusion.
Is the comparison the government makes with the Court's ruling on the gambling licence granted to a single operator not incomplete?
Is de vergelijking die de regering maakt met de uitspraak van het Hof over de kansspelvergunning aan één exploitant niet onvolledig?

Accepts the temporary nature of the bill as the best route but asks whether the forced merger of permit holders into one legal person and the EU justification for exclusive rights are sufficiently grounded.
Are these arguments sufficiently tenable within European regulation?
Zijn deze argumenten voldoende houdbaar binnen de Europese regelgeving?

Opposes market liberalisation of ambulance care, suspects the government is working behind the scenes on a privatisation agenda, and demands full transparency and information for parliament on each step.
The SP members expect that the House will from now on be kept precisely informed of every step and every development.
De leden van de SP-fractie verwachten dat de Kamer voortaan van elke stap en elke ontwikkeling nauwkeurig op de hoogte wordt gehouden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises on the temporary ambulance care bill (Tijdelijke wet ambulancezorg), raising concerns about the designation procedure for regional ambulance provision (EU law transparency and non-discrimination, abuse of market power, lack of compensation for existing license holders) and the five-year duration, and advises revision before submission. The government's reply accepts most points, adding procedural criteria, clarifying the EU justification, referencing market-regulation and competition tools, pointing to the sanering subsidy scheme, and explaining why five years is needed.
concerns: The Council asked for clear criteria for designating a regional ambulance provider when parties fail to cooperate; the government added a publication requirement for further criteria before 1 October 2011.

The Council doubted that the exclusion of newcomers from designation is justified under EU free movement rules and asked for an adequate justification; the government clarified the justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Council warned of abuse of market power by the designated provider over non-designated license holders and asked for safeguards; the government pointed to existing NZa, competition and procurement powers rather than new rules.
The Council found no adequate compensation for existing license holders losing their position; the government referred to the existing sanering subsidy scheme and a transitional provision.

The Council advised keeping the period of uncertainty as short as possible given the investment reluctance caused by a five-year temporary arrangement; the government justified five years on procedural grounds and depreciation periods.

32863.s: The bill makes a set of mostly technical corrections and omission fixes across several Dutch statutes, including the Police Data Act, the Private Security Organisations Act, the Extradition Act, the Civil Code and the Municipalities Act. Most provisions restore lost wording or update cross-references, while a few change who may be designated or regulated by general administrative order (AMvB).
32863.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly as technical corrections of errors and omissions and as clarifying legal basis, not as new executive powers.
d: designation of regulations for administrative fines
composition and working of guardianship council
XX, A and B (Art. 3 and 5 Wet controle op rechtspersonen)
designation of administrative bodies, supervisors and investigative services for risk reports
rules on camera surveillance by municipalities (made optional)
p: XX, A and B (Art. 3 and 5 Wet controle op rechtspersonen)
Broadens the set of bodies and persons that can be designated by general administrative order to receive risk reports and personal data, moving the designation power to the executive.
Changes mandatory rule-setting on camera surveillance data handling into an optional power, reducing statutory safeguards for privacy in municipal camera use.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a Verzamelwet Veiligheid en Justitie 2011 containing technical and drafting amendments, flagging that the Vreemdelingenwet wrongly excludes the bestuurlijke lus (article 49(6) Wet op de Raad van State) in asylum and immigration procedures and advising to correct this, plus several drafting remarks. The minister's nader rapport accepts the point, notes the Afdeling's power to grant the administration an opportunity to remedy defects, and reports that the bestuursrecht bill was amended accordingly and all drafting remarks were adopted.
concerns: Multiple technical and cross-reference corrections in the bill (article references, Kamerstuk numbering, deletion of an obsolete article) were adopted as listed in the annex.
The omission of the bestuurlijke lus from the Vreemdelingenwet creates uncertainty; the government accepted the advice and amended the Algemene wet bestuursrecht bill to clarify the position.

32872.s: The bill requires intermediaries that place temporary workers to register in the Handelsregister and bars placing workers without registration, backed by administrative fines and a ban on using unregistered agencies. It also lets the Labour Inspectorate and Tax Authority share data with accredited certifying bodies and the SNCU, and sets out enforcement, fine levels and an implementing general administrative order.
32872.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and data-sharing by the need to tackle malafide agencies effectively and to strengthen private certification and control of the sector.
q: Therefore the government proposes to oblige the tax authority and the Labour Inspectorate to pass information on malafide temporary work agencies to accredited certifying bodies.
Daarom stelt de regering voor om de rijksbelastingdienst en de AI te verplichten om informatie over malafide uitzendondernemingen door te geven aan erkende certificerende instellingen
d: obligations of labour intermediaries under general administrative order
rules on cases and manner of data provision between authorities
content, retention, security and use of certification data
rules on the report sent to affected parties after inspection
policy rules setting fine amounts for violations
standards for accredited certifying bodies, set with Finance minister
designation of a foundation to transmit certification data
p: Authorities may share and disclose data, including personal data and BSN use, with each other and with private certifying bodies, limited only by a privacy-intrusion exception.
Inspectors may seize objects at any time without a stated limit beyond return once the investigation allows.
Administrative fines up to EUR 76,000 are imposed by a civil servant, and the judge may increase the fine to the detriment of the appellant.

parties: Asks whether the Labour Inspectorate will also check employment agencies without direct signals, how registration of foreign firms works, and whether self-regulation works.
Especially in the first few years after introduction of this system, the VVD members consider it important to target checks on registered companies.
Zeker in de eerste paar jaar na introductie van dit systeem is het naar de mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie van belang om geregistreerde ondernemingen gericht te gaan controleren.
Questions why user firms are liable only for the statutory minimum wage and not for generally binding collective agreement wages, and asks about enforcement and evaluation of self-regulation.

Especially in cross-border work, the government has, in these members' view, a statutory duty under the Working Conditions for Cross-Border Labour Act to ensure generally binding collective agreement wages are paid.
