Zeker in het geval van grensoverschrijdende arbeid heeft de overheid in de visie van deze leden een wettelijke taak op grond van de Wet arbeidsvoorwaarden bij grensoverschrijdende arbeid om erop toe te zien dat algemeen verbindend verklaarde Cao-lonen worden uitbetaald.

Supports the registration obligation but stresses that effective enforcement by the Cao police, tax authority and Labour Inspectorate and a watertight system are necessary; asks about foreign and letterbox firms outside the obligation.
However, these members note that companies established abroad and companies without a fixed establishment ('06-busjes') fall outside the registration obligation.
Ondernemingen, die in het buitenland zijn gevestigd en ondernemingen zonder vaste vestiging («06-busjes»), vallen naar de mening van deze leden echter buiten de registratieplicht.

Doubts self-regulation works given many agencies break the rules, questions whether fines are high enough, and asks about enforcement against fleeting malafide firms and pending motions not yet incorporated.
From this it can be concluded that self-regulation in this sector hardly works, if at all.
Hieruit kan geconcludeerd worden dat zelfregulering in deze branche niet of nauwelijks werkt.

Asks why certification is not made mandatory and proposes stronger rules against strike-breaking labour supply, including immediate workplace access for the inspectorate and extending liability to clients.
The SP members propose that the company that hires in labour, or gives the order to supply workers, also be treated as an offender.
De leden van de SP-fractie stellen voor om ook het bedrijf dat arbeidskrachten inleent, dan wel de opdracht geeft om arbeidskrachten te leveren, als overtreder wordt aangemerkt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on the Wet registratieplicht intermediairs bill, which requires temporary-work agencies to register and imposes fines, and which obliges the tax authority and Labour Inspectorate to pass enforcement signals to private certifying bodies. The Afdeling supports the aim but raises concerns on justification of the data transfer to private bodies under EVRM Article 8, the scope of data shared, delegation level, the fine amount relative to the Wav, and EU and GATS aspects; the government reply accepts most points, adapting the data provisions, the delegation and the commentary, while defending the fine level and the registration obligation.
concerns: Transfer of enforcement data to private certifying bodies requires a well-reasoned proportionality and subsidiarity assessment under EVRM Article 8, which the explanatory memorandum does not provide; the government adds a justification but does not change the transfer structure.
The data provided should be limited to the signalling function, as the text of Article 14b is broader than the intended purpose; the government amended the provision accordingly.
Rules on the content and processing of shared data should be set at the level of an algemene maatregel van bestuur, so the words 'of krachtens' should be deleted; the government followed this.

The proposed fine of EUR 76,000 is disproportionate compared with the EUR 45,000 maximum under the Wav; the government instead plans to raise the Wav fine to EUR 76,000 rather than lower the Waadi fine.

The registration obligation is a non-discriminatory restriction on free movement of services under EU law requiring justification; the government revised the memorandum to address it but did not substantively justify the restriction beyond noting access to the register.

The explanatory memorandum should address applicability of GATS articles VI, XIV and III including a notification duty; the government considers no provision conflicts with GATS and sees no need to supplement.
Several redactional comments on the wording of Article 14b Waadi should be adopted; the government incorporated them.

32890.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code to abolish the statute of limitations for offences carrying a prison sentence of twelve years or more, and for certain serious sexual offences committed against persons under eighteen. It also adjusts the general limitation period to twenty years for offences with a maximum of eight years or more and makes related technical changes.
32890.j: The memorandum justifies abolishing limitation periods for the most serious offences by their impact on victims and society and argues that delayed trials do not undermine judicial reliability, since courts still assess evidence reliability.
q: Judicial decision-making in criminal cases is not influenced by the passage of time.
De rechterlijke oordeelsvorming in strafzaken wordt niet door tijdsverloop beïnvloed.

parties: Supports abolishing limitation for serious crimes, citing cold-case forensic possibilities and victims' interests, and expresses trust in the judiciary.
Victims and their next of kin have the right that the perpetrator never goes free.
Slachtoffers en hun nabestaanden hebben er recht op dat de dader nimmer vrijuit gaat.

Asks how reliable witness memory is after many years, whether expectations are unrealistic, how a suspect can test old testimony, and how often child sex crimes have been successfully prosecuted after 15 or 20 years.
These members ask to what extent the memory of witnesses, victims or perpetrators is reliable.
Voornoemde leden vragen in hoeverre het geheugen van de getuigen, slachtoffers of daders betrouwbaar is.
Asks whether removing limitation periods affects evidence retention rules and whether limitation should be abolished for all offences given prosecutorial discretion.

Supports the bill in principle but questions victim impact, the reliability of late testimony, and whether the scope should be narrowed as the Raad van State suggested, raising concerns about overbreadth.
These members realise that the weight that can be given to an individual witness statement in a given criminal case depends on that statement itself.
Voornoemde leden beseffen dat het van de individuele getuigenverklaring afhangt welke waarde daaraan in een bepaald strafproces kan worden gehecht.

Argues the justification is thin, that the government shifts the line on the same arguments previously rejected, and warns of unreliable evidence, wrongful convictions and inflated expectations among victims.
The justification for this proposal is therefore very thin.
De onderbouwing van dit voorstel is dan ook erg mager.

Argues the government too easily sets aside legal-certainty interests of suspects, asks for more specific reasoning and for research on the number of people affected by prolonged uncertainty, and questions balance.
These members believe the government too easily sets aside the interests that argue in favour of limitation of criminal offences.
Voornoemde leden menen dat de regering hiermee te gemakkelijk heenstapt over de belangen die vóór verjaring van strafbare feiten pleiten.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised, on a bill abolishing prosecution limitation for offences carrying twelve years or more and for serious sexual offences against minors, that the bill be reconsidered in part, notably by aligning the core rule with offences eligible for retrial to the detriment. The minister's reply rejects the proposed alternative criterion with reasons (systematic coherence, clarity, the existing life-imprisonment rule), adds justification for the eight-year extension, and declines to add comparative foreign law, while adding minor editorial changes.
concerns: The Council proposed aligning the no-limitation rule with offences eligible for retrial to the detriment (intentional offences causing death), which the government rejected as systematically incoherent and clashing with the clarity sought.

The Council considered the twelve-year threshold too broad for some offences (e.g., arson-type endangerment, damage to buildings) and too narrow for some violent offences (e.g., manslaughter of children), which the government did not accept.

The Council questioned the need for abolishing limitation for certain child sexual offences given evidentiary problems, and the government defended the trauma-based rationale while noting that the criterion of prosecutability differs by offence.
The Council asked for the explanatory memorandum to be supplemented on the extension of limitation periods for offences with eight years' maximum, and the government did so.
The Council asked for explanation of foreign limitation regimes in neighbouring countries, which the government declined to add, citing the earlier initiative bill's comparative overview.

33079.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure to create a new general right to inspect, copy or extract documents concerning a legal relationship from those holding them, enforceable by court order. It replaces the former article 843a (exhibition duty) with new articles 162a-162c, covering both separate proceedings and pending cases, and adjusts related provisions.
33079.j: The memorandum justifies the change as improving truth-finding, efficiency and cost savings in civil litigation, with safeguards against fishing expeditions.
q: The right to a copy of documents is not absolute.
Het recht op afschrift van bescheiden is niet absoluut.
p: Expands citizens' procedural right to obtain documents held by others, enforceable before a court, subject to privilege, overriding reasons and judicial discretion over conditions.

parties: Worries the bill could enable fishing expeditions and a discovery-style claims culture, and asks how judges will limit document requests and handle confidentiality.
According to these members, it is absolutely undesirable for a claims culture to emerge in the Netherlands, whether or not facilitated by 'discovery' as in particular in the United States.
Het is volgens deze leden absoluut onwenselijk dat in Nederland een claimcultuur onstaat, al dan niet gefaciliteerd door «discovery», zoals dat in met name de Verenigde Staten bestaat.
Asks whether the bill clarifies existing law or broadens the right, and what time limits and standards apply to government disclosure.
These members ask whether the proposed amendment is a clarification or a broadening of the arrangement.
Deze leden vragen of de voorgestelde aanpassing een verduidelijking is of dat er sprake is van een verruiming van de regeling.
Questions the consequences of the bill and fears that the new family privilege could be used to shelter litigious documents.
These members fear that introducing the family privilege encourages litigious documents being placed with persons who can invoke the family privilege.

Bij voornoemde leden bestaat de vrees dat het invoeren van het familiaal verschoningsrecht in de hand werkt dat litigieuze bescheiden worden ondergebracht bij personen die een beroep op het familiaal verschoningsrecht kunnen doen.
Asks about in-house lawyers invoking privilege and why the government did not codify derivative privilege; also questions the advisory committee's objection to mid-proceedings requests.
Can the government elaborate on the circumstances under which a large company employing lawyers can invoke the privilege?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de vraag onder welke omstandigheden een grote onderneming die advocaten in loondienst heeft zich kan beroepen op het verschoningsrecht?
Asks how much discretion judges have, what counts as abuse of right, and how to prevent the right being used to delay proceedings.
Is it correct that this involves a broad degree of discretion for the judge?
Klopt het dat het hier gaat om een ruime mate van beoordelingsvrijheid voor de rechter?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill expanding rights to inspect or obtain copies of documents in civil cases to third parties, but asks for clarification on the family privilege versus spousal information rights, the derived privilege, and the relation to pre-trial discovery under the Hague Evidence Convention and EU evidence regulation. The government's nader rapport accepts these points and adds explanatory text to the explanatory memorandum, while redactional comments were adopted.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should address the relation between the family privilege and the spousal right to information under Book 1 of the Civil Code, and the government adjusted the text accordingly.
The derived privilege for clients of privileged persons needed fuller explanation, and the government clarified that clients may invoke the privilege where documents are held by others.
The relation to the Hague Evidence Convention Article 23 declaration and EU Evidence Regulation Article 1(2) against pre-trial discovery needed explanation, which the government added.
Several redactional comments on wording in the amended article 162a and 162c were adopted.

33097.s: The bill changes the Waterschapswet so that members of water board general boards are elected by municipal council members rather than by residents, introducing a central electoral board, weighted votes per municipality, and a list-based seat allocation. It also postpones the 2012 water board elections, sets incompatibility rules for council members, and leaves many procedural details to general administrative orders.
33097.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for technical election procedures and continuity, and cites the need to limit administrative burden and costs of the 2012 elections.
q: Skipping the 2012 elections better guarantees continuity and avoids high administrative burdens and costs.
Het overslaan van de verkiezingen in 2012 waarborgt de continuïteit beter en voorkomt hoge bestuurslasten en -kosten.
d: duties and working method of the polling board
election day, ballot paper voting, proxy voting and vote counting rules
date by which the board must supply resident data
rules on establishing and announcing election results
decision establishing a new water board and appointing its board
p: ARTIKEL I A and E (art. 16, 20 Waterschapswet)
Replaces direct election of water board members by residents with election by municipal council members, reducing direct democratic input from residents.
Extends the term of the sitting water board by about one and a half years, postponing elections.
Allows a new water board to be installed by decision without elections, with board seats set administratively.

parties: Supports indirect election by municipal councillors but asks government to justify the choice against inclusion in the Kieswet and to split off the postponement of elections into a separate bill.
Requests the government to remove the part concerning postponement of the water board elections from this bill and place it in a separate bill.
Verzoeken de regering het onderdeel dat betrekking heeft op uitstel van de waterschapsverkiezingen uit het onderhavige wetsvoorstel te halen en in een apart wetsvoorstel onder te brengen.
Questions why direct elections combined with municipal elections were not preferred, the politicisation risk, and whether a grondwet change is needed, citing the Council of State's doubts.
Will the government also give its view on whether abandoning (in)direct elections does or does not entail a constitutional amendment?
Wil de regering ook haar oordeel geven over de vraag of het afzien van (in)directe verkiezingen wel of niet grondwetswijziging met zich meebrengt?
Supports municipal councillors as electors but flags risks for niche water parties and possible conflicts where a water board and municipality have a permit relationship.
Can the government explain why a distinction is made on this point?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom op dit punt onderscheid wordt gemaakt?
Would have preferred placing water boards under the provinces; questions the added value of an election-based system with risk of politicisation and the lack of progress since 2009.
Why has the government not chosen to place the water boards under the provinces?
Waarom heeft de regering er niet voor gekozen om de waterschappen bij de provincies onder te brengen?
Strongly critical; backs the Council of State's near-rejection, questions the consultation between the Council and ministers, and says the rationale for the choice is insufficient.
The D66 members endorse the Council of State's Advisory Division's view that the proposed choice is not yet adequately justified by the government.
De leden van de D66-fractie scharen zich achter het oordeel van de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State dat de voorgestelde keuze thans niet afdoende onderbouwd wordt door de regering.
Asks why the government dismisses the Council of State's serious objection to the bill and the advice of Elzinga on thirteen problems, and questions abandoning direct elections.
Asks for justification of choosing indirect elections over direct elections on the same day as municipal elections in 2014, and of the stated costs savings.
Questions whether the change is necessary given limited experience with the new system, and whether indirect elections risk politicisation and reduce citizen involvement.
Is it therefore not wise and desirable to keep citizen involvement intact rather than thwart it with indirect elections?
Is het daarom niet verstandig en wenselijk de betrokkenheid van burgers vast te houden en niet te doorkruisen met indirecte verkiezingen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the bill reintroducing indirect election of water board general boards by municipal councillors, citing insufficient grounds, lack of analysis of past elections, excessive delegation, and risks of politicisation and gerrymandering. The minister's nader rapport accepts several points (six-month term, closed lists, dropping constituencies, dropping preference votes) but defends the core choice of indirect elections and the incompatibility rule.
concerns: The Afdeling found insufficient reason to radically change the electoral system based on the 2008 experience, given the 2010 successful election with a different voting method.

The Afdeling said extending the term of elected representatives should happen only in very urgent cases; the government justified the extension via the Kiesraad advice and added a specific transitional basis.
The Afdeling objected to extensive delegation of electoral matters to lower regulation, and the government moved the single voting date into the law itself.
The Afdeling noted that the executive being a direct stakeholder in electoral rules argues for regulating them in formal law rather than by administrative decree.

The Afdeling argued that the legal necessity of elections for water boards is not compelled by the Grondwet, and that indirect election does not fit the water board's functional character; the government maintained its choice for democratic legitimacy.
The Afdeling asked for the Kieswet integration to be carried out promptly; the government deferred it, citing time constraints and the functional nature of the water boards.

The Afdeling said the incompatibility between water board membership and municipal council membership needed justification; the government gave reasons (autonomy, avoiding politicisation) and kept it.
The Afdeling advised dropping constituencies (gerrymandering risk) and preference votes; the government adopted closed lists and removed the constituency provision.

33187.s: The bill amends the Dutch vocational education acts (WEB, WVO, WSF, WHW, WEB BES and related laws) to shorten and intensify vocational programmes, introduce a one-year entry programme (entreeopleiding) and entry requirements for level-2 programmes, and modernise funding. It also lets ministers set rules by general administrative order and ministerial regulation on the use of public funds for private activities in education.
33187.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that the rules on sharing public funds with private activities need clear norms in advance so institutions know the conditions and the government can intervene where needed.
q: The delegation provisions in the bill make it possible to set rules in subordinate regulations, for example on the use of public funds for private activities.
De in het wetsvoorstel opgenomen delegatiebepalingen maken het mogelijk om bijvoorbeeld voor de besteding van publieke middelen aan private activiteiten in lagere regelgeving regels te stellen.
d: rules on use of state contribution for private activities in education
rules on use of state contribution for private activities of centres of expertise
maximum share of students that may enrol in an occupational domain
conditions under which deviation from rules may be applied
nadere regels on study programme by the competent authority
further rules on binding study advice and support measures set by competent authority
p: Institutions may refuse or end enrolment of students who do not respect the institution's principles, subject to written reasons.
Competent authority decides on admission to entry, basic and specialist programmes, which may be delegated to an admissions committee set up by it.
Institutions may issue a binding study advice that can lead to termination of the enrolment in the entry programme, with appeal to an examinations appeal committee within two weeks.

parties: Asks whether shorter, more intensive courses reduce total teaching time and whether funding incentives are sufficient, and how the urennorm will still be enforced after it is dropped as a funding parameter.
Can the government explain how dropping the teaching-hours norm as a funding parameter relates to raising the norm in this bill, these members ask.
Kan de regering toelichten hoe het schrappen van de urennorm als bekostigingsparameter zich verhoudt tot het verhogen van de urennorm in dit wetsvoorstel, zo vragen deze leden.
Doubts the shortening is evidence-based and asks for independent research; questions who checks negative binding study advice and whether students can appeal.
Is the government willing and planning to commission independent research into the suggested link before pushing this bill through, the members ask.
Is de regering bereid en van plan om nader onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten doen naar het gesuggereerde verband, alvorens dit wetsvoorstel door te zetten, zo vragen de leden.
Supports shorter courses but wants minimum teaching-time criteria and asks whether cascade funding creates perverse incentives to maximise intake.
The members ask whether the emphasis on funding the first year will not encourage institutions to maximise intake, undermining careful study choice.

De leden vragen of de nadruk op bekostiging van het eerste jaar de instellingen niet zal aanmoedigen een zo groot mogelijke instroom te realiseren en daarmee het streven naar een zorgvuldiger studiekeuze zal ondermijnen.
Asks why some programmes exempted from shortening may still be offered in three years and notes the bill's many delegation clauses, suggesting it is a framework law.
The CDA members note that the bill contains a considerable number of delegation provisions.
Het valt de leden van de CDA-fractie op dat er een flink aantal delegatiebepalingen in de wet is opgenomen.
Asks whether students can be expelled and how they can contest a decision, whether supervision enforces the hours norm, and whether institutions will refuse more students.
How can a student enforce good guidance and coaching?
Hoe kan een student goede begeleiding en coachting afdwingen?
Asks whether negative binding study advice can be reviewed or appealed and who decides, and whether entry-level places are guaranteed given limited budget.
Can an objection and appeal be lodged against it?
Kan er bezwaar en beroep tegen worden aangetekend?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill modernising vocational education funding and shortening/intensifying MBO courses, but raises objections on shortening MBO level-4 courses without evidence, the 1000-hour norm, and extending the reforms to the Caribbean Netherlands (BES). The government's nader rapport largely rejects these objections, defending the evidence base and the norms while accepting some drafting and wording changes.
concerns: The Afdeling finds that shortening MBO level-4 courses does not meet the evidence-based policy norm and asks for careful implementation; the government disagrees, citing existing practice and international research.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address the Commissie-Oudeman conclusions on the 1000-hour norm and show it is necessary and feasible; the government answers by citing the Van den Broek evaluation and substantiating the norm.
The Afdeling advises not to extend the Dutch education reform to the BES islands given their specific situation; the government keeps the Europe-aligned approach with delayed entry into force.

The Afdeling asks that the BES public bodies be informed and consulted under the Wet openbare lichamen; the government argues no such request was made and the bodies are informed via the Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland.
The Afdeling asks to nuance the claim that administrative burdens do not increase; the explanatory memorandum is adjusted accordingly.
The Afdeling makes numerous redactional comments; most are adopted, while several (tables, wording of articles 2.2.2 and 8.1.1a, delegation terminology) are not.

33259.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act to adjust measures targeting long-term students, changing bachelor/master graduate definitions, extending study-year allowances for students with disabilities or chronic illness, and adding financial support for students with unstudiable programmes. It sets entry into force on 1 September 2012, with some provisions retroactive to 1 January 2011.
q: This bill aims to amend the Higher Education and Research Act.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt tot wijziging van de Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek.

33268.s: The bill amends the Kieswet (Electoral Act) to make it easier for Dutch citizens abroad to vote, centralises candidate-list submission and the electoral calendar, and reforms registration, polling-station, postal and proxy voting rules. It also places the Kiesraad under the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen with several supervisory powers excluded, and adjusts rules on polling-station members, observers and the publication of results.
33268.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations as technical detail, and says the Kiesraad delegations were narrowed in response to advice to limit delegation.
q: The government does not share this concern. Even if additional objections were to arise, this cannot be considered problematic given the transparency and verifiability of the electoral process.

Deze zorg deelt de regering niet. Zo er al sprake zal zijn van extra bezwaren, kan dit met het oog op de transparantie en de controleerbaarheid van het verkiezingsproces niet als bezwaarlijk worden gekarakteriseerd.
d: national rules on polling-station member training
admission, numbers, conduct and rights of observers
further rules on voting by post
publication of software and conditions for its use in seat calculation
model forms for voter passes and applications
where and when registration forms are available
p: A 3 (Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen applied to Kiesraad, exemptions for arts 12, 21, 22)

The Kiesraad is placed under the Kaderwet ZBO with the minister's policy-rule and annulment powers excluded, strengthening its independence from the executive while retaining intervention for serious neglect of duty.
Observers gain a general right to attend the electoral process, with rules on conduct and public reporting.

parties: Asks whether differentiated training for polling station chairs and members is intended, and asks for clarification on observer appointment and the scope of future amendments.
To what extent does the government now intend to differentiate between chairs and other polling station members when it comes to training?
In hoeverre is de regering nu voornemens om, als het gaat om de training, te differentiëren tussen voorzitters en andere stembureauleden?
Supports the bill's aims but asks about the limits on the Kiesraad's independence and the minister's responsibility, and about safeguards for fair electronic counting.
These members ask the government about progress on the study into a different ballot paper and the associated possibilities for electronic counting.
Deze leden vragen de regering naar de voortgang met het onderzoek naar een ander kiesbiljet en de bijbehorende mogelijkheden van elektronisch tellen.

Objects to assistance inside the voting booth for voters other than those with physical disabilities and questions whether voters understand what they vote for; also questions feasibility of publishing records online for large municipalities.
The PVV members consider it undesirable that voters other than those with a physical disability receive assistance in the voting booth.](#)
De leden van de PVV-fractie achten het niet wenselijk dat, anders dan diegenen met een lichamelijke beperking, kiezers assistentie krijgen in het stemhokje.
Asks why training is mandatory without a test, asks what the minister could do if the Kiesraad neglects its duties, and raises ballot-size concerns for secrecy of the vote.
These members do ask why the government chose to make only attending the training mandatory and not to require a test.
Wel vragen deze leden, waarom de regering ervoor gekozen heeft alleen het volgen van de training verplicht te stellen en geen toets af te nemen.
Questions whether the ban on proxy voting inside the polling station is enforceable and whether the lowered eilandraad threshold should wait for island councils' views.
These members would prefer to keep the 75% threshold until the response from the island councils has been received.
Deze leden zouden graag de drempel van 75% handhaven tot de reactie van de eilandraden is ontvangen is.
Asks the government to justify the change to the island council seat threshold against its own commitment to legislative restraint, and asks for criteria for when that restraint applies.

These members ask the government to demonstrate that the governability of the public bodies has been affected by the said residual-seat allocation to such an extent that an exception to this commitment is justified.

Deze leden vragen de regering aan te tonen dat de bestuurbaarheid van de openbare lichamen door de genoemde restzetelverdeling dermate is aangetast dat een uitzondering op deze toezegging is gerechtvaardigd.
Asks what safeguards exist if the Kiesraad neglects its tasks, questions the legal basis for correcting polling records, and asks whether the 3-month election deadline should be kept in the Kieswet.
With a view to possible neglect of duties by the Kiesraad, the SGP considers that clear provisions should be put in place.
Met het oog op de eventuele taakverwaarlozing door de Kiesraad moeten naar de mening van de SGP-fractie duidelijke voorzieningen getroffen worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the Kieswet amendment but objects to the Kiesraad's legal design (dual status as ZBO and advisory body), the four-year appointment term, broad dismissal grounds, the exclusion of Aruba/Curaçao/Sint Maarten voters from a rijkswet, the 100% seat threshold in Caribbean Netherlands, and the 'zo spoedig mogelijk' decision deadline. The government reply accepts several points (deadline, dismissal ground rewording, observers, clarifying the Kiesraad's status) but rejects the longer appointment term, the Kiesraad-initiated dismissal requirement, the separate rijkswet and the threshold change pending evaluation.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the Kiesraad should be a college sui generis outside the Kaderwet zbo's to guarantee independence; the government rejects this but adjusts the statutory framework and removes the advisory task as main task.
Appointment term of four years lets each cabinet replace the whole Kiesraad; the Afdeling wants a term longer than one cabinet period, which the government rejects as impractical.
Dismissal ground 'andere zwaarwegende gronden' is too broad and vague and should be dropped; the government rewords it to refer to reasons relating to the person concerned.
Dismissal or suspension should be initiated only by the Kiesraad itself; the government rejects sole Kiesraad initiative but adds a requirement that the Kiesraad be heard.

Afdeling asks whether Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten voting for the European Parliament should be regulated by rijkswet to avoid unequal treatment; the government declines and keeps the current arrangement with improved registration measures.
'Zo spoedig mogelijk' decision deadline for kiezerspas gives insufficient certainty; the government restores 'terstond' for oral requests.
Raising the seat threshold in Caribbean island councils from 75% to 100% lacks sufficient basis; the government keeps the change, pending consultation with island councils and evaluation.

Observers should be defined more precisely as covering the verkiezingsproces; the government clarifies this in the explanatory memorandum rather than in statute, and drops the rule on how international observers report.

33277.s: The bill abolishes the household income test in the Dutch Work and Assistance Act by redefining family and means, so that adult children living at home no longer count against assistance claims, and updates the associated norms and debt-protection amounts. It also adds transitional rules for beneficiaries and claims made before entry into force.
33277.j: The memorandum justifies the transitional handling of rejected applications by leaving the municipality discretion to withdraw or amend decisions under the General Administrative Law Act, with review on request otherwise.
q: To the extent the municipal council sees no reason to do so, revision will take place on request under the proposed Article 78# .
Voor zover het college daartoe geen aanleiding ziet, vindt herziening met toepassing van het voorgestelde artikel 78# op aanvraag plaats.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikelen 20-24) and Artikel 78# transitional rules
Sets assistance norms and transitional amounts directly in the statute, reducing discretion for the executive rather than expanding it.
Artikel I, onderdeel AC (Artikel 78# Uitbetaling door Sociale verzekeringsbank aan het college)
Allows the Sociale verzekeringsbank to pay recovered claims to the municipality without the beneficiary's authorisation, bypassing consent for a debt offset.

parties: Asks how retroactive benefit entitlement is legally possible without a formal application and who must prove past entitlement, raising questions about administrative procedure and municipal decisions.
Under administrative law, must a formal application not first be made before anything can be retroactively corrected?
Moet er in het bestuursecht niet eerst een formele aanvraag worden gedaan, alvorens iets met terugwerkende kracht gerepareerd kan worden?
Welcomes abolition, calls the test a principled error, and questions how municipalities will revise prior decisions and whether the state must reimburse municipal costs.
Does the government share the view that municipalities should be able to recover from the SZW ministry the extra costs (estimated around EUR 20 million) they incurred?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden dat gemeenten de extra kosten (geraamd rond € 20 miljoen) die zij hebben moeten maken ... moeten kunnen verhalen op het ministerie van SZW?
Says the explanatory materials give sufficient insight and it has no additional questions.
The PVV faction therefore currently has no additional questions.
De PVV fractie heeft op dit moment dan ook geen aanvullende vragen.
Agrees with abolition and asks about the timeline for retroactive removal and ministry support for municipalities.
They do want to learn from the government how and within what period the household test will be abolished with retroactive effect.
Zij willen nog wel van de regering vernemen hoe en binnen welke termijn de huishoudtoets met terugwerkende kracht wordt geschaft.
Asks about the size of affected groups, whether municipalities retain discretion not to revise decisions, risks of unclear communication to citizens, and the two-month application window.
Does this mean the college still has room not to change a decision even though someone received no benefit solely because of the household income test, these members want to know.
Houdt dit in dat het college toch de ruimte heeft om een besluit niet te wijzigen ook al heeft iemand alleen op grond van de huishoudinkomenstoets geen uitkering gekregen, zo willen deze leden weten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill abolishing the household income test in the Work and Assistance Act but raises objections on the transitional arrangements, particularly retroactive effect for non-applicants and unclear re-assessment of rejected claims. The government's reply accepts clarifications, extends the notification window to two months, and justifies its retroactivity choice while rejecting the proposed 1 May cut-off.
concerns: The Afdeling finds unclear whether rejected applicants must reapply or are reassessed ex officio, and asks for clarification and specification of the group covered by transitional law.
The Afdeling notes that retroactive benefit for non-applicants raises implementation problems for municipalities and asks for a substantive justification beyond coalition agreements.
The Afdeling asks for an explanation of how public information on the transitional arrangement will be provided, given the tight notification deadline.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to explain when the transitional provision could lead to a higher benefit, with an example.
The Afdeling makes redactional comments on the wording of the proposed articles 78# and 41 WWB.

33286.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 by removing the words on a maximum detention of one month, and corrects a cross-reference in the Wet modern migratiebeleid. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: In Article 108, fifth paragraph, of the Vreemdelingenwet 2000, the words 'at most a detention of one month or a' are deleted.
In artikel 108, vijfde lid, van de Vreemdelingenwet 2000 vervallen de woorden «ten hoogste een hechtenis van een maand of een».

parties: Asks why the Vreemdelingenwet was not in line with European case law for so long and whether enforcement remains important, raising questions about the legal basis and rule of law.
Does this mean that the Dutch Aliens Act has not been in line with European case law all this time?
Betekent dit dat de Nederlandse Vreemdelingenwet al die tijd niet conform Europese jurisprudentie is geweest?
Supports the change so that European court rulings are respected, and questions whether treating nationals differently from non-nationals is legally tenable and equal.
Does the government consider it legally defensible to still impose detention on its own nationals for failing registration obligations while non-nationals are not threatened with it?

Acht de regering het in dit kader juridisch houdbaar om de eigen onderdanen voor het niet nakomen van inschrijfverplichtingen wel hechtenis op te leggen, terwijl niet-onderdanen daarmee niet worden bedreigd?
Opposes EU involvement in Dutch admission policy and asks for the reasoning of the case law and the expected level and enforcement of the fine.
How high will the fine be in practice and what happens when the fine is not paid, these members ask.
Hoe hoog zal de genoemde boete in de praktijk zijn en wat gebeurt er wanneer de boete niet betaald wordt, zo vragen deze leden.
Supports the bill but asks how the fine will be enforced if unpaid, and whether theoretical detention provisions in the Vreemdelingenwet should also be amended.
These members ask to what extent the detention mentioned in paragraphs 1 and 2 of article 108 VW is theoretical.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre de hechtenis genoemd in de leden 1 en 2 van art. 108 VW theoretisch is.

33295.s: The bill allows conservatory seizure of a suspect's assets to secure a victim's claim for damages, so that a future damages measure under article 36f of the Criminal Code can be enforced. It also adds a rule allowing oral authorisation by the investigating judge in cases of discovery in the act, and makes related technical amendments to the Code of Criminal Procedure, Criminal Code and the International Criminal Court Implementation Act.
33295.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as needed to let victims recover damages quickly and effectively, and to allow decisive action in urgent cases while keeping rule-of-law safeguards.
q: To be able to act decisively and effectively for victims while retaining the necessary rule-of-law safeguards for suspects, it is proposed that an ex ante oral authorisation may suffice.

Om toch daadkrachtig en effectief op te kunnen treden voor slachtoffers met behoud van de nodige rechtsstatelijke waarborgen voor verdachten, wordt voorgesteld dat dan met een ex ante mondelinge machtiging kan volstaan.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 103, derde lid Sv)
oral authorisation of seizure by investigating judge in cases of discovery in the act
p: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 103, derde lid Sv)

Allows seizure of a suspect's or third party's property on the prosecutor's request on the basis of an oral authorisation by the investigating judge, to be put in writing afterwards, in discovery-in-the-act cases.
Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 552a, eerste lid Sv)
Extends the complaint procedure so that the rightful claimant and the seized party may complain about non-application of the power in article 116(4) Sv.
Extends conservatory seizure of assets, to secure recovery of a damages measure, to suspects or third parties on the basis of suspicion of offences carrying a fourth-category fine.

parties: Supports the bill but asks why complex claims cannot be heard in separate damages hearings and questions the wrongful-seizure liability risk and the €5,000 threshold.
These members ask why these kinds of complex or extensive cases cannot be handled in separate damages hearings, for example before the cantonal judge.
Deze leden vragen waarom dit soort (complexe/omvangrijke) zaken niet in aparte schadezittingen, bij bijvoorbeeld de kantonrechter, kunnen worden behandeld.
Asks practical questions about revenue effects of prioritising victim compensation and the use of the existing seizure powers.
These members ask how the victim's own option to have conservatory seizure imposed on the suspect's assets relates to the proposed option for the state to do this on the victim's behalf.

Deze leden vragen hoe de mogelijkheid die het slachtoffer heeft om zelf conservatoir beslag te laten leggen op het vermogen van de verdachte zich verhoudt tot de voorgestelde mogelijkheid dat de staat dit voor het slachtoffer gaat doen.
Supports the measure and asks about the scope of seizable assets including wages, executory seizure and natural persons facing third-category fines.
At all times it must be prevented that collecting compensation is impossible because a suspect has (deliberately) disposed of assets.
Te allen tijde moet worden voorkomen dat inning van een schadevergoeding niet mogelijk is omdat een verdachte vermogen (bewust) heeft vervreemd.
Welcomes the improved victim position but questions the fourth-category threshold, the retroactive unlawfulness of seizure when no order is imposed, and the threshold for seizing low-value items.
They ask the government to clarify the words 'as a rule'.
Zij vragen de regering de woorden «in de regel» te verduidelijken.
Agrees with the principle but worries about rigid detention for unpaid compensation, the lack of individual tailoring, the threshold and financial investigation capacity.
They know of various practical examples of people who would like to pay the compensation but cannot.
Zij kennen diverse voorbeelden uit de praktijk van mensen die de schadevergoeding wel zouden willen, maar niet kunnen betalen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill allowing conservatory seizure of a suspect's assets to secure victim compensation orders, but raises concerns about applicability, oral authorisation by the examining judge, complaint rights against handing items to a reasonably entitled party, juveniles, and the seizure's use as leverage. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most points, adopting the oral-authorisation limits, the complaint right for interested parties, and removal of the drukmiddel wording, while rejecting the proposed new seizure ground and the juvenile-related changes.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned for which cases the seizure is intended and whether it would be effective, advising limiting use to sums above EUR 5,000; the government accepted by clarifying the scope with CJIB figures.

Oral authorisation by the examining judge in urgent cases was insufficiently justified; the Afdeling advised limiting it to cases of discovery in the act and requiring later written recording, which the government adopted.
The suspect lacked an explicit right to complain against the handing over of seized items to a reasonably entitled party; the government extended complaint rights to interested parties.

The explanatory memorandum suggested seizure could serve as leverage for a settlement, which is not a legal purpose under art. 94a Sv or art. 1 of the First Protocol; the government removed that wording.
Several technical drafting comments on articles I and 257a Sv were largely adopted, though the suggested change to the 126b Sv wording was not made.
The Afdeling proposed a new seizure ground for return to a reasonably entitled party, which the government rejected as unnecessary and unworkable given article 116 Sv.
The Afdeling flagged complications with juvenile suspects and parental liability and advised precisifying article 488a Sv; the government declined both, citing existing legal clarity.

33367.s: The bill abolishes the mandatory works-council training levy managed by the SER and shifts training costs onto employers, with the SER able to set guideline amounts for training costs. It also removes the compulsory mediation step at the company committee before going to court, and clarifies works-council information rights over international group control relationships.
33367.j: The memorandum justifies removing mandatory mediation by noting that parties often bypass it as an unnecessary step that lengthens proceedings, and that mediation remains possible voluntarily.
q: Under the bill it is no longer mandatory to first seek advice from the company committee before turning to the court in cases on compliance with this act.
Het is op basis van het wetsvoorstel niet meer verplicht dat eerst advies wordt gevraagd aan de bedrijfscommissie voordat men zich kan wenden tot de rechter in zaken over de naleving van deze wet.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 22, derde lid WOR)
SER sets guideline amounts (richtbedragen) for training costs
p: Removes the mandatory prior referral to the company committee for mediation before works councils or employers can go to court, lowering a procedural hurdle to judicial recourse.

parties: Asks which mandatory costs disappear with the levy, what happens to the GBIO institute, how the guideline amount is built up, and why an extra article is needed beside existing WOR article 22.
Why does the government consider an extra article necessary, especially given the first paragraph of article 22 of the WOR?
Waarom acht de regering een extra artikel noodzakelijk, zeker gezien het eerste lid van artikel 22 in de WOR.
Worries that about 15.7 million euro of mandatory levy disappears without a guarantee that works council training will be funded, and that small firms may give members less or no training.
The PvdA faction is concerned that from 2013 15.7 million euro of mandatory levy disappears, but this amount will no longer be invested in training of works council members through self-regulation.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie maken zich zorgen over de mogelijkheid dat er per 2013 voor € 15,7 miljoen aan verplichte heffing verdwijnt, maar dit bedrag middels zelfregulering niet meer in de scholing en vorming van OR-leden zal worden geïnvesteerd.

Asks whether a training budget can be fixed for the whole term under article 22(4) and why the advice to keep a voluntary mediation body was not followed, and why paragraphs 3 and 4 of article 36 WOR are struck.
The members ask why paragraphs 3 and 4 of article 36 WOR are being deleted in their entirety.
De leden vragen waarom lid 3 en 4 van artikel 36 WOR in hun geheel worden geschrapt.
Supports abolishing the levy but asks whether guideline training amounts are binding and whether employers may dispute costs, creating friction with works councils.
Is there not a risk that in practice discussions will arise between unwilling employers and the works council about the costs to be reimbursed?
Bestaat niet het risico dat in de praktijk discussies gaan ontstaan tussen onwillende werkgevers en OR over de te vergoeden kosten?

Asks why training costs become subject to agreement between employer and works council given the council's dependent position, and warns that a guideline could have a normative effect that limits works council budgets or excuses minimal employer payment.
Is the tightening of the reimbursement obligation not largely undone by this amendment?
Wordt de aanscherping van de vergoedingsplicht niet in belangrijke mate ongedaan gemaakt door deze wijziging?

33400-IV.s: The bill sets the 2013 budget statement for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV), fixing expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros and setting entry into force as 1 January 2013. The explanatory memorandum covers the Kingdom's guarantee function, financial oversight of Curaçao and Sint Maarten by the College financieel toezicht, and budget items for rule of law cooperation.
33400-IV.j: The memorandum explains that the Kingdom may take measures in cases of serious breaches of fundamental rights, but gives no separate justification for new delegated powers.
q: The Kingdom government may take measures if there is a serious breach of fundamental rights and freedoms in a country
De Koninkrijksregering kan maatregelen nemen, als er sprake is van ernstige inbreuk op fundamentele rechten en vrijheden in een land

33400-VI.s: This bill fixes the 2013 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Security and Justice, covering policy articles (police, legal procedure, security, sanctions, youth, counterterrorism) and operational agencies such as DJI, CJIB, NFI, Dienst Justis and GDI. It also confirms that the minister is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Raad voor de rechtspraak.

33439.s: The bill amends the Justice Subsidies Act to align it with government subsidy guidelines, broadening crime prevention and aftercare subsidies, shifting certain subsidy rules from policy guidelines to ministerial regulations, and adding a chapter on subsidies for parental international child abduction. It also removes the tolkencentra and some debt-relief and Halt provisions and makes several subsidy-allocation and ceiling powers explicit.
33439.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation power as necessary to align with the Awb and because policy rules have a less binding character than regulations, and the ceiling power as required to comply with Awb article 4:26.
q: By ministerial regulation, rules may be laid down concerning the subsidies referred to in article 34.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen regels worden gesteld omtrent de subsidies, bedoeld in artikel 34.
d: rules on crime prevention, terrorism prevention, aftercare and volunteer subsidies
minister sets subsidy ceiling and allocation of available amount
subsidy ceiling and further rules on parental child abduction subsidies
p: Replaces the power to issue non-binding policy rules with a binding ministerial regulation covering subsidy criteria, conditions and procedures, which the bill says is more binding in character.
The minister may set a subsidy ceiling and decide how the available amount is divided, as the memorandum notes this is required under Awb article 4:26.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet Justitie-subsidies to align it with the Aanwijzingen voor subsidieverstrekking, supporting its aim but raising remarks on applying Awb section 4.2.8 and on subsidy deadlines. The government's nader rapport accepts the reference to section 4.2.8 for crime prevention and restores the reference, while explaining the retained 13-week deadlines.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the choice to apply Awb section 4.2.8 per subsidy item be explained in light of the €125,000 threshold, and the government explained the crime-prevention exception and restored the reference.
The Afdeling asked for motivation for deviating from the six-month deadline of Awb 4:74 for Halt-bureaus, and the government justified the shortened 13-week term by reference to the Aanwijzingen.

The Afdeling asked for justification of the 13-week decision deadline for subsidy-settlement requests under the 22-week standard in the Aanwijzingen, and the government kept 13 weeks as a voortvarend-bestuur choice without fully adopting the Afdeling's requested alignment.

33466.s: The bill amends the Dutch Environmental Management Act and the Economic Offences Act to align Dutch emissions trading rules with two new EU regulations on monitoring, reporting and verification, removing or redirecting national ministerial-regulation powers. It transfers several monitoring and verification matters to the EU regulations and gives the emissions authority (NEa) its own sanctioning and appeal powers.
33466.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical and legal-technical alignment with new EU regulations that moved monitoring and verification rules from ministerial regulation to EU level, avoiding overlap.
q: the bill is therefore purely an editorial and legal-technical adjustment to the shift of monitoring and verification rules to a different level of regulation (from ministerial regulation to EU regulation)
het wetsvoorstel betreft dan ook louter een redactionele en juridisch-technische aanpassing aan de verschuiving van voorschriften voor monitoring en verificatie naar een ander niveau van regelgeving
d: further rules implementing EU monitoring regulation and emissions reports
rules implementing EU verification and accreditation regulation
rules on free allocation of emission allowances
p: The minister decides free allocation of emission allowances per trading period, subject to the emissions authority's powers under Article 16.31.
The emissions authority board may determine that an emissions report does not meet requirements, after the reporting party has been heard under Article 16.17.
Adds new prohibitions tied to EU regulation provisions, enforceable by the emissions authority's administrative sanctions.

parties: The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
Asks who checks the emission factor that operators determine themselves when non-sustainable biomass is used.
If non-sustainable biomass is used, the operator must determine the emission factor itself, these members note.
Als niet-duurzame biomassa wordt ingezet moet de exploitant zelf de emissiefactor bepalen, zo constateren deze leden.
The members of the PVV faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
The members of the SP faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
The members of the CDA faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
Questions the delegation of rules to ministerial regulation and the breadth of the delegation grounds, and asks why free allocation provisions are needed.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
The members of the GroenLinks faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
The members of the SGP faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de SGP-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
The members of the Partij voor de Dieren faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de Partij voor de Dieren-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
The members of the 50PLUS faction have taken note of the bill and have no questions on it at this time.
De leden van de 50PLUS-fractie hebben kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill aligning the Dutch Environmental Management Act with two directly applicable EU regulations on ETS monitoring, reporting and verification, and recommended dropping retroactive effect of the monitoring-plan obligation. The government's reply states the retroactivity clause was removed and most drafting remarks were followed, except two.
concerns: The retroactive effect of the obligation to submit a revised monitoring plan from 1 August 2012 is unnecessary and could give rise to disputes, so the Afdeling advised deleting Article IV, second paragraph.
Several redactional remarks on definitions, cross-references and wording were adopted, with the third and sixth remarks not followed.

33475.s: The bill amends the Dutch Foreign Workers Employment Act (Wet arbeid vreemdelingen) to tighten conditions for issuing work permits, including new refusal and revocation grounds tied to employer labour-law fines and convictions, a five-year work-permit threshold for residence-permit annotations, and shorter permit periods. It also removes suspensive effect of objections and appeals against permit revocation and lets ministerial and general administrative orders set quotas and exceptions.
33475.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as preventing strategic behaviour by employers who use suspensive appeals to keep workers in place and as ensuring permits serve the Dutch national interest.
q: It is desirable to remove the suspensive effect that objection and appeal against revocation of the work permit currently has.
Het is wenselijk de schorsende werking die uitgaat van het aantekenen van bezwaar en beroep tegen intrekking van de tewerkstellingsvergunning te schrappen.
d: limits on number of work permits per category
exemptions from labour-market tests for asylum seekers with a document
categories of work excluded from foreign labour permits
exemptions from labour-market tests and vacancy notification in specified cases
categories of foreigners receiving unrestricted work annotation
p: Permits may be refused or revoked based on employer administrative fines or criminal convictions within five years, expanding ministerial discretion over employers.
Removes the suspensive effect of objections and appeals against permit revocation, so revocations take effect before judicial review ends.
Art. I.B and Art. I.G (art. 5, art. 11)
Minister is competent to issue and revoke work permits and permits are limited to one year, with limited extension possibilities.

parties: Asks how UWV will test sufficient job seekers, how quotas are set, and how the labour-market test and refusal grounds will work in practice.
Asks how UWV's discretionary power to refuse permits for work-related offences will be framed and on what criteria the sector-level assessment will rest.
Is the discretionary power also framed in some way?
Is de discretionaire bevoegdheid ook op een bepaalde manier ingekaderd?

Argues the provisions are too vague ('caoutchouc-artikel'), that the employer definition should be widened to affiliated entities, and that contract-based circumvention of pay rules must be prevented.
In the proposed current form, the PVV members consider the relevant article a 'rubber article'.
In de voorgestelde huidige vorm achten de leden van de PVV-fractie het desbetreffende wetsartikel een «caoutchouc-artikel».
Asks how the labour-market test works if the market is inefficient, what role municipalities play, and how sector effort can be expected once the PBO is abolished.
Can the government, besides the role of UWV and job seekers, also address the role of municipalities?
Kan de regering naast op de rol van het UWV en werkzoekenden bovendien ingaan op de rol van gemeenten?
Asks for criteria on the abstract labour-market test and quotas, whether a law change is needed for quotas, and how competing employers would be prioritised.
First, these members ask on what criteria it is determined whether a quota is imposed.
Ten eerste vragen deze leden op basis van welke criteria wordt vastgesteld of er een quotum wordt opgelegd.
Asks on what criteria sector sufficiency and quotas are determined, and how the discretionary power of UWV will be used.
Can the government explain on what criteria UWV may use the discretionary power?
Kan de regering nader toelichten op basis van welke criteria het UWV gebruik kan maken van de discretionaire bevoegdheid?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion supports the draft amendment of the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen but raises objections on the altered priority-labour-supply test, the increased burden on employers, and incompatibility with EU-Turkey Association Law stand-still clauses. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice, adding the burden analysis and a specific clause excluding Turkish nationals with Association rights from the restrictions.
concerns: The proposed restrictions (one-year permit validity, abolition of extension, quotas, refusal/revocation powers) conflict with stand-still clauses and Associatierecht rights of Turkish workers, so a specific exclusion clause is needed.

The shift from availability to presence in the priority-labour test lays the burden on employers without addressing the roles of job seekers, municipalities and UWV; the memorandum was supplemented but the policy rationale remains contested.
The cumulative administrative burden on SMEs from annual renewal of vacancy lists and the five-year TWV obligation is insufficiently offset, and the explanatory memorandum should address it.
A redactional remark recommends replacing the reference to Regulation 1612/68 with Regulation 492/2011 on free movement of workers.

33484.s: The bill amends the Code of Civil Procedure and the Civil Code to make forced sales of immovable property more transparent and accessible, by allowing internet auctions, publishing sale conditions online, capping buyer costs for residential property, and requiring the mortgagee to invoke the tenancy clause and obtain court permission before eviction. It also adds a duty for occupants to allow viewings and tightens the procedures for eviction and management powers over mortgaged property.
33484.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new powers as making executive auctions more transparent, faster and more accessible, and as protecting buyers and the value of the property.
q: To make the executory auction more transparent, everything must be done to provide potential buyers with as much good information as possible before the auction.
Om de executoriale veiling transparanter te maken dient alles in het werk te worden gesteld om voorafgaand aan de veiling de potentiële koper zoveel mogelijk van goede informatie te voorzien.
d: technical safeguards and security standards for internet auction websites
p: Mortgagees may take over mortgaged property and evict occupants, with court authorisation required and the tenant exception retained.
Mortgagor and occupants must tolerate notices and viewings, which the mortgagee may enforce with the sterke arm.
Eviction after auction requires a bailiff's order and a three-day period, giving the occupant opportunity to seek judicial review before eviction."}],

parties: Asks whether the mortgagee's duty to invoke the tenancy clause is too burdensome and what the legal position of an unknown tenant would be after a forced sale.
Does this not place too much burden on the mortgagee?
Belast dit de hypotheekhouder niet te veel?
Argues the 8-day period for auction conditions is too short for consumers who are not property specialists and wants at least 30 days.
These members believe a period of at least 30 days is necessary to give consumers reasonable time to inform themselves properly, as they are not property specialists.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat een termijn van minimaal 30 dagen noodzakelijk is om consumenten redelijkerwijs de tijd te gunnen zich goed te informeren.
Questions whether the proposed three-month maximum eviction period gives tenants a reasonable time to find replacement housing, especially with minor children.
These members, like the NOvA advisory committee, ask whether a three-month term gives the tenant a reasonable period to find replacement housing.

Voornoemde leden vragen, net als de Adviescommissie Huurrecht van de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten (NOvA) of met de termijn van drie maanden de huurder een redelijke termijn wordt geboden vervangende woonruimte te vinden.
Questions the reduction of the eviction period to three months and the compulsory viewing of homes, which may infringe privacy and family life, asking about safeguards and sanctions.
These members understand that a viewing can contribute positively to higher proceeds and attendance, but that does not change that the measure is very intrusive.
Deze leden begrijpen dat een bezichtiging een positieve bijdrage kan leveren aan een hogere opbrengst en opkomst, maar dat neemt niet weg dat de maatregel erg ingrijpend is.
Asks whether forced viewings and forced sales can be avoided for cooperative homeowners and whether the bill is sufficient to protect owners from unnecessary executions.
Can it clarify how often forced auctions are announced in situations that can demonstrably be resolved in the short term?
Kan zij duidelijk maken hoe vaak executieveilingen worden aangezegd in situaties die aantoonbaar op korte termijn oplosbaar zijn?
Asks whether the three-day warning period before eviction allows occupants to have a judge review the eviction, and questions the vagueness of the term 'beheer' for mortgagees.
The three-day period is however short to give the occupant a realistic opportunity to find a lawyer.
De termijn van drie dagen is echter kort om de bewoner een reële gelegenheid te geven een advocaat te zoeken.
Questions whether a three-month maximum eviction period is sufficient given the tight housing market and asks about investigating conditions for mandatory landlord consent.
The D66 members ask the government to explain why it considers a maximum eviction period of three months for the tenant sufficient.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering toe te lichten waarom zij een maximum ontruimingstermijn van drie maanden door de huurder voldoende acht.
Asks whether the concept of 'beheer' in article 3:267 is sufficiently clear and responds to fears it will cause problems in practice.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill to make executory auctions of immovable property more transparent and accessible, including online publication, cost allocation, a viewing clause and tenancy and eviction rules, but raises many technical objections, notably on the shipping exception, the 'gegronde redenen' test, the eviction clause and transitional law. The minister's reply largely follows the advice, adopting online publication of veiling conditions, deleting the bidder-solvency provision, moving the risk transfer to registration, requiring a judge's authorisation for the take-over clause and revising transitional law.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the risk of loss or damage pass only on registration of the transfer, rather than by contractual clause, which the government adopted with a statutory change to article 517 Rv.
The Afdeling asked that the take-over clause (onder zich nemen) require a judge's authorisation, which the government adopted in a revised article 3:267 BW.
The Afdeling said the bidder-solvency provision in article 519c Rv added nothing to existing law and should be dropped, which the government accepted.

The Afdeling questioned whether the damage-deduction provision (article 524b) has real added value and whether it departs unjustifiably from normal practice; the government kept the mechanism but moved the risk transfer.
The Afdeling said the 'gegronde redenen' exception to invoking the tenancy clause was unclear and that GBA registration is not reliable, leading to a reformulated article 3:264 BW.

The Afdeling said the transitional provision on the viewing clause interferes with the freedom of contract of existing mortgagors and suggested reconsidering it; the government revised the transitional law.
The Afdeling asked that the online announcement be visible for at least thirty days and that the shipping regime not be changed silently, both addressed in the reply.
The Afdeling offered a list of redactional comments on the text, which the government says were taken into account.

33493.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998, the Gas Act and the Heat Act to clarify grid connection definitions, introduce grid protection and gas quality rules, and create a new electronic system for guarantees of origin for renewable energy, with the Minister responsible and powers to be set by ministerial regulation. It also adds a Minister's binding instruction power to protect grids against external influences and empowers the Minister to set gas specifications by ministerial regulation.
33493.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation for gas specifications by the need to respond quickly to changing gas composition and the public interest in user safety.
q: That is why it was chosen not to include these specifications, which relate to user safety, in the technical conditions but in a directly operative ministerial regulation.
Daarom is gekozen om deze specificaties, die verband houden met de veiligheid van gebruikers, niet in de technische voorwaarden op te nemen, maar in een direct werkende ministeriële regeling.
d: binding instructions to grid operators on protection against external influences
binding instructions to gas grid operator on protection against external influences
fees and rules for guarantees of origin for electricity
mandating guarantee of origin tasks to an independent body
transport tariff charged to producers feeding into networks
fees and rules for heat guarantees of origin
fees and rules for gas guarantees of origin
p: The Minister may issue binding instructions to grid operators on protection against external influences, with no stated limit or review beyond the operators' own responsibility.
Gas quality specifications, which relate to user safety, are moved from technical codes into a directly operative ministerial regulation, allowing quick changes outside parliamentary scrutiny.

parties: Asks whether shifting gas quality specifications from the NMa regulator to a ministerial regulation undermines the independent regulator's role.
By setting the feed-in and delivery specifications via a ministerial regulation, does the government not instruct the NMa, although under the gas directive this is a task belonging to the regulator?

Geeft de regering door het vaststellen van de invoed- en afleverspecificaties via een MR niet een instructie aan de NMa, dat op grond van de gasrichtlijn (2009/73/EG) een taak is die toebehoort aan de toezichthouder?
Generally positive about the proposed amendments but has further questions on several points.
The members are generally positive about the proposed amendments.
De leden zijn over het algemeen positief over de voorgestelde wijzigingen.
Worried that loosening the net-metering limit and allowing non-specification gas raises costs and reduces control, asking whether the NMa can supervise all regional network operators.
For these members, feeding in green gas must not lead to higher costs in any way, and they want to know whether the NMa is able to supervise this properly at all regional network operators.

Wat deze leden betreft mag de invoeding van groen gas op geen enkele wijze leiden tot hogere kosten en de leden willen dan ook graag weten of de NMA in staat is hier ook bij alle regionale netbeheerders goed op toe te zien?
Insists that the criteria underlying the ministerial regulation on gas composition be written into the law itself rather than left to delegated rules.
The SP members urge that the criteria underlying the ministerial regulation be included in the law.
De leden van de SP-fractie dringen erop aan dat de criteria die ten grondslag liggen aan de MR in de wet worden opgenomen.
Argues the proposed net-metering change does not implement the motion for owners' associations and questions the fairness and administrative burden for consumers.
The CDA members therefore find that the proposed amendment does not give effect to the motion of member Paulus Jansen et al.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vinden daarom dat met de voorgestelde aanpassing geen uitwerking wordt gegeven aan de motie van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s.

Asks for a careful process with possible objections, questions the use of ministerial rules rather than an AMvB, and requests information on a possible minority privatisation and the vague grounds for directives to network operators.
In the view of these members, setting the gas composition requirements could have far-reaching consequences for the energy system and the parties involved in the coming years.
Naar mening van deze leden heeft het bepalen van de eisen aan de gassamenstelling potentieel de komende jaren vergaande gevolgen voor de energiehuishouding en betrokken partijen.
Asks how the network operators' duty of care for safe gas installations is legally established after feeding in deviating gas, and asks about the government's criteria for certification.
The ChristenUnie members ask about the network operators' duty of care for the safe functioning of gas installations and appliances of connected customers.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen naar de zorgplicht van netbeheerders voor het veilig functioneren van gasinstallaties en toestellen bij aangeslotenen.

33538.s: The bill amends the Dutch childcare and preschool quality act to strengthen child safety, transparency and inspection of childcare and host-parent care, including a continuous VOG (certificate of conduct) screening regime and mandatory reporting duties. It also shifts registration and removal powers over childcare and preschool entries to the municipal college and the Minister, and extends the foreign childcare register.
33538.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new powers by child safety, the need for faster intervention than periodic screening allows, and the goal of reducing public inspection over time through greater private quality assurance.
q: The purpose of the LRKP is broader than merely making registered childcare institutions findable.
Het doel van het LRKP is breder dan enkel het vindbaar maken van de ingeschreven kinderopvanginstellingen.
d: further rules on removing or amending register entries
rules on data for foreign childcare registration and its duration
designating categories of foreign facilities treated as registered
further rules on certificate of conduct duties
information childcare centres must publish to parents and public
p: Gives the Minister and municipal colleges power to amend or remove register entries without a prior request from the operator.
Minister is given responsibility for a foreign childcare register supporting enforcement and quality assurance, with details left to decree.
Continuous VOG screening lets inspectors require repeat certificates from staff and from household members aged 12 and over on suspicion of offences, without a fixed statutory trigger.

parties: Asks about the delay between a screening hit and informing the employee, the legal position of staff, and how the protocol and data linkage will be governed.
The VVD members find the chain between a hit arising and informing the employee still very long.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden de keten tussen het ontstaan van een «hit» en het informeren van de werknemer nog altijd erg lang.
Supports continuous screening but asks about the timeline for full coverage and the costs involved.
The PvdA members note that the baseline check concerns 150,000 persons working in the sector.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie constateren dat de nulmeting betrekking heeft op 150.000 personen die werkzaam zijn in de sector.
Asks about the legal position of staff after a hit, possible suspension and dismissal, and the weight given to foreign certificates of conduct.
What is the (employment law) position of the employee at the moment they are told that a new VOG must be applied for?
Wat is de (arbeidsrechtelijke) rechtspositie van de medewerker op het moment dat hem medegedeeld wordt dat een nieuwe VOG moet worden aangevraagd?
Sees continuous screening as an improvement but questions the reporting duty, the discretionary 'kan' provision for staff, and whether enforcement by the GGD will work.
What if the GGD decides not to conduct an investigation? Does the government think the provider's reporting duty is sufficiently secured in this way?
Wat als de GGD besluit om geen onderzoek in te stellen? Is de regering van mening dat de meldplicht van de houder op deze manier voldoende geborgd is?
Questions the necessity and proportionality of continuous screening as an intrusion on privacy and its compatibility with Article 8 ECHR.
These members ask in particular how the government intends to prevent this bill from conflicting with Article 8 of the ECHR.
Deze leden vragen daarbij met name in te gaan op de vraag hoe de regering denkt te voorkomen dat dit wetsvoorstel strijdig is met artikel 8 van het EVRM.
Asks about the framing of additional measures, the long-term full register, and the controllability of checks on persons aged twelve and over at the address.
They ask in what form these additional measures will take shape in the law or in sectoral guidelines.
Zij vragen zich af in welke hoedanigheid deze aanvullende maatregelen vorm krijgen in de wet of in (sectorale) richtlijnen.
Asks on what statutory basis the Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur for information exchange rests and when the Chamber will be informed about it.
On the basis of which statutory article is the mentioned Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur made possible, these members want to know.
