Op basis van welk wetsartikel wordt de genoemde Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur mogelijk wordt gemaakt, zo willen deze leden weten.
Supports quality improvement and safeguards but questions whether imposing a website duty on private providers respects subsidiarity and freedom of business.
From the standpoint of subsidiarity, is there sufficient ground to infringe on the freedom of business?
Is er vanuit het oogpunt van subsidiariteit voldoende grond om inbreuk te kunnen maken op het recht van vrije bedrijfsuitoefening?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the Verzamelwet kinderopvang 2013 but raises objections on proportionality and scope of continuous screening of childcare workers, the necessity of mandatory websites for childcare providers, publication of GGD inspection reports about home-based childminders (privacy), and the heavier information duty for parents using foreign childcare. The minister's nader rapport largely accepts the advice on motivating continuous screening and the register of foreign childcare, but rejects anonymisation of GGD reports and the single central website, and partly adjusts the wording of the register duty.
concerns: Continuous screening of all childcare workers' criminal records is disproportionate without concrete suspicion and needs better justification and scope analysis, which the minister supplied in an expanded memorie van toelichting without changing the scheme.

Publishing GGD inspection reports on home childminders with names and addresses, without anonymisation, may breach privacy and data protection rules; the minister rejected anonymisation but added a legal basis and justification.
Publication of GGD reports via each childminder agency's own website, rather than one central site, risks inconsistent privacy protection; the minister rejected the central-site alternative.

The necessity of a mandatory website for every childcare provider is not adequately justified given falling waiting lists and the current coverage of the voluntary Kinderopvangkaart; the minister did not substantively address this.

Shifting the duty to report changes to foreign childcare registration onto parents imposes a heavy burden and weakens parents' legal position; the minister narrowed the duty to easily verifiable data but kept it on parents.
Transitional rules for the nulmeting of VOGs risk leaving workers unable to work if COVOG cannot process applications in time; the minister explained capacity and enforcement arrangements.
Various wording and cross-reference adjustments were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum for clarity and consistency.

33556.s: The omnibus bill (Verzamelwet SZW 2013) amends many social security laws, mainly to allow the SVB and UWV to offset administrative fines against claims held by the fined person, to make compensation for certain benefit recipients require an application, to remove the requirement to fix medical protocols by ministerial regulation, and to adjust various technical provisions across the sector. It also grants further rule-making powers to the Minister and some implementing bodies through ministerial regulations.
33556.j: The memorandum justifies the offset powers and ministerial regulations on administrative and practical grounds, such as enforceability and avoiding loss of income-related supplements, and notes that removing protocol regulations reduces administrative burden.
q: Without prejudice to the first paragraph, the Social Insurance Bank may offset the administrative fine against a claim that the person on whom the administrative fine was imposed has against it.
Onverminderd het eerste lid kan de Sociale verzekeringsbank de bestuurlijke boete verrekenen met een vordering die degene aan wie de bestuurlijke boete is opgelegd op hem heeft.
d: further rules on compensation for seizure-free amount
further rules on released amount for seizure
indexation of amounts announced by the Minister in Staatscourant
rules on information provision and record-keeping to the Minister
Artikel XXII, K (Wet werk en bijstand, art. 69, lid 3)
rules on distribution of benefit funds among municipalities
re-determination of daily wage for employees falling ill later
rules for tax credit for partial-year premium liability
Artikel IX, A (WAO art. 18, lid 10) and corresponding articles
removal of requirement to fix medical protocols by ministerial regulation
Artikel XXI, B (Wet WAJONG art. 2:5, lid 5)
p: Artikel I, B; II, C; III, B; VIII; and similar offset provisions
Administrative bodies may offset administrative fines against benefit claims held by the fined person, expanding executive recovery powers over citizens' income.
Artikel XXI, B; Artikel XVI, A
Schattingsbesluit under the Wajong may depart from the statute by general administrative order, shifting detailed rule-making from parliament to the executive.
Artikel XXII, D; Artikel XXIII, H and similar
The Schattingsbesluit and benefit provisions grant the executive wider discretion in determining benefit levels and eligibility without parliamentary review.

parties: Asks whether the bill's rules on setting the free amount for debt recovery will be set by general administrative order, whether that order has a pre-consultation procedure, and wants the scientific basis of medical assessment safeguarded after protocols leave the ministerial regulation.
Which further rules can be set by general administrative order? Does the still-to-be-shaped general administrative order in this area have a pre-consultation procedure?
Welke nadere regels kunnen bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden gesteld? Kent de nog vorm te geven algemene maatregel van bestuur op dit vlak een voorhangprocedure?

Welcomes the temporisation of the tax credit reduction but asks how the ministry will set rules on the provision of information and access to data by the UWV through ministerial regulation, and what the basis was for medical protocols in regulation.
In what way will the government further elaborate the rules on the provision of information and access to data and documents by the UWV through ministerial regulation?
Op welke manier gaat de regering de regels ten aanzien van de verstrekking van inlichtingen en inzage in gegevens en bescheiden door het UWV nader uitwerken bij ministeriële regeling?

Criticises the tightening of WWB obligations and repressive sanctions instead of preventive measures and tailored support, and asks whether medical protocols will be publicly available and what legal status they will have outside a ministerial regulation.

Does the government share the view that it is preferable for municipalities first to engage in conversation with benefit recipients who 'provide insufficient cooperation' rather than immediately presenting a punitive reduction?

Deelt de regering de mening dat het wenselijker is dat er vanuit de gemeenten eerst het gesprek wordt aangegaan met bijstandsgerechtigden wanneer zij «onvoldoende medewerking verlenen» in plaats van direct een strafkorting te presenteren?
Asks about the rules the UWV information-access powers will be elaborated into by ministerial regulation and raises hardship-clause concerns for childcare allowance for grandparent cohabitants.
which rules on the provision of information and access to data and documents by the UWV the government intends to further elaborate.
welke regels ten aanzien van de verstrekking van inlichtingen en inzage in gegevens en bescheiden door het UWV de regering voornemens is nader uit te werken.
Asks how the government will elaborate rules on UWV information access by ministerial regulation and what the consequences of the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling were for benefit payments.

Can the government explain to the PVV and SP factions what consequences the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on the term 'insufficient cooperation' under the duty to provide information has had for benefit payments?

Kan de regering nader toelichten aan de leden van de PVV- en de SP-fracties welke gevolgen de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep ten aanzien van het begrip «onvoldoende medewerking verlenen» bij de inlichtingenplicht heeft gehad op de uitkeringsverstrekkingen?
Asks how UWV information-access rules will be elaborated by ministerial regulation and about communication of retroactive changes and the compensation regulation's rules.

The CDA and ChristenUnie factions further ask in what way the government will elaborate the rules on the provision of information and access to data and documents by the UWV through ministerial regulation.

De leden van de CDA- en ChristenUnie-fracties vragen voorts op welke manier de regering de regels ten aanzien van de verstrekking van inlichtingen en inzage in gegevens en bescheiden door het UWV nader gaat uitwerken bij ministeriële regeling.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the Verzamelwet SZW 2013 but asks for changes to the removal of the requirement that scientific insights for insurance-physician protocols be fixed by ministerial regulation, and for clarification on consultation with Caribbean Netherlands authorities. The government's nader rapport adds the requested motivation and information on the BES islands and adopts the editorial remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling asks why the statutory obligation for insurance physicians to use scientific insights should remain in the law once protocols are used anyway, and the government added a motivation to the explanatory memorandum.

The explanatory memorandum does not say whether the BES island administrations requested consultation on the maximum daily wage in the Wet ongevallenverzekering BES, and the government added a passage on how they will be informed.
Several editorial remarks on the bill and explanatory memorandum were adopted and technical changes made.

33565.s: The bill amends the General Pensions Act for political office holders (Algemene pensioenwet politieke ambtsdragers) to raise the pensionable age to the statutory pension age and to restructure the pension scheme for ministers, members of parliament, provincial executives and aldermen, moving to a final-salary-to-average accrual model with a number of transitional and recalculation rules. It defers most implementing details to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial rules, and allows pension entitlements to be reduced in line with ABP fund reductions.
33565.j: The memorandum justifies the broad use of delegation by stating that the new scheme is considerably more complex than the current one and that a full overhaul of the Appa is too far-reaching given the implementation deadline, so a bounded delegation is seen as appropriate.
q: But a comprehensive revision of the Appa goes too far now – certainly given the deadline by which the change must be introduced.
Maar een algehele herziening van de Appa voert nu te ver – zeker gelet op de termijn waarop de wijziging ingevoerd moet worden.
d: detailed rules on accrual, pensionable salary, recalculation, conversions, franchise, small-pension buy-out
rules on survivor and orphan pension determination in connection with the Appa transition
Artikel I, M (artikel 28a) and U (artikel 74a), AG (artikel 151a)
rules on buy-out of small survivor and temporary pensions
rules on accrual for service years before 2014 and transitional calculation
rules on survivor and orphan pensions for members of the Tweede Kamer, Eerste Kamer, and provincial bodies
p: The Minister may reduce pension entitlements and pensions in line with reductions decided by the ABP pension fund, after only informing the affected persons with a one-month waiting period.
Artikel I, AJ (artikel 163g) and P (artikel 40b), X (artikel 85b)
Pension entitlements accrued before the Appa transition may be reduced retroactively from 1 January 2013, with no further safeguards in the bill.
Artikel I, F (artikel 13c, lid 5 en 13e lid 3)
Accrual can be set to zero and pension amounts varied over time; these choices rest on individual request and do not involve the executive imposing changes directly.
The law and implementing measures may be given retroactive effect to 1 January 2013, allowing AMvB and ministerial rules to reach back in time.

parties: Asks how cutting accrued pension rights for former political office holders squares with legal certainty and whether retroactive effects apply.
These former political office holders were entitled to form expectations from the legal position regulation and the law in force.
Deze oud politieke ambtsdragers hebben toch verwachtingen mogen ontlenen aan de rechtspositieregeling en de geldende wet.
Asks about the lack of supervision of Appa pensions compared with pension funds and whether the government will address the risks of decentralised administration.

Will the government also address aspects such as the lack of control over Appa pensions which, unlike pension funds, are not supervised by De Nederlandsche Bank and the Authority for the Financial Markets?

Zal de regering daarbij ook in gaan op aspecten zoals het gebrek aan controle op Appa-pensioenen die, in tegenstelling tot pensioenfondsen, niet onder toezicht van de Nederlandse Bank en de Autoriteit Financiële Markten staan?

Criticises the selective alignment and the retained special unemployment and disability arrangements for political office holders, and notes parliament would otherwise repeatedly debate its own pensions.
These members note that the government is selective.
Deze leden constateren dat de regering selectief is.
Supports the government's premise of a balanced contribution from political office holders and asks clarifying questions on the transition and the financing decision.

They endorse the government's premise that by shaping the reduction in the same way as for public sector employees, a balanced contribution is asked of political office holders towards moderating pensions, which also proves necessary elsewhere in society.

Zij onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van de regering, dat «door de regeling van de verlaging op dezelfde leest te schoeien als die bij overheidswerknemers, van de politieke ambtsdragers een evenwichtige bijdrage [wordt] gevraagd aan een versobering van de pensioenen, die ook elders in de maatschappij noodzakelijk blijkt».

Asks why implementing rules are left to a general administrative order rather than the statute, asks about financing risks and effectiveness of fragmented administration, and presses for a timetable on the Dijkstal proposal.
They ask for further explanation of this choice.
Zij vragen nadere toelichting over deze keuze.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill adjusting the Appa pension for political office holders to the rising AOW and pension age, but raises concerns about partial adjustment without the broader shift to middle-salary schemes and transfer to ABP, unexplained extension of the unemployment-style benefit period, unexplained automatic linkage of pension cuts to ABP cuts, and an overly broad delegation to lower regulation. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely explains the choices, accepts the request to clarify the middle-salary and delegation issues, limits delegation to general administrative orders, and makes several textual clarifications.
concerns: The very broad delegation basis in article 14 needs solid justification and should be limited to general administrative orders; the government narrowed it to AMvB level and argued the complexity justifies delegation, while retaining some ministerial adjustment of amounts.

The partial adjustment should be placed in the perspective of the broader shift toward middle-salary schemes and possible transfer to ABP; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum but did not commit to the broader shift.

The extended unemployment-style benefit period for political office holders should be explained in light of recent cuts for employees; the government stated no change in duration is intended in this bill.

The automatic linkage between cuts to ABP pensions and Appa pensions requires explanation; the government justified it through the coupling principle and expanded the explanation in the general part of the memorandum.
Several textual clarifications and removal of obsolete references were made in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

33619.s: The bill amends the Youth Care Act so that the Inspectie jeugdzorg may file disciplinary complaints within a professional disciplinary system, and extends the professional accountability rules (verantwoorde werktoedeling) to particular youth detention institutions, Halt bureaus and related bodies by reference. It enables the professionalisation of youth care professions, with the detailed rules left to a general administrative order (AMvB) to be issued later.
33619.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to set professional quality rules and says the Wet op de jeugdzorg already offers sufficient possibilities to set such rules by AMvB.
q: By general administrative order, further rules on this matter may be laid down.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen ter zake nadere regels worden gesteld.
d: Artikel I (new lid 10 of Wet op de jeugdzorg art. 47)
further rules on disciplinary complaints by Inspectie jeugdzorg
Artikel II (Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen art. 3b, via reference to Wet op de jeugdzorg art. 25 and 28)
responsibility allocation rules applied to private youth institutions via referenced provisions
Artikel III (Wet Justitie-subsidies art. 48g lid 6, via reference)
responsibility allocation rules applied to Halt bureaus via referenced provisions
p: Artikel I (Wet op de jeugdzorg art. 47 lid 10)
Gives Inspectie jeugdzorg officials standing to file disciplinary complaints within a professional body's system, with details left to an AMvB.

parties: Asks whether the Inspectorate can file disciplinary complaints and how review of the exception to the work allocation norm would work without a statutory test.
There is after all no statutory norm to test against.
Er is immers geen wettelijke norm om aan te toetsen.
Supports quality requirements but worries about unequal standards, the broad exception to the work allocation norm, and the speed of implementation before the 2015 transition.
Conditions on professionals will raise and safeguard quality of care for vulnerable families and children.
Voorwaarden aan professionals zal de kwaliteit binnen de zorg voor kwetsbare gezinnen en kinderen verhogen en waarborgen.

Asks why key criteria are set by general administrative order, why the register and private disciplinary law sit outside government accountability, and how municipalities and the Inspectorate will enforce the norm.
To what extent can democratic control take place if the government no longer has responsibility for this.
In hoeverre kan de democratische controle plaatsvinden als de regering hier niet meer over gaat.
Asks how the bill relates to the forthcoming new Youth Act and whether the comply-or-explain rule is too burdensome for low-threshold support.
The members do wonder whether the comply-or-explain rule is not too heavy for the many low-threshold support services given to families.
Wel vragen de leden zich af of de comply or explainregel niet te zwaar is voor de vele laagdrempelige begeleiding die aan gezinnen gegeven wordt.
Finds the bill unsatisfactory because most details are left to an AMvB, asks when it will be submitted to Parliament, and asks whether tribunal decisions will be public.
That is unsatisfactory for these members, and they will consider the bill together with the announced AMvB.
Dat is voor deze leden onbevredigend en zij zullen het wetsvoorstel in samenhang met de aangekondigde amvb beschouwen.
Questions whether a private register and disciplinary law can exclude professionals without an explicit statutory basis, and why the bill is not placed in the Wet BIG.
Given the far-reaching consequences of the proposed plans, they find the absence of certain statutory bases in the bill remarkable.
Met het oog op de verstrekkende gevolgen van de beoogde plannen vinden zij het ontbreken van bepaalde grondslagen in het wetsvoorstel opmerkelijk.

v.summary: The Council of State advised against the proposed bill on professionalising youth care workers: existing law already allows quality requirements and the registry and foundation are not necessary, and the state would bind itself to private professional associations. The government's reply accepted moving the work-allocation norm and registry conditions to an AMvB and reworking the explanatory memorandum, but kept the registry and the foundation.
concerns: The Council found the bill unnecessary because existing law already allows requiring registered professional ethics and disciplinary law; the government moved the norms to an AMvB but defended the need for a registry.

The Council objected that the state binds itself via statute to the professional associations and their private disciplinary law; the government disputed this in part and added monitoring and evaluation.
The Council held that the delegation basis for the work-allocation norm was unnecessary; the government dropped the statutory amendment and used existing delegation powers.
The Council asked for structural and editorial changes to the explanatory memorandum and bill text, which the government largely adopted.

33637.s: The bill makes mainly technical amendments to several tax laws and introduces a temporary reduced VAT rate on renovation and repair work on homes to stimulate construction investment. It also updates ministry names, EU references and some renseignering and enforcement provisions, including a new delegation to lower-level regulation for information obligations in the Successiewet 1956.
33637.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as codifying existing practice and aligning with renamed ministries and EU references, with the VAT measure explained as an investment stimulus to prevent postponement effects.
d: designation of administrative obligors and information duties for inheritance tax
rules on payment deferral and related conditions
rules for remission of tax on termination of payment deferral
Artikel XI, onderdeel H.4 (Wet OB 1968, art. 11, eerste lid, onderdeel v)
limits on VAT exemption for fundraising canteen services
Artikel XVII, onderdeel A.11 (Wet op de accijns, art. 1a, tweede lid)
adjusting GN codes in excise law to match EU directive
Artikel XIX, onderdeel A (Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag, art. 2, tweede lid)
adjusting GN codes in environmental taxes to match EU directive
p: Replaces a statutory reporting duty with a power to set information obligations by general administrative order, extending it to third-party beneficiary payers.
Allows remission of tax to be granted under rules set by ministerial regulation rather than in the statute itself.

parties: Asks whether sufficient consultation took place with smaller sports clubs and the sports world before abolishing the canteen regime, and asks for written confirmation.
Would the government be willing to give written confirmation of this consultation?
Zou de regering een schriftelijke bevestiging willen geven van dit overleg?
Asks the government to clarify the scope of the reduced VAT rate, budgetary effects of the canteen threshold, and the expected extension of information (renseignering) obligations.
Asks about the expected effect of the reduced VAT rate on renovation, why it applies for only one year, and its interaction with the landlord levy.
Argues the government's broad interpretation of the reduced VAT rate for architects and gardeners conflicts with the strict interpretation by the EU Court of Justice, and asks for a legal analysis.
The CDA members would like a legal analysis on the basis of which the government reached its 2010 view on gardeners and architects.
Graag ontvangen de leden van de CDA-fractie een juridische analyse op basis waarvan de regering in 2010 tot haar oordeel gekomen is ten aanzien van hoveniers en architecten.
Asks whether the policy decision and the bill correspond one-to-one, the status of a promised broader interpretation for office-to-housing conversion, and evaluation timing of the work bonus.
These members are curious whether the policy decision and this bill correspond one-to-one in their elaboration?
De leden zijn benieuwd of het beleidsbesluit en dit wetsvoorstel qua uitwerking één op één overeenkomen?
Asks what 'accompanying work' by architects means and how the Tax Administration can verify it.
How can the Tax Administration check that architects also perform 'accompanying work'?
Hoe kan de Belastingdienst controleren dat architecten ook «begeleidende werkzaamheden» verrichten?
Proposes extending the reduced VAT rate to office buildings older than two years converted into homes for starters, and asks whether this fits the EU VAT Directive.
These members ask whether the extension of the VAT rule they intend is possible within the options offered by the European VAT Directive.
Deze leden vragen of de door hen bedoelde uitbreiding van de btw-regeling mogelijk is, binnen de mogelijkheden die de Europese BTW-richtlijn biedt.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the Fiscale verzamelwet 2013, a technical tax bill, raising remarks on the broad reading of reduced VAT for renovation of homes, the withdrawal of the sports-club canteen scheme, and the scope of reporting obligations under the Successiewet 1956. The government's reply explains the broader VAT scope for architects, gardeners and houseboats/caravans, justifies the withdrawal of the canteen scheme, and declines to limit the delegation power for reporting obligations while adding clarifications.
concerns: The Council criticised the broad reading of reduced VAT for renovation and repair of homes as at odds with the strict interpretation required by EU case law, and asked for justification in the explanatory memorandum; the government explained the wider scope and added justification.
The Council asked for a justification in the explanatory memorandum for withdrawing the canteen scheme for sports clubs, which the government added.

The Council advised limiting the delegation power in the Successiewet 1956 reporting obligations to life insurers, third-party beneficiaries and other financial institutions; the government did not follow this, citing future needs such as pre-filled inheritance tax returns.
The Council asked the memorandum to explain which implementation problems the reporting amendment resolves; the government clarified the explanatory text.
The Council made numerous redactional and technical comments on articles and cross-references, which the government largely adopted, except for one comment on article VII based on a misunderstanding.

33646.s: The bill broadens the duty to report serious adverse events under the Medical Research Involving Human Subjects Act, adding new definitions and reporting deadlines and removing some paragraphs. It also adds a delegation for reporting requirements to be set by ministerial regulation, with retroactive effect to 1 July 2012, and restricts disclosure of inspection reports under the Wob.
33646.j: The memorandum justifies the retroactive ministerial delegation by the lapse of the earlier delegation basis on 1 July 2012, so existing regulation must be re-established.
q: The new article 13r is given retroactive effect to and including 1 July 2012, as stated in article II of this amending act.
Aan het nieuwe artikel 13r wordt, blijkens artikel II van deze wijzigingswet, terugwerkende kracht toegekend tot en met 1 juli 2012.
d: requirements for reports under articles 13o, 13p and 13q
disclosure of inspection report to EU states and committees on request
p: Reporting requirements for research are left to ministerial regulation rather than fixed in the statute, with retroactive effect to 2012.

parties: Asks how exceptions for foreseeable serious events in the protocol work, how METCs avoid divergent practice, and whether a protocol can exclude reporting entirely.
How is it prevented that different Medical Ethics Review Committees (METCs) assess this point in different ways?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat verschillende Medisch-Ethische Toetsingscommissies (METC's) op verschillende wijze op dit punt toetsen?
Supports the aim of patient safety but asks why reporting goes to the sponsor rather than the committee, whether the DSMC advice is binding, and what the reporting differences between METCs are.
These members ask to what extent this advice is binding in nature.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre dit advies dwingend van aard is.
Generally positive but questions the option to deviate from reporting in the protocol and the reporting deadlines, and asks whether 'kan' should be 'moet' for suspending research.
First, the SP members ask why the option to deviate from the reporting obligation was chosen.
Allereerst vragen de leden van de SP-fractie waarom er is gekozen voor een mogelijkheid om af te wijken van de meldingsplicht.
Asks whether use of the exception protocol is left to the researcher or set within a CCMO framework, and what else falls under serious undesirable events.
These members ask whether it is left to the executor/sponsor of the research to use the exception protocol or whether a framework is agreed within the CCMO.
Genoemde leden vragen of dit aan de uitvoerder/verrichter van het onderzoek wordt overgelaten, gebruik te maken van het uitzonderingsprotocol of dat er een kader wordt afgesproken binnen CCMO.
Asks why the participant is not informed directly, why reporting deadlines differ, why observational research is covered, and whether there are disagreements between METCs.

Why did the new proposal choose to have the person conducting the research report immediately to the sponsor, but not directly (also) inform the research subject, as is the case in the current Article 10?

Waarom is er in het nieuwe voorstel ervoor gekozen degene die het onderzoek uitvoert onmiddellijk te laten rapporteren aan degene die het onderzoek verricht, maar niet direct (ook) de proefpersoon op de hoogte te stellen, zoals in het huidige artikel 10 het geval is?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill extending the serious adverse event reporting duty of the WMO from drug trials to all medical-scientific research, but advises a fix to the wrongly lapsed article 13r with retroactive effect to 1 July 2012. The government's reply accepts the advice, adds retroactive effect to 1 July 2012 and re-establishes the lapsed regulation articles, and adopts the drafting remark on article 11.
concerns: The accidentally lapsed article 13r left the Regeling wetenschappelijk onderzoek met geneesmiddelen without statutory basis, and the Afdeling advises retroactive effect to 1 July 2012, which the government adopts.

The Afdeling asks that article 11 and the explanatory memorandum align on the term for the person conducting the research and that 'onderzoek' be qualified as 'wetenschappelijk'; the government accepts this.

33664.s: The bill moves the funding of regional public broadcasters from the provincial fund to the national media budget from 2014, and amends the Mediawet 2008 accordingly, including removing the provinces' guarantee of at least one regional broadcaster per province and shifting designation to the Commissariaat. It also deletes several unexercised provisions on hate speech and sanctions and extends governance, financial oversight and reserve rules to regional broadcasters.
33664.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the budget moves to the national media budget, that detailed rules will follow in an amvb and ministerial regulation, and that the Commissariaat's new powers are needed for effective oversight.
q: It is my intention to make provision in such a regulation so that a certain budget for the regional broadcaster is available per province.
Het is mijn voornemen in een zodanige regeling te voorzien dat per provincie een bepaald budget voor de regionale omroep beschikbaar is.
d: distribution of total regional broadcasting budget and application rules
rules for advance payments to regional broadcasters
Commissariaat grants contributions from the regional budget on application
p: The Minister sets the total regional broadcasting budget annually, moving funding control from provinces to the national executive.
The provinces lose their role in funding and the guarantee of at least one regional broadcaster per province lapses, replaced by designation by the Commissariaat after advice from provincial bodies.
Reserves of regional broadcasters are capped at ten percent of expenditure, with Commissariaat consent and conditions it sets.
The Commissariaat gains legal-compliance review of regional broadcasters' expenditure and a duty to promote uniform financial accounting.
I, A, B, C, D, I, K, Z, AA, CC
Unexercised sanction provisions on hate speech and broadcast bans are deleted, and the memorandum notes that criminal courts under article 137h Sr are the proper route for such cases.

parties: Asks why regional broadcasters remain organised by provincial boundaries and how the provincial role is maintained after funding is centralised.
These members ask the government to explain why regional broadcasters are still organised via provincial boundaries.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan aangeven waarom er toch gekozen blijft worden om regionale omroepen via provinciegrenzen te organiseren.
Worries that the government would set the allocation of funds to regional broadcasters by AMvB without parliamentary involvement.
These members note with some concern that the government wishes to grant itself the power to determine how funds are divided among regional broadcasters by AMvB, without parliamentary influence.`

Deze leden constateren met enige zorg dat de regering zichzelf de bevoegdheid wenst te verlenen te bepalen hoe de middelen over de regionale omroepen verdeeld worden, middels een AMvB 7 , zonder invloed daarop van het parlement.
Asks the government to wait for the outcome of the future-exploration before proceeding with cuts, and warns of harm to broadcast quality.
They ask whether the government is willing to first examine the outcomes of the future exploration before proceeding with this bill.
Zij vragen of de regering bereid is eerst naar de uitkomsten van de toekomstverkenning te kijken voordat tot de behandeling van voorliggend wetsvoorstel wordt overgegaan.
Asks about the allocation of funds across regional broadcasters and whether provinces may still add their own funding, raising questions of equalisation and provincial role.
They ask whether this means other regional broadcasters will receive less budget than they previously got from the province.
Zij vragen of dit dan betekent dat andere regionale omroepen minder budget gaan ontvangen dan zij voorheen toebedeeld kregen van de provincie.
Asks why the 2011 reference amount is still used, why the definitive amount is still under negotiation, and requests information on the outcomes of consultations with provinces.
They finally ask whether the House can be informed about the progress and outcomes of this consultation.
Zij vragen tot slot of de Kamer kan worden geïnformeerd over de voortgang en de uitkomsten van dit overleg.
Asks whether the AMvB will contain allocation criteria and why the regional public task amount is not earmarked.
They ask whether this AMvB will also contain criteria on which basis the total budget will be allocated by the Commissariaat.
Zij vragen of deze AMvB ook criteria zal bevatten op welke grond het totaalbudget door het Commissariaat zal worden verdeeld.
Doubts the quality of programming under the extra €100 million cut and asks why the regional funding provisions on quality and activity levels were dropped from the statute.
These members also notice that the new article 2.170 no longer guarantees that the media offering must be of high quality.
Deze leden valt ook op dat in het nieuwe artikel 2.170 niet langer sprake is van de garantie dat het media-aanbod kwalitatief hoogwaardig moet zijn.

33673.s: The bill amends the Wet veiligheidsonderzoeken to create a statutory basis for charging the employer for the costs of security screenings, with fees to be set by ministerial regulation. It also allows suspension of the decision deadline while the applicant supplies further data, removes the requirement of the relevant minister's consent for refusing or withdrawing a clearance, and raises the maximum penalty for non-compliance.
33673.j: The memorandum justifies the fee basis by the requirement under Article 104 of the Constitution that state levies be regulated by law, and the tariffs by reference to actual costs and prior publication in the Staatscourant.
q: In view of Article 104 of the Constitution (state levies must be regulated by law), a statutory basis in formal law must be provided.
Gelet op artikel 104 van de Grondwet («. heffingen van het Rijk worden bij wet geregeld.») dient dan ook te worden voorzien in een formeelwettelijke grondslag.
d: amounts charged to employers for security screening costs
p: Removes the requirement that the relevant minister or the competent authority of a High State College consent to refusal or withdrawal of a clearance, leaving the decision with the Minister of Interior Affairs alone.
Allows the minister to withdraw a clearance when a new screening yields insufficient data to establish adequate safeguards, broadening withdrawal grounds.
Suspends the statutory decision deadline while the applicant is asked for further data, a procedural adjustment favouring the administration.

parties: Asks how the bill guarantees that positions are designated as positions of trust when needed and not omitted for financial reasons, and why the bill is necessary given the declining number of such positions.
These members ask how the bill guarantees that a given function is actually designated as a position of trust where necessary and that this designation is not omitted for financial reasons.

Deze leden vragen hoe het voorliggende wetsvoorstel garandeert dat een bepaalde functie, zo dat nodig is, daadwerkelijk als een vertrouwensfunctie wordt aangewezen en dat die aanwijzing niet om financiële redenen wordt nagelaten.

Asks how the rise in requests for trust-position designations fits with the fall since 2007, whether the new guideline achieves the bill's aims, and whether charging costs could make employers reluctant to submit sensitive positions.
What is not intended is that employers, for financial motives, stop submitting vulnerable positions although they are obliged to do so.
Wat niet wordt beoogd is dat werkgevers vanwege financiële motieven, kwetsbare functies niet meer gaan voorleggen, hoewel zij daartoe wel verplicht zijn.

Sees risks that cost pricing leads employers to underestimate vulnerable positions, doubts that stricter law and higher penalties suffice, and warns of added bureaucracy and juridification through invoicing and appeals.
These members consider such a development undesirable. How will the government prevent this?
Deze leden achten een dergelijke ontwikkeling ongewenst. Hoe gaat de regering dit voorkomen?

Asks the government to respond to the Raad van State advice that a cost incentive could lead employers to underestimate risks, on what criteria designations are deemed too high, whether a quota is applied, and whether an evaluation is planned.

Asks whether legal options are overused, whether integrity-based screening departs from the original national security purpose, whether the bill should distinguish security from integrity screenings, and whether a cost incentive is the most suitable instrument; also raises legal certainty if clearance withdrawal costs employment.
These members ask whether the statutory possibilities are not applied too often.
Deze leden vragen of de wettelijke mogelijkheden niet te vaak worden toegepast.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division accepts the principle of charging security-screening costs to employers but warns that financial incentives could lead employers to underestimate risks, so that functions warranting designation are not designated, and asks for analysis of rising numbers of positions and clarification of 'pools' of screened staff. The government's nader rapport largely rebuts the risk as low, points to existing statutory duties and penalties, and commits to revising and tightening the designation policy and exploring broader function clustering.
concerns: Cost-charging could lead employers to underestimate vulnerable functions, so designation of positions needed for national security could be avoided; the government considers this risk low given existing duties and penalties, and has increased penalties and revised policy.

The explanatory memorandum lacks a quantitative and policy analysis of the causes and scale of the rise in designated positions and of measures to achieve an acceptable number; the government added explanation and a new designation guideline.

Unclear whether 'pools' of screened staff without specific positions fall under the AIVD's function clustering; the government clarified that pools are distinct from clustering and it will explore broader clustering.

33691.s: The bill amends the Gemeentewet, Provinciewet, Wet openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba and Waterschapswet to adjust institutional rules on mayors, commissioners, governors and water board chairs, including shifting some appointment and oversight tasks from the commissioner as provincial organ to a state task under government instruction. It also adds a few data-sharing duties for the tax authority and integrity-promotion duties for the mayor, commissioner and water board chair.
33691.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as clarifying role division between council and college and as making the commissioner's appointment tasks a state responsibility under the Constitution's article 126.
q: The bill therefore designates the appointment of an acting mayor in article 78 as a state task.
Het wetsvoorstel wordt daarom de benoeming van een waarnemend burgemeester in artikel 78 als rijkstaak aangemerkt.
d: allowances and facilities for water board members and executive members
appointment, reappointment, suspension and dismissal rules for water board chair
p: Commissioner's tasks on mayoral appointment and related matters are performed under a government-issued instruction rather than provincial authority.
Council must give the college an opportunity to state its views before consultations with the commissioner on mayoral appointment criteria and reappointment.
Mayor is informed about coalition negotiations only on request rather than as a standing right.
Removal of the former third paragraph of article 160 reduces the council's procedural role in municipal decisions on public-private arrangements.
ARTIKEL III U (artikel 182 Provinciewet / WolBES adjustments)
Commissioner gains advisory and mediation powers in cases of disrupted administrative relations and threatened integrity, with periodic reporting to the minister.

parties: Asks how the external chair of council committees may be appointed and whether councillors and aldermen may attend bodies handling objections.
It is not clear to the VVD members whether this external chair must be someone on a party's candidate list or may be someone who is not.

Het is de leden van de VVD-fractie niet duidelijk of deze externe voorzitter iemand moet zijn die op de kandidatenlijst van één van de fracties staat of dat het ook iemand mag zijn die daar niet op staat.
Worries that giving the mayor a right to be informed of coalition talks could make the mayor too influential over the college.
However, the members fear that by giving the mayor the right to be informed, he could also state his views on the ongoing coalition talks and thereby influence their outcome.

Echter, zo vrezen de aan het woord zijnde leden, door de burgemeester het recht te verschaffen zich te laten informeren kan hij desgewenst ook zijn mening geven over de dan nog lopende collegebesprekingen en zo wellicht toch invloed uitoefenen op de uitkomst van die besprekingen.
Says the mayor's influence on forming a college would grow considerably and that outside influence on coalition programmes is undesirable.
Although the mayor of course forms part of a future college, the SP members find that his influence on forming a college is considerably increased by this.
Hoewel de burgemeester natuurlijk deel uit maakt van een toekomstig college, vinden de leden van de SP-fractie dat zijn invloed op de vorming van een college hiermee wel fors vergroot wordt.
Argues dualisation was never completed and that only an elected mayor with independent standing would be a true end point; questions the mayor's dependence on council for reappointment.
These members believe that only an elected mayor with an independent position who decides the composition of his own college would truly be the capstone of the dualisation process.

Deze leden menen dat slechts een gekozen burgemeester met een eigenstandige positie die zelf over de samenstelling van zijn college gaat, daadwerkelijk het sluitstuk is van de het dualiseringstraject.
Objects to allowing external chairs of council and provincial committees and to dropping the mayor's citizen annual report, which they see as weakening accountability.
The ChristenUnie members have difficulty with the proposal to allow an external chairmanship of council committees.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie hebben moeite met het voorstel om een extern voorzitterschap van raadscommissies mogelijk te maken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill on institutional amendments to municipal, provincial, BES and water board law, but objects to excluding Wob disclosure for the commissioner of the King's reports and to clarifying a deputy mayor's access to secret documents, and it opposes the external chairing of council committees only insofar as the council's final responsibility must remain. The government reply accepts most advice: the reports are now handled by the minister under the Wob, the proposed secret-documents provision is dropped, and the explanatory memorandum clarifies the external chair's limited role.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the blanket exclusion of the Wob for the commissioner's reports is not justified by pressing reasons, so the exclusion should be dropped or limited to requests handled by the minister.
The Afdeling found no practical problem justifying a statutory clarification of secret-document access for absent deputy mayors and advised dropping the provision.
The Afdeling stressed that the council's final responsibility cannot be transferred, so an external committee chair must be limited to technical chairing and the memorandum should say so.
The Afdeling made several redactional comments in an annex, which were incorporated.

33718.s: The bill approves for the European and Caribbean parts of the Netherlands the 2013 tax treaty with China on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion on income taxes. The explanatory memorandum describes the treaty's allocation of taxing rights, permanent establishment, transfer pricing, dispute resolution and mutual assistance provisions, without delegating rule-making power to the executive.

parties: Asks why the treaty departs from Dutch standard treaty criteria and whether Dutch negotiators resisted anti-abuse provisions, seeking government explanation and accountability to parliament.
Can the government dispel the impression of the PvdA members that the Netherlands opposed including anti-abuse provisions in the negotiations with China?
Kan de regering de indruk van de leden van de PvdA-fractie wegnemen dat Nederland het opnemen van antimisbruikbepalingen in de onderhandelingen met China heeft tegengewerkt?
Asks about China's concerns over treaty abuse, whether China proposed anti-abuse rules, and whether the Netherlands gave in, probing the substance of the negotiated safeguards.
May it be concluded from this that China had concerns about possible treaty abuse, ask the SP members?
Mag daaruit worden geconcludeerd dat China zorgen had over mogelijk verdragsmisbruik, vragen de leden van de SP-fractie?
Asks why the treaty often deviates from the Dutch treaty policy note 2011 and where it differs from China's treaties with Belgium, the UK and Denmark.
Could the government explain why the tax treaty so often deviates from Dutch tax policy on tax treaties as laid down in the 2011 Fiscal Treaty Policy Note, ask the PVV members?

Zou de regering eens kunnen uitleggen waarom zij, in het belastingverdrag zo vaak afwijkt van het Nederlandse belastingbeleid in zake belastingverdragen zoals vastgelegd in de Notitie Fiscaal Verdragsbeleid 2011, vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie?
Welcomes the improved treaty and lower dividend withholding as an investment stimulus, while asking about the missing arbitration clause and transfer pricing and state-owned enterprise effects.
The CDA members would like to know why the new treaty with China does not provide for an arbitration arrangement?
De leden van de CDA-fractie willen graag weten waarom het nieuwe verdrag met China niet voorziet in een arbitrageregeling?
Asks whether anti-abuse rules were inserted at China's insistence, why the limitation-on-benefits clause failed, and how realistic it is that developing countries negotiate similarly.
These members ask whether they can conclude from this that the anti-abuse provision was included at China's insistence and not at the Netherlands' insistence?
Deze leden vragen of zij hieruit kunnen concluderen dat de antimisbruikbepaling in het verdrag is opgenomen op aandringen van China, en niet op aandringen van Nederland?

33745.s: The bill replaces the penitentiary programme with electronic detention as an execution modality for the final part of prison sentences of at least six months, served at a home address under electronic supervision for up to twelve months. It also restructures the detention regime, adds a detention and re-integration plan, and gives the Minister power to decide on the application and termination of electronic detention.
33745.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the societal interest in controlled reintegration, research showing that controlled return reduces recidivism, and the need to align detention phasing with conditional release.
q: Because this bill makes the application of electronic detention possible, additional safeguards are provided for a safe execution of prison sentences aimed at limiting recidivism.

Doordat dit wetsvoorstel de toepassing van elektronische detentie mogelijk maakt, wordt voorzien in aanvullende waarborgen voor een veilige en op beperking van de recidive gerichte executie van vrijheidsstraffen.
d: Artikel I, C (Artikel 4, lid 4-5 Penitentiaire beginselenwet)
conditions, supervision and termination of electronic detention
Artikel I, I (Artikel 18a lid 3 Penitentiaire beginselenwet)
requirements for detention and re-integration plan
Artikel I, L (Artikel 47 lid 4 Penitentiaire beginselenwet)
application of work obligation and prisoner wage rules
p: Electronic detention at the home is introduced as an execution modality, with conditions to be set by general administrative order and the Minister deciding on application and termination without involving a judge.
The Minister decides on electronic detention and its termination, and termination leads to imprisonment without a court order, the sentencing judge not being involved.
Replacement of fixed regime categories with a general regime and director discretion over the degree of activity participation linked to good conduct.
Artikel II, A (Artikel 15d Wetboek van Strafrecht)
Adds a ground for postponing or refusing conditional release where the convict has insufficiently shown suitability for reintegration, with the judge deciding.
Introduces a mandatory detention and re-integration plan set by the director.

parties: Supports conditional release and electronic detention as a reintegration aid but insists it can never replace a court-imposed prison sentence and asks for evidence on recidivism effects.
They nevertheless maintain that electronic detention can never count as a punishment in place of a prison sentence imposed by a judge.
Daarbij blijven zij van oordeel dat elektronische detentie nooit als straf kan gelden in plaats van een door de rechter opgelegde gevangenisstraf.
Asks how electronic detention will be organised, what role the reclassering will play, and whether excluding addicted prisoners in advance serves recidivism reduction.
They fear that if a seriously addicted prisoner returns to society unprepared after detention, the risk of recidivism increases.
Zij vrezen dat als een ernstig verslaafde gedetineerde na zijn detentie zonder voorbereiding terugkomt in de samenleving de kans op recidive daarmee juist toeneemt.
Suspects the measure is primarily a cost-cutting measure, criticises removal of detention phasing without evidence, and questions selection and the exclusion of vulnerable groups.
Can this be confirmed? If not, on the basis of which vision and/or scientific premises is electronic detention being introduced?
Kan dat worden bevestigd? Zo nee, op basis van welke visie en/of wetenschappelijke uitgangspunten wordt de elektronische detentie dan ingevoerd?
Questions whether the bill serves rehabilitation or budget goals, doubts the punitive character is preserved, and asks about selection criteria, appeal rights and the reclassering's role.
Can the government reassure these members that the principle that a sentence should in principle be served in full is not undermined?
Kan de regering deze leden geruststellen dat niet afgedaan wordt aan het principe dat een straf in beginsel volledig dient te worden uitgezeten
Missing evidential basis for abolishing detention phasing and for the 10 percent recidivism target; asks for clarity on criteria and monitoring.
What is the necessity for abolishing detention phasing?
Wat is de noodzaak voor afschaffing van de detentiefasering?
Asks for objectifiable criteria for granting privileges and electronic detention and what happens to prisoners excluded from the scheme.
Regarding the granting of the plus programme to a prisoner, these members ask which objectifiable criteria will be used for this.
Ten aanzien van de toekenning van het plusprogramma aan een gedetineerde vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden welke objectiveerbare criteria hiervoor zullen worden gebruikt.
Asks whether the aims could be met within existing law, whether technology is reliable, and how consistent application will be guaranteed.
These members ask to what extent the existing technology can be regarded as fully reliable.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre de bestaande techniek als volledig betrouwbaar beoordeeld kan worden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against the proposal to abolish the existing detention phasing and introduce electronic detention, criticising the lack of a substantiated necessity, unclear costs, unclear roles of partner organisations and unclear forensic care continuity. The government's reply rejects the need for a stronger evidential basis for recidivism claims, provides cost estimates of 16 million euro per year, and commits to involving the reclassering and forensic care arrangements.
concerns: The Afdeling finds no substantiated justification for abolishing detention phasing and doubts its effectiveness in reducing recidivism, which the government answers by citing mixed scientific literature and arguing for stronger criminogenic intervention.

The Afdeling considers the cost calculation too summary and the financial effects for municipalities and benefit recipients unclear; the government promises a further cost estimate and an impact analysis.
The Afdeling asks for clarification of the roles and tasks of partner organisations such as the reclassering and the prosecution service, which the government says are still under discussion.

The Afdeling requests guaranteed continuity of forensic mental health care during electronic detention, which the government addresses by allowing participants access to forensic care under existing rules.
The Afdeling makes redactional remarks on the definition of electronic detention and on aligning article 15 with the forensic care bill, which the government adopts.

33754.s: The bill tightens anti-fraud rules for child-benefit and tax systems by letting the tax authority deny or reduce advance payments and benefits when the address is doubtful, raising administrative fines and criminalising wilful non-payment, and extending liability to bank-account holders and intermediaries. It also lets the ministry designate exceptions to the single-bank-account rule and sets administrative fines for intermediaries and users who fail to meet deposit or reporting duties.
33754.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to combat fraud in the benefits and tax system and to intensify control at the entrance.
q: The cabinet proposes to provide for this after all.
Het kabinet stelt voor daarin alsnog te voorzien.
d: exceptions to single bank account rule for debt-relief budget management
rules on advance payments and information requirements under the benefits act
exceptions to deposit obligation for temporary-work agencies
p: Art. I.A (AWR art. 13(5)), Art. II.C (IW 1990 art. 9(11)), Art. III.B (Awir art. 16(7)), Art. III.E-F (Awir art. 23, 24a)
Tax and benefit authorities may withhold or reduce advance payments, benefits and refunds on mere doubt about the taxpayer's address, for up to five years, without a written decision in some cases.
Art. II.E (IW 1990 art. 48a), Art. III.H (Awir art. 33)
Any third party with access to a bank account receiving benefit or tax payments becomes jointly liable for the debt, extending liability beyond designated persons.
Administrative fines for benefit fraud are extended to instigators and accomplices, departing from the general definition of offender, subject to a 2019 sunset unless renewed by law.
Wilful non-payment of tax due on return becomes a criminal offence punishable by imprisonment up to six years or a fine.
Administrative fines up to 100 percent of the underpaid amount apply to wilfully incorrect information in advance-payment or revision requests.

parties: Welcomes concrete action against benefit fraud and asks a few questions about implementation.
The VVD members note that this government is taking concrete action to tackle benefit fraud.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat deze regering met concrete acties komt om fraude met toeslagen aan te pakken.
Supports the drastic approach but doubts whether the chosen measures are sufficient, and questions the impact of longer decision periods on people dependent on allowances.
Given the demonstrated risks of large-scale systemic fraud, these members consider a drastic approach unavoidable and have therefore noted the bill with approval.
Gegeven de gebleken risico's van grootschalige systeemfraude achten deze leden een drastische aanpak onvermijdelijk en hebben daarom met instemming kennisgenomen van voorliggend wetsvoorstel.

Asks why the fine for offenders was not extended to the whole administrative law and why the Raad van State's suggested criminal-order route was not chosen; also flags a possible drafting error in the duty to inform.
Why, as the Raad van State suggested, was the introduction of a criminal order in the Awir not chosen, the PVV members ask.
Waarom is, zoals de Raad van State heeft gesuggereerd, niet gekozen voor de introductie van de strafbeschikking in de Awir, zo vragen de leden van de fractie van de PVV.

Questions the capacity of the tax authority, the proportionality of the extended decision period and withholding of advances, the risk of wrongly labelled applicants, and whether co-residents can be held liable.
Does the government not consider a period of half a year excessively long to find out whether an applicant is actually entitled to an allowance?
Vindt de regering een periode van een half jaar niet buitensporig lang om te ontdekken of een aanvrager daadwerkelijk recht heeft op een toeslag of niet?
Supports fighting fraud but warns that a six-month wait and loss of allowances could harm good-faith citizens, and questions possible criminal-law and ECHR implications of household-level sanctions.
In the view of the CDA members, this bill focuses only on the allowance recipient.
Naar de mening van de leden van de CDA-fractie focust dit wetsvoorstel slechts op de toeslagontvanger.
Stresses proportionality, asks about the number of people affected by longer decision periods, withheld advances and fines on accomplices, and about the expected fraud savings.
Fraud control must, however, burden people who are not in violation as little as possible.
Fraudebestrijding moet echter mensen die niet in overtreding zijn zo min mogelijk belasten.
Worries that anti-fraud measures could harm vulnerable groups entitled to allowances and asks what legal protection and safeguards exist for them.

They ask the government what forms of legal protection it can offer these groups and what safeguards will be built in to prevent these groups from being disproportionately affected by the anti-fraud measures.

Zij vragen de regering welke vormen van rechtsbescherming de regering deze groepen kan bieden en welke waarborgen worden ingebouwd om te voorkomen dat deze groepen onevenredig door de fraudemaatregelen getroffen worden.
Supports the strict approach but asks whether the high statutory interest rates and criminal liability for non-payment are proportionate, especially in disputed cases under objection.
The 50PLUS members also would like an explanation of how cases are handled where tax is deliberately, partly or late unpaid and there is clearly no fraud.

Ook krijgen de leden van de 50PLUS-fractie graag een toelichting hoe gehandeld wordt in gevallen dat opzettelijk niet, gedeeltelijk niet of niet tijdig aangiftebelasting wordt betaald, en er duidelijk géén sprake is van fraude.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division supports the bill combating fraud in childcare and tax benefits but raises objections on extending the offender concept to participation forms, the information duty and administrative fine, the fine calculation basis, the sub-delegation for temporary staffing deposits, and the tie to the Belastingplan 2014 package. The government replies by largely rejecting the offender extension and the bill's decoupling, adapting the information duty wording, fixing the delegation level and EU justification, and adjusting the fine base formulation minimally.
concerns: The extension of the administrative offender concept to incitement, instigation and accessories is a fundamental choice that the explanatory memorandum does not justify; criminal law instruments would be preferable.
The fine base 'is or would have been reclaimed' does not provide clear maximum punishment, undermining foreseeability of an punitive sanction.
Article 41 first paragraph extends to anyone, contrary to the explanatory memorandum's intent to exclude a general reporting duty; wording should be aligned.
The deposit requirement for temporary staffing agencies must be justified under EU free movement of services as necessary and proportionate.
Ministerial delegation to exempt agencies from the deposit requirement is unbounded and should be limited and moved to an AMvB.
Coupling the bill to the Belastingplan 2014 package risks hasty treatment of a punitive sanctions reform; decoupling and a royal decree date were advised.

33781.s: The bill introduces a driving licence requirement (a new T-category) for operating agricultural and forestry tractors and low-speed motor vehicles designated by general administrative order, with transitional rules for existing B, C and certificate holders. It also amends the Wegenverkeerswet and the Wet rijonderricht motorrijtuigen to set instructor certification and exemptions, and provides enforcement obligations to stop vehicles and show certificates.
33781.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set technical details of the T-licence, exemptions and examination requirements, to be worked out in general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
q: The proposal provides for the introduction of the T driving licence on the one hand and, on the other, for a certificate under the WRM 1993 for category T.
Het voorstel voorziet enerzijds in de invoering van het T-rijbewijs en anderzijds in de invoering van een certificaat op grond van de WRM 1993 voor de categorie T
d: designation of tractors and low-speed vehicles subject to the licence requirement
designation of foreign licences recognised for T-category driving
ARTIKEL II, A (art. 1 Wet rijonderricht motorrijtuigen 1993)
designation of the EU directive on driving licences
ARTIKEL II, B (art. 7 lid 5 Wet rijonderricht motorrijtuigen 1993)
designation of vehicles for which instructor certificate T is required
ARTIKEL II, C (art. 9a and 9b Wet rijonderricht motorrijtuigen 1993)
requirements for additional T-category instructor certificates
conditions for exchanging existing certificates for T-category licences
conditions for issuing combined B/T licences and recognition of foreign B licences
defining agricultural education for transitional exemptions
ARTIKEL VI lid 2 onderdeel a en b
passes and identity cards for exempt agricultural instructors

parties: Questions whether a driving licence will reduce accidents given that the Raad van State attributes them more to vehicle characteristics than to driver incompetence, and asks why the bill is separated from the registration requirement.
However, the advice of the Council of State shows that accidents with such vehicles are not so much caused by incompetent driving as by the physical characteristics of the vehicle.

Uit het advies van de Raad van State blijkt echter dat de ongelukken met dergelijke voertuigen niet zozeer worden veroorzaakt door onkundig besturen als wel door de fysieke kenmerken van het voertuig.
Supports introducing the licence requirement given annual casualties; asks why holders of a tractor certificate without a B licence must retake an examination and asks for data on that group.

The PvdA members believe it is sensible to introduce the licence requirement for agricultural and forestry tractors and low-speed motor vehicles because on average fifteen people die and one hundred are hospitalised each year in traffic accidents involving these vehicles.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn van mening dat het verstandig is dat de rijbewijsplicht wordt ingevoerd voor landbouw- en bosbouwtrekkers en motorrijtuigen met beperkte snelheid omdat er jaarlijks gemiddeld vijftien doden en honderd ziekenhuisgewonden vallen bij verkeersongevallen met deze voertuigen.

Positive about the T-licence but asks why the registration requirement is not submitted simultaneously, expected accident reduction and its basis, costs, and whether a B licence should automatically exempt holders.
The SP members are positive about introducing the T-licence but have some questions and comments on it.
De leden van de SP-fractie staan positief tegenover de invoering van het T-rijbewijs, maar hebben hierover nog wel enkele vragen en opmerkingen.

Asks for justification of expected reduction in casualties, the government's view on the Commissie-Peijs advice linking licence to registration and speed increases, and ways to lower costs such as exemptions for existing certificate holders.
They have some questions about this.
Welcomes the introduction of the T-licence and asks about the timetable for other measures and how the T-licence differs in examination requirements and training time.
The ChristenUnie members are glad that the T-licence is finally being introduced.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie zijn blij dat het T-rijbewijs eindelijk wordt ingevoerd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill introducing a T-licence for agricultural and forestry tractors and low-speed motor vehicles, raising effectiveness concerns (licence alone only partly addresses vehicle-characteristic causes, so a registration requirement would be more effective) and omission of the costs of obtaining the licence. The minister's reply states that registration is being handled in a separate bill following a parliamentary motion, and that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on the licence costs, which the advice requested.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the T-licence alone effectively addresses the problem, since accidents stem mainly from vehicle characteristics, and advises explaining this in the explanatory memorandum and adjusting the bill if needed.
The explanatory memorandum omits the costs of obtaining the T-licence (driving lessons, theory and practical exams), which should be added to the weighing of necessity against costs.

33790.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Alkmaar, Graft-De Rijp and Schermer into a new municipality of Alkmaar, dissolving the two smaller ones with effect from the reorganisation date. It also sets transitional rules on council elections, judicial districts, safety regions and the transfer of obligations, and takes immediate effect on publication.
33790.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies immediate entry into force, rather than the usual fixed transition dates, by the municipalities' wish for a 1 January 2015 merger and the excessive disadvantages a delay would cause.
q: This deviation is permissible, since postponement – given the municipalities' wish for a reorganisation as of 1 January 2015 – would lead to excessive disadvantages for the municipalities.
Deze afwijking is geoorloofd, nu uitstel – gelet op de wens van de gemeenten tot herindeling per 1 januari 2015 – zou leiden tot buitensporige nadelen voor de gemeenten.
d: designating a municipality for instructions and regulations under the reorganisation act
designating the new municipality for tax, joint-arrangement and utility transfer provisions

parties: Notes the merger is voluntary to strengthen administrative capacity and raises no remarks or questions on the bill.
They note that this is a voluntary merger aimed at strengthening the administrative capacity of the three municipalities.
Zij constateren dat het hier gaat om een vrijwillige samenvoeging teneinde de bestuurskracht van de drie gemeenten te versterken.
Asks why no referendum or representative survey was held to establish whether residents support the merger, arguing merger should proceed only if a majority wants it.
They are of the opinion that a merger should only proceed if it is what the residents of the municipalities concerned want by majority.
Zij zijn van mening dat er pas tot herindeling moet worden overgegaan als dit is wat de inwoners van de betreffende gemeenten in meerderheid willen.

Stresses local community identity and service quality, asks whether the pre-merger administrative integration has taken effect, and asks how smaller municipalities can be strengthened in regional cooperation without merger.
In what way can the position of smaller municipalities in cooperation arrangements be strengthened without the need for municipal merger, ask these members.
Op welke wijze kan de positie van kleinere gemeenten in samenwerkingsverbanden worden versterkt, zonder de noodzaak van gemeentelijke herindeling, zo vragen deze leden.
Considers local support essential and asks whether residents of smaller kernels will remain involved long term and whether objections about service points have been fully addressed.
These members consider public support for a merger very important, as well as whether the merger takes place at the request of the municipalities concerned.
Deze leden vinden draagvlak voor een herindeling erg belangrijk, alsmede de vraag of er sprake is van een herindeling op verzoek van de betrokken gemeenten.

33805-V.s: The bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statements of the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments and expenditure by policy article in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 December 2013 and states that the amended budget statements are set by law.

33817.s: The bill amends the Framework Act on advisory bodies to cap their membership at a chair plus nine members and to remove the mandatory cabinet response to advice, so the minister must only consider advice rather than adopt a formal position. It also trims membership caps for the Council for Science and Technology Policy Advisory Council and the Council for Public Administration, with transitional rules for existing bodies.
33817.j: The memorandum justifies removing the mandatory cabinet response as a way to work more efficiently, noting parliament can still request a position under article 68 of the Constitution.
q: This offers the possibility to work as efficiently as possible.
Dit biedt de mogelijkheid om zo efficiënt mogelijk te werken.
p: The minister no longer has to report a formal position on advisory opinions to both chambers within three months, reducing parliamentary visibility into government responses to advice.
ARTIKEL I D (Kaderwet art. 28, vierde lid)
The minister must still inform parliament of a position on evaluation reports, but only with a motivated notice if the position is not set within the deadline.](...)

parties: Supports reducing advisory body membership for a leaner state and asks whether one-off advisory bodies should still require a cabinet response.
They endorse the reduction of the maximum number of members of advisory bodies.
Zij onderschrijven de vermindering van het maximum aantal leden van adviescolleges.
Questions abolishing the mandatory cabinet response, arguing it weakens advisory bodies' role in the checks and balances of the democratic state.
Asks what the problem with the mandatory cabinet response is and why the deadline is not simply extended instead of abolishing the response.
Why does the government not choose the logical solution of extending the deadline if it turns out to be often missed?
Waarom kiest de regering niet voor de logische oplossing om de deadline te verlengen als blijkt dat deze vaak niet gehaald wordt
Doubts the bill achieves transparency and political primacy, and questions the government's reasoning on dropping the cabinet response and reducing tijdelijk geassocieerde leden.
These members are not yet convinced that the present bill contributes to that.
Deze leden zijn er evenwel nog niet van overtuigd dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel daaraan bijdraagt.
Values the mandatory cabinet response for transparency toward parliament and public, and questions the proportionality of abolishing it and reducing membership risking advice quality.
These members would therefore like to hear how proportionate it is to abolish both the response deadline and the obligation to give a cabinet response.
Deze leden horen daarom graag hoe proportioneel het in dit kader is om zowel de reactietermijn als de verplichting tot een kabinetsreactie, af te schaffen.

Worried about dropping the mandatory cabinet response, arguing it reduces the value of the advisory system and parliament's ability to shape policy, and suggests keeping at least a response deadline or an obligation on request.
They ask what not giving a response within a reasonable period contributes to increasing transparency.
Zij vragen wat het niet geven van een reactie binnen een redelijke termijn bijdraagt aan het vergroten van de transparantie

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against abolishing the mandatory government reply to advisory bodies' opinions and asked for better justification of reducing maximum membership and omitting temporary associate members. The government's nader rapport rejects the objections, arguing the reply obligation is procedural and that the amendment aims at better linking advice to the political agenda, with the memorandum to be supplemented.
concerns: Abolishing the mandatory government reply weakens the advisory bodies' contribution to checks and balances and the parliamentary debate, which the government rejects, arguing the reply was procedural and the amendment improves agenda linkage.

The justification for reducing the maximum number of members to ten is thin, and flexibility is lost; the government says the reduction fits broader rijksdienst efficiency goals and needs no change beyond the Act.
Omitting temporary associate members lacks adequate motivation given members' positive reaction; the government declines to regulate this, but agrees to supplement the explanatory memorandum.
The explanatory memorandum is too summary on the proposal's justification, and the government agrees to supplement it with its reasoning.

33844.s: The bill amends the Penitentiary Principles Act, the Principles Act on Detention of Persons Placed at Government Disposal, and the Juvenile Institutions Principles Act to clarify responsibility and oversight for prisoner transport, creating a transport oversight commission and complaint and appeal routes, and moves the medical complaints procedure into formal law. It also adds an experimentation clause allowing temporary deviation by general administrative order and lets the Minister appoint deputy directors to impose disciplinary measures.
33844.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer of transport powers to the Minister by the need for clarity and effective, unified rights protection, and justifies the experiment clause as enabling pilots while keeping parliamentary control.
q: It is proposed to give the Minister of Security and Justice certain powers with regard to transport.
Voorgesteld wordt om de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie enkele bevoegdheden te geven ten aanzien van het vervoer.
d: powers, composition and procedure of transport oversight commission
temporary experiments deviating from listed Pbw provisions
appointment of deputy directors with disciplinary powers
p: ARTIKEL I, G/Art. 29 lid 2 Pbw; ARTIKEL I, H/Art. 35 lid 2 Pbw
The Minister may search prisoners' bodies and clothing and use force or restraints during transport, with transport oversight conducted by a commission under the Minister's own establishment.
ARTIKEL I, L/Art. 57 lid 1 onder l Pbw
Transfer of a prisoner to another location within the same institution is moved to the director's competence, with complaint rights available.
ARTIKEL I, M/Art. 59a Pbw; ARTIKEL I, O/Art. 62 lid 1
A mediation procedure is formalised in law, with a committee member barred from complaint hearings where they mediated, strengthening complaint channels.
ARTIKEL I, F (Art. 18d-18e Pbw); ARTIKEL II, E; ARTIKEL III, G
Responsibility for transport moves from prison directors to the Minister, with transport staff exercising powers on the Minister's behalf and complaints routed to a ministry-based commission.
Deputy directors appointed by ministerial decision may impose disciplinary measures and order measures in the director's absence, with the director informed.
Experiments may temporarily depart from specified detention rights via general administrative order, subject to voorhang and a two-year limit.

parties: Asks whether delegation of transport powers to the minister under mandate will actually improve complaint handling and rights protection rather than add administrative burden.
