These members also value the legal protection of detainees but ask whether this amendment will in practice lead to better handling of complaints rather than more administrative burden.

Deze leden hechten ook aan de rechtsbescherming van gedetineerden maar vragen of deze wetwijziging in de praktijk ook zal leiden tot een betere afhandeling van klachten en niet tot meer administratieve lasten.
Not convinced of the need for an experiment clause allowing pilots without changing the law, given detainees' interests; asks why it is not done by statute.
They ask whether the need for experiments outside the law can be better demonstrated.
Zij vragen of de noodzaak van experimenten buiten de wet om beter aangetoond kan worden.
Questions the two separate transport procedures and the weaker, more distant complaint route for detainees, and doubts the experiment clause allowing departures from statutory rights.
Detainees are entrusted 24 hours a day to the care of Justice and Security in general and of the director of the relevant prison in particular.
Gedetineerden zijn 24 uur per dag toevertrouwd aan de zorg van Veiligheid en Justitie in het algemeen en aan de zorg van (de directeur van) de betreffende penitentiaire inrichting in het bijzonder.

Asks about the removal of an appeal option, wants restrictions on liberty explicitly legitimised by statute, and questions the budgetary motives and rights implications of the experiment clause and mandatory clothing in TBS.
These members believe that infringements on citizens' liberty by the government, including those of detainees, must be explicitly and concretely legitimised through statutory provisions.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat de door de overheid gemaakte inbreuken op de vrijheid van burgers, zo ook die van gedetineerden, expliciet en concreet gelegitimeerd dienen te worden middels wettelijke bepalingen.

Raises concern that removing an appeal option deprives convicted persons of a legal remedy, and asks how frequent strip searches are safeguarded and how the director's advice is ensured to carry weight.
The aforementioned members note that deleting an appeal option will deprive the convicted person of a legal remedy.
Voornoemde leden merken op dat het schrappen van een beroepsmogelijkheid er toe leidt dat de veroordeelde een rechtsmiddel zal worden ontnomen
Asks whether the transport liability change is truly necessary given that the problem lies in interpretation by the RSJ, and asks for transparent, critical evaluation of experimental provisions.
After all, the problem is not the right legislation but the correct application and interpretation of the existing legislation.
Het schort immers niet aan de juiste wetgeving, maar aan de juiste toepassing en uitleg van de reeds aanwezige wetgeving.

Asks about the medical complaints procedure, prisoner communication with the prison doctor, limits of the appeals committee, and whether the RSJ advice on medical complaints for TBS detainees was rightly set aside.
Can the detainee file a complaint with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate?
Kan de gedetineerde een klacht bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) indienen?

Objects that a major change to detention phasing and work obligations is made through an amendment rather than a separate bill, and asks whether it will be submitted to the Council of State for advice.
Is the government willing to detach this major legislative change from the present bill and submit it to the Council of State's advisory division and for consultation?

Is de regering bereid om deze forse wetswijziging alsnog los te koppelen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en deze voor te leggen aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State en ter consultatie aan te bieden?

Retains doubts about prison policy changes, asks whether the Council of State and other consulted parties should be asked again about the amendment, and raises complaints about promotion and demotion decisions.

Notes that the newly added detention phasing and promotion/demotion provisions lack advice from the advisory bodies, and asks the government to obtain such advice before plenary debate; questions the added value of the new regime given earlier success of phasing in reducing recidivism.
What stands out to the D66 members is that advice from the advisory bodies is missing for this fundamental addition.
Daarbij valt het de leden van de D66-fractie vooral op dat op deze fundamentele toevoeging adviezen van de adviesinstanties ontbreekt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Penitentiary Principles Act, the Youth Institutions Principles Act and the Principles Act on detention under TBS, covering experimental clauses, transport of detainees, and medical complaints. It raised major objections to the experimental clauses and to abolishing the appeal right against departure from a judge's TBS advice, and advised deleting or re-motivating them; the government's reply largely accepts the medical-complaints points and partly accepts the others, moving the TBS change to a separate amendment note.
concerns: The experimental clauses lack a demonstrated need and concrete examples of projects, so the Council advised dropping them unless properly justified; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum.

Abolishing the detainee's appeal against departure from the judge's TBS advice weakens legal protection without a substantiated rationale; the government moved this change to a separate amendment note for advice from consulted bodies.
The bill should define medical treatment in the statute for clarity and legal protection; the government chose instead to rely on the existing definition and clarified the complaint procedure.
Redactional comments on the medical complaints provisions and sunset clauses were adopted, except one comment on a seventh paragraph in Article 77a, which the government did not adopt.

33853.s: The bill ends the advance payment scheme (voorschotregeling) for old-age pensions and gives the executive power, by general administrative order (amvb), to set rules on what counts as sharing a main residence for unmarried pensioners, the so-called two-homes rule. It also makes related Work and Assistance Act provisions expire with the advance scheme and adds a transitional provision preserving the current care exception.
33853.j: The memorandum justifies the amvb power by the need for more objective, uniform and legally certain application of the household criterion across social security schemes.
q: the possibility is created to set rules by general administrative order (amvb) on having the main residence in the same dwelling
de mogelijkheid gecreëerd bij algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) regels te stellen met betrekking tot het hebben van het hoofdverblijf in dezelfde woning
d: rules on main residence in the same dwelling for joint household
p: Lets the executive define by amvb the criteria for joint household status that determine whether pensioners' benefits are reduced, without statutory criteria or parliamentary approval.

parties: Asks whether the implementing AMvB will be sent to the House and why the rules are not in the Act itself, and asks how strategic behaviour will be prevented.
These members are curious whether, and if so when, the general administrative order (AMvB) setting further rules on main residence in the same home will be sent to the House.

Genoemde leden zijn benieuwd of, en zo ja wanneer, de algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) om nadere regels te stellen met betrekking tot het hebben van het hoofdverblijf in dezelfde woning aan de Kamer wordt gezonden.
Asks how the SVB can verify housing costs and whether the executing agency's implementation test will be shared with the House.
Is the government willing to send the SVB's implementation assessment to the House?
Is de regering bereid de uitvoeringstoets van de SVB aan de Kamer te zenden?
Asks what the AMvB will contain and whether a pre-consultation procedure (voorhang) will be followed or the AMvB sent before debate.
Does the government intend to follow a pre-consultation procedure, or will it send the AMvB to the House before the bill is debated?
Is de regering van plan een voorhangprocedure te volgen of wil de regering de AMvB nog voor de wetsbehandeling aan de Kamer sturen?
Asks why the substance of the AMvB is not written directly into the Act, arguing this would give citizens more certainty.
Asks how the proposed rules relate to the cost-sharer norm and about the financial consequences.
The CDA members ask the government to indicate how the proposed rules relate to the cost-sharer norm in the AOW.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om aan te geven hoe de voorgestelde regelgeving zich verhoudt tot de regelgeving rond de kostendelersnorm in de AOW.
Asks for quantitative data on disputes and court cases about joint households across several benefit schemes, and why the rules are delegated to an AMvB.
How many legal proceedings are conducted on this (annually)?
Hoeveel juridische procedures worden hierover (jaarlijks) gevoerd?
Asks about fraud risks in municipal registration and oversight of the new rule, and whether the care exemption for family caregivers should be widened.
Can the government explain how the risk of fraudulent registrations in the municipal basic administration is prevented and what oversight of the new two-homes rule will look like?

Kan de regering toelichten hoe het risico op frauduleuze inschrijvingen in de Gemeentelijke Basisadministratie wordt voorkomen en hoe het toezicht op de nieuwe twee-woningen-regel er uit komt te zien?
Asks whether it is legally consistent for the same person to fall under different joint-household regimes across benefit schemes, raising legal certainty and equality concerns.
Does the government consider this desirable from the standpoint of legal certainty and equality before the law?
Acht de regering dit uit het oogpunt van rechtszekerheid en rechtsgelijkheid wenselijk?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised in December 2013 that the bill creating a basis for rules on 'same dwelling' (two-dwelling rule) for AOW pension purposes is supported, but the explanatory memorandum should address whether the planned removal of the care exception could wrongly capture one-person care-related multi-person households under the linked WWB bill. The government's nader rapport of January 2014 explains the sequencing with the WWB bill, adds transitional and retroactive provisions, and amends the explanatory memorandum to address the concern.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address whether care-related multi-person households are covered by the removal of the care exception, and the government amended the memorandum accordingly.
The Afdeling pointed to mismatched timing between this bill and the WWB-maatregelen bill, and the government added linking provisions and explained the planning.

33871.s: The bill implements Directive 2012/13/EU on the right to information in criminal proceedings by requiring that suspects be informed of the offence and their rights, in writing for arrested suspects and orally or in writing for non-arrested suspects, and it adds a judicial-authorisation requirement for withholding certain case documents. It also amends the Surrender Act (Overleveringswet) to require written notice of rights to persons arrested under a European arrest warrant and makes a technical change to Article 44 Sv on summonses.
33871.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to a general administrative order because the listed rights are not set out at statutory level in Dutch law.
q: because these are rights that are not laid down at statutory level in Dutch law
omdat het hier gaat om rechten die in het Nederlandse recht niet op het niveau van de wet zijn vastgelegd
d: ARTIKEL I, A (art. 27c, lid 3, sub g)
additional rights to be notified to arrested suspects
p: Technical amendment adding the summons for opposition proceedings to the list of notices about the right to request a lawyer.

parties: Asks whether the bill deviates from the Directive, how rights notifications and detention time limits are handled, and what consequences omissions may have for prosecution.
The members asked whether the bill deviates from the Directive.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen of in het wetsvoorstel wordt afgeweken van de Richtlijn.
Questions whether detailed information on charges is given in time under Article 6 and whether the public prosecution service must provide essential case documents without request.
Do these members understand correctly that the government considers the moment a suspect receives detailed information about the offence to be when the suspect learns of the indictment?

Begrijpen deze leden het goed dat de regering van mening is dat het moment waarop de verdachte gedetailleerde informatie over het strafbare feit krijgt, het moment is dat de verdachte kennisneemt van de tenlastelegging?
Stresses that rights must be realised in practice, not only on paper, and asks about access to wiretap transcripts and accessibility for illiterate or visually impaired suspects.
Does the government share the view that it is of great importance that the right to information in criminal proceedings is not only regulated on paper but that compliance in practice is essential?
Deelt de regering de opvatting dat het daarbij van groot belang is dat het recht op informatie in strafprocedures niet alleen op papier is geregeld, maar dat naleving in de praktijk essentieel is?

Supports the bill as strengthening safeguards for arrested suspects and notes the government adequately responded to Raad van State and consulted bodies, while asking about consequences if their feared interpretation problems materialise.
The aforementioned members ask what consequences the government attaches if the fears expressed by those bodies turn out to be justified.
Voornoemde leden vragen welke consequenties de regering eraan verbindt als de door de bedoelde instanties geuite vrees bewaarheid gaat worden.
Asks for concrete examples of the added value of notifying rights to arrested and stopped suspects and on the applicability of service requirements to non-arrested suspects.
The PVV members ask whether the government can argue what the added value is of notifying rights where an arrested person is immediately taken to the police station for presentation.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering beargumenteerd kan aangeven wat de toegevoegde waarde is van het mededelen van de rechten in het geval een aangehouden persoon terstond wordt overgebracht naar het politiebureau ter voorgeleiding?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill implementing Directive 2012/13/EU on the right to information in criminal proceedings but asks for better justification and possible adjustment of the grounds for refusing access to case documents, which it finds differ from Article 7(4) of the Directive. The government's reply rejects the claim that the wording differs in substance, adds explanation to the memorie van toelichting, and makes a minor redrafting change to Article 27c.
concerns: The Afdeling asks how the refusal ground for witness overlast or serious obstruction relates to the Directive's requirement that life or fundamental rights be seriously endangered; the government explains the fundamental rights basis and adds this to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling considers the stricter national refusal grounds (zwaarwegend opsporingsbelang, staatsveiligheid) require a reasoned justification in the explanatory memorandum; the government disagrees, arguing these grounds already fully give substance to the 'overriding general interest' concept.

The government redrafts Article 27c(3)(a) so the written rights notice need only state the right to know the offence of suspicion, not describe the specific offence, and makes a technical renumbering in the Overleveringswet references.

33907.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act and the Dutch Caribbean environmental law (Wet volkshuisvesting, ruimtelijke ordening en milieubeheer BES) to implement the 2009 amendment to the 1996 London Protocol on marine dumping, by prohibiting export of carbon dioxide except as allowed under that Protocol and requiring a permit for transfers. It contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive beyond the ministerial permit requirement.
33907.j: The memorandum justifies the new regime as necessary to implement the 2009 Protocol amendment, with the permit tied to the Protocol's requirements.
q: A permit as referred to in the first paragraph of this article is granted only if the transfer takes place in accordance with article 6, second paragraph, of the 1996 Protocol concluded in London on 7 November 1996

Een vergunning als bedoeld in het eerste lid van dit artikel wordt uitsluitend verleend indien het overbrengen geschiedt in overeenstemming met artikel 6, tweede lid, van het op 7 november 1996 te Londen tot stand gekomen Protocol van 1996
p: Wet milieubeheer art. 10.60a; Wet BES art. 4.15a
The minister is given a permit power over carbon dioxide transfers, but the permit may only be granted if the transfer complies with the Protocol's conditions.

33940-V.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) by changing expenditure and commitment amounts, expressed in thousands of euros. It takes effect from 1 June 2014, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2014 to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V).
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2014 wijzigingen aan te brengen in: de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

33961.s: The bill replaces the sanctions mechanism for decentralised governments (municipalities, provinces, water boards) in the Dutch sustainable public finances act with a correction mechanism, allowing measures by general administrative order (AMvB) after administrative consultation when the collective EMU balance share is exceeded over several years. It also removes the reference to imposing cuts (kortingen) and to article 6 from article 9, and the AMvB takes effect only four weeks after publication, with notice to both chambers.
33961.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB route by the structural nature of the macro norm and the need to consider forecasts as well as realisations, and it notes that a voorhang procedure lets the States General comment on proposed measures.
q: A voorhang procedure always applies, in which the States General can express a view on the proposed measures for decentralised governments.
Er geldt steeds een voorhangprocedure, waarbij de Staten-Generaal zich kan uitspreken over de voorgestelde maatregelen aan de decentrale overheden.
d: measures to ensure decentralised governments meet collective EMU balance target
p: Allows the government to impose measures on decentralised governments by AMvB, with administrative consultation as the only prior step and a voorhang procedure before parliament.
Delays entry into force of the AMvB by four weeks after publication and requires immediate notice to both chambers of the States General.

parties: No additional questions or remarks on the bill.
They see no reason to ask additional questions or make remarks.
Zij zien geen reden tot het stellen van aanvullende vragen of opmerkingen.

Welcomes the replacement of sanctions by a correction mechanism but questions whether it may reduce subnational investment, contrary to a Kamer motion, and objects to relying on CPB forecasts for multi-year overshoots.
Is the government willing to still consult with the decentralised governments to reach closer agreement on this point?
Is de regering bereid om alsnog met de decentrale overheden in overleg te gaan om op dit punt nader tot elkaar te komen?

Sees the correction mechanism as an improvement but wants national correction avoided, wants investment phasing reconciled with the Van Hijum motion, and insists multi-year overshoots be based on hard realised figures rather than forecasts.
These members are of the view that this overshoot must be evident from hard realised figures.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat deze overschrijding moet blijken uit harde realisatiecijfers.

33970.s: The bill re-enacts the Instellingswet for the Raad voor strafrechtstoepassing en jeugdbescherming, sharpening the separation between its advisory and adjudicative roles, broadening review grounds in penitentiary case law, and introducing cassation in the interest of the law before the Hoge Raad. It also amends the Penitentiary Principles Acts and the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie to add buitengewone leden and the new cassation route.
33970.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for organisational separation of advisory and adjudicative tasks and for consistent rule-making under European Court case law.
q: It is proposed to also distinguish the two tasks of the RSJ more sharply.
Voorgesteld wordt ook de beide taken van de RSJ scherper te onderscheiden.
d: appointment of Raad members by royal decree on Minister's nomination
Raad internal procedural rules subject to Minister approval
travel and allowance reimbursement for Raad members by general administrative order
commencement date set by royal decree, possibly differing per chapter
p: The Minister nominates the chair and Raad members and appoints the secretary and staff, giving the executive a role in shaping the adjudicating body's personnel.
The Minister may demand inspection of documents from the Raad, which could affect the independence of the advisory and adjudicating functions.

Amendments require the penitentiary authorities to weigh public safety and victims' interests alongside individual interests when granting freedoms, expanding executive discretion over detainees and ter beschikking gestelden.

parties: Supports separating advisory and adjudicative tasks but argues the separation does not go far enough and asks for strict separation in appointments and budgets.
As far as the VVD members are concerned, the proposed separation of tasks does not go far enough.
Wat de leden van de VVD-fractie betreft gaat de voorgestelde scheiding van taken niet ver genoeg.

Questions whether anchoring victims' and safety interests in law could unduly weigh against detainees, and doubts the need for cassation in the interest of the law given the Hoge Raad's own reservations.
Can the government elaborate on this?
Kan de regering hier nader op ingaan?
Supports sharper separation of tasks but questions the minister's involvement in RSJ organisation and whether the new review ground is necessary, as the RSJ already weighs these interests.
These members ask, however, whether this is not already taken into account and to what extent this change is necessary to safeguard these interests.
Deze leden vragen echter of daar niet nu al rekening mee wordt gehouden en in hoeverre deze wijziging noodzakelijk is om deze belangen te waarborgen.

Supports the victims and safety review ground but questions how it will be implemented, who is responsible for contacting victims, and whether cassation is the right remedy for disagreements with RSJ rulings.
They ask the government whether the wish to propose cassation in the interest of the law does not merely stem from the government's dissatisfaction with certain RSJ decisions in these cases.
Deze leden vragen de regering of de wens om cassatie in het belang der wet voor te stellen niet louter voorkomt uit onvrede van de regering met bepaalde beslissingen van de RSJ in deze casus.
Asks whether members must disclose secondary positions and how dual membership is prevented from undermining the RSJ's independence and impartiality.
How can the independence and impartiality of the RSJ be legally guaranteed given the possibility of this dual membership?
Hoe kan door de mogelijkheid van dit dubbellidmaatschap de onafhankelijkheid en onpartijdigheid van de RSJ juridisch gewaarborgd worden?
Supports avoiding partiality and its appearance, but asks how the multidisciplinary approach and basic expertise are safeguarded and how the proposal relates to the Raad van State model.
Can the government further explain how that multidisciplinary approach and sufficient basic expertise, which the RSJ attaches such importance to, are safeguarded in the proposal?
Kan de regering nader toelichten hoe die multidisciplinaire benadering en voldoende basisdeskundigheid waar de RSJ zo aan hecht, in het voorstel wordt gewaarborgd?

Asks about safeguarding the RSJ's quality and independence, the minister's role in appointing the chair, the use of external experts, and how cassation's added value is proven given its proportionality.
They ask to elaborate on this caveat and to also give insight into what other options for appointing a chair have been considered.
Zij vragen nader op deze kanttekening in te gaan en daarbij tevens inzicht te geven welke andere mogelijkheden voor de benoeming van een voorzitter zijn overwogen.
Asks why dual membership is allowed here while the government proposes banning it for the Raad van State, and about the rationale for cassation given the Afdeling advisering's criticism.
Why are dual memberships possible here, while the government in 2010 chose to make this less straightforward at the Raad van State and now proposes to prohibit it entirely?

Waarom zijn dubbellidmaatschappen hier wel mogelijk, terwijl de regering er in 2010 voor gekozen heeft dit bij de Raad van State minder eenvoudig te maken en intussen voorstelt dit helemaal te verbieden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised reconsidering the introduction of cassatie in het belang der wet against RSJ rulings, questioning its necessity and the loss of Hoge Raad members sitting in the RSJ, and asked for better justification of explicit review grounds and the shortened appointment term. The government's nader rapport defends the cassatie proposal, accepts a clarified explanation of the review grounds, and partly accepts the advice by allowing a second reappointment for a maximum of four years, with several drafting points adopted.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity of cassatie in het belang der wet against RSJ rulings insufficiently demonstrated, which the government rejected, arguing such rulings can raise legal questions and rechtseenheid needs a procedural safeguard.
The Afdeling warned that loss of Hoge Raad members sitting in the RSJ could harm legal unity, which the government did not accept as outweighing the benefits of the cassation instrument.
The Afdeling asked that the explicit review grounds (safety of society and victims' interests) be justified and possibly dropped, and the government clarified their purpose without deleting them.
The Afdeling asked for justification of the shortened appointment term and the bar on reappointment as buitengewoon lid, and the government allowed a second reappointment for up to four years.
The Afdeling made several redactional remarks, most of which the government adopted, except for one final remark on article 29.

34096.s: The bill amends the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren to allow judicial officials and trainees working at public prosecution district offices to be assigned work on Sundays and public holidays under the ZSM model, without invoking a service-interest justification. The explanatory memorandum states the change allows routine weekend and holiday rostering with a surcharge set by ministerial regulation.
34096.j: The memorandum justifies the change by stating that ZSM's 7x14-hour openness makes weekend and holiday work unavoidable, so a case-by-case service-interest test is no longer meaningful.
q: The nature and organisation of the ZSM working method make daily opening of the public prosecution service throughout the calendar year, from 8.00 am to 10.00 pm, including Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays (7 x 14-hour shifts), unavoidable.

De aard en organisatie van de ZSM-werkwijze maken een dagelijkse openstelling van het OM gedurende het gehele kalenderjaar, van 8.00 uur in de ochtend tot 22.00 uur in de avond, ook op zaterdagen, zondagen en feestdagen (7 x 14-uursdiensten) onvermijdelijk.
d: surcharge rates for ZSM work outside regular hours
p: Removes the requirement that weekend and holiday work be justified as unavoidable service interest, replacing it with a standing rostering rule for ZSM staff.

parties: Supports fast handling of minor offences via ZSM and asks about the level of allowances and whether the draft ministerial regulation can be shared with the House.
The VVD members note that it is important that common offences, such as street nuisance, are handled quickly.
De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat het belangrijk is dat veel voorkomende delicten, zoals overlast op straat, snel worden afgehandeld.
Asks about the pilot results, whether the OM has enough capacity, and how costs are borne given existing budget cuts.
Can the government indicate what the outcomes of this pilot are?
Kan de regering aangeven wat de uitkomsten van deze pilot zijn?
Asks whether officials with religious objections to Sunday work could be compelled, how the employer will accommodate them, and how dismissals or transfers are guarded against.

These members ask the government to what extent this bill could result in increasingly calling on officials who prefer not to work on these days because of their religion to perform work on these days.

Deze leden vragen de regering in hoeverre onderhavig wetsvoorstel als gevolg zou kunnen hebben dat in toenemende mate een beroep op het verrichten van arbeid op genoemde dagen zal worden gedaan op functionarissen die dat liever niet willen vanwege het belijden van hun godsdienst.
Asks whether the amendment only covers judicial officials at the OM and not those in the judiciary.
The PVV members ask the government whether it is correct that the amendment exclusively concerns judicial officials working at the OM.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering of het klopt dat de wetswijziging uitsluitend ziet op de rechterlijke ambtenaren werkzaam bij het OM.
Supports voluntary structural rostering to protect religious freedom, asks for an estimate of the group not willing to work, and whether the Council of State's concern was addressed in SORM.
These members support the approach of structurally rostering officials on Sundays and recognised holidays as far as possible on a voluntary basis.
Deze leden steunen de lijn de inzet van functionarissen op zondagen en erkende feestdagen zo veel mogelijk op vrijwillige basis structureel in te roosteren.

Questions whether Sunday work is truly necessary and whether the bill goes beyond what is needed; asks why voluntariness and the 'dienstbelang' safeguard are not written into the statute and what 'organisatie van de arbeid' means.
These members ask why that voluntariness is not laid down in the text of the bill, as was also done, for example, in the Working Hours Act.
Deze leden vragen waarom die vrijwilligheid niet in de tekst van het wetsvoorstel is vastgelegd, zoals bijvoorbeeld ook in de Arbeidstijdenwet is gedaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill allowing judicial officers (officieren van justitie) to be assigned work on Sundays and public holidays for the ZSM working method, but asks the explanatory memorandum to address consequences for staff who refuse such work for religious reasons. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented as advised, that the government will try to accommodate objecting staff, and that drafting remarks were incorporated.
concerns: The bill may touch freedom of religion, as employees may be obliged to work on religious holidays, so the explanatory memorandum should address the consequences for those objecting on religious grounds.
A redactional remark on the citation title and the reference in Article III was incorporated into the bill.

34159.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure and related laws to expand suspects' rights to legal assistance, including earlier notification of the right to counsel, full recording of interrogations, and appointment of counsel by the legal aid board rather than via the judge. It also adjusts detention rules, extending the maximum period of questioning-detention for offences carrying pre-trial detention to nine hours and the appearance deadline before the investigating judge, and lets the legal aid board recover costs from convicted persons of sufficient means.
34159.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to current practice, European case law requiring prompt appearance before a judge, and the need to make legal aid and interrogation records more reliable for courts to review.
q: It is proposed to assign the power of arrest outside flagrante delicto to the officials who actually exercise it in practice, on the order of the public prosecutor or duty officer.

Voorgesteld wordt de bevoegd heid tot aanhouding buiten heterdaad neer te leggen bij de functionarissen die deze in de praktijk daadwerkelijk, op bevel van de officier van justitie of de hulpofficier, uitoefenen:
d: Wet op de rechtsbijstand art. 43 lid 4 (new)
detailed rules on recovering legal aid costs from convicted persons
p: Extends the maximum period a suspect may be held for questioning from six to nine hours for offences carrying pre-trial detention, and lets prosecutors perform powers normally reserved for the duty officer.
Prosecutor may bar counsel access for up to six days, subject to court review within the framework of the existing rules.
Assigns the power to arrest outside flagrante delicto to the officers who actually carry it out, reflecting current practice rather than the duty officer personally.

parties: Asks why the detention period extension and the new lawyer-access rules are needed, and whether a lawyer can realistically be arranged within six hours for offences without pre-trial detention.
This is primarily relevant to the bill on access to a lawyer in criminal proceedings, but also has relevance for the present bill.
Dit is primair relevant voor het wetsvoorstel recht op toegang tot een advocaat in strafprocedures, maar heeft ook relevantie voor het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.
Objects that giving the police hulpofficier power to order arrest without the prosecutor, opposed by NOvA and Rvdr, is insufficiently justified and removes prosecutorial oversight.
The NOvA and the Rvdr object to this extension.
Tegen deze uitbreiding maken de NOvA en de Rvdr bezwaar.
Worries that removing the prosecutor's explicit role in ordering arrests weakens safeguards for citizens, and that suspects who voluntarily report are not informed of their rights.
These members share the concerns of the Council of State advisory division, the NOvA and the Rvdr, since the explicit role of the public prosecutor is almost entirely undone.
Deze leden delen de zorgen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State, de NOvA en de RvdR, nu de expliciete rol van de officier van justitie vrijwel teniet wordt gedaan.
Asks whether suspects who are not wealthy enough will be charged for legal aid, the funding source (the 105 million police reserve), and the reliability of police records.

These members also ask the government to respond to the remarks made by Mr van de Kamp, chair of the police union ACP, in reaction to a survey of Dutch criminal lawyers on the accuracy of police records.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering in dit kader ook te reageren op de opmerkingen die de heer van de Kamp, voorzitter van de politievakbond ACP, maakte in reactie op een enquête onder Nederlandse strafrechtadvocaten over de juistheid van door politieambtenaren opgestelde processen-verbaal.
Asks why the existing article 49 Sv cost-recovery power is unused and why the new provision is expected to work in practice, and questions the meaning of 'special cases' for extra counsel.
Why is this possibility not used in practice, and why is it expected that the proposed article will be used in practice?
Waarom wordt van deze mogelijkheid in de praktijk geen gebruik gemaakt en waarom wordt verwacht dat men in de praktijk wel gebruik zal gaan maken van het voorgestelde artikel?
Asks about the cumulative financial effect of three cost-recovery proposals on convicted persons and how the hulpofficier can stay objective with broadened powers.

To what extent has the government considered the cumulative effects of these three cost-recovery proposals, and can it calculate the minimum and maximum financial consequences for a convicted suspect?

In hoeverre heeft de regering de stapelingsgevolgen van deze drie verhalingsvoorstellen bezien en kan zij voorrekenen wat in het licht van alle drie de wetsvoorstellen minimaal en maximaal in financiële zin de gevolgen kunnen zijn voor een verdachte die onherroepelijk veroordeeld wordt?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill's changes to arrest, detention for investigation and pre-trial custody be limited to the extension of the detention-for-investigation period, as the other changes were not adequately justified and should await the wider modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The government's reply, while withdrawing the inverzekeringstelling changes and the extension of arrest powers to all offences into the modernisation, kept the remaining measures and explained its reasons.
concerns: The Council found the necessity of extending arrest outside flagrante delicto to all offences insufficiently justified; the government moved this change to the modernisation bill.

The Council required that the automatic judicial review of lawfulness of detention and mandatory appearance before the examining magistrate be preserved, in line with Article 5(3) ECHR; the government withdrew the change to the modernisation.
The Council held the abolition of the rechter-commissaris lawfulness check and extension of inverzekeringstelling insufficiently motivated and suggested other solutions for weekend availability.
The Council advised that the hulpofficier van justitie not be involved in cases where they themselves investigate; the government saw no signals of lack of professionalism and did not adopt this.
The Council advised that the officier van justitie be notified without delay of arrest outside flagrante delicto; the government did not adopt a separate notification duty and explained why.

The Council advised motivating the expected average cost recovery from convicted persons and the feasibility of recovering legal aid costs; the government revised the financial calculation and moved the regulation into the Wet op de rechtsbijstand.
The Council made several redactional comments on wording and cross-references, which were adopted.

34195.s: The bill amends the Childcare Act and the quality rules for playgroups to create a personal register for childcare and playgroup workers, enabling continuous screening of their criminal records instead of periodic certificate of conduct (VOG) requirements. It also sets out registration, blocking, fee and data-processing rules, most of which are to be fleshed out by general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial regulation.
34195.j: The memorandum justifies continuous screening by the need to protect children and reduce administrative burden, and cites Article 8 ECHR as the legal basis for processing criminal data.
q: As a result, employees who may pose a threat to the safety of the children in care can quickly be excluded from childcare.
Hierdoor kunnen medewerkers die mogelijk een bedreiging vormen voor de veiligheid van de opgevangen kinderen, snel worden geweerd uit de kinderopvang.
d: 1.48d, lid 7 (Wko, inserted by Art. I B)
rules on data processing in the childcare personal register
timing of transitional registration of existing and remaining workers
entry into force by royal decree, possibly different per article
p: Establishes continuous, ongoing screening of workers' criminal records with data exchange between ministries, removing periodic individual certificate checks and placing the register under ministerial control.
Allows the inspector to trigger a fresh VOG demand and immediate blocking of a person's register entry on a signal, with notice of the reason withheld from the employer and worker.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill creating a continuous-screening personal register for childcare and playgroup workers, raising proportionality, cost-recovery, and data-protection concerns. The minister's nader rapport accepted most points: limiting screening to structurally present persons, removing cost charges to household members, clarifying the Wbp relationship, and dropping the purpose delegation.
concerns: Continuous screening should be limited in the statutory text to persons structurally present during opening hours, including for childcare centres.
Cost recovery from registrants is disproportionate; the public interest also benefits, so structural costs should be shared with government.
The explanatory memorandum inadequately explains the relationship between the bill and the Wbp and Wjsg data-protection regimes.
Delegation to amend the purpose of data disclosure by AMvB should be removed; all purposes belong in the statute.
Several redactional corrections to article references and wording were recommended and incorporated.

34210-IV.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2015 budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (IV), raising expenditure on Kingdom partner autonomy and realigning funds for the coastguard, border control and judiciary on Sint Maarten. It adjusts appropriations in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2015.
q: The budget is set in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de begrotingsstaat geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

34210-VI.s: This is a first supplementary budget bill (eerste suppletoire begroting) amending the 2015 departmental budget of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the budgets of several executive agencies (DJI, IND, CJIB, NFI, JUSTIS). It sets out the expenditure, revenue and cash-flow changes across policy articles, mainly to cover shortfalls and new costs.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice for the year 2015.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2015.

34276.s: The bill amends the Dutch international tax assistance act and the Caribbean Netherlands tax act to implement the OECD Common Reporting Standard and EU Directive 2014/107/EU, requiring financial institutions to identify account holders and report account information automatically to the tax authority for exchange with other jurisdictions. Key operational rules, including identification and reporting requirements and the definitions of exempt entities and accounts, are delegated to a general administrative order and ministerial regulations.
34276.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by stating that the identification and reporting rules are extensive and detailed and that they follow the structure of the EU directive and the CRS.
q: The identification and reporting requirements contain extensive and detailed provisions. A delegation basis will be included in the WIB on which these requirements will be based.

De identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften bevatten uitgebreide en gedetailleerde bepalingen. In de WIB zal een delegatiegrondslag worden opgenomen waar deze voorschriften op zullen worden gebaseerd.
d: Artikel I.B (artikel 2a, lid 1, onderdeel d; artikel 2a, lid 1, onderdeel h)
designating additional non-reporting financial institutions and exempt accounts
identification and reporting rules for reporting financial institutions
deadline and manner of providing account information to the tax authority
Artikel II (artikel 8.133a, lid 3, onderdelen a en b)
designating low-risk institutions and accounts for Caribbean Netherlands
p: Detailed identification and reporting requirements for financial institutions are left to a general administrative order rather than set out in the statute itself.

parties: Asks the government to confirm that shared information is exchanged only on a confidential basis between tax authorities, a data-protection safeguard.
The VVD members ask the government whether it can confirm that shared information is exchanged only on a confidential basis between tax authorities.
De leden van de fractie van de VVD vragen de regering of zij kan bevestigen dat de gedeelde informatie alleen op vertrouwelijke basis tussen belastingdiensten wordt uitgewisseld?
Supports automatic exchange as an important tool against tax avoidance and evasion, while asking about alignment with FATCA and identification rules.
Automatic data exchange is a very important instrument in the fight against tax evasion and tax avoidance.
Automatische gegevensuitwisseling is een zeer belangrijk instrument in de strijd tegen belastingontduiking en belastingontwijking.
Asks which data are shared, what the exceptions are, how the Global Forum data-protection review works, and what sanctions apply for non-compliance.
The SP members ask the government to explain as clearly as possible exactly which data on financial accounts held at financial institutions are shared.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering zo helder mogelijk aan te geven welke gegevens over financiële rekeningen die worden gehouden bij financiële instellingen precies worden gedeeld.
Raises practical feasibility for banks, the delegation of rules to an AMvB, the scope of residence determination, and whether taxpayers can appeal disputed residence findings.
Is objection and appeal possible, as in disputes over residence between the taxpayer and the inspector?
Is er bezwaar en beroep mogelijk zoals bij onenigheid over de woonplaats tussen de belastingplichtige en de inspecteur?
Supports the aim of combating tax avoidance and evasion and Dutch early-adopter status, while asking about progress in partner countries and US reciprocity under the IGA.
This contributes to combating tax avoidance and evasion, a goal these members warmly support.
Hiermee wordt een bijdrage geleverd aan het tegengaan van belastingontwijking- en ontduiking, een doel dat door deze leden van harte wordt gesteund.
Asks about the duty to inform account holders that data are collected, and whether the Schrems ruling on data transfers remains relevant for FATCA disclosures to the United States.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the bill implementing Directive 2014/107/EU and the OECD Common Reporting Standard, but requested a legal basis and criteria for designating excluded accounts and non-reporting institutions, clearer explanation of BES-island choices, terminology alignment, a fuller transposition table, and clarification on referendum exemption. The government's nader rapport accepted nearly all points, amended the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly, and rejected only the redactional points it chose not to adopt.
concerns: The Council required a statutory basis and criteria for designating excluded accounts and non-reporting entities, which the government added to articles 2a WIB and 8.133a BelBES.
The transposition table was insufficient for tracing implementation of the directive's annexes, and the government supplemented it.
The explanatory memorandum needed to specify which excluded accounts and institutions are concerned, which the government did.

The choice to apply EU-based options to the BES islands was insufficiently justified and consultation of island authorities was unclear; the government explained the reasoning but did not consult them.

Terminology differences ('entiteit' versus 'onderneming', 'persoon uit een deelnemend rechtsgebied' versus 'persoon van een lidstaat', and bruto amounts wording) were pointed out and aligned or explained.
The explanatory memorandum on entry into force needed to address the Referendum Act exception, which the government clarified.

34285.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by incidental supplementary budget changes in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force on 1 October of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2015 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd

34294.s: The bill adds two standalone offences to the Dutch Criminal Code: simple money laundering and simple culpable money laundering, covering only the acquisition or possession of objects directly derived from one's own offence, without any concealment intent. It also adjusts related provisions on additional penalties and pre-trial arrest powers in the Code of Criminal Procedure.
34294.j: The memorandum justifies the new offences by arguing that the existing case-law exclusion for own-offence proceeds leaves prosecutors unable to act against cash-based organised crime, so a separate offence is needed.
q: The fact that the legislator creates these additional offences precisely because the case-law qualification exclusion makes criminal action impossible must be reason enough for the judge to refrain from applying that exclusion to such conduct.

Het feit dat de wetgever deze aanvullende strafbaarstellingen in het leven roept juist omdat het op grond van de jurisprudentie geformuleerde kwalificatie-uitsluitingsgrond niet mogelijk is strafrechtelijk op te treden, moet daarbij voor de rechter reden genoeg zijn ervan af te zien
p: New standalone offences criminalise acquiring or possessing proceeds of one's own offence without concealment intent, expanding prosecutorial reach over suspects while being defined with fixed penalty maxima.
Adds the new offences to the list allowing arrest for questioning and investigative powers, widening the investigative toolkit available to prosecutors.

parties: Supports the bill as implementing a motion to close a gap left by Supreme Court case law, and asks whether past unrecovered criminal assets can now be seized.
The VVD members are therefore pleased and very content that this bill implements this motion.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn dan ook blij en zeer content dat met dit wetsvoorstel uitvoering wordt gegeven aan deze motie.
Asks how to prevent prosecutors from too easily switching to money-laundering charges instead of pursuing the predicate offence, and how many suspects were discharged.
How can it be prevented that prosecution of the predicate offence is too easily dropped in favour of prosecution under the money-laundering articles?
Hoe kan worden voorkomen dat te gemakkelijk wordt afgezien van vervolging van het gronddelict en in plaats daarvan wordt overgestapt naar vervolging op basis van de witwasartikelen?
Asks how the burden of proof works for objective indicators of laundering and what the suspect must show to rebut it, and whether the offence is broader than case law.
What is expected of a suspect to prove the contrary?
Wat wordt van een verdachte verwacht om het tegendeel te bewijzen?
Warns the Supreme Court may narrow the offence again, asks for objective indicators in the legislative history, and questions the low penalty range (six months) relative to predicate offences.
The CDA members ask the government to reconsider its choice of the low penalty on the proposed articles, because the ratio (six months vs. four years) already seems too disproportionate.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering haar keuze voor de geringe strafbedreiging op de voorgestelde artikelen te herzien omdat de verhouding (zes maanden vs. vier jaar) nu wel al te zeer uit verhouding lijkt.
Raises the risk of cumulative liability for closely related offences in breach of the ne bis in idem principle, and asks how the new offence relates to confiscation.

The ChristenUnie members note that this bill risks cumulative criminal liability for the same or related offences, which conflicts with the principle that one cannot be convicted twice for the same act.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie constateren dat met dit wetsvoorstel het risico bestaat dat rond dezelfde of aan elkaar verwante strafbare feiten een cumulatie van strafrechtelijke aansprakelijkheden ontstaat, die schuurt met het beginsel dat men niet twee keer voor hetzelfde feit veroordeeld kan worden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill's aim of criminalising the mere acquisition or possession of proceeds of one's own offence, but advises reformulating the new provisions as standalone offences and aligning the wording of the predicate offence with case law. The government's reply accepts these points, redrafts the provisions as standalone offences, changes the predicate-offence wording, and amends article 67 Sv so pre-trial detention is available for the new offences.
concerns: The new offences were framed as provisions modifying the sentence for money laundering rather than as standalone offences, creating unclear scope; the government redrafted them as standalone offences.
The phrase 'misdrijf dat de schuldige heeft gepleegd' suggested a stricter proof requirement than case law; the government replaced it with 'eigen misdrijf' to align with existing jurisprudence.

Article 67 Sv was inconsistent because the negligence variant fell within pre-trial detention powers while the intentional variant did not; the government amended article 67 Sv to include the new offences.

34300-IV.s: The bill sets the 2016 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Kingdom Relations chapter (IV) and the BES-fonds for Caribbean Netherlands, in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2016. The explanatory memorandum describes spending on guarantees, financial supervision, integrity and rule-of-law support for Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands.
q: The budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2016 belonging to this Act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34300-VI.s: This bill fixes the 2016 budget statements (departmental and agency) of the Ministry of Security and Justice, setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It also clarifies that the Minister is not responsible for the efficiency of court administration but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Council for the Judiciary.
q: With reference to article 21 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 in conjunction with articles 23 and 91 of the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie, the Minister of Security and Justice is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's business operations.

Onder verwijzing naar het bepaalde in artikel 21 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

34348.s: The bill amends the Mijnbouwwet (Mining Act) to strengthen safety considerations and give the Minister more control over exploration, extraction and storage permits, including new grounds for refusal, amendment and revocation tied to structuurvisie and general administrative measures. It also makes the state mining supervisor (SodM, now the inspecteur-generaal der mijnen) more independent by attributing its supervisory and enforcement powers directly to it, limiting ministerial instructions, and allowing cost recovery from industry.
34348.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded ministerial powers as necessary to strengthen safety and steer strategic decisions on subsurface use, while strengthening SodM's independence and oversight role.
q: With this bill the Minister gets more possibilities to steer by broadening the ability to attach conditions and restrictions to an exploration, extraction or storage permit.

Met dit wetsvoorstel krijgt de Minister meer mogelijkheden om regie te voeren door verruiming van de mogelijkheid om voorschriften en beperkingen aan een opsporings-, winnings- of opslagvergunning te verbinden.
d: areas excluded from exploration or extraction by general administrative order
rules on extraction installations, areas, depth, activity and substance type attached to permits
Mijnbouwbesluit rules on excluding areas, depth, activity type and substance type
rules on cost recovery (retributions) from mining operators
amount of retributions fixed by ministerial regulation
rules on splitting pre-1965 permits and adjusting restrictions
p: The Minister gains broader discretion to attach conditions, amend and revoke existing mining permits on safety, land-use and changed-circumstances grounds.
Procedural changes extend the extended preparation procedure and advisory role of provinces, municipalities and water boards in approvals of winning plans.
Ministerial instructions to the inspecteur-generaal are limited to written form, non-delegable, and cannot concern investigations or findings, with special instructions sent to Parliament.
Enforcement and supervisory powers are attributed directly to the inspecteur-generaal der mijnen, making SodM an independent administrative body rather than acting under ministerial mandate.
Pre-1965 permits can be split, with the new permit for the split area falling under the regular regime while conditions are carried over.

parties: Asks how the reversed burden of proof relates to the Commissie Bodemdaling findings on a link between building damage and gas extraction.
The VVD members further ask the government how the content of Article 177a, first paragraph relates to the findings of the Bodemdaling Commission.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering verder hoe de inhoud van artikel 177a, eerste lid zich verhoudt tot het onderzoek van de Commissie Bodemdaling.
Asks why the presumption is limited to the contour area and whether it should apply across the Netherlands given the weaker procedural position of individuals.
Is it correct that the aim should be to better balance the legal positions of the parties, especially because the burden of proof for an individual against a mining company is far too heavy?
Klopt dat het doel zou moeten zijn het meer in evenwicht brengen van de rechtsposities van partijen, met name omdat de bewijslast voor een particulier tegenover een mijnbouwbedrijf veel te zwaar is?
Argues the bill excludes victims outside the contour map and that the presumption is weakened by exculpatory causes and complex cases.
In the view of many SP members, the way the 'presumption of proof' law is now being filled in does not solve the problem that has arisen.
Naar menig van de leden van de SP-fractie wordt met de wijze waarop nu invulling wordt gegeven aan de «wet bewijsvermoeden» de gerezen problematiek niet opgelost.
Asks for a central desk for damage outside Groningen and an evaluation of the reversed burden of proof two years after entry into force.

These members ask the government to evaluate the reversal of the burden of proof in the Groningen effect area and the functioning of the central desk for possible mining damage two years after this amendment takes effect.

Om bovengenoemde redenen vragen deze leden de regering om de omkering van de bewijslast in het effectgebied in Groningen en het functioneren van het centraal loket voor mogelijke schade door mijnbouw nadat deze wetswijziging twee jaar in werking is, te evalueren.
Asks what the presumption concretely means in practice and whether it applies only to the Groningen field, and criticises the coalition for claiming credit for an opposition motion.
Is it correct that this introduction of the presumption applies only to the Groningen field?
Klopt het dat deze invoering van het bewijsvermoeden alleen van toepassing is op het Groningenveld?
Welcomes the statutory presumption but asks why it is limited to Groningen when other mining areas face similar weaker positions, and whether non-physical damage is excluded.
They ask, however, why the introduction of the statutory presumption is limited to the province of Groningen.
Zij vragen echter waarom de introductie van het wettelijk bewijsvermoeden zich beperkt tot de provincie Groningen.
Probes the arbitration agreements with NAM, including whether victims keep access to courts and appeal, and the role of the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen.
Can the government indicate whether a standard arbitration agreement will be drawn up?
Kan de regering aangeven of er een standaard arbitrageovereenkomst wordt opgesteld?
Says the amended bill is heavily watered down compared with the amendment Vos/Ouwehand, limiting the reversal to Groningen gas damage and to physical damage to buildings.
The Vos/Ouwehand amendment (TK 34 041, no. 12) to reverse the burden of proof for mining damage has been seriously watered down.
Het amendement Vos/Ouwehand (TK 34 041, nr. 12 ) om de bewijslast bij mijnbouwschade om te keren is ernstig uitgekleed.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Mining Act strengthening the minister's control over mining decisions and the State Supervision of Mines (SodM), while raising concerns about SodM independence, municipal/water board advice rights, cost recovery and urgency of referendum procedure. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely rejected the independence and cost-recovery objections, while accepting several other points, such as clarifying the rationale for licence withdrawal and cost differentiation.
concerns: Restricting the minister's power to instruct SodM undermines ministerial responsibility under Article 44 of the Constitution; the Afdeling advised dropping this and using an internal regulation instead.
Independence of SodM from the gas sector was not addressed, and the Afdeling advised justifying why no changes are proposed to secure it.
Advice rights for municipalities and water boards on storage licences were not justified; the Afdeling advised a justification or amendment.
Meaning and scope of the safety criterion across the successive decision moments were unclear and needed explanation.
Licence withdrawal on changed circumstances needed concrete examples and consequences in the explanatory memorandum.
The meaning of 'betrekken bij' for provincial executive advice to municipalities and water boards was unclear.

Charging fees for licences departs from earlier policy without adequate justification and the broadened cost recovery for supervision is inconsistent with the Maat houden principles, so it should be differentiated.
Using the urgency procedure for referendum in the implementing decree is not justified as urgent; the Afdeling advised dropping it or making it a statutory provision.

34375.s: The bill amends the Working Conditions Act to strengthen the role of company doctors and occupational health services, including their access to workplaces, a complaints procedure, second opinions, and cooperation with works councils and prevention staff. It also makes failure to report occupational diseases by occupational health providers an offence, with the enforcement provision to enter into force only conditionally.
34375.j: The memorandum justifies the new obligations and enforcement by citing research showing many company doctors never report occupational diseases and by stressing the need to protect professional independence and the reporting duty.
q: Research by the Labour Inspectorate and the Health Care Inspectorate from 2014 shows that 46% of company doctors never report an occupational disease.
Uit onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg uit 2014 blijkt dat 46% van de bedrijfsartsen nooit een beroepsziekte meldt.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (Artikel 9, derde lid)
obligations of company doctors and occupational health services to report occupational diseases
Artikel I, onderdeel C (Artikel 14, vierde lid)
agreement between employer and occupational health provider on how assistance is delivered
Artikel I, onderdeel B (Artikel 13, eerste lid)
choice and positioning of expert employee, determined with works council consent
p: Extends enforceable requirements to company doctors and occupational health services, reinforcing supervisory enforcement by the labour inspectorate over these providers.
Artikel I, onderdeel H (Artikel 30, zevende lid)

Removes the automatic suspensive effect of exemption and waiver decisions during the objection period, so such decisions take effect immediately, though affected parties may still request suspension from the administrative court.

parties: Questions the necessity and empirical basis of the bill, doubts it improves care quality, and asks about burdens on small employers and how the employer's advisory role and privacy are handled.
Why does the government nevertheless believe that independence is under pressure?
Waarom is de regering dan toch van mening dat de onafhankelijkheid onder druk staat?
Asks how the conditional fine for non-reporting will be enforced and what counts as substantial improvement before it takes effect, and whether Inspectie SZW has enough capacity.
What does the government understand by 'a substantial improvement in the reporting of occupational diseases by company doctors' before the fine provision could take effect?
Wat verstaat de regering onder «een substantiële verbetering van het melden van beroepsziekten door bedrijfsartsen» voordat de bepaling van het opleggen van boetes in werking zou kunnen treden?

Asks whether the 'stand der wetenschap' should be codified in law, questions the change from bijstand to advisering, and asks why the employer rather than the doctor should not bear the duty to report occupational disease.
The SP members ask whether the government is willing to give a statutory basis to existing guidelines such as those on arbokennisnet.nl.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering bereid is om reeds bestaande richtlijnen zoals deze: http://www.arbokennisnet.nl/richtlijnen.html een wettelijke basis te geven
Argues the change from bijstand to advisering weakens rather than strengthens the bedrijfsarts's independence, and considers a fine for non-reporting disproportionate, following the Raad van State.
In their view, imposing a fine is disproportionate.
Het opleggen van een boete is in hun ogen disproportioneel.

Asks how enforcement of the second opinion right and the conditional fine will work, how privacy is protected when employers can learn which workers consulted the doctor, and whether conditional entry into force is sound lawmaking.
First, these members find it an undesirable way of legislating to submit a bill that enters into force conditionally.
Allereerst vinden deze leden het een onwenselijke wijze van wetgeven, om een wetsvoorstel in te dienen dat voorwaardelijk in werking treedt.

Asks why the conditional fine is not brought into force now, how it could be enforced given Inspectie capacity problems, and how access to the bedrijfsarts is arranged for zzp'ers and temporary workers.
Why does the government refrain from bringing into force the provision to impose fines on company doctors who do not report?
Waarom ziet de regering af van het in werking laten treden van de bepaling om boetes op te kunnen leggen aan bedrijfsartsen die niet melden?

Asks why the second opinion is to be fully at the employer's expense and why it is not awaited an evaluation of other measures, and whether a free second opinion right could create perverse incentives.
To what extent is there a risk that anchoring a free right to a second opinion has a pull effect that does not always serve the intended purpose?
In hoeverre bestaat het risico dat het verankeren van een kosteloos recht op second opinion een aanzuigende werking heeft die lang niet altijd het beoogde doel dient?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised the Minister to proceed with the bill amending the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet on occupational health services, but asked for stronger justification and changes, notably dropping the fine for not reporting occupational diseases and clarifying the rules on works council consent, the doctor's independence and client access. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks, including dropping the fine for now (conditionally reintroducing it) and changing the works council right to consent, while keeping the advisory terminology and the works council consent right.
concerns: The Afdeling found the problem analysis on the occupational doctor's independence limited and asked for a stronger motivation; the government expanded the memorie van toelichting but kept the policy.
The Afdeling considered a fine for not reporting occupational diseases disproportionate and ineffective; the government made the fine conditional and not yet in force.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of the causes of non-reporting and the SER recommendations; the memorie was expanded on this point.
The Afdeling asked for concretisation of the notion of effective access to the occupational doctor; the memorie was sharpened.
The Afdeling advised replacing the works council's consent right on appointment of the preventiemedewerker with an advisory right; the government rejected this.

The Afdeling advised putting obligations on the occupational doctor (house visits, second opinion, complaints procedure) directly in the law rather than via contracts; the bill was adapted accordingly.
The Afdeling gave redactional remarks on cross-references and placement of transitional provisions; these were largely adopted.
The Afdeling asked to explain in the memorie the relation of the complaints procedure to the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg; the government addressed this by limiting statutory detail.
The Afdeling asked to reconsider the exemption of the occupational doctor from the risk inventory on access; the government adopted the advice to remove the exemption.

34384.s: The bill replaces the per-election registration of Dutch voters living abroad with a permanent registration administered by The Hague municipality, simplifying postal and proxy voting procedures. It amends the Kieswet, the Wet raadgevend referendum, the Tijdelijke experimentenwet and the Awb, and largely delegates procedural details to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
34384.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations by the wish to keep the Kieswet clear and consistent and by the procedural, administrative nature of the matters, while noting the Kiesraad's objection to two delegation provisions.
q: The government therefore sees the importance of delegating regulatory power where it concerns the provision of forms, data for registration and (decision) deadlines for applications.

De regering ziet daarom het belang van het delegeren van regelgevende bevoegdheid waar het de verstrekking van formulieren, gegevens voor de registratie en (beslis-)termijnen voor de aanvragen betreft.
d: data and documents constituting permanent registration
deadline for deciding on registration applications
further rules on registration, applications, decisions and ex officio changes
further rules on voting with a voter pass
further rules on voting by proxy
model form for requesting postal voting
details of postal voting: forms, sending and return of voting documents
Artikel I, D 6 lid 1 / M 9 Kieswet
data in the list of persons allowed to vote by post
one-off invitation to registration based on existing data files
transitional deviating deadlines in the first year
p: The Hague municipality may remove a person from the permanent register ex officio when it learns circumstances showing they should not be registered, with appeal available to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division.
Title 8.3 Awb (objection procedure) is excluded for registration decisions, with a direct appeal to the Council of State and shortened periods, limiting the usual administrative review step.
For the first year, a general administrative order may set deadlines that deviate from those in the statute, limited in time to the initial year.

parties: Asks why registration deadlines and referendum registration rules differ and whether procedures are consistent and workable.
The request for registration must be submitted at least six weeks before the day of voting.
Het verzoek tot registratie moet uiterlijk zes weken voor de dag van de stemming worden gedaan.
Worries that without repeated checks the register may contain errors, such as outdated addresses or deceased voters, and asks what safeguards exist.
The only safeguard in the system appears to be that changes in the Personal Records Database are processed in the register of foreign voters.
De enige waarborg in het systeem lijkt te zijn dat mutaties in de Basisregistratie Personen verwerkt worden in het register van buitenlandse kiesgerechtigden.
Asks how the system will be kept free of outdated addresses and how voters abroad will be reached, and whether sending ballots by email is safe.
The SP members ask how it will be prevented that the system becomes polluted with old addresses of voters who fail to report their move.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe voorkomen gaat worden dat het systeem vervuild raakt met oude adressen van kiesgerechtigden die verzaken hun verhuizing door te geven.
Supports easier participation but asks the government to justify delegation of electoral rules, in line with the Council of State's caution.
Together with the Council of State, the CDA members attach importance to restraint regarding delegation of electoral regulations.
Advies Kiesraad Met de Raad van State hechten de leden van de CDA-fractie aan terughou-dendheid ten aanzien van delegatie van kiesregelgeving.
Supports easier voting from abroad but questions how loss of Dutch nationality is tracked and whether a passport copy with each ballot can prevent ineligible voting.
If Dutch nationality is lost shortly after applying for a passport, a person could potentially exercise voting rights for almost ten years without being entitled to do so.
Indien het Nederlanderschap verloren gaat snel na het aanvragen van een paspoort, zou dat betekenen dat iemand mogelijk nog bijna tien jaar kiesrecht kan uitoefenen zonder daartoe gerechtigd te zijn.
Asks why the decision deadlines are delegated rather than fixed in statute, and warns that growing use of lower regulation withdraws rules from parliamentary view.

In this context these members point out that since 2010 the number of general administrative measures and ministerial regulations appears to have increased strongly, so that more regulation partly escapes parliamentary view.

Deze leden wijzen er in deze context op dat sinds 2010 het aantal algemene maatregelen van bestuur en ministeriële regelingen sterk lijkt te zijn toegenomen en daarmee meer regelgeving zich deels onttrekt aan het zicht van het parlement.
Supports the idea but asks about timing near early elections, the secrecy of the vote given the required proof of nationality, and how to keep the register current.
How can it be prevented that it is clear for which party someone has cast a vote?
Hoe kan worden voorkomen dat duidelijk is op welke partij iemand een stem heeft uitgebracht?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the proposed amendment to the Kieswet simplifying permanent voter registration for Dutch citizens abroad should proceed only after revisions, objecting to delegating application decision deadlines to a general administrative order and questioning the differing application deadlines of six and nine weeks. The government's nader rapport kept the delegation of decision deadlines, arguing it suits administrative detail, and added explanation to the memorie van toelichting on the differing deadlines while not moving application deadlines to the delegated order.
concerns: Delegating decision deadlines for registration requests to a general administrative order is inconsistent with the principle that essential electoral elements must be set in formal law, and the Afdeling advised including them in the law itself.

Differing application deadlines (six weeks for new registrations, nine weeks for amendments) may lead voters to circumvent the nine-week deadline, so the choice needed justification and possibly adjustment; the memorie van toelichting was supplemented.

34429.s: The bill amends the Dutch Medical Research Involving Human Subjects Act and the Medicines Act to align national law with EU Regulation 536/2014 on clinical trials, which now governs trials of medicinal products directly. It reassigns coordination, validation and supervisory tasks to the central ethics committee CCMO, adds enforcement powers for the Health Inspectorate including administrative fines, and sets transitional rules.
34429.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers as needed to implement binding EU law and to ensure efficient, consistent supervision and enforcement.
q: Under the new article 29 this power lies with the review committee that assessed the research.
Op grond van het nieuwe artikel 29 komt deze bevoegdheid te liggen bij de toetsingscommissie die het onderzoek beoordeeld heeft.
d: Artikel I, A, 1 (3e lid art. 3a, 4 en 5 wet)
corrective measures by ethics committees on clinical trials
central committee coordination tasks and allocation of dossiers
ethics committees checking risks of continuing certain research
guidelines on language of application dossiers
rules on reporting and good clinical practice for medicinal research
designation of contact person established in the Netherlands
designation of national contact point under the Regulation
safety rules for preparing and importing trial medicines
p: Health Inspectorate officials may impose orders under penalty for violations of the Regulation and the Act, using an administrative sanction instead of criminal prosecution.
The Minister may impose administrative fines up to €150,000 or €33,500 without the criminal-law safeguards that apply to prosecution, with appeal available under general administrative law.
Affected parties may lodge administrative appeal with the central committee against committee decisions, preserving a protection channel.
The CCMO must organise its supervisory task independently of its support tasks, with ministerial rules possible to secure that independence.

parties: Asks that the CCMO's supporting and supervisory tasks be kept separate to ensure independent supervision of ethics committees.
The VVD members are of the view that these two tasks must be separate.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn van mening dat deze twee taken gescheiden moeten zijn.
Asks whether combining medical-scientific and medical-ethical review in one body could subordinate ethical interests, and how independence is safeguarded.
These members ask whether mixing medical-scientific and medical-ethical aspects could subordinate ethical interests to the wish for a scientific result.
