Deze leden vragen of de vermenging van medisch wetenschappelijke aspecten en medisch-ethische aspecten juist niet zou kunnen leiden tot het ondergeschikt maken van de medisch-ethische belangen.
Stresses protection of trial subjects, questions inclusion without consent in emergencies, tacit approval, and requests detail on compensation and sanctions.
Asks about consequences if ethical review cannot finish within the strict deadlines and whether ethics committees can work efficiently enough.
The CDA members ask what the consequences are if the medical-ethical review cannot take place within the strict deadlines set by the regulation.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen wat de consequenties zijn als het proces van medisch-ethische toetsing niet heeft kunnen plaatsvinden binnen de strakke termijnen die door de verordening gesteld worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing EU Regulation 536/2014 on clinical trials may proceed, but that the maximum administrative fine of EUR 150,000 needs revision: it is disproportionate for largely administrative offences and inconsistent with the criminal sanctions. The minister's reply adopted a differentiated fine system, raised the criminal fine to the fifth category, and substantiated the maximum amounts, plus made redactional corrections.
concerns: The maximum administrative fine of EUR 150,000 is disproportionate to the largely administrative nature of many offences and needs justification and differentiation.
The gap between the criminal fine and the administrative fine must not be too large; the criminal fine is raised to the fifth category.
Redactional remarks on cross-references, terminology and paragraph numbering were adopted.

34447.s: The bill concentrates maritime (scheepvaart) litigation exclusively or additionally in the Rotterdam district court by amending several provisions of the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure and related Book 8 references. It also adds Rotterdam as an alternative competent court in various enforcement, attachment and summary proceedings, while leaving pending cases under the old law.
34447.j: The memorandum justifies the concentration by citing the benefits of specialised judges' expertise, efficiency of proceedings and the presence of shipping sector actors in Rotterdam.
q: It is expected that this will contribute to the quality of the judiciary and to the efficiency of the legal process in those cases.
Verwacht wordt dat dit zal bijdragen aan de kwaliteit van de rechtspraak en aan de efficiëntie van de rechtsgang in die zaken.

34474.s: The bill amends the Dutch Railways Act to implement EU railway safety and interoperability directives, mainly by setting fixed decision deadlines of four months that override the general administrative law timeline. It also adds procedures for rolling-stock authorisations, including powers to demand additional information, risk analyses and tests, and rules on the independence of market regulator ACM members.
34474.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers mainly as required for one-to-one implementation of the EU railway directives, which mandate the national safety authority's competences and deadlines.
q: The bill contains no tasks or powers for the ACM.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat geen taken of bevoegdheden voor de ACM.
d: further rules on applying the rolling-stock authorisation prohibition
further rules on non-TSI-compliant rolling stock authorisation
p: The minister may require additional information, risk analyses and tests from applicants and compel anyone to cooperate, after consulting the applicant, with limited constraints on scope.
For non-TSI-compliant vehicles the minister may demand additional information, risk analyses and tests and compel cooperation, fixing their scope after consulting the applicant.
The minister may prohibit the use of main-line infrastructure by a rolling stock vehicle that does not comply with the essential requirements, without stated procedural limits.
The minister may amend, suspend or withdraw type authorisations for rolling-stock types when technical rules change.
Sets competence, conflict-of-interest and cooling-off requirements for members of the market regulator ACM, strengthening independent oversight of the railway sector.

parties: Asks whether the implementation further limits national licensing powers of the ILT and how the licensing distinctions work.
Is there not, with this implementation, nevertheless a restriction of national powers in licensing?
Is er met deze implementatie niet toch sprake van inperking van de nationale bevoegdheden bij de vergunningverlening?
Asks how the Fyra enquiry committee's recommendations relate to the bill and whether licensing procedures will follow them.
Does the government expect to be able to realise that aim, the PvdA members ask.
Verwacht de regering die inzet waar te kunnen maken, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Worries that the penalty provisions are so complex they are practically unreadable, endangering legal certainty.
Due to the complicated wording this penalty provision has become practically unreadable.
Door de ingewikkelde formulering is deze strafbepaling praktisch onleesbaar geworden.
Asks whether ILT powers are limited in specific cases, which would be an undesirable restriction of national licensing powers.
These members believe that in that case this implementation would still amount to a restriction of national licensing powers, which is undesirable.
Deze leden menen dat in dat geval met deze implementatie toch sprake zou zijn van inperking van nationale bevoegdheden bij de vergunningverlening, hetgeen ongewenst is.
Asks the government to clarify the licensing types, the ILT's power to demand additional information and tests, and the extent of restricted national powers.
The D66 members also request the government to make clear to what extent this implementation involves a restriction of national powers in licensing.
De leden van de D66-fractie verzoeken de regering ook inzichtelijk te maken in hoeverre met deze implementatie sprake is van de inperking van nationale bevoegdheden bij de vergunningverlening.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises proceeding with the bill implementing three EU railway directives, but asks for better accessibility of the Railways Act, relocation of the ACM cooling-off rule to the ACM institutional law, and revision of the four-month decision deadlines. The government reply accepts most points, including moving the ACM rule and deadline wording, while rejecting full transposition tables and leaving the transitional rules unchanged.
concerns: Unclear structure and many cross-references in the Railways Act for TSI-conform and non-TSI-conform vehicle licences hamper legibility and enforceability; the government reworked articles 36 to 36b and copied directive text where possible.
Advice to rewrite the railway legislation more closely to the directives and to include full, current transposition tables was only partly taken up, with tables limited to the articles in this bill.

The cooling-off ban for ACM members is better placed in the ACM institutional law, and the requirements on expertise and conflicts of interest are now also in statute rather than in non-binding internal regulations.

Fixed four-month decision deadlines risk becoming de facto norms and are unnecessary given current eight-week practice; the Council suggested only setting a four-month cap on extensions, which the government did not adopt.
The Council asked for transitional rules for pending applications that do not specify the procedure chosen; the government said the ILT can request the applicant's choice and no change is needed.

34483.s: The bill amends the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg to create a national implant register run by the Minister of VWS, and requires providers to record implant data in patient files and supply it to the register for categories set by general administrative order. It also lets the Minister set rules by ministerial regulation on how and when data are supplied, and extends IGZ enforcement tools to these duties.
34483.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying categories of implants cannot all be registered at once, so the rollout must be phased and prioritised by risk.
q: Therefore it is proposed to designate by general administrative order the categories for which registration becomes mandatory.
Daarom wordt voorgesteld om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur de categorieën aan te wijzen waarvoor registratie verplicht wordt.
d: categories of implants to be registered
data to be recorded in patient file about implants
implant categories for supply of data to register
manner and deadlines for supplying implant data
p: The Minister keeps a register of implants in clients, with the categories left to be set by general administrative order and with no parliamentary approval required for that choice.
Artikel I, B (artikel 7b, eerste en derde lid)
Providers must record implant data traceable to the client and give the client written copies, with details to be fixed by administrative order.

parties: Asks how harmonised electronic patient records and UDI alignment will support the register and whether patients receive adequate information.
In what way will this development be a precondition for the intended aim of this bill?
Op welke wijze zal deze ontwikkeling randvoorwaardelijk zijn voor het beoogde doel van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel?
Supports the register but asks how compliance by care providers is checked and what sanctions apply for incorrect registration.
They do ask how it is verified that care providers always do this correctly and what sanctions apply to providers who do not register implants correctly.
Wel vragen zij hoe wordt nagegaan of zorgverleners dit altijd keurig doen en wat eventuele sancties zijn voor zorgverleners die implantaten niet correct registreren.

Worries the system is fragile because identifying data sits only with care providers and records may be destroyed after 15 years; asks about delays and privacy justification, echoing Raad van State concerns.
Because implant defects often manifest only in the long term, this makes the system vulnerable.
Omdat gebreken aan implantaten zich vaak pas op de lange termijn manifesteren, maakt dit het systeem kwetsbaar.
Asks how the IGZ can verify that providers trace all affected patients and when administrative fines would be imposed.
These members ask how the IGZ can check whether the care provider actually traces all affected clients and takes further action where necessary.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen op welke wijze de IGZ kan controleren of de zorgaanbieder daadwerkelijk alle betrokken cliënten traceert en indien nodig verdere actie onderneemt.
Questions the scope of the register, the lack of identifiers that could trace patients, and privacy protection, including whether anonymised personal data with a separate legal basis is needed.
These members, however, have doubts about the government's assumption that traceability is sufficiently ensured through care providers.
Genoemde leden hebben echter twijfels bij de aanname van de regering dat traceerbaarheid voldoende gewaarborgd wordt via zorgaanbieders.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises the bill establishing an implant register to proceed, but asks for clarification or amendment because the bill does not say how patients will be informed of health risks if the treating provider stops practising. The minister's nader rapport accepts the point, states that the duty to keep and transfer records continues after a practitioner stops, and supplements the explanatory memorandum with minor redactional changes.
concerns: The bill does not specify how patients with implants will be informed of health risks when the provider who implanted the device no longer practises.
The reference to the patient file definition in the Civil Code was replaced by the term 'dossier' as defined in the Wkkgz, and an obsolete reference in article 7b(4) was removed.

34492.s: The bill approves the 2015 tax treaty between the Netherlands and Kenya on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion for income taxes, so that the Kingdom can be bound by it. It sets the entry into force a few months after the Staatsblad publication date.
34492.j: The memorandum justifies approval by stressing that the treaty clearly delineates taxing powers and provides a basis for consultation and dispute resolution, benefiting Dutch business.
q: The limits of the taxing powers of both states are clearly defined and a good basis has been laid for consultation and dispute resolution.
De grenzen van de heffingsbevoegdheden van beide staten zijn duidelijk vastgelegd en er is een goede grondslag gelegd voor overleg en geschillenbeslechting

parties: Asks what the treaty changes concretely for the division of taxing rights and why the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom are excluded.
Why does the treaty then apply exclusively to the European part of the Netherlands and not to the Caribbean part of the Netherlands?
Waarom heeft het verdrag dan uitsluitend betrekking op het Europese deel van Nederland en dus niet het Caribische deel van Nederland
Asks for comparisons of withholding tax rates and anti-abuse provisions with Kenya's other treaties to test whether the treaty is sufficiently protective.
The SP members also ask the government whether a comparison can be made of the anti-abuse provisions in the treaties Kenya has signed or brought into force.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering tevens of ook een vergelijking kan worden gemaakt van de antimisbruikbepalingen die zijn opgenomen in de verdragen die Kenia heeft ondertekend of in werking zijn getreden.
Asks whether information exchange is automatic or only on request, and how the government weighed the interests of Dutch citizens and firms against Kenya's taxing interests.
Furthermore, the CDA members ask the government to further justify why it believes the present treaty has balanced the interests of Dutch citizens and businesses.</br>

Verder vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering nader te motiveren waarom zij meent dat in het voorliggende verdrag op evenwichtige wijze rekening is gehouden met de belangen van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven
Asks whether the main purpose test meets the minimum principal purpose test recommended under the OECD BEPS project.
In action point 6 of the BEPS project, this principal purposes test is named as the minimum for an anti-abuse provision.
In actiepunt 6 van het BEPS-project wordt deze principal purposes test als minimum van een antimisbruikbepaling genoemd.
Asks whether the anti-abuse provisions are effective, whether the treaty creates revenue leakage risks, and whether stakeholders such as the Kenyan parliament and NGOs were involved.
The GroenLinks members are curious to what extent the Kenyan parliament and other relevant stakeholders such as NGOs were involved in this treaty.</br>
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks zijn benieuwd in hoeverre het Keniaanse parlement en andere relevante stakeholders zoals ngo's zijn betrokken bij dit verdrag.

34528.s: This omnibus bill amends many social security, employment, welfare and benefits statutes of the Ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and of Security and Justice, mostly through technical and wording corrections and alignment of cross-references. It also adjusts specific rules such as indexation, parental leave, debt-collection powers under the Remigratiewet, data-sharing with UWV and SVB, and the supervision of municipal debt assistance.
34528.j: The memorandum justifies most changes as technical corrections, clarifications of Central Council of Appeal rulings, and harmonisation, with data-sharing justified by the need for municipal labour-market activation.
q: Suspension under article 54 of the Participatiewet is therefore not possible if a claimant does not comply with a summons to appear at a certain place and time in connection with his labour integration.

Opschorten op grond van artikel 54 PW is daarom niet mogelijk als een belanghebbende niet meewerkt aan een oproep om op een bepaalde plaats en tijd te verschijnen in verband met zijn arbeidsinschakeling.
d: ARTIKEL XXIII (Wet minimumloon, art. 13 lid 2 and 18b)
categories of employees for wage deduction authorisations and related records
ARTIKEL XXIV (Wet ongevallenverzekering BES, art. 5a lid 2)
changing the funeral-cost allowance amount in special circumstances
further rules on the investigation report under collective agreement law
ARTIKEL XV (Wet arbeid en zorg) and ARTIKEL XXXII (Ziektewet, art. 63c lid 2 etc.)
employer-level rules on sick leave and occupational health service referral
ARTIKEL XXIX / Wfsv art. 38d lid 10 (ARTIKEL XIX B)
further rules on registration and data provision for quota of disabled workers
p: The Sociale verzekeringsbank gains enforcement powers including set-off against benefits and exemption from the statutory minimum-subsistence protection for administrative fines collected by writ of execution.
ARTIKEL IX (Participatiewet, art. 17 lid 2 and art. 54)
The duty to cooperate with the municipality is clarified and the municipality may require information, with related data access rules for administrations.
UWV may disclose information on request to employers in connection with ending insurance contracts, extending its existing disclosure authority.
Employer as sickness-benefit risk bearer is given authority to grant trial placements in the sickness-benefit framework.

parties: Asks the government about legal basis for employer wage liability after the 104-week period and whether it is unlimited if the employee does not cooperate with the WIA application.
What is the legal basis on which an employer must continue paying wages after the 104-week waiting period has expired?
Wat is de rechtsgrond op basis waarvan een werkgever loon moet door betalen nadat de 104 weken wachttijd zijn verstreken?
Asks how municipalities will be prevented from using youth data for other purposes and how personal data protection is guaranteed.
Can the government explain how it is guaranteed that municipalities handle personal data carefully?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat gemeentes zorgvuldig met de bescherming van de persoonsgegevens omgaan?
Asks how many people face income losses from the IOAW change and on what basis a six-month period is considered reasonable.
On what basis does the government consider a period of six months reasonable for the affected persons to prepare for the new situation?

Op basis waarvan acht de regering een periode van zes maanden redelijk en billijk voor de desbetreffende personen om zich voor te bereiden op de nieuwe situatie en (eventueel) aanpassingen te plegen in het uitgavenpatroon?
Questions how misuse of privacy data by municipalities is prevented and how careful handling of personal data is ensured, and asks for justification of the 26-week decision period.
But the question is how it is prevented that municipalities use this information for purposes other than intended and that privacy data is misused.
Maar vraag is wel hoe wordt voorkomen dat gemeenten deze informatie voor andere doelstellingen gebruiken dan wordt beoogd en dat er misbruik wordt gemaakt van privacygegevens.
Asks the government to explain precisely what changes in the quota calculation and in the CAO reporting obligation, and what the consequences are.
Since this repair concerns a 'legal-technical omission' in the Van Weyenberg amendment, the members ask the government to explain exactly what is changed and what the consequences are.

Aangezien deze reparatie van een «wetstechnische omissie» is van het amendement-Van Weyenberg, vragen de betreffende leden of de regering exact uiteen kan zetten wat hier nu wordt gewijzigd en wat daarvan de gevolgen zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Verzamelwet SZW 2017, criticising the lack of justification for the experiment clause on the Quotumwet, the broadened Inlichtingenbureau definition, and invoking the urgent procedure of the Wet raadgevend referendum. The minister's nader rapport reports that the advice was followed on the Quotumwet experiment, the Inlichtingenbureau broadening was removed, the Caribbean leave extension was supplemented, the WAZO paragraph was clarified, and the urgent referendum procedure was motivated.
concerns: The necessity of allowing experiments that deviate from the Quotumwet was not justified, so the provision was dropped.
Broadening the Inlichtingenbureau's tasks beyond work and income was too general and unsuitable for an omnibus bill, so it was removed.
Use of the urgent procedure under article 12 Wrr required a substantive motivation, which was added to the explanatory memorandum.
The explanatory memorandum on consultation with the Caribbean public bodies on maternity leave was supplemented.
The explanatory memorandum on the WAZO aftercare provision was clarified regarding which WGA benefit applies.

34537.s: The bill re-enacts a Dutch data retention obligation for telecom providers (12 months for telephony, 6 months for internet access) after the EU Court of Justice struck down the EU directive and a Hague court suspended the national law. It also requires prior authorisation by the rechter-commissaris before prosecutors can demand retained traffic data, and sets storage and security requirements.
34537.j: The memorandum justifies the retention duty by the need for historical telecom data in investigating serious crime and fraud, and frames prior judicial authorisation as a safeguard responding to the Court of Justice ruling.
q: It is proposed that a demand by the public prosecutor for historical traffic data ... may only be made after prior judicial review.
Voorgesteld wordt dat een vordering van de officier van justitie tot verstrekking van historische verkeersgegevens ... slechts kan worden gedaan na voorafgaande rechterlijke toetsing.
d: how providers comply with data requests and statistics
p: Access to retained traffic data requires prior written authorisation by the rechter-commissaris, limited to offences of sufficient gravity.
Providers must retain traffic and location data of all customers for 6 to 12 months for investigating serious offences, a general retention duty affecting everyone regardless of suspicion.

parties: Welcomes the prior judicial review before accessing retained data but asks about the consequences for police, prosecution and judiciary workload and costs.
Stresses privacy and selectivity, asks whether the rechter-commissaris has enough criteria and whether effectiveness data will be provided.
Because it concerns investigating serious crimes, it is of the greatest importance that storing and searching personal data is done as selectively as possible.
Omdat het gaat om de opsporing van ernstige misdrijven is het van het grootste belang dat zo selectief mogelijk gehandeld wordt als het gaat om het opslaan en het doorzoeken van persoonsgegevens.

Doubts the retention of data on non-suspects remains proportionate, criticises the vague list of data and the lack of clear definition of serious offences, and questions the added value of the judicial review.
However, these members are concerned about the extra workload this brings for the judiciary.
Wel maken deze leden zich zorgen over de extra werklast die dit meebrengt voor de rechtspraak.

Argues the retention period is unnecessarily short compared with European case law and that the extra judicial review goes beyond what EU law requires; questions the prosecution's trustworthiness and the added-value of the examining magistrate check.
These members ask the government why the three-day period is not too short when a verbal order must afterwards be put in writing.
De voorgenoemde leden vragen de regering of de termijn van drie dagen niet te kort is wanneer achteraf na een mondeling bevel dit op schrift gesteld dient te worden.

Critical of the general retention obligation affecting non-suspect citizens; asks whether the amendments remove fundamental rights infringements and proportionality, and asks for more transparency statistics which the government opposes.

The aforementioned members have already made clear they are critical of the government's choice to again apply a general retention obligation under which communications data of non-suspect citizens are retained.

De voorgenoemde leden hebben reeds kenbaar gemaakt kritisch te zijn over de keuze van de regering om opnieuw een algemene bewaarplicht te hanteren waarbij communicatiegegevens van niet-verdachte burgers worden bewaard.
Asks for examples of urgent necessity justifying oral orders and for justification of which data were removed as not strictly necessary.
The aforementioned members ask whether examples can be given of cases where there is urgent necessity.
De voorgenoemde leden vragen of er voorbeelden kunnen worden gegeven van gevallen waarbij sprake is van een dringende noodzaak.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the data retention bill to parliament but with changes, mainly to fully incorporate the annulled Wet bewaarplicht articles, narrow the categories of offences allowing access to retained data, add an exception for professionally privileged persons, adjust the retention period for internet telephony, and notify the European Commission. The government's reply followed most points, including the consolidation of annulled articles, the retention period fix and notification, but did not adopt the exception for professional privilege holders nor the PNR-based offence list.
concerns: Annulled articles of the Wet bewaarplicht telecommunicatiegegevens should be fully incorporated into the bill and repealed to avoid ambiguity about the effect of the court's suspension.

Access to retained data should be limited to offences of sufficient seriousness with concrete criteria, possibly by defining the offence categories more precisely; the government added judicial pre-authorisation but rejected the PNR-based list.
An exception for professionally privileged persons (lawyers, doctors, notaries) from access to retained telecommunication data should be added to the bill.
The bill should make clear that internet telephony not meeting the criteria carries a six-month retention period rather than twelve months.

The bill should be notified to the European Commission under Directive 2015/1535 and the free movement of services should be addressed in the explanatory memorandum; the explanation was added but the notification is only partly addressed in the reply.

34550-X.s: This bill sets the 2017 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Defence, including appropriations for policy articles, non-policy articles and the agencies DTO and Paresto. The accompanying explanatory memorandum reports operational readiness targets, budget effects and oversight relations with ZBO/RWT bodies, without creating new executive discretion.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2017 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34555.s: The bill ends the possibility of tax-facilitated pension accrual in own management (pensioen in eigen beheer) from 1 January 2017 and allows already accrued amounts to be bought out or converted into an oudedagsverplichting under a tax-friendly transitional regime. It also makes several related technical and tax changes, including rate reductions on the buy-out levy and the admission of investment firms as providers of lijfrente products.
34555.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial and general administrative delegations as needed to set technical detail such as the market interest rate, information requirements and remission rules.
q: By general administrative order it will be determined which information must be provided to the Tax Authority and how this information must be submitted.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur zal worden bepaald welke informatie aan de Belastingdienst moet worden verstrekt en op welke wijze deze informatie moet worden aangeleverd.
d: Artikel III (art. 38n, vijfde lid, Wet LB 1964)
rules for applying the buy-out and conversion provision, including information retention and provision
Artikel III (art. 38p, eerste lid, Wet LB 1964)
the annual market interest rate applied to oudedagsverplichting
rules for remission of tax payment deferral on buy-out or conversion
rules for remission of deferred tax on partial conversion

parties: Asks about the tax treatment of buy-outs, the information obligation, and whether the government will publish implementing regulations in time, which bears on parliamentary scrutiny of the rules.
This raises the pressing question of when this general administrative order will see the light of day, the PvdA members ask.
Dat roept de klemmende vraag op wanneer deze AMvB uiterlijk het licht gaat zien, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Welcomes the bill but asks for active information to partners and rules of thumb for a fair split of benefits, given risks of distrust in divorce situations.
This raises the question of whether the government intends to do active information outreach, especially towards partners.
Dat roept de vraag op of de regering voornemens is aan actieve voorlichting te doen, juist in de richting van partners.
Questions the government's revenue and emigration-leak assumptions and asks for the expected timing of the AMvB and worked examples, challenging the government's estimates.
The SP members ask the government to indicate within what period the general administrative order can be expected.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven binnen welke termijn de AMvB verwacht kan worden.
Doubts the revenue estimates and the 36% buy-out assumption, and asks about partner rights, gift tax exposure and the short time before entry into force.
The CDA members have serious doubts about the estimated revenue of 2.1 billion.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben grote twijfels bij de geraamde opbrengsten van 2,1 miljard.
Asks for consultation with directors on information duties to limit administrative burden, and questions the capacity of advisers and the Tax Administration.
The D66 members urge that consultation take place with (representatives of) directors on which information is necessary.
De leden van de D66-fractie dringen er op aan dat overlegd wordt met (vertegenwoordigers van) dga’s over welke informatie noodzakelijk is.
Welcomes a long-awaited solution to the problem and asks the government to respond to technical questions raised by the NOB.
It is important that a solution is finally found for this problem, these members believe.
Het is van belang dat er nu eindelijk een oplossing wordt gevonden voor deze problematiek, zo menen deze leden.
Warns of inadequate old-age provision and weak partner protection in buy-outs, and questions the generosity of the discount and possible abuse.
Responsibly buying out the director's pension requires very good agreements and careful consideration, also in the interest of the (former) partner and any survivors.
Het verantwoord afkopen van het dga-pensioen vergt heel goede afspraken en een zorgvuldige afweging, óók in het belang van de (ex)-partner en eventuele nabestaanden.
Calls the discount generous and asks why the measure cannot be budget-neutral or limited to writing off the claim.
Is this not a very generous arrangement, the PVV members ask.
Is dit niet een erg ruimhartige regeling, vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie.

34573.s: The bill lowers the age at which full statutory minimum wage applies from 23 to 22 (with a further step to 21 after two years) and adjusts youth wage scales, the apprenticeship exception, and related benefit ages. It also creates an explicit legal basis for paying minimum wage on overtime (meerwerk) and tightens rules on piece-rate and compensation in paid time off, with implementing detail delegated to general administrative measures and ministerial regulations.
34573.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as technical tools to protect apprenticeship places and to convert working-time rules, and justifies the explicit overtime basis by a Council of State ruling requiring a legal foundation for enforcement.
d: percentages of youth minimum wage for apprenticeship (bbl) workers by age category
rules converting non-weekly working time periods into a normal weekly working time
minister may set a different normal working time for a category of employees on joint request of employer and employee organisations
designate payment obligations of certain public-sector employees under civil law provisions
minister may once adjust benefit amounts in the Toeslagenwet to changed minimum wage percentages
p: Allows employers to compensate overtime in paid time off instead of wages, subject to written agreement and collective agreement provision, reducing employee protection relative to the employer.
Empowers the minister to adjust benefit amounts once without new legislation, lapsing after two years and six months.

parties: Asks how the employment and training effects of the staged youth minimum wage increase will be monitored and what sectoral measures would follow if effects are negative.
The VVD members ask the government how it will monitor the effects on youth employment and training participation of the proposed staged increase in the statutory youth minimum wage.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering hoe de gevolgen voor de werkgelegenheid en de scholingsdeelname van jongeren van het voorliggende voorstel van een stapsgewijze verhoging van het wettelijk minimumjeugdloon gaat monitoren.
Welcomes the bill's guarantee of a subsistence minimum for piece-rate workers and asks clarifying questions about monitoring and the Raad van State's concerns.
In addition, the PvdA members are pleased that the amendment guarantees a subsistence minimum for employees currently working on piece rates.
Daarnaast zijn de leden van de PvdA-fractie verheugd dat de wijziging een bestaansminimum garandeert voor werknemers die momenteel op basis van stukloon werken.
Questions whether the age reduction respects equal pay for equal work and asks how the government will enforce piece-rate minimum wage compliance.
How does the government intend to enforce this?
Hoe denkt de regering hierop te kunnen handhaven?
Supports the lower age in principle but fears rising youth unemployment and asks why the meerwerk and piece-rate rules are not in a separate bill for separate assessment.

Firstly, they ask the government why the proposals on enforcing the minimum wage for overtime and piece rates are included in this bill on lowering the adult minimum wage age rather than in a separate bill, so that a separate judgement can be made.

In de eerste plaats vragen zij de regering waarom de voorstellen over handhaving van het WML bij meerwerk en het stukloon in onderhavig wetsvoorstel over de verlaging van de leeftijd van het volwassenenminimumloon worden gedaan en niet in een apart wetsvoorstel, zodat hier een apart oordeel over gevraagd kan worden?
Welcomes the staged approach but asks how the automatic move to age 21 will be stopped if negative employment effects appear and whether a new bill would be needed.
In that case, how will this further reduction not go ahead? Would a new bill be needed to prevent the further reduction to age 21, or does the government have another option?

Op welke manier gaat deze verdere verlaging dan niet door? Is in dat geval een nieuw wetsvoorstel nodig om de verdere verlaging naar 21 jaar geen doorgang te laten vinden, of heeft de regering hiervoor ook een andere mogelijkheid?
Supports the direction but asks what 'considerable employment effects' means and how that assessment for the second step will be made.
Can the government indicate what it understands by 'considerable employment effects'?
Kan de regering aangeven wat zij verstaat onder «aanzienlijke werkgelegenheidseffecten?
Asks how the government defines equal pay for equal work and whether it applies to all adults regardless of age, and what the international criticism entails.
The GroenLinks members also ask how the government defines 'equal pay for equal work in the same place'.
Ook vragen de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks hoe de regering «gelijk loon voor gelijk werk op dezelfde plek» definieert.

Questions whether the piece-rate change erodes the essence of piece-rate pay and whether compensation in time for overtime should be limited to collective agreements, which could be unduly restrictive.
They ask the government to elaborate on these considerations.
Zij vragen de regering nader in te gaan op deze overwegingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division endorses the stepwise lowering of the adult minimum wage age from 23 to 21 but warns that the piece-rate change may cause unintended effects and new enforcement problems, and advises revising the bill, especially the collective-agreement condition for paying overtime in time off. The government reply largely rejects the piece-rate objections, adds clarification on productivity and enforcement, and accepts a motivation of the cao condition, with the bill otherwise unchanged in substance.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that removing the piece-rate 'reasonably required time' criterion is an adequate legislative solution to the enforcement problem and may produce unintended effects.
Employers with little or no insight into work done at a distance (home work, post delivery) may be unable to comply with a time-based norm, creating new enforcement problems.
Effects on lower-productivity workers and on employment chances, and on the freedom to set one's own pace, were insufficiently weighed; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

The restriction that overtime may be compensated with paid time off only if a collective agreement provides for it lacks sufficient motivation in the Afdeling's view and should be justified or amended.
Redactional remarks on the structure of article I (amending paragraphs) were adopted by re-enacting article 12.

34591.s: The bill amends the Aviation Act, the Environmental Management Act and the Railways Act with technical updates, including renaming the ministry, adding exemption powers for unmanned aircraft and accreditation powers for inspection bodies. It also shifts airport regulation from provincial assemblies to provincial executives and changes certification and publication deadlines.
34591.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by citing the disproportionate burden of the existing procedure and the sufficiency of existing supervision and enforcement instruments.
q: The procedure for establishing airport regulations by ordinance of provincial assemblies proves in practice to be disproportionately burdensome, mainly because of the very long lead time.
De procedure van vaststelling van luchthavenregelingen bij verordening door provinciale staten blijkt in de praktijk onevenredig zwaar te zijn, met name vanwege de erg lange doorlooptijd.
d: requirements and proof for airworthiness or noise certificate applicants
exemptions from unmanned aircraft rules in special circumstances
accreditation of inspection bodies, conditions, supervision and tariffs
rules for application and fees for security certificates
rules for terrain outside airports used by aircraft
p: Airport operating regulations move from provincial assemblies (by ordinance) to provincial executives (by decision), removing the elected council's role in this area.
The minister gains a discretionary power to exempt unmanned aircraft operators from statutory rules where circumstances warrant, with a safety-based limit.
The minister may accredit private bodies, set their conditions and tariffs, and suspend or withdraw accreditation without statutory criteria beyond compliance.

parties: Asks why the exemption fee is about 125 euros and whether the ROC procedure for Dutch operators will be made more efficient and cheaper; also asks why a Railway Act change is included in an aviation bill.
They would like to hear the reason why requesting an exemption should cost approximately 125 euros.
Zij horen graag wat de reden is dat het vragen van een ontheffing ca. € 125 moet kosten.

Asks how safety and control of activities at airports are guaranteed now that EASA certification no longer requires periodic recertification, and asks for clarity on the exemption procedure for foreign operators.
they do ask how safety and control of airport activities is guaranteed with this.
zij vragen wel hoe hiermee de veiligheid en de controle van de activiteiten op luchthavens is gewaarborgd.
Asks why the exemption possibility is extended beyond AOC holders, whether it may broaden in future, and how it relates to the existing ROC regime for remotely piloted aircraft.
The CDA members note that the exemption possibility has been limited to drone operators, but that a broadening exemption practice in the future cannot be ruled out.

De leden van de CDA-fractie constateren dat ervoor gekozen is om de ontheffingsmogelijkheid te beperken tot de exploitanten van drones, maar dat een ruimer wordende ontheffingenpraktijk in de toekomst niet kan worden uitgesloten.

Doubts whether exemptions for foreign unmanned aircraft are desirable given privacy risks, asks how privacy of individuals will be guaranteed, and asks how many exemptions are expected and how expansion will be prevented; also asks which bodies and how often airports are checked for EASA compliance.
These members doubt whether it is desirable to grant exemptions to unmanned aircraft of foreign operators in view of privacy.
Deze leden betwijfelen of het wenselijk is ontheffingen te verlenen aan onbemande vliegtuigen van buitenlandse operators met het oog op de privacy.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises sending the bill to parliament but asks that the proposed broad exemption power from the AOC requirement be narrowed to drone operators and better justified. The government's nader rapport accepts narrowing the power to unmanned aircraft in the statutory text and supplements the justification, while rejecting the claim that the exemption practice could grow over time.
concerns: The Afdeling considers the broadened exemption power from the AOC requirement too far-reaching and too broadly formulated, and advises deleting it or limiting it to the intended cases with reasoned necessity.
The Afdeling finds insufficient explanation of the practical problems that make the exemption necessary, and of why the existing ROC regime cannot serve foreign operators.
The Afdeling proposes several redactional changes, including deleting a duplicate article, moving transitional provisions and clarifying provincial airport regulations, which the government adopted.

34609.s: The bill amends the two Dutch implementing acts for the EU small claims and European order for payment procedures to align them with Regulation 2015/2421, raising the small claims ceiling from EUR 2,000 to EUR 5,000 and reopening appeal for claims above EUR 1,750. It also adds rules on electronic filing and service and on which court and procedure apply when a European procedure continues under national law.
34609.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need to implement the EU regulation and to avoid a notable divergence from the national appeal regime, rather than by any new executive power.
q: It was therefore chosen no longer to maintain the general exclusion of appeal.
Er is daarom voor gekozen de algehele uitsluiting van het appel niet langer te handhaven.

parties: Asks whether the government shares the observation that no notable criticism came from practice and whether research or signals exist on unfamiliarity with the procedure and procedural barriers for non-lawyers.
With regard to both procedures, these members ask whether the government shares the observation that no notable criticism or comments have been voiced about these proposals from the field.
Deze leden vragen met betrekking tot beide procedures of de regering de observatie deelt dat er geen noemenswaardige kritiek of opmerkingen zijn geuit op deze voorstellen uit het veld.
Expresses interest in the bill and has no questions for the government at this stage.
At this stage they have no questions for the government about this.
Zij hebben hierover vooralsnog geen vragen aan de regering.

34627.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998 and the Gas Act to support the energy transition, widening the experimentation power, allowing temporary tasks to be assigned to network operators, tightening investment-plan rules, and regulating cross-shareholdings and transfers of network lines. It also clarifies supervisory roles between the ACM and the Minister (SodM) and removes ministerial approval of network operators' statutes.
34627.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility to experiment and adapt rules during the energy transition, with details left to lower regulation after consultation and technical review.
q: However, the legislation currently leaves no room to experiment with all relevant aspects of renewable energy, energy saving, CO2 reduction, efficient use of the grid, new market models and tariff regulation.

Er is echter in de wetgeving geen ruimte om te experimenteren met alle relevante aspecten rondom hernieuwbare energie, energiebesparing, reductie van CO 2 uitstoot, efficiënt gebruik van het net, nieuwe marktmodellen en tariefregulering.
d: exceptions to storage reserve for network parts or situations
temporary additional tasks for network operator
investment plan content, procedure and frequency
cost shares and procedure for moving or undergrounding lines
temporary additional tasks for gas network operator
additional activities of gas group companies
implementing EU regulations and decisions for gas
III (Wet implementatie EU-richtlijnen energie-efficiëntie art. 31 lid 3)
assigning supervision of EV charging rules to ACM
p: Expands the minister's power to grant experiment exemptions from electricity law, with the scope and conditions left to an AMvB.
Allows temporary extra tasks for network operators to be granted by AMvB for up to five years, subject to a four-week draft submission to parliament.
Gives the minister power to designate line sections for relocation or undergrounding on municipal or provincial request, with cost rules set by regulation.
Permits cross-shareholdings by foreign transmission operators, requiring parliamentary consent and a thirty-day notice period before negotiation.
I, B / Art. 12-13 and Art. 1c oversight in II, D
Removes ministerial approval of network operators' statutes and shifts gas safety oversight to SodM, with ACM handling other matters.

parties: Asks how the ACM can enforce against cross-subsidisation and whether experiments may burden grid operators' core tasks.
These members believe experiments at network companies must not come at the expense of those companies' tasks.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat deze experimenten bij netwerkbedrijven niet ten kosten mag gaan van de taken van deze netwerkbedrijven.
Asks why the gas connection obligation and full disclosure were not included in the bill.
Why has the government not followed through on the energy report's promise to stop building new gas infrastructure in new housing areas and amend the Gas Act accordingly?
Waarom heeft de regering geen gevolg gegeven aan de belofte van het energierapport om geen nieuwe gasinfrastructuur meer aan te leggen in nieuwbouwwijken en daarvoor de Gaswet aan te passen?
Questions the democratic legitimacy of key energy decisions and argues specific cross-participation transactions should be approved by the House.
How are the decisions we are now taking for the future democratically legitimised?
Hoe worden de besluiten die wij nu voor de toekomst nemen democratische gelegitimeerd?
Asks why Staten-Generaal approval is not required for cross-participation share swaps and why a separate bookkeeping duty for grid operators was dropped.
Objects to experiments and N-1 exemptions, asks whether the ACM can supervise experiments and cost burdens on citizens, and wants a cost-benefit analysis.
Can the government indicate whether the ACM is able to strictly supervise all experiments?
Kan de regering aangeven of de ACM in staat is hier bij alle experimenten strikt op toe te zien?
Asks whether experiments require prior approval or only ex-post review, and what the boundaries are for affiliated companies.

They ask the government to set out the conditions it will impose on the duration and type of experiments grid operators may conduct, and whether they must always seek prior permission or whether only ex-post review applies.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering uiteen te zetten welke voorwaarden ze wil gaan stellen aan de duur en het soort experimenten die netwerkbeheerders mogen doen, en of zij vooraf steeds bij ieder experiment toestemming moeten vragen of dat achteraf alleen wordt gekeken of aan alle voorwaarden is voldaan.
Asks for full transparency and separate bookkeeping for network operators and companies, and warns against cross-subsidisation of commercial activities.
They believe there should be full public disclosure of the direct and indirect use of public funds.
Zij zijn van mening dat er volledige openbaarheid hoort te zijn over het directe en indirecte gebruik van publieke middelen.
Stresses that grid reliability must not be diluted with N-1 exceptions and asks for mandatory outage reporting.
These members consider it important, especially given vulnerable businesses, that the current reliability of the high-voltage grid must not be compromised.
Deze leden vinden het van belang dat, zeker ook met het oog op kwetsbare bedrijven, niet afge dongen mag worden op de huidige betrouwbaarheid van het hoogspanningsnet.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised (10 July 2017) against two amendments to the Electricity Act 1998 that would close Dutch coal plants by imposing efficiency requirements, finding serious risk of conflict with the Industrial Emissions Directive and that such closure is improper; it suggested a direct closure law instead and said compensation is not necessarily required under Article 1 of Protocol 1 if transition periods are adequate and justified. The minister's reply accepts the advice in full and advises against both amendments.
concerns: The amendments likely conflict with the Industrial Emissions Directive, as efficiency requirements may not be used to force closure of plants and unattainable standards breach best-available-techniques principles.
Closure without compensation may breach Article 1 of Protocol 1 ECHR unless transition periods are adequate and justified; the amendments' transition periods are not reasoned.
Closure via efficiency standards is improper; a direct closure act would be the more appropriate instrument, subject to further EU-law and policy examination.
No enforcement basis exists in the Electricity Act for the proposed efficiency requirements; provincial authorities should be made competent for enforcement.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Electricity Act 1998 and the Gas Act to facilitate the energy transition, raising major objections on cross-participation conditions under EU free movement of capital, state-only ownership of the high-voltage grid operator, the parliamentary consent mechanism, and the exclusion of landspecifieke kenmerken for the gas grid. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, amending the bill to add justification, align consent rules with the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, extend the gas-grid carve-out, and insert a transposition table.
concerns: Advice to justify under EU law the proportionality and suitability of the 75% public ownership requirement and parliamentary consent conditions on cross-participation; government added justification in the explanatory memorandum.

Parliamentary consent requirement makes a ministerial power legally dependent on both Chambers, departing from ministerial responsibility; government adopted an approval procedure modelled on Comptabiliteitswet 2001 article 34.
Unclear why only the State, not other public bodies, may hold the high-voltage grid operator shares; government retained state-level overriding control and explained this choice.
Exclusion of landspecifieke kenmerken from efficiency assessment applied only to the electricity grid, without justification for omitting the gas grid; government extended and explained it.
Lack of EU transposition table and European legal context in the explanatory memorandum; government added a table and corrected redactional points.

34654.s: The bill amends the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT, formerly the Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen) to extend pay caps to executives for four years after leaving office, cap severance and non-activity pay, add an anti-cumulation rule, and shift detailed reporting requirements from the statute to ministerial regulation. It also reduces administrative burdens for small semi-public bodies, lifts the ban on variable pay, and lets the Minister of BZK adjust the pay cap by ministerial regulation.
34654.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for periodic adjustment, reduced administrative burden and practical flexibility, and it notes the Minister will be restrained in changing the rules.
q: the manner in which institutions must account for themselves to be elaborated in a ministerial regulation
de wijze waarop instellingen zich moeten verantwoorden uit te werken in een ministeriële regeling
d: functions exempted from four-year post-office pay cap
joint ministerial decision allowing higher pay than the cap
sectoral pay maxima for semi-public bodies
disclosure data required in financial reporting
limiting or exempting disclosure duties for small bodies
exemption from duplicate pay disclosure under Civil Code
raising statutory pay cap to minister's salary
list of bodies subject to the act
p: Extends the pay cap to former top officials for four years after leaving, with exemptions set by ministerial regulation.
Moves detailed disclosure rules from the statute to ministerial regulation, allowing changes without parliament and exempting some bodies from disclosure.}],

parties: Asks how WNT supervisors' expanded data-request powers work for the UWV and Chamber of Commerce and how uniform exemption decisions by the ministers are guaranteed without arbitrariness.
How is arbitrariness prevented? Have criteria been drawn up?
Hoe wordt willekeur voorkomen? Zijn er criteria opgesteld?
Objects to dropping the general anti-misuse provision and asks how ministerial regulations on variable pay and exemptions could be subject to parliamentary scrutiny.
The members place great value on a more general anti-misuse provision that gives the Minister the power to act against those who seek to circumvent the WNT.
De aan het woord zijnde leden hechten daarom zeer aan een meer algemene antimisbruikbepaling die de Minister de mogelijkheid biedt om op te treden tegen degenen die de WNT willen omzeilen.
Objects to moving accountability rules into ministerial decisions rather than statute, to allowing variable pay, and to reduced publication of exceedances of the pay norm.
Does the government agree with these members that a statutory basis offers more firm footing and that this is desirable regardless of which Minister of the Interior is in office?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat een wettelijke grondslag meer houvast biedt en dat dit, ongeacht welke Minister van BZK op dat moment in functie is, wenselijk is?
Asks whether the stacking of pay-related legislation and transitional law hampers evaluation of side effects and raises the risk of errors in implementation and accountability.

Does the government share the concern of these members that, as a result of this stacking of legislation combined with the ongoing transitional law, the chances increase that institutions make errors in implementation and accountability?

Deelt de regering de zorg van deze leden, dat als gevolg van deze stapeling van wetgeving in combinatie met het lopende overgangsrecht, de kansen toenemen dat instellingen fouten maken in de uitvoering en verantwoording?
Asks which situations the pay norm does not fully cover, what additional administrative burden reductions are possible, and which roughly 200 institutions drop out of scope.
Can the government explain in which situations the norm currently does not apply, or does not fully apply, where that would be desirable?
Kan de regering toelichten in welke situaties de normering nu niet of niet volledig geldt waar dat wel gewenst is?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against sending the Evaluatiewet WNT bill to parliament until its objections on expanding the WNT's scope to affiliated entities and care-service providers, and on a general anti-abuse provision, were addressed. The Minister's reply (nader rapport) dropped those three measures from the bill, retained only technical changes, and noted that the advice was largely accepted.
concerns: The extension of WNT to parent entities and holding companies goes beyond what is necessary to prevent circumvention and lacks a fair balance with property rights; the government dropped this extension.
Extending WNT to private-sector organisations interferes with property rights under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR without sufficient justification; the government dropped the extension.
Extension of WNT scope to private organisations affects EU free movement rules without adequate justification; the government dropped the extension.
The general anti-abuse provision creates excessive legal uncertainty, unclear criteria and an unbalanced burden of proof; the government dropped the provision.
The evaluation does not demonstrate a structural, widespread circumvention problem justifying the far-reaching measures.

Extending WNT to organisations performing services for care institutions lacks a sufficiently targeted justification and would apply to purely commercial activities; the government dropped this measure.
Delegation of indexation of the maximum severance payment to a general administrative order is adjusted with an objective calculation rule to be fixed in the implementing decree.

34717.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to implement EU Directive 2015/1513 on fuel quality and renewable energy, redefining renewable fuel categories, the obligation on suppliers to end consumers, and the registry. It adds a new title 9.8 creating a greenhouse gas reduction obligation for transport emissions operated through the emissions authority's registry.
34717.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to operationalise the directive's reduction obligation and the registry, and to allow flexibility as the system is implemented.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order it may be determined that one gigajoule of certain forms of renewable energy is worth more than one HBE.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kan worden bepaald dat één gigajoule van een aantal vormen van hernieuwbare energie meer dan één HBE waard is.
d: quota of renewable fuel units per type
data to enter in the account and proof of end-consumption
further rules on ex officio determination of obligations
rules on raw materials and proof of sustainability for renewable fuel units
list of materials counting as advanced feedstock
share of units that may be saved and order of saving
percentage greenhouse gas reduction obligation per year
data and calculation method for registry entries
rules for acquiring exploitation reduction units
operation, availability and security of the register
refusal, blocking and closure of accounts for fraud or misuse
fees for opening and maintaining registry accounts
p: The emissions authority may refuse, block or close registry accounts on suspicion of fraud or non-compliance, with rules to be set by general administrative order.
The emissions authority may ex officio set an obligee's supply or obligation retroactively up to five years after the year concerned.
Administrative fines and a temporary ban on registering biofuel are added as sanctions for violations of the new rules.

parties: Asks which body verifies renewable energy compliance and how the NEa checks suppliers' obligations, and questions the administrative burden of reporting.
Who checks whether suppliers properly meet the annual obligation?
Wie controleert of de leveranciers op een juiste wijze aan de jaarverplichting voldoen?
Opposes the blending obligation on cost, food-fuel and safety grounds and asks for cost and accident data before proceeding.
These members have never wanted such a blending obligation and will never argue for it.
Deze leden hebben een dergelijke bijmengverplichting nooit gewild en zullen daar ook nooit voor pleiten.
Asks how fraud will be prevented given the NEa's findings of high fraud risk and weak enforcement, and whether the cap and double-counting are appropriate.
Given the retention of double-counting and the higher annual obligation, the CDA asks how the government will prevent fraud with used cooking oil.
Gezien het behoud van de dubbeltelling en de hogere jaarverplichting vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie hoe de regering fraude gaat voorkomen met gebruikt frituurvet.
Asks for scenario comparisons, justification of the 16.4% obligation, and clarification of the consultation and delayed entry into force of the anti-circumvention provision.
Rejects the proposed high obligation and cap as harmful to people and environment and asks the government to justify its choice against CE Delft's advice.
These members are not satisfied with the bill as it now stands.
Deze leden zijn niet tevreden met het wetsvoorstel dat nu voorligt.
Asks about lifecycle emissions, possible side effects of the HBE trading system, fraud risk, and whether conventional biofuel volumes can still be tracked.
The SP members ask for further explanation of the choice of the HBE system.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen een verdere toelichting op de keuze voor het systeem van HBE’s.
Asks for justification of the 5% cap and 16.4% obligation, fraud prevention given NEa-identified weaknesses, and transparency on supply volumes.
Argues conventional biofuels should be phased out to 0% and asks why the government does not ban the most harmful biofuels.
The use of conventional biofuels should therefore not be permitted in sustainable energy policy.
Het gebruik van conventionele biobrandstoffen zou daarom niet moeten worden toegestaan in duurzaam energiebeleid.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on a bill amending the Wet milieubeheer to implement EU Directive 2015/1513 and operationalise the fuel reduction obligation advises a reasoned justification or adaptation of the provision on biofuel supply to the Dutch transport market, which would not yet enter into force, and clarification of the savings of renewable fuel units. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, commits to clarifying and expanding the consultation report, and reverses the planned abolition of double counting following a parliamentary motion.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a reasoned justification for postponing entry into force of the narrower definition of supply to the Dutch transport market, given the substantial discrepancy in figures and the 2020 deadline; the government clarifies the cause and says entry into force will follow if no other solution is found, by 1 January 2020 at the latest.

The Afdeling notes it is unclear for which purpose the delegation for saving HBEs for a year other than the next year is created, and asks for clarification in the explanatory memorandum, which has been added.

The Afdeling asks for a fuller report of the internet consultation in the explanatory memorandum covering double counting, a single CO2 value and upstream emission reductions, which has been included.
The Afdeling makes editorial comments and corrections to the transposition table, which are incorporated.

34725-IIB.s: This bill is a Slotwet (closing budget act) for 2016 that amends the departmental budget of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and three governor cabinets in Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. It adopts the realised figures and adjusts appropriations and commitments for the year, with effect from the day after publication and retroactively to 31 December.
q: This bill aims to make changes for the year 2016 to the departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, the Nationale ombudsman and others.
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2016 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman

34730-X.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) by adjusting expenditure, commitment and revenue ceilings, as set out in an attached supplementary budget table. It takes effect on 1 June 2017 and is a budgetary adjustment rather than a delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34735.s: The bill overhauls the accreditation system for Dutch higher education by restructuring chapter 5 of the WHW, so that accreditation of existing programmes no longer lapses automatically after six years and the accreditation body NVAO handles new and existing programme assessments under revised rules. It also reduces administrative burdens, strengthens student involvement in visitations, and lets the Minister withdraw accreditation in exceptional cases and set rules by general administrative order (AMvB).
34735.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the detailed rules belong in an AMvB or ministerial regulation because they cannot be achieved through the accreditation framework alone and the framework is subject to parliamentary scrutiny.
q: The accreditation framework or any amendment requires the approval of the Minister.
Het accreditatiekader of een wijziging daarvan behoeft de goedkeuring van Onze Minister.
d: accreditation framework drawn up by the accreditation body, approved by the Minister
grounds and conditions for accreditation of new programmes under conditions
cases in which conditional accreditation is withdrawn
reference list for internationally recognisable degree additions
work of the accreditation body on non-higher education assessments
tariffs institutions owe the accreditation body
p: The Minister may withdraw accreditation or the ITK recognition mid-cycle on advice of the accreditation body, a discretionary power exercised as an ultimum remedium but without a fixed threshold beyond a changed quality assessment.
After annulment of decisions the Minister may set transitional arrangements keeping funding and degree-awarding powers for a period he determines.
Ministerial nomination of board members of the accreditation body must follow consultation with institutions and staff unions.

parties: Asks whether quality assurance of degrees is safeguarded, whether programme-level accreditation remains necessary, and whether the government has considered the NVAO's role and lessons from earlier deregulation.
The members attach great value to limiting the burden, but state that the quality assurance of the degree in higher education must not be compromised.
De leden hechten veel waarde aan het beperken van de lastendruk, maar stellen dat de kwaliteitsborging van het diploma in het hoger onderwijs niet in het geding mag komen.

Questions the need for the bill since much is already changed in the assessment framework, and asks the government to justify the changes and respond to the Raad van State's criticism and NVAO proposals.
These members ask the government to further motivate the necessity and purpose of this bill and specifically of this part.
Daarom vragen deze leden dan ook aan de regering om nut en noodzaak van dit wetsvoorstel en specifiek op dit onderdeel nader te motiveren.

Asks how withdrawal of accreditation for late reports will work, whether publishing recommendations is necessary, and how the cost reductions were calculated; questions whether the change actually reduces burdens.
Asks how the visitation report is communicated to the institution, who has direct access to it including student and faculty bodies, and why the reports are not published directly.
The members further ask what considerations lie behind not publishing both reports directly.
De leden vragen voorts wat de overwegingen zijn om beide rapporten niet direct openbaar te publiceren.

Doubts that the institution-wide assessment is a good replacement for programme-level checks, questions the arbitrary 'excellent' rating, and asks whether the accreditation framework can be further slimmed to minimum standards.
The members continue to have doubts about the institution-wide ITK as a replacement for part of the assessment of individual programmes.
De leden blijven twijfels hebben over de instellingsbrede ITK als vervanging van een deel van de beoordeling van individuele opleidingen.
Supports the aim of shaping accreditation on trust and reducing burden, and requests no further explanation at this stage.
The members endorse the objective of shaping the accreditation system more on the basis of trust and having it experienced as less burdensome by those involved.
De leden onderschrijven de doelstelling om het accreditatiestelsel meer vorm te geven op basis van vertrouwen en het door betrokkenen als minder belastend te laten ervaren.

Supports pre-evaluation relief but fears added burdens and unclear accreditation frameworks restricting professional freedom; questions the legal basis for quality-of-teaching standards and the wording of institutional duties.
However, they see room for further accommodations and moreover fear that the bill could also lead to an increase in burdens.
Zij zien echter ruimte voor verdergaande tegemoetkomingen en vrezen bovendien dat het wetsvoorstel ook tot verzwaring van lasten kan leiden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised submitting the Wet accreditatie op maat bill to parliament but asked for substantive justification and amendments, notably that reducing 'experienced burdens' is not a sound legislative aim, that administrative burden reduction is unproven, and that an independent broader evaluation of accreditation is needed. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts several points, amends the bill (e.g. summary of recommendations published within a year, removal of the student-obligation wording, clarified transitional rules), but rejects the call to drop student participation provisions and the proposal to delete the rule on negative accreditation outcomes.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the bill substantially reduces administrative burden and asked for an adequate calculation of burden and the claimed 15% reduction, which the reply addresses only by clarifying the estimate.

The Afdeling noted that accreditation not lapsing automatically offers no real difference and that the 'herstelperiode' renaming is merely linguistic; the government clarified the choice of terminology and the conditions.
The Afdeling considered it premature and of little use to expand opleidingscommissie tasks and student panels, advising deletion; the government did not follow this advice.
Numerous redactional and technical drafting points were raised and incorporated in the amended bill.

34753.s: The bill creates a standalone legal basis and procedure for recovering state aid that the European Commission has ordered repaid, using a repayment decision issued by the administrative body concerned and enforceable by collection order. It also amends the General State Taxes Act, the Collection Act, the Municipalities Act, the Provinces Act, the Water Boards Act and the Bankruptcy Act so that tax-based aid is recovered within the tax system and court challenges go to the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal in a single instance.
34753.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the Netherlands' EU obligation to recover unlawful state aid effectively and by the lack of a consistent legal basis in existing Dutch law.
q: The bill provides for appeal to the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal in first and only instance against repayment decisions.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in beroep bij het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBb) in eerste en enige aanleg tegen beschikkingen tot betaling
d: administrative body may amend or withdraw decisions ex officio to regulate the legal relationship with a beneficiary
commencement of articles set by royal decree, possibly differently per article
p: The administrative body may recover aid by repayment decision without the normal objection suspension regime, with appeal only to the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal in a single instance.

Sections 4.4.2 and 4.4.3 of the General Administrative Law Act are excluded for the repayment debt and collection is by enforcement order without a court judgment, leaving only a court request for suspension.
The administrative body is obliged to revise its own decisions that breached the Treaty's state aid rules where no Commission decision exists.

parties: Asks why the earlier 2008 state-aid recovery bill was left unfinished for a decade, and whether a complete set of legal bases is needed sooner.
These members consider a watertight set of national legal bases for recovering state aid not granted in accordance with the rules important.
Deze leden vinden een sluitende set nationaalrechtelijke grondslagen voor de terugvorderingen van niet overeenkomstig de regels verstrekte staatssteun van belang.
Worries that setting aside the national trust principle and placing a far-reaching investigation duty on businesses undermines legal certainty and trust in government.
This undermines trust in the national government and institutions.
Daarmee wordt het vertrouwen in de nationale overheid en instellingen aangetast.
Asks whether placing responsibility on the entrepreneur creates obstacles for smaller firms without legal expertise in European law, and how well administrative bodies know the TFEU.
These members wonder whether the government shares this view of the Court, and whether placing responsibility with the entrepreneur is justified in the government's view.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd of de regering deze mening van het Hof deelt, of het leggen van de verantwoordelijkheid bij de ondernemer naar de mening van de regering terecht is
Asks how appeal to the College van Beroep and interim relief fit with the absence of suspensive effect, and about the financial effects on aid-dependent organisations.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised that the bill on recovery of state aid should be supplemented or better justified, since the withdrawal of the earlier bill leaves private and tax law gaps unaddressed when no Commission decision underlies recovery. The government's reply adopted several changes (clarified scope of fiscal recovery, narrowed limitation exception in Article 4, expanded explanation of fiscal knock-on effects, new Bankruptcy Act provision) while rejecting the call to add private-law reinstatement obligations.
concerns: Gaps in Civil Code and tax law remain unaddressed when recovery rests on a national court ruling rather than a Commission decision, which the advisory division said needed justification or amendment.
The exception in Article 4 allowing beneficiaries to invoke limitation periods was too broad and inconsistent with EU procedural rules and case law, so it was removed.
Scope differences between the general and fiscal recovery regimes required justification, and the fiscal regime was supplemented to match the general regime's scope.
Knock-on effects of fiscal recovery (e.g. allowances, tax credits, transfer pricing, subsidies) were treated too summarily and needed fuller explanation.
The Bankruptcy Act exclusion was wrongly described and needed a clearer link to the Commission's recovery policy, leading to a new provision on homologation of arrangements.
Redactional points on phased entry into force, alignment of text and explanation, and related provisions were addressed.

34762.s: The bill amends the Wet opslag duurzame energie to set new surcharge rates for sustainable energy on electricity and natural gas consumption for 2018, funding further stimulation of renewable energy production. It takes effect on 1 January 2018, or on a date set by royal decree if publication is later, and provides for deviation from the referendum timing rules.
34762.j: The memorandum justifies the royal decree fallback as a contingency in case publication in the Staatsblad misses the 1 January 2018 deadline, and the referendum-timing deviation as a practical measure after Council of State advice.
q: In the unlikely event that the bill is not published in the Staatsblad before 1 January 2018, provision is made for its entry into force on a date to be set by Royal Decree.

Voor het onverhoopte geval dat het wetsvoorstel niet voor 1 januari 2018 aanstaande in het Staatsblad wordt gepubliceerd, is voorzien in de inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel op een bij Koninklijk Besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: setting the entry-into-force date by royal decree if publication occurs after 31 December 2017

parties: Asks how much of the energy reserve is not legally committed, why it is not spent faster, how the tariffs compare with the coalition agreement, and whether the cost split with business is balanced.
The CDA members ask the government how much money in the sustainable energy budget reserve is not legally committed.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering hoeveel middelen in de begrotingsreserve duurzame energie niet juridisch verplicht zijn.

Criticises the tariff increase as a growing burden on low incomes and households, and asks for reflection on the 50-50 split between businesses and households and on the distribution of SDE subsidies toward businesses.
The risk that the well-intended sustainable energy levy ends up becoming an ever heavier burden on the lowest incomes appears to be coming true with this proposal.
Het risico dat de goed bedoelde opslag voor duurzame energie uiteindelijk zou veranderen in een steeds zwaardere last voor de laagste inkomens lijkt met voorliggend voorstel te worden bewaarheid.

34771.s: The bill amends the Dutch International Assistance in Tax Matters Act to implement EU Directive 2016/2258, giving the Dutch tax authority access to anti-money-laundering information held by financial institutions so it can verify CRS reporting. It adds a new article 10g empowering the Minister of Finance, to be delegated to the Tax Administration, to obtain such access within a time limit and in a manner the Minister sets, and extends penalty provisions accordingly.
