34771.j: The memorandum justifies the access power as necessary to let the tax authority check that CRS data supplied by financial institutions is correct and complete, and says the manner of access is subject to reasonableness and good-administration principles.
q: Directive (EU) 2016/2258 requires full access for tax authorities to these anti-money-laundering records in order to implement Directive 2011/16/EU.
Richtlijn (EU) 2016/2258 schrijft de (volledige) toegang voor belastingautoriteiten tot deze antiwitwasinlichtingen voor met het oog op de uitvoering van Richtlijn 2011/16/EU
d: access to anti-money-laundering information, time limit and manner set by Minister
p: The tax authority gains broad access to anti-money-laundering records on request, with timing and manner left to ministerial discretion, subject to reasonableness and general principles of good administration.

parties: Asks whether the criterion of expected relevance is too broad to prevent fishing expeditions and how long collected information is retained.
Is the stated criterion that the information is expected to be relevant for taxation in that other EU member state not too broad to counter fishing expeditions?
Is het genoemde criterium dat «de inlichtingen naar verwachting van belang zijn voor de belastingheffing van die andere EU-lidstaat» niet te breed om fishing expeditions tegen te gaan?
Asks what additional powers the bill gives the tax authority compared with existing CRS implementation and what administrative burdens it creates for firms.
Can the government give an overall picture of which additional powers the Tax Authority receives under this bill compared with current legislation?
Kan de regering een globaal beeld geven welke extra bevoegdheden de Belastingdienst krijgt door onderhavig wetsvoorstel ten opzichte van de huidige wetgeving?
Raises concerns about data protection of sensitive financial data, the purpose limitation on full access, and the impact on the legal professional privilege (verschoningsrecht).
In earlier consultations with the government, the D66 members already shared their concern about changing the right of privilege (verschoningsrecht).
Al in eerdere overleggen met de regering hebben de leden van de D66-fractie hun zorg gedeeld over het aanpassen van het verschoningsrecht.
Argues that more information exchange is insufficient to combat tax evasion and asks whether the tax authority is equipped to use the data and whether the burden of proof should be reversed.
Does the government share the view that the Tax Authority should adopt this reversal of the burden of proof in its policy?
Deelt de regering de mening dat de Belastingdienst deze omkering van de bewijslast dient op te nemen in haar beleid?

34780.s: The bill amends the Aanbestedingswet 2012 and the Aanbestedingswet op defensie- en veiligheidsgebied to implement Directive 2014/55/EU on electronic invoicing in public procurement. It adds a delegation basis allowing detailed rules on receiving and processing e-invoices to be set by general administrative order (AMvB), with a transition period of 18 months after publication of the European standard.
34780.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as the existing structural way to regulate implementation details of the procurement directives by AMvB, and notes the transition period needed for contracting authorities.
q: This follows the existing structure of the procurement acts to regulate by or pursuant to a general administrative order the further rules implementing the procurement directives on communication between the contracting authority and the business.

Hiermee wordt aangesloten bij de bestaande structuur van de aanbestedingswetten om nadere regels ter uitvoering van de aanbestedingsrichtlijnen en de concessierichtlijn over de communicatie tussen de aanbestedende dienst of speciale-sectorbedrijf en de ondernemer bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen.
d: ARTIKEL I, B (artikel 4.12, eerste lid, Aanbestedingswet 2012)
rules on receiving and processing electronic invoices in procurement
ARTIKEL II, B (artikel 3.1, eerste lid, Aanbestedingswet op defensie- en veiligheidsgebied)
rules on receiving and processing electronic invoices in defence and security procurement

parties: Asks the government to explain expected effects on invoice payment speed and payment terms, whether suppliers can easily meet e-invoicing requirements, and whether the law will be evaluated.
Could the government elaborate on what effect is expected from this bill on these points?
Zou de regering nader kunnen ingaan welke effect wordt verwacht door dit wetsvoorstel op deze punten?

Asks how many contracting authorities can already use e-invoices, whether invoicing software providers have adopted the system, and whether the one-billion-euro savings estimate from a three-year-old analysis is still current.
These members ask the government about the currency of this figure, which is now three years old.
Deze leden vragen de regering naar de actualiteit van dit inmiddels drie jaar oude cijfer.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises submitting the bill implementing Directive 2014/55/EU on electronic invoicing in public procurement to parliament, but asks for clearer justification of the implementation deadline and the relation between Article 11(1) and 11(2) of the directive. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been amended to clarify these points and that the transposition table has been adjusted as suggested.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should justify why the directive can be implemented by March 2019, departing from the deadline in Article 11(1), and clarify the relation between Article 11(1) and 11(2).
The transposition table for the definitions in Article 2 of the directive should state whether each definition needs no implementation, is already implemented, or must be implemented.

34807.s: The bill amends the Municipalities Act and the Provinces Act so that municipal councils and provincial states may grant exemption from the residency requirement for aldermen and deputies without the previous fixed-term limits. The explanatory memorandum says councils would then freely decide the duration and conditions of any exemption.
34807.j: The memorandum justifies the wider discretion by local autonomy and the possibility of local customisation, and by ending routine renewal decisions and politically motivated non-renewals.
q: The government considers it important that the council can make its own assessment, at its own discretion, regarding exemption from the residency requirement for aldermen.
De regering acht het van belang dat de raad naar eigen inzicht een afweging kan maken inzake ontheffing van het woonplaatsvereiste voor wethouders.
d: granting exemption from residency requirement for aldermen
granting exemption from residency requirement for deputies
p: Councils and provincial states receive an unconditioned discretion to exempt officials from the residency requirement, removing the previous fixed one-year limit and forced renewals.

parties: Wants the government to explain how partisan considerations in exemption decisions will be prevented, given the unconditional discretion the bill gives councils, and how councils will be made aware of the residence-requirement principle.
In the view of the VVD faction, party-political considerations could still play a role.
Naar de mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie kunnen partijpolitieke overwegingen dan nog steeds een rol spelen.
Asks for examples of non-renewal decisions driven by political considerations and whether the bill prevents such decisions being politically motivated.

These members also ask to what extent the bill prevents decisions not to extend the exemption from being driven, or partly driven, by political considerations.; the CDA asks for examples of such decisions.

Ook vragen deze leden, in hoeverre met het voorliggende wetsvoorstel voorkomen wordt, dat besluiten tot niet-verlenging van de ontheffing door politieke overwegingen of mede door politieke overwegingen worden ingegeven.
Questions whether municipalities actually report political assessment of renewals as a real problem, given that all renewal requests were granted in 2011.
They ask the government whether municipalities have indicated that this is a real problem.
Zij vragen de regering of gemeenten hebben aangegeven dat dit een reëel probleem is.
Supports the residence requirement's link to the local community but wants further explanation on one point, and asks whether the bill will increase non-resident aldermen.
At the same time these members see the need for more room for local consideration.; The ChristenUnie asks whether the simplified exemption will increase the number of non-resident aldermen.
Tegelijk zien deze leden de behoefte aan meer ruimte voor een lokale afweging.
Endorses the Council of State's warning that the bill undermines the residence requirement in local practice and asks the government to withdraw the bill.

On the basis of these considerations, the 50PLUS faction asks the government to withdraw the bill.; The 50PLUS faction endorses the Council of State's advice that local governance requires officials rooted in the community.
Op grond van deze overwegingen verzoeken de leden van de 50Plus-fractie de regering het wetsvoorstel in te trekken.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises against sending the bill to parliament until its remarks are considered, arguing that an unlimited exemption from the residence requirement for aldermen and deputies undermines the principle of local roots and that the annual review should be kept. The minister's reply rejects this, arguing that local autonomy and local tailoring justify the broader discretion and that the concerns are unfounded.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the bill, by allowing unlimited exemptions, could further undermine the residence requirement as the main rule, which the minister rejects as a negative framing of local discretion.
The Afdeling considers the bill hinges on two inconsistent ideas, binding local officials and enabling external appointments, and asks for reconsideration; the minister sees no reason to reconsider.

34825.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Aalburg, Werkendam and Woudrichem into a new municipality called Altena, effective on a date set by royal decree. It also designates Altena as the successor for tax, joint-arrangement and utility transfers and updates electoral, judicial and safety-region lists.
34825.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by citing the municipal councils' concerns about weak administrative capacity and the wish to match governance scale to social tasks, not any new executive powers.
q: According to Mr Veerman (see § 2.1) it is unlikely that the current municipalities can provide adequate capacity
Volgens de heer Veerman (zie § 2.1) is het niet waarschijnlijk dat de huidige gemeenten in adequate capaciteit kunnen voorzien
d: setting the date the law enters into force by royal decree

parties: Accepts the voluntary merger and raises no remarks or questions.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks the government to send the herindelingsadvies and the province's zienswijze to the Chamber, since website publication is not equivalent to submission.
They are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Zij zijn van mening dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
Welcomes the bottom-up process and the expected creation of a capable municipality; no further questions at this stage.
At this stage in the process they have no further questions.
Zij hebben op dit moment in het proces geen nadere vragen.
Asks how citizens, organisations and local politics were involved in preparing the merger.
These members ask the government to further explain how residents, civil society organisations and local politics in the municipalities were involved in preparing the merger proposal.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken zijn geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
Questions whether a majority of residents supports the merger, why no referendum was held, and why the merger proceeds without majority support.
If no citizen consultation has taken place, why was that not chosen?
Indien er geen burgerraadpleging heeft plaatsgevonden, waarom is daar niet voor gekozen?
Endorses the planned merger and has no further questions at this stage.
At this stage of the proceedings they have no further questions about the proposal.
Zij hebben in deze fase van de behandeling geen nadere vragen met betrekking tot het voorstel.
Asks how the gap between local government and residents in the various kernels will be prevented from widening after the merger, and how council involvement in decision-making was considered.
How will it be prevented that this distance becomes too large?
Hoe wordt voor komen dat deze afstand te groot wordt?

34852.s: This is a technical repair bill amending numerous Dutch laws within the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, correcting outdated article references, wording and typographical errors. It makes no substantive shift of power to the executive, mostly replacing terms like bevoegd gezag with bevoegd orgaan and updating cross-references.
34852.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as repairs of minor technical defects and outdated references, with no new powers claimed.
d: entry into force by royal decree

parties: The SP asks when the government will deliver on the adopted motion equalising rent-price protection for tenants with temporary contracts, and wants this done quickly.
These members ask when an outcome of the motion can be expected.
Deze leden vragen wanneer een uitkomst van de motie te verwachten is.

34861.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2016/681 by requiring airlines to transfer passenger name record data on flights to and from third countries and within the EU to a new Passenger Information Unit under the Minister of Justice and Security. The unit may compare passenger data against databases and risk criteria, pass results to designated competent authorities and other countries, and retain data for five years with data protection safeguards.
34861.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the directive's aim to counter terrorism and serious crime and states that the directive does not require new powers for competent authorities, with safeguards such as a data protection officer and the Wet politiegegevens applied.
q: In view of the right to respect for private life, the right to protection of personal data and the right to non-discrimination, the PNR Directive contains a number of safeguards.
Gelet op het recht op eerbiediging van het privéleven, het recht op bescherming van persoonsgegevens en het recht op non-discriminatie is in de PNR-richtlijn een aantal waarborgen opgenomen.
d: manner of transmitting passenger data by airlines
organisation, structure and working method of the Passenger Information Unit
how risk criteria are drawn up and the requirements they must meet
rules on transfer of data to other member states and conditions for use
rules on transfer of data to Europol and further processing
conditions for transfer of data to third-country authorities
manner and conditions for requests to other member states
manner and conditions for requests to airlines via other member states
manner and conditions for direct urgent requests to other member states
p: Allows the unit to screen all passengers against databases and pre-set risk criteria before arrival or departure to identify persons for further investigation, a significant expansion of state surveillance over travellers.
Permits analysis of passenger data to create and adjust risk criteria, with criteria set by the unit in consultation with competent authorities and details left to a general administrative order.
Allows passenger data to be transferred to third-country authorities, including without prior consent in urgent cases, with conditions largely set by general administrative order.
Allows pseudonymised data older than six months to be disclosed with approval of the public prosecutor and after notification to the data protection officer.

parties: Asks why the government does not itself analyse the Directive's future-proofing given the risk the Court of Justice annuls it, and why no evaluation clause is in the bill.
Asks how the Directive interacts with the GDPR and whether national implementation could be adjusted in line with the Court of Justice's opinion.
Can the Netherlands, on the basis of the Court of Justice's opinion, adjust the implementation of the PNR Directive on certain points so that it is in line with the opinion?
Kan Nederland op basis van het advies van het Hof van Justitie op bepaalde punten de implementatie van de PNR-richtlijn zo aanpassen dat deze in lijn is met het advies?
Accepts implementation must proceed but asks how the Directive complies with Charter fundamental rights and questions the necessity and retention periods.
Can the government statistically substantiate that this directive can make a substantial contribution to combating serious crime and terrorism?
Kan de regering statistisch onderbouwen dat deze richtlijn een wezenlijke bijdrage kan leveren aan het bestrijden van ernstige criminaliteit en terrorisme?
Argues implementing legislation likely conflicts with EU Charter rights and that mass retention of data on innocent travellers is disproportionate.
In short, legislation is being created that is in all likelihood in conflict with nationally and internationally recognised fundamental and human rights.
Het betekent kort en goed dat wetgeving tot stand komt die naar alle waarschijnlijkheid strijdig is met nationaal en internationaal erkende grond- en mensenrechten.
Objects to the far-reaching privacy intrusion of collecting data on all intra-EU flights and asks why data is not deleted sooner for non-hits, and why processing is not limited to selected flights.

It seems to these members much more proportionate if, at least after determining hits on the basis of objective criteria or a database comparison, the data of the ordinary holidaymaker are deleted from the system immediately when there are no hits.

Het lijkt deze leden veel meer proportioneel wanneer tenminste na het bepalen van de hits op basis van objectieve criteria of een bestandsvergelijking de gegevens van de «gewone» vakantieganger direct uit het systeem worden verwijderd wanneer er geen «hits» zijn.
Asks the government whether it has pressed the European Commission to revise the Directive's position and to bring it in line with the EU Charter.
Has the government urged the European Commission to revise the position that the obligation on member states to implement the directive remains unchanged?
Heeft de regering er bij de Europese Commissie op aangedrongen om het standpunt, dat de plicht van de lidstaten om de richtlijn te implementeren onveranderd blijft, te herzien?
Asks which EU member states already operate a national PNR or similar system.
Which member states of the European Union already have a national PNR or similar system storing flight data from that country for combating terrorism and serious crime?

Welke lidstaten van de Europese Unie hebben nu reeds een nationaal PNR- of daarop gelijkend systeem waarmee vluchtgegevens vanuit het desbetreffende land worden opgeslagen in het kader van de bestrijding van terrorisme en ernstige criminaliteit?
Asks about consequences of not applying PNR to intra-EU flights, information exchange reciprocity, and why AIVD and MIVD are not designated competent authorities.
Why have these services not been designated as competent authorities precisely now that the PNR directive concerns preventing and investigating terrorist offences?
Waarom zijn deze diensten niet benoemd als bevoegde instantie juist nu de PNR-richtlijn ziet op het voorkomen en onderzoeken van terroristische misdrijven?

Notes the directive contains provisions nearly identical to the EU-Canada PNR agreement the CJEU found incompatible with fundamental rights; asks for necessity and proportionality justification of intra-EU collection and how special personal data is prevented.
Does the government see implementing a directive containing elements that the CJEU considers incompatible with European fundamental rights as a dilemma?
Ziet de regering het implementeren van een richtlijn die elementen bevat die door het HvJEU als onverenigbaar worden gezien met de Europese grondrechten als een dilemma?

Supports fighting terrorism but asks for a proper balance with privacy and data protection, questions the directive's future-proofing given the CJEU ruling, and asks for justification of intra-EU flight coverage.
However, a good balance must be struck with fundamental rights such as respect for private life and protection of personal data.
Daarbij moet evenwel een goed evenwicht worden gevonden met de grondrechten als eerbiediging van het privéleven en bescherming van persoonsgegevens.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the PNR implementation bill, a faithful transposition of Directive 2016/681, cannot simply proceed as drafted because parts of the directive may conflict with fundamental rights in light of the CJEU's opinion 1/15 on the EU-Canada PNR agreement, and asked for an explanation and steps toward compliance. The minister's reply rejects the CJEU opinion as directly relevant to the directive, stresses the narrow room for national choice, and accepts the requested addition of third-country transfers to article 5 and the redactional remarks.
concerns: The Council argues parts of the PNR directive conflict with Charter fundamental rights (privacy and data protection) in light of CJEU opinion 1/15, which the minister rejects as not directly applicable to the directive.

The Council asks the government to take steps in Brussels to bring the directive in line with the Charter; the minister says the Commission has been asked to consider the matter and the government will press for its view where opportune.
The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to explain how the chosen implementation relates to the identified fundamental-rights pressure points, which the minister does not substantively elaborate.
The Council advises adding the transfer of passenger data to third countries to article 5 of the bill, which the minister followed by clarifying the memorandum.

34870.s: The bill replaces the Wet bekostiging financieel toezicht, revising how the costs of supervision by the AFM and De Nederlandsche Bank are divided among supervised categories and how budgets and accounts of these supervisors are governed. Detailed allocation of ongoing supervision costs and one-off fees is moved from statute into lower regulation (AMvB and ministerial regulation), while the cost-ceiling framework and budget/accounts rules stay in the law.
34870.j: The memorandum justifies delegation by the need for flexibility to adjust cost allocation quickly, since statutory amendments take about two years, while noting that the cost ceiling and key principles remain in the law under parliamentary control.
q: For this reason it is proposed that the elaboration of the allocation of costs for ongoing supervision will henceforth be regulated by general administrative order (AMvB).
Daarom wordt voorgesteld om de uitwerking van de verdeling van de kosten voor het doorlopend toezicht voortaan bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen.
d: detailed rules on the layout of the budget
detailed rules on the layout of the annual accounts
rules on the layout of the annual report
list of one-off handlings and their fees
categories of supervised persons and allocation of ongoing supervision costs
p: Ministers may depart from the cost ceiling in exceptional circumstances, informing both chambers in time.
Detailed allocation of ongoing supervision costs over supervised categories is moved from statute to an AMvB, reducing parliamentary control over that allocation.

parties: Delegation of cost allocation to lower regulation may reduce control over costs and the cost ceiling, and the VVD asks for parliamentary involvement and transparency.
These members also ask how it is prevented that delegation to lower legislation results in less control over the cost figures and less control over keeping costs in check.
Deze leden vragen eveneens hoe wordt voorkomen dat delegatie naar lagere wetgeving resulteert in minder controle op het kostenplaatje en minder controle op het in de hand houden van de kosten.
The CDA asks whether parliament's involvement and ability to influence cost frameworks becomes larger or smaller under the bill.
Does involvement, and therefore the possibility of influence, become greater or smaller with this bill?
Wordt de betrokkenheid en daarmee ook de mogelijkheid tot beïnvloeding groter of minder groot met dit wetsvoorstel?
D66 questions the delegation of cost allocation to an AMvB and asks whether an independent third party should review cost developments.
Is the government of the opinion that an independent third party should look along at the development of costs?
Is de regering van mening, dat een onafhankelijke derde partij mee zou moeten kijken naar de ontwikkeling van de kosten?
The SP fears that parliament will only be informed rather than authorising the supervisors' budgets, and that delegation moves decisions further from parliament and society.
The members of the SP faction are concerned that the House does not authorise the budgets of the AFM and the Dutch Central Bank (DNB), but is only informed.
De leden van de SP-fractie maken zich zorgen dat de Kamer de begrotingen van de AFM en de Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) niet autoriseert, maar dat zij alleen wordt geïnformeerd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised submitting the Wet bekostiging financieel toezicht 2019 to parliament, but asked for more insight in how supervisory costs are determined and capped under the multi-year cost framework, plus some drafting remarks. The government's reply accepts the cost-determination point by adding explanation to the memorie van toelichting, rejects one drafting suggestion, and adopts the other, and adds two amendments (transitional fix and a DGS cost-measure change).
concerns: The Afdeling asked for explanation of how supervisory costs are determined and capped in the cost framework, which the government addressed by adding explanatory text to the explanatory memorandum while noting the new tasks must be costed as they arise.
Redactional remark on clarifying the relation between the multi-year framework and a given year, and on wording of tasks, was adopted.
Suggestion to add 'betreffende het financieel toezicht' to the scope article was not adopted because the law covers tasks beyond financial supervision.

34915.s: The bill approves the 2017 Tallinn treaty between the Netherlands and Ukraine on international legal cooperation over the downing of flight MH17, enabling Dutch prosecution, video-conference hearings of suspects in Ukraine (only with their consent), and transfer of sentence enforcement. It takes effect under the advisory referendum act and contains no delegation of rule-making powers to the executive.
34915.j: The memorandum justifies the treaty by explaining that extradition of Ukrainian nationals is barred by the Ukrainian constitution, so video-conference hearings and transfer of enforcement were agreed instead.
q: It is for the (Dutch) judge to decide whether the possibility of appearing by video conference is used.
Het is aan de (Nederlandse) rechter om te beslissen of van de mogelijkheid van terechtstaan per videoconferentie gebruik wordt gemaakt.

parties: Asks whether a summons-enforcement order (bevel tot medebrenging) could be issued without the suspect's consent and why the treaty omits a Dutch-style mechanism, and asks about priority between competing extradition requests.
Do the VVD members correctly see that Article 205 of the Code of Criminal Procedure gives the investigating judge the power to issue an order to bring in a suspect who does not appear on the summons?

Zien de leden van de VVD-fractie het juist dat artikel 205 Sv de bevoegdheid geeft aan de rechter-commissaris een bevel tot medebrenging uit te vaardigen tegen een verdachte die niet op de dagvaarding verschijnt?

Questions why trial by videoconference requires the suspect's consent and whether in absentia convictions could leave suspects unaccountable before a public court, asking whether Ukraine should retain jurisdiction.
The CDA members read that appearing for trial by videoconference is only possible if the suspect consents to it.
De leden van de CDA-fractie lezen dat terechtstaan per videoconferentie alleen mogelijk is indien de verdachte daarmee instemt.

Asks about procedures for non-Ukrainian suspects from countries with similar extradition bans, the conditions attached to consent to videoconference trial, and the risk of sentences being reduced under Ukrainian law.
What agreements have been made with Ukraine regarding suspects' cooperation with their trial?
Welke afspraken zijn met Oekraïne gemaakt over de medewerking van verdachten aan hun proces?
Regrets that the Ukrainian constitutional ban on extraditing nationals could not be lifted or exempted and asks why no comparable treaty was made with Russia.
These members regret this and ask the government to explain why it has not proven possible to find an amendment or exception to it.
Deze leden betreuren dat en vragen de regering toe te lichten waarom het niet mogelijk is gebleken een aanpassing of uitzondering hierop te vinden.
Supports videoconference trial but insists it be surrounded by sufficient safeguards and asks whether consent can be withdrawn and whether the record reflects substance.
In their view, this must however be surrounded by sufficient safeguards.
Dit dient naar hun opvatting wel met voldoende waarborgen omgeven te zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on the bill implementing the MH17 prosecution arrangements and the Netherlands-Ukraine treaty on international legal cooperation, asking for clarification of the relation to the Netherlands' reservation to the Second Additional Protocol to the European Convention on Mutual Assistance, the EVIG and EVOS, and for more attention to consultation comments. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points by adding explanatory text and amendments, including narrowing the delegation basis in article 4(8) of the implementing act.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify how the treaty relates to the Netherlands' declaration on videoconference hearings under the Second Additional Protocol, and the government added this explanation.
The Afdeling asked that the bill be explicitly described as supplementing or facilitating the EVIG and EVOS, and the government adjusted the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
The Afdeling advised narrowing the delegation basis in article 4(8) of the implementing act as concretely as possible, and the government amended the provision.

The Afdeling asked for more specific attention to consultation objections on fair trial safeguards for videoconference trials, including the defendant's right to counsel, and the government addressed some but not all of them in the explanatory text.

34933.s: This bill amends the Dutch Pensioenwet and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling so that a worker or professional who has had contributions paid but is not yet enrolled in a pension scheme when employment ends receives a refund of contributions or their investment value. It implements EU Directive 2014/50/EU on pension rights portability for mobile workers and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
34933.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as a minimal implementation of an EU directive, noting that supervisors AFM and DNB raised no objections.
q: This means that the amendment of article 14, second paragraph, of the Pensioenwet has no material consequences for the pensions sector.
Dat betekent dat de aanpassing van artikel 14, tweede lid, van de Pensioenwet materieel geen gevolgen heeft voor de pensioensector.

parties: The PVV opposes adapting Dutch pension law to implement unnecessary EU directives and asks the government to withdraw the bill.
They therefore request the government to withdraw this bill and not proceed with implementation.
Zij verzoeken de regering dan ook dit wetsvoorstel in te trekken en niet tot implementatie over te gaan.
The CDA accepts the directive's limited impact but asks how the government is pursuing payment of Greek pensions owed to Dutch workers via the SVB.
Can the government indicate how progress is being made together with the Social Insurance Bank to have those pensions paid after all?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe er samen met de Sociale Verzekeringsbank vorderingen gemaakt worden om die pensioenen alsnog uitbetaald te krijgen?
D66 asks the government to confirm the directive has no material effect in the Netherlands and questions the legality of waiting-period practices.
Is it correct that no companies or sectors apply waiting periods, but that this is legally possible in the Netherlands?
Klopt het dat er geen bedrijven of sectoren zijn die drempeltijden hanteren, maar dat dit wettelijk in Nederland wel mogelijk is?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing EU pension directive 2016/2341 may proceed, but asked the government to explain how the rules on key functions affect outsourcing by pension funds for persons who do not set day-to-day policy. The minister accepted the remark, added clarification to the explanatory memorandum, split the bill into two, and sent the revised bills to parliament.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum clarify the implications of the directive for outsourcing of key functions by persons who do not set day-to-day policy.

34950-IIB.s: This Slotwet amends the 2017 departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the three Caribbean governor cabinets, setting final realized figures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no new executive powers.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, and the Nationale ombudsman.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman.

34960-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the States General (Staten-Generaal, chapter IIA) through a first supplementary budget, raising appropriations by about EUR 4.8 million for the Eerste and Tweede Kamer and related items. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2018.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2018.

35000-IX.s: This bill formally establishes the 2019 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget statement (IXA) in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget structure, tax administration modernisation, and financial-market, customs and VAT compensation policy areas.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this law for the year 2019 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35086.s: The bill adds a new offence (article 5a) criminalising intentional, seriously dangerous driving that endangers life or risk of serious bodily harm, with a non-exhaustive list of conduct, and raises maximum penalties for related traffic offences. It also extends the criminal liability of hit-and-run drivers to cases where damage to others was known or should have been suspected, and adds road traffic offences to the list in article 43b of the Criminal Code.
35086.j: The memorandum justifies the broader offence by arguing that the Supreme Court's strict requirements for recklessness have left too narrow a scope, so the legislature wants a wider, clearer offence and sentencing options.
q: As a result the scope of recklessness is too narrow, and this bill therefore aims to widen that scope again in line with the legislature's original intention.
Hierdoor is het toepassingsbereik van roekeloosheid te beperkt en daarom beoogt dit wetsvoorstel dat bereik weer te verbreden in lijn met de oorspronkelijke bedoeling van de wetgever.
p: Creates a broad, open-ended criminal offence with a non-exhaustive list of conduct, giving prosecutors and judges wider discretion to treat driving as criminal.

parties: Asks whether police investigative powers for hit-and-run cases can be regulated now rather than waiting for the Code of Criminal Procedure modernisation, and asks how police enforceability concerns were addressed.
Is it possible to regulate the investigative powers for hit-and-run cases, which many parties are asking for, already in this law?
Is het mogelijk de opsporingsbevoegdheden bij het doorrijden na een ongeval, waar veel partijen om vragen, toch al in deze wet te regelen?
Questions the intent requirement in new art. 5a, how intent would be recorded and assessed by judges, and whether recklessness should be framed differently to aid provability.
These members point to the many comments in advice from the Council of State's advisory division and various other bodies and interest groups about the intent character of the new article 5a.

Voornoemde leden wijzen op de vele opmerkingen die in adviezen van zowel de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State als diverse andere betrokken instanties en belangengroeperingen zijn gemaakt over het opzet-karakter van het nieuwe artikel 5a.
Questions how intent can be proven in practice and where the line lies with ordinary criminal traffic offences, and asks about the consistency of the recklessness definition.
They fear practical problems in proving that there was also intent to commit the violation 'to a serious degree'.
Zij vrezen in de praktijk problemen met het bewijzen dat er ook opzet was op het «in ernstige mate» begaan van de overtreding.
Questions whether enforcement capacity and the police reduction are realistic, and asks the basis for the penalty increases, including whether it reflects judges hitting limits.
Does the government not thereby create a law that sounds good on paper but is not enforceable in practice, or at least changes nothing simply because there is no capacity?
Creëert de regering zo niet een wet die mooi klinkt op papier maar die in de praktijk niet uitvoerbaar is of in ieder geval geen verandering teweeg brengt simpelweg omdat er geen capaciteit is?
Asks for justification of the chosen penalty maxima compared with other countries and about post-detention supervision such as licence withdrawal and retesting.
Can the government explain why six months was chosen rather than, for example, twelve months?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom er is gekozen voor de lengte van zes maanden, en bijvoorbeeld niet voor twaalf maanden?
Supports stricter punishment of deliberately dangerous driving but asks how courts have sentenced comparable cases and whether the sentencing disparity between harm and no-harm cases will change.
These members ask how, under current case law, sentences are imposed in such cases.
Deze leden vragen hoe naar de huidige stand van de rechtspraak de opgelegde straffen zijn in zulke gevallen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill tightening criminal liability for serious traffic offences by broadening the concept of recklessness and adding a new article 5a WVW 1994 with a non-exhaustive list of dangerous driving behaviours, and asked for clarification in the explanatory memorandum on the intended effect, the role of intent, and the scope of the open list. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the memorandum was amended in line with each point, including clarifying intent and the comparable-gravity requirement, and that the wording was adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify that the broadened recklessness concept may lead to a heavier sentence than article 5a, and the government clarified that a different outcome than current case law is intended.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the role of the intent requirement in article 5a compared with the existing recklessness standard, and the government explained the intent requirement in the memorandum.
The Afdeling asked that the open list of behaviours be limited to conduct of comparable gravity, and the government added this requirement to both the bill and the memorandum.
The Afdeling made a redactional comment, which the government adopted, adding 'voor een ander' after 'zwaar lichamelijk letsel'.

35095-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the States General (Tweede suppletoire begroting), changing spending and commitment amounts for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and related parliamentary items, effective from 1 December 2018. It is a purely budgetary adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power or new executive powers.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2018
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2018

35167.s: The bill prohibits generating electricity from coal in production installations to reduce CO2 emissions, with transitional periods for most plants and an earlier effective date for the Hemweg plant. It allows the Minister to grant compensation to operators disproportionately burdened, and assigns supervision to officials of the Dutch Emissions Authority with enforcement via administrative coercion.
35167.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary compensation power as a safeguard against an individual, disproportionate burden that would upset the fair balance of property rights under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR.
q: The bill explicitly includes in Article 4 the power to offer additional compensation should an individual and excessive burden unexpectedly arise from the prohibition.

In het wetsvoorstel is in artikel 4 nog wel expliciet de bevoegdheid opgenomen om aanvullende compensatie te kunnen bieden, mocht onverhoopt sprake blijken te zijn van een individuele en buitensporige last
d: discretionary compensation to coal plant operators
designation of supervisory officials of the Dutch Emissions Authority
p: The Minister may grant compensation to operators at his discretion, with no criteria beyond a showing of disproportionate burden and no parliamentary involvement.
Supervisory officials may share information with a licensing authority, subject to a confidentiality safeguard.

parties: Asks how the law leaves room for owners to recover long-term investments and whether reliable dispatchable capacity faces obstacles during the transition.
Can the government explain how, given the long-term investments of these coal plants, the law leaves room for their owners to still recover their investments?

Kan de regering aangeven hoe, gelet op de lange-termijn investeringen van deze kolencentrales, de wet ruimte biedt voor de eigenaren van deze kolencentrales om hun investeringen nog terug te kunnen verdienen?
Accepts the coal phase-out as necessary under international climate commitments while asking about leakage effects, ETS allowances and whether the disproportionate-burden test is met.

Given the international agreements on reducing CO2 emissions, first the Kyoto Protocol (1997) and the Paris Climate Agreement (2015), this step is necessary because of coal emissions and available alternatives, as agreed in the coalition agreement.

Gezien de internationale afspraken over het terugbrengen van CO 2 - emissies, eerst met het Protocol van Kyoto (1997) en met het Klimaatakkoord van Parijs (2015) is, vanwege de emissies van het gebruik van kolen voor elektriciteitsopwekking en de voorhanden zijnde alternatieven voor het opwekken van elektriciteit, deze stap noodzakelijk, zoals afgesproken in het Regeer akkoord.
Supports the CO2 reduction goal and asks how future biomass co-firing and the ETS allowances released at closure will be handled.
These members ask how the government intends to handle the ETS allowances released when the coal plants close in 2030.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze de regering wil omgaan met de vrijgekomen ETS-rechten bij sluiting van de kolencentrales in 2030.
Worries the bill closes only one plant by 2020 and so will not meet the Urgenda court ruling; asks whether the government will send a plan to parliament and set conditions on replacement fuels.
These members estimate that this will not achieve the target imposed by the court in the Urgenda ruling.
Deze leden schatten in dat hiermee het doel wat is opgelegd door de rechter inzake het Urgenda-vonnis niet wordt gehaald.
Asks who pays compensation to owners, how the polluter-pays principle is applied to households, and what support is given to workers; also questions biomass subsidies and their emissions accounting.
Is the government focusing on green jobs for these workers?
Wordt er ingezet op «groene banen» voor deze werknemers?
Agrees closure is needed to meet CO2 goals but asks about CO2 standards for replacement fuels, leakage, and potential compensation claims by operators.
Does the government agree that, since CO2 reduction is the aim of this bill, CO2 standards should be set that replacement fuels for coal must meet?
Deelt de regering dat, aangezien CO 2 -reductie het doel van het voorliggend wetsvoorstel is, er CO 2 -normen moeten worden gesteld waaraan de vervangers van steenkool zouden moeten voldoen?
Wants a quick coal exit and a fair transition for workers, but asks why a rising CO2 minimum price and ending biomass subsidies were not chosen instead of a statutory ban.
Would such a strategy not have been more attractive, both from the taxpayer's perspective and legally, than a statutory ban on coal-fired electricity generation?

Was een dergelijke strategie zowel vanuit het perspectief van de belastingbetaler als vanuit juridisch perspectief niet een aantrekkelijker strategie dan een wettelijk verbod op energieopwekking uit kolen?
Says the phase-out dates are arbitrary and too late and asks the government to close plants sooner, and criticises billions in biomass subsidies as more polluting.
Can the government explain how it arrived at the 2025 and 2030 closure dates? These dates seem arbitrarily chosen.
Kan de regering aangeven op welke wijze zij tot de stopdata 2025 en 2030 is gekomen? Deze data lijken arbitrair gekozen.
Doubts effectiveness and the realism of switching to biomass, citing the Council of State's critical questions and PBL findings, and asks for economic justification of the transition period.
The Council of State's advisory division did not ask critical questions about the realism of the proposed switch for nothing.
De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State stelde niet voor niets kritische vragen over het realiteitsgehalte van de voorgestelde omschakeling.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division endorses the proposed coal ban for electricity generation as a proportionate climate measure but raises concerns on security of supply, property protection under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR (especially for the newer plants and fair balance), justification of restrictions on free movement, and the effect of the Achmea ruling on investor arbitration under the ECT. The government's reply (nader rapport) addresses each point by supplementing the explanatory memorandum, adding a transitional provision for the Hemweg plant, and stating that intra-EU investment arbitration is no longer considered admissible.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a broader assessment of security of supply combined with a national CO2 minimum price and the tightened ETS, which the government addressed by supplementing paragraph 7 of the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling raised questions on whether the coal ban respects property protection under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR, especially fair balance for the newer generation plants, and the government supplemented the memorandum and explained the transition periods, though a general compensation scheme was not provided.

The Afdeling asked for justification of the restriction on free movement by an overriding reason of general interest and proportionality, which the government added to paragraph 10.4 of the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the consequences of the Achmea ruling for investor arbitration under the Energy Charter Treaty, and the government revised paragraph 6.2 and pointed to its joint declaration with other member states.

35194.s: The bill modernises Dutch rules on work in the fishing sector by implementing the ILO Work in Fishing Convention 2007 and EU Directive 2017/159, amending the Civil Code, Commercial Code, Seafarers Act and Metrology Act. It introduces a fishing-vessel labour certificate, written contract and repatriation duties, and extends complaint rights, with most detailed rules left to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
35194.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement the ILO convention and EU directive and to allow technical detail to be set by ministerial regulation.
q: On request, the Minister issues a fishing-vessel labour certificate for a vessel as referred to in the first paragraph, if after investigation it appears the vessel complies with the requirements

Onze Minister geeft op aanvraag een visserij-arbeidscertificaat af voor een vissersvaartuig als bedoeld in het eerste lid, indien na onderzoek blijkt dat voor dat vissersvaartuig wordt voldaan aan de voorschriften
d: accommodation, food and recreational facilities for seafarers
exemptions from accommodation requirements granted by the minister
rules on safety, health and working conditions of seafarers
conditions for issuing the fishing-vessel labour certificate
p: The minister issues a fishing-vessel labour certificate after verifying listed requirements, a routine administrative licensing power.

parties: Asks whether shipowners can play member states off against each other to avoid strict controls or high fines, and whether the ILT gets the extra capacity needed for enforcement.

They ask the government how it will be prevented that EU member states and/or other treaty states are played off against each other by large shipping companies, and therefore do not dare to impose strict controls or high fines.

Zij vragen de regering hoe voorkomen gaat worden dat EU-lidstaten en/of andere verdragstaten, tegen elkaar uitgespeeld worden door grote rederijen en derhalve geen strenge controles of hoge boetes durven op te leggen.

35200-IV.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) that adjusts the 2018 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) to reflect actual spending and revenue. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 31 December of the budget year, with no explanatory memorandum attached.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the budget statement of the BES Fund (H) for the year 2018
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H), voor het jaar 2018

35200-VI.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) for 2018 that adjusts the departmental budget and agency budget statements of the Ministry of Justice and Security. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed, as We hereby resolve and decree
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

35248.s: The bill amends the Scheepvaartverkeerswet and the Loodsenwet to revise compulsory pilotage rules, mainly by allowing a Pilotage Exemption Certificate (PEC) and making exemptions and pilotage obligations set by general administrative order. It also creates a basis for pilotage experiments and removes some older provisions.
35248.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to lower regulation by the technical nature of pilotage rules and the need for flexibility to test new techniques through experiments.
q: It is therefore proposed to allow room for experiments in lower regulations by allowing deviation from articles of that lower regulation concerning exemption or dispensation for the purpose of an experiment.

Daarom wordt voorgesteld in de lagere regelgeving ruimte voor experimenten te bieden door ten behoeve van een experiment van artikelen uit die lagere regelgeving die betrekking hebben op vrijstelling of ontheffing af te kunnen wijken.
d: designation of pilotage areas and waterways, obligations, and authority in charge
exemptions from pilotage obligation, requirements for captains, and experiments
Artikel I C (art. 11, lid 1 onderdeel c Svw)
experiments allowing deviation from exemption and pilotage rules
cases where exempted persons must still use a pilot
operational rules for captains on pilotage
exemption of naval warships from certain pilotage rules
p: Exemptions from compulsory pilotage and experimental deviations are left to general administrative order, with the authority granted power to attach conditions and process personal data.
Naval warships may be exempted from pilotage rules by administrative order without statutory detail on which rules apply.

parties: Has no further questions or comments on the bill.
have no further questions or comments on this.
hebben hierover geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.

Worries that the PEC-A has too low training and frequency requirements, that no practical assessment occurs upfront, and that enforcement and reporting of the frequency requirement are unclear, urging stronger tests and reporting.
The pilotage service supports dropping this PEC-A with too low training and frequency requirements.](Wait)
Het loodswezen is voorstander van het vervallen van dit PEC-A met te lage opleidings- en frequentie-eisen.
Asks whether pilots' role in combating drug smuggling in Rotterdam has been considered, since exemptions could create blind spots, and asks about pilot availability per port.
Exceptions and exemptions may create more blind spots, making the port perhaps even more attractive for drug smuggling.
Uitzonderingen en of vrijstellingen kunnen zorgen voor meer blinde vlekken, waardoor de haven wellicht nog aantrekkelijker wordt voor drugstoevoer.

Concerned that minimal knowledge is required for PEC holders of small seagoing vessels, with no ex-ante testing of skills, and asks how many such vessels sail in Dutch waters and what the safety consequences are.

These members conclude that the knowledge required for a captain of a small seagoing vessel to obtain a PEC is minimal and that no ex-ante assessment of the captain's knowledge and skills takes place.

Deze leden concluderen dat de vereiste kennis voor een kapitein van een klein zeeschip om een PEC te ontvangen minimaal is en dat geen toetsing aan de voorkant plaatsvindt van de kennis en kunde van de kapitein.
Worries that low language and frequency requirements for PECs and the lack of local knowledge could reduce safety, and asks for enforcement and evaluation details.
The GroenLinks members want to emphasise that a change in practice must not lead to less safety.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie willen benadrukken dat een verandering van de praktijk niet mag leiden tot minder veiligheid.
Asks what the purpose and exact relation of the bill is to the draft Loodsplichtbesluit 2021, why the exemption is extended, and how safety on the Ems is guaranteed.
The SP members ask whether the government can clarify the coherence and exact difference between the proposed new-style pilotage obligation and the draft Loodsplichtbesluit 2021 currently submitted.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering duidelijk kan maken wat de samenhang en het exacte verschil is tussen de hier voorgestelde loodsplicht nieuwe stijl en het momenteel voorgehangen ontwerp Loodsplichtbesluit 2021.
Asks whether the renamed PEC could mean less experienced captains and how enforcement of the frequency requirement is set out, and asks about constitutional and EU law aspects.
According to these members, enforcement is crucial for the safety of users of waterways and ports.
Volgens deze leden is handhaving cruciaal voor de veiligheid voor gebruikers van waterwegen en havens.
Questions the low frequency requirement and the possibility of combining multiple routes and vessels, which could amount to pseudo-pilotage services, and asks how this will be prevented.
Is the assumption correct that this can lead to pseudo-pilotage services? How will the government prevent this?
Is de veronderstelling juist dat dit kan leiden tot pseudoloodsdiensten? Hoe gaat de regering dit voorkomen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the Pilotage Act reform (loodsplicht nieuwe stijl) after the government motivates the proposed sub-delegation to a ministerial regulation and restores the power to attach conditions to exemptions in the law, plus redactional points. The government's nader rapport reports that it accepted the redactional points, adjusted the article on exemptions to add a conditions power, and explained the choice of ministerial regulation by pointing to site-specific detail and user needs.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the necessity of delegating key loodsplicht elements to ministerial regulation be justified; the government explained site-specific detail and flexibility but did not change the delegation level.
The Afdeling advised restoring in the law the power to attach restrictions or conditions to a loodsplicht exemption, which the government accepted by adding a new fourth paragraph to article 11.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on linking exemptions to the captain and clarifying that an exemption is a decision, which were adopted.

35275.s: This omnibus bill (Verzamelwet SZW 2020) makes many technical amendments across social affairs and employment laws, including AOW pension age rules, WW, WGA, debt-collection exemptions, and posting of workers. Most changes are administrative and cross-referencing corrections, with a few adjustments to UWV and sanction-related provisions.
35275.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the price-index and pension-age delegations as technical updates to amounts without detailing separate safeguards.
d: annual setting of pension age and starting age via formula
ARTIKEL VIII (Wet algemene ouderdomsverzekering BES art. 14, lid 3)
annual adjustment of pension amount based on price index for BES islands
ARTIKEL IX (Wet algemene weduwen- en wezenverzekering BES art. 17, lid 3)
annual adjustment of amount based on price index for BES islands
ARTIKEL XIV D/E (Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen art. 99 lid h)
designating UWV implementation costs chargeable to unemployment fund
Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen executes article with modified application of cited provisions
p: Shifts execution of a participation provision from municipalities to the UWV agency with modified application of statutory provisions.
ARTIKEL XIV A.1 (Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen art. 61)
Removes the 5% surcharge on overdue premiums and alters the conditions under which a negligence decision is revised or withdrawn.

parties: Asks for the basis of assumptions on repayment of the inburgering loan and whether differentiation between culpable and non-culpable non-compliance was considered.
When setting the maximum term, did the government consider distinguishing between those who did not meet the integration obligation through fault and those who did not through no fault of their own?

Heeft de regering bij het vaststellen van de maximale termijn overwogen om een onderscheid te maken tussen zij die verwijtbaar en zij die niet-verwijtbaar nog niet aan de inburgeringsplicht hebben voldaan?
Asks whether the implementing agency UWV considers the amendments feasible and whether its reservations in the implementation test have been addressed.
They also ask whether the reservations the UWV makes in the implementation test have been met, and whether the later amendments in the Verzamelwet 2020 are also feasible according to the UWV.
Daarnaast vragen deze leden of aan de voorbehouden die het UWV maakt in de uitvoeringstoets is voldaan, en of ook de latere wijzigingen in de Verzamelwet 2020 volgens het UWV uitvoerbaar zijn.
Presses the government for a direct yes-or-no answer on the AOW coupling formula and for a full overview of piece-rate work and rates, with controls against falling below the minimum wage.
How is it ensured in setting the piece rate that people do not fall below the statutory minimum wage? What control is there over this?
Hoe is bij het vaststellen van het stukloon verankerd dat mensen niet onder het wettelijk minimumloon zakken? Welke controle is hierop?
Asks for the justification of additional requirements on piece-rate norms and for the rationale of the waiting period in the Caribbean accident insurance revision.
Can the government further explain why this is considered desirable?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom dit wenselijk wordt geacht?
Asks the government to confirm it still intends a legislative change on employer self-risk in sickness benefit and whether private implementers will be involved.
These members ask whether the government can confirm that it still intends to make a legislative change on this point.}]},
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan bevestigen dat zij nog steeds het voornemen heeft tot een wetswijziging op dit punt te komen.
Has no remarks or questions on the bill.
They found no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Zij hebben geen aanleiding gevonden tot het maken van opmerkingen of het stellen van vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Verzamelwet SZW 2020, objecting that the provision giving employers acting as own-risk bearers for the Ziektewet a public-law competence (making them administrative bodies) is an omnibus-law change of too great scope and complexity, and that the explanatory memorandum insufficiently addresses its consequences. The minister's reply states the provision has been removed from the bill, with the Afdeling's points to be taken up in a further elaboration with UWV.
concerns: The bill is an omnibus law, which should contain only technical changes, clarifications and small policy, whereas the own-risk bearer competence is too large and complex for that category and warrants a separate bill.
The explanatory memorandum hardly addresses the consequences of giving own-risk employers public-law competences and their preparedness as administrative bodies.

The division of competences and responsibilities between UWV and own-risk bearers becomes less transparent and its fit within the administrative law system, including the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, is unclear.

35284.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet kenbaarheid publiekrechtelijke beperkingen onroerende zaken so that all public-law restrictions on immovable property are registered in the Kadaster's public registers, with municipalities transferring their local restriction registers to the Kadaster within about one year. It also changes Kadaster identification rules, allows electronic submission without a qualified electronic signature, and sets transitional provisions that expire on 1 January 2021.
35284.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical detail to be set in ministerial regulation and Kadaster rules within the framework of the Wkpb, with a fixed one-year transition period.
q: Rules on the submission referred to in the first paragraph will be laid down by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden nadere regels gegeven over de aanlevering, bedoeld in het eerste lid.
d: identification of objects and geometry; manner of submitting restriction decisions
Kadaster board rules on changes to object identification and submission
rules on submission of municipal restriction decisions to the Kadaster
alternative authentication instead of electronic signature
p: Artikel I, onderdeel I (Art. 17a, lid 1 and 3)
Municipalities may transfer restriction decisions to the Kadaster in bulk and may use non-current cadastral identifiers, with the Kadaster publishing a list of municipalities completed.
The Kadaster must show authorities when registered objects are no longer current, a signalling function that supports accuracy of registers.

parties: Asks whether municipalities can complete the transfer of restriction registrations on time, what happens if they do not, and how errors affecting rights holders can be corrected.
What are the consequences if municipalities are not ready in time, the members of the VVD faction ask.
Wat zijn de gevolgen als gemeenten niet tijdig klaar zijn, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Asks whether all municipalities can meet the transition deadline and about the costs this imposes on each municipality.
They would like to know whether all municipalities are deemed capable of doing so and whether the municipal administrations are up to date.
Graag vernemen zij of alle gemeenten daartoe in staat worden geacht en of de administraties bij de gemeenten up-to-date zijn.
Asks how far the transition work has progressed, what the reduced number of tranches means for the bill's goals, and how digital system links and document accessibility will be ensured.
Can the government explain in more detail how far it currently is with the transition work from municipal registers to the Kadaster?
Kan de regering nader toelichten hoe ver zij momenteel met de transitiewerkzaamheden van gemeentelijke registraties naar het Kadaster zijn?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises amending the bill simplifying the Wkpb register of public-law restrictions on immovable property, mainly to better secure the transition period and to add express transitional rules requiring municipalities and the Kadaster to complete transfers before 1 January 2021. The government reply accepts the redactional remarks but declines the express transitional obligation, expressing confidence that the transition will be completed on time.
concerns: The advisory division asks the explanatory memorandum to address whether municipalities and the Kadaster can complete the transition before 1 January 2021 and what measures apply if it is at risk; the government responds that preparations are advanced, progress is monitored and an escalation procedure has been agreed.

The advisory division advises expressly providing in the proposed article 17a that municipalities deliver restriction decisions to the Kadaster and the Kadaster registers them before 1 January 2021, since the temporary regime lapses on that date; the government declines, judging an explicit obligation not the most suitable instrument given the relationship between municipalities and the state.
The advisory division asks that paragraphs in article I, part C not be renumbered; the government does not follow this because renumbering aids the law's clarity.
The advisory division asks that article 17a(2) state publication occurs via the Kadaster website, which the government adopts.
The advisory division asks that the Uitvoeringsbesluit and Uitvoeringsregeling be expressly repealed, which the government adopts.

35293.s: The bill removes the alcohol interlock programme (ASP) from administrative law in the Road Traffic Act 1994 and the Driving Instruction Act 1993, replacing it with an educational measure or a suitability examination ordered by the CBR. It also repeals related registration, certification and interlock-instructor provisions and adds transitional and commencement rules.
35293.j: The memorandum justifies the change by a 2015 Administrative Jurisdiction Division ruling that required the CBR rather than the ASP to impose measures, so the ASP is removed from administrative law.
q: With this bill the ASP is being dismantled in administrative law.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt het ASP in het bestuursrecht afgebouwd.
d: exceptions to duty to cooperate with imposed measure
p: The CBR decides, in cases set by ministerial regulation, whether to impose an educational measure or a rijvaardigheid/geschiktheid examination within four weeks of notification.

parties: Asks whether effective alternatives to the alcohol lock exist, requests statistics on drink-driving deaths, controls and recidivism, and asks about the technical and legal objections to the lock.
To properly assess whether definitively scrapping the alcohol lock programme is sensible, these members have several questions, including whether effective alternatives will be available.

Om goed te kunnen beoordelen of het definitief schrappen van het alcoholslotprogramma verstandig is hebben deze leden verschillende vragen, onder andere of er effectieve alternatieven voorhanden zullen zijn.

Supports aligning law with practice in principle, but regrets that the court's annulment of the sober-driving option means license revocation should be ordered far more often, and calls for a higher chance of enforcement and effective sanctions.
That option was annulled by the court.](Note: the verbatim Dutch sentence above is the court-annulment point.)
Die optie is door de rechter vernietigd.

Points to a WODC report showing recidivism roughly halved after the programme and asks how the government weighs that effectiveness, and asks about the alcohol-meter pilot and whether a criminal-law alcohol ban would be imposed less readily.
First research results point to a halving of recidivism after completing the alcohol lock programme.
De eerste onderzoeksresultaten wijzen op een halvering van de recidive na het volgen van het alcoholslotprogramma.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no substantive objections to the bill abolishing the mandatory alcohol lock programme in administrative law under the Road Traffic Act and the driving instruction act, advising it be submitted to parliament, with only one drafting remark. The minister's reply states that the editorial remark has been incorporated into the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling proposed deleting one sentence in article 133(4) about applying title 4.4 of the General Administrative Law Act, and the government adopted this editorial change.

35347.s: The bill amends the Nature Conservation Act, the Animal Act, the Economic Offences Act, the Infrastructure Act, the Wind Energy at Sea Act, the Crisis and Recovery Act and related decrees to speed up a coordinated approach to nitrogen deposition affecting Natura 2000 areas. It introduces a ministerial power to set threshold values and exemptions from the permit requirement, a national nitrogen deposition registration system, ministerial rules on animal feed composition and emergency ministerial regulations, while removing permit requirements for 'other acts'.
35347.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for a coordinated national approach and speed given the nitrogen crisis and recent court rulings against the existing programme.
q: To this end, this bill provides for the possibility of introducing a threshold value or a nitrogen registration system by ministerial regulation.
Met het oog daarop voorziet dit wetsvoorstel in de mogelijkheid tot invoering van een drempelwaarde of een stikstofregistratiesysteem bij ministeriële regeling
d: categories of projects exempt from Natura 2000 permit requirement
factors not taken into account in permit assessment
national nitrogen deposition registration and allocation system
rules on composition of animal feed for environmental protection
maximum content of substances in animal products
emergency nitrogen rules for Natura 2000 activities, valid twelve months
p: Artikel I H and I (art. 2.9, 5.5, 5.5a Wnb)

Moves exemption thresholds and nitrogen allocation from provincial regulation or general administrative order to ministerial regulation, reducing parliamentary and provincial control over permit exemptions.
Allows emergency nitrogen rules to be set by ministerial regulation, bypassing the general administrative order normally required, for up to twelve months.
Artikel I C (art. 2.7 lid 2 en wegnemen 'andere handelingen')
Removes the permit requirement for other nitrogen-emitting acts, narrowing the scope of permit review and citizens' ability to challenge such activities.

parties: Asks how inter-governmental cooperation will be ensured and what developments the threshold or registration system enables.
The VVD members note that good cooperation between the various governments is of great importance and ask how this will be guaranteed.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat een goede samenwerking tussen de diverse overheden van groot belang is en vragen op welke wijze dat gewaarborgd wordt.
Questions the existence and scale of the nitrogen problem and asks about legal and EU options to set nitrogen rules aside.
Why does the government completely accept the political view that there is a nitrogen problem in the Netherlands?
Waarom legt de regering zich volledig neer bij de politieke opvatting dat er een stikstofprobleem is in Nederland?
Worries that the rushed emergency law risks legal gaps and asks how its legal quality is guaranteed given the short preparation time.
They would like to know how it is guaranteed that this law meets the high requirements of legal quality.
Graag vernemen zij op welke wijze gewaarborgd is dat deze wet aan de hoge eisen van juridische kwaliteit voldoet.
Supports the measures but asks how much of the nitrogen reduction returns to nature and how the bill relates to the forthcoming long-term advice.
What percentage of the nitrogen space is returned to nature?
Hoeveel procent van de stikstofruimte wordt terug gegeven aan de natuur?
Doubts the legal tenability of the bill, which it says lacks a comprehensive approach, and asks whether parliament is asked to approve future policy blindly through ministerial regulations.
Does the government share the analysis that parliament is now asked to approve blindly future policy whose precise content is still completely unknown?
Deelt de regering de analyse dat het parlement nu gevraagd wordt blind in te stemmen met toekomstig beleid waarvan de precieze invulling nog volstrekt onbekend is?
Supports the need for the law but questions the 30/70 split, asks whether it will legally hold, and criticises the lack of an end date for an emergency law.
They are of the view that an emergency law should have an end date and ask why this was not chosen.
Zij zijn van mening dat een spoedwet een einddatum dient te kennen en vragen waarom hier niet voor gekozen is.

Objects that key elements such as thresholds and maximum speed are set by ministerial regulation, which hinders parliamentary control, and asks why general administrative orders with pre-consultation were not used.
This hinders parliamentary control over these instruments.
Daarmee wordt de parlementaire controle op deze instrumenten belemmerd.
Argues the bill knowingly violates the EU Habitats Directive, that the 70% reuse of reduced emissions is legally contestable, and that voluntary measures failed before.
How does the government legally justify that 70% of the realised emission reduction can be reused for activities, while most Natura 2000 areas are seriously overloaded?

Hoe onderbouwt de regering juridisch dat 70% van de gerealiseerde emissiereductie opnieuw gebruikt kan worden voor activiteiten, terwijl er sprake is van ernstige overbelasting op de meeste Natura 2000-gebieden?
Doubts the legal robustness of a national threshold and warns that one court ruling could halt activities nationwide, preferring area-specific thresholds.
It must be prevented that a single court ruling halts all activities under such a threshold throughout the country.
Voorkomen moet worden dat door één rechterlijke uitspraak alle activiteiten onder een dergelijke drempelwaarde in het hele land platgelegd worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Spoedwet aanpak stikstof, asking for a fuller explanation of effects, the legal basis for drempelwaarden under the Habitats Directive, the necessity and proportionality of feed rules, and a temporary character for the nitrogen registration system. The government's nader rapport largely addressed these points by expanding the memorie van toelichting, but kept the registration system permanent and rejected the temporary-character advice.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller account of the expected effects of the measures on Natura 2000 conservation objectives, which the government addressed by expanding paragraph 2 without giving quantified effects.

The Afdeling asked for a justification of drempelwaarden under Article 6(3) and 6(4) of the Habitats Directive, which the government addressed by discussing justification grounds while keeping options open.
The Afdeling advised making the nitrogen registration system temporary because it delays nitrogen reduction and complicates Article 6 compliance, but the government saw no need to do so.

The Afdeling asked for reasoned justification that feed-composition rules are suitable and proportionate given the free movement of goods, which the government addressed with a reference to a Wageningen study and a comparison with herd reduction.
The Afdeling asked for more explanation of how the nitrogen registration system would function in practice, and the government added a description of its operation.
The Afdeling's remarks on the explanatory memorandum were addressed through redactional and technical changes and removal of the speed-limit provisions.

35356.s: The bill approves the 2012 Seoul Protocol to eliminate illegal trade in tobacco products and implements it by amending the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act, the Economic Offences Act, the Excise Act and the Extradition Act. It introduces customer-identification and sales-administration duties for tobacco producers, importers and exporters, and a licensing requirement for tobacco production machinery administered by the Customs authority.
