35356.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules as necessary to implement the Protocol's controls and to protect public health, and states that details will be set in lower regulation.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, rules may be set on how customers are identified and how sales to customers are administered.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gesteld over de wijze waarop klanten geïdentificeerd worden als bedoeld in het eerste lid en de wijze waarop verkoop aan klanten geadministreerd wordt als bedoeld in het tweede lid.
d: Artikel II (Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, art. 11, derde lid)
rules on how customers are identified and sales administered
Artikel IV (Wet op de accijns, art. 90a, vierde lid)
licence conditions and exemptions from licensing for production machinery
p: Artikel IV (Wet op de accijns, art. 90a)
Customs may grant or refuse licences for tabaksproductieapparaat and the statute leaves the licensing conditions largely to ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks the government to make all draft AMvBs available before plenary debate, since key rules will be set by decree outside parliament's scrutiny.
They want to involve the elaboration of the AMvBs in the bill's consideration and ask the government whether it can make all draft AMvBs available before the plenary treatment of the bill.

Zij willen de uitwerking van de AMvB’s daarom graag betrekken bij de wetsbehandeling en vragen aan de regering of zij alle concept-AMvB’s beschikbaar kan stellen voorafgaand aan de plenaire behandeling van de wet.
Asks for data on illegal cigarette factories, the status of the EU Tobacco Tax Directive revision and bilateral excise talks.
These members also ask whether the government can indicate whether, and if so, due to which circumstances, the Netherlands is a relatively favourable location for illegal cigarette factories.
Deze leden vragen daarnaast of de regering kan aangeven of – en zo ja, vanwege welke omstandigheden – Nederland een relatief gunstig vestigingsland voor illegale sigarettenfabrieken is.
Supports the measures against illegal trade but asks how the monitoring of sales and international information exchange will take shape and what its costs and effects will be.
They would like further information on how such international exchange will precisely take shape.
Graag ontvangen zij nadere informatie over hoe een dergelijke internationale uitwisseling precies vorm gaat krijgen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering reviewed a bill approving the 2012 Seoul Protocol on eliminating illicit trade in tobacco products and raised no substantive objections, only two drafting remarks. The government reply confirms both remarks were taken on board by amending the transposition table, the explanatory memorandum and the bill's article V.
concerns: Advice to explain in the transposition table and explanatory memorandum why the option in article 6(2) of the Protocol is not used, which the government adopted.
Advice to add article 99(2) of the Excise Act to article V (new article 51a(2) of the Extradition Act), which the government incorporated.

35374.s: The bill amends the Participatiewet so that debts arising from recovery claims or administrative fines for breaching the information obligation are no longer deducted from assets in the means test for social assistance. It also adds transitional rules applying this exclusion to existing fraud claims for those already receiving assistance.
35374.j: The memorandum justifies the change by arguing that it is unacceptable for fraud to pay off and that assistance must be a last-resort safety net.
q: It is undesirable that fraud pays, and for that reason it is desirable to provide in the Participatiewet that debts arising from breaching the information obligation are not deducted from the value of assets;

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het onwenselijk is dat fraude loont en het om die reden wenselijk is om in de Participatiewet te regelen dat schulden die zijn ontstaan wegens het schenden van de inlichtingenplicht niet in mindering worden gebracht op de waarde van de bezittingen;
d: rules deviating from Participatiewet for self-employed assistance
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel A (artikel 34, vijfde lid)
Fraud-related debts are excluded from the means test, which alters how assistance eligibility is assessed for affected claimants without an individual hardship safeguard in the text.

parties: Supports the bill as strengthening public support for social security; asks about monitoring municipal investigations and foreign asset checks, which is mainly information-seeking.
This amendment thus contributes to increasing public support for social security in the Netherlands.
Deze wijziging draagt daarmee bij aan het vergroten van het draagvlak voor de sociale zekerheid in Nederland.
Asks why unintentional breaches are treated the same as deliberate fraud and whether a hardship clause can protect people who fell short unintentionally.

They ask the government, referring to the Council of State's advice, why the bill does not take into account, for example through a hardship clause, people who unintentionally failed to comply.](Note: evidence excerpt is paraphrased from the CDA paragraph.)

Zij vragen de regering, daarbij verwijzend naar het advies van de Raad van State, waarom in dit wetsvoorstel geen rekening wordt gehouden, bijvoorbeeld door middel van een hardheidsclausule, met mensen die onopzettelijk in gebreke zijn gebleven.
Concerned about effects on vulnerable groups; asks how municipalities can apply the human measure and whether residents are adequately informed of their duties.
Asks whether good-faith people who breach the duty without intent could fall back under the subsistence minimum due to unrecognised debt, and questions punishing people unaware of wrongdoing.
Does the government agree with the GroenLinks members that it is undesirable to punish someone who does not even know they are doing something wrong?
Is de regering het met de leden van GroenLinks-fractie eens dat het niet wenselijk is om iemand te straffen als diegene niet eens weet dat hij of zij iets verkeerd doet?
Objects to equating unintentional form errors with fraud, citing low literacy and mental health problems, and asks whether the bill can be re-submitted to the Council of State.
Where is regard for the human measure?
Waar is oog voor de menselijke maat?
Supports tackling deliberate fraud but fears harsh outcomes for vulnerable people; asks how municipalities' discretion will be used to avoid such cases.
These members ask the government to explain further how harrowing situations will be prevented.
Deze leden vragen de regering om nader toe te lichten hoe schrijnende situaties voorkomen zullen worden.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the draft amendment to the Participatiewet excluding fraud-based claims from the asset test, raising concerns about intent and the broad use of the term 'fraud'. The government's reply rejected the terminology objection and made only limited adjustments, adding a clarifying paragraph, a corrected reference in the Wajong provision, and a privacy impact assessment.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for justification for excluding claims arising from non-intentional breaches of the information duty from the asset test, and the government clarified its reasoning in the explanatory memorandum without changing the bill.

The Afdeling considered the broad use of the term 'fraud' incorrect and misleading, and the government declined to change the bill's text, defending the term as consistent with existing social security definitions.
The Afdeling noted the Wajong information duty was missing from the enumeration, and the government added the reference to article 3:74(1) of the Wajong.

35392.s: The bill adds a new title on franchising to the Dutch Civil Code, requiring franchisors to act as good franchisors, provide pre-contractual and ongoing information, and obtain franchisee consent for certain unilateral changes, with mandatory protection for franchisees. It also allows a general administrative order (AMvB) to set further rules on the form and content of mandatory information.
35392.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegation as a means to quickly add detail to the new franchise rules in response to practical problems, since no experience yet exists with the new regime.
q: Further elaboration by general administrative order may then be appropriate to respond quickly to any practical bottlenecks in implementation.
Nadere uitwerking bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kan dan aangewezen zijn om snel in te kunnen spelen op eventuele knelpunten bij de uitvoering.
d: detailed rules on nature, content and manner of providing pre-contractual and ongoing information

parties: Asks whether the bill's rules and definitions are clear enough to prevent disputes going to court, and how franchisees can object to the franchisor's drempelwaarde.
An additional benefit is that potential conflicts can be resolved without a judge.
Bijkomend voordeel is dat daardoor eventuele conflicten zonder rechter beslecht kunnen worden.
Asks how the bill applies to foreign franchisees, whether extraterritorial effect is intended, and how the Raad voor de Rechtspraak's concern about economically strong franchisees is addressed.
Is extraterritorial effect of the law intended?
Is een extraterritoriale werking van de wet beoogd?
Asks why the government does not drop article 918 as the Raad van State advised, and worries that consent requirements may block innovation.
Why then does the government not delete article 918 for that reason, as the Afdeling advises?
Waarom schrapt de regering om die reden dan niet artikel 918, zoals de Afdeling adviseert?
Supports rebalancing power but questions the bill's compatibility with the EU Services Directive and the public-order exception, following the Raad van State.
Fears that the open norm 'redelijkerwijs' will have to be filled in by judges, which could make the legislation too open-ended.
they fear that the interpretation of the term 'redelijkerwijs' will have to be done by the judge and that this could lead to overly open norms in legislation.
vrezen zij dat de invulling van het begrip «redelijkerwijs» door de rechter zal moeten gaan gebeuren en dat dat voor wetgeving tot te open normen zou kunnen gaan leiden.
Welcomes the bill as implementing the coalition agreement and has no further questions at this stage.
These members therefore have no need at this time to ask further questions.
Genoemde leden hebben derhalve op dit moment geen behoefte aan het stellen van nadere vragen.
Supports strengthening franchisees without undue harm to entrepreneurial freedom, and asks about unintended effects on diverse franchise chains and foreign-operating franchisors.
They are in favour of strengthening the position of franchisees without unduly undermining entrepreneurial freedom.
Zij zijn voorstander van het versterken van de positie van franchisenemers zonder teveel afbreuk te doen aan de ondernemersvrijheid.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Franchise Act adding franchise rules to Book 7 of the Civil Code, raising concerns about the franchisee's investigation duty (redundant with existing doctrine), delegation via an AMvB (advised to be dropped), and insufficient justification under the Services Directive for public-order grounds. The government's reply explains the added value of the investigation duty and the delegation clause, which it did not drop, and supplements the justification in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for justification of the added value of the franchisee's investigation duty, which merely codifies existing case law; the government motivated it in the explanatory memorandum but did not remove it.

The Afdeling advised dropping the delegation clause allowing an AMvB to set rules on information provision, given restraint required and that the government saw the bill as adequate; the government kept it for flexibility.

The Afdeling found the public-order justification for the requirements under the Services Directive insufficiently explained and asked for supplementation; the government added explanation in the memorandum.

35419.s: The bill amends Article 137 of the Constitution so that only the Tweede Kamer elected after a declaration law is published considers the constitutional amendment in second reading, and the amendment lapses by law if that chamber does not decide. It also adds a transitional provision (Article V) and removes the separate dissolution requirement and the requirement to hear the Raad van State for such second readings.
35419.j: The memorandum justifies the change by pointing to unclear procedure, uncertainty about when second readings must start, and the need to prevent delay for political advantage, while noting that the Raad van State advice requirement can be dropped by ordinary law.
p: The amendment lapses automatically if the newly elected Tweede Kamer does not decide on it, which tightens a time limit on parliamentary consideration of constitutional change.

parties: Asks whether the Eerste Kamer could decline to treat the second reading, and why the Afdeling advisering should be bypassed when a bill may have changed substantially in first reading.
Why should hearing the Advisory Division be omitted in a second reading?
Waarom zou in een tweede lezing het horen van de Afdeling Advisering achterwege moeten blijven?
Wants the Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State to advise on second-reading proposals and asks how the Reglement van Orde ensures prompt referral.
These members attach importance to the Advisory Division of the Council of State also advising on second-reading proposals.
Deze leden hechten eraan dat de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State ook over voorstellen in tweede lezing adviseert.
Says the bill offers no complete solution, lacks procedural safeguards for timely second reading, and questions whether a short parliamentary term always allows proper treatment.
The present declaration, however, does not offer a total solution but is only one possible component of it.
De voorliggende verklaring biedt echter geen totaal-oplossing, maar is slechts een mogelijk onderdeel daarvan.
Asks whether a short parliamentary term after dissolution should allow postponing a major constitutional second reading, possibly by a two-thirds majority.
In the government's view, is such a case a special situation in which it should be possible to decide to postpone treatment of such a major revision by at most one term?
Is zo'n geval volgens de regering een bijzondere situatie waarin besloten zou moeten kunnen worden om de behandeling van een dergelijke grote herziening met maximaal één periode uit te stellen?
Asks how the bill relates to proposed Reglement van Orde changes and whether the lapse rule for initiative bills should be treated differently from government bills.
Does the government see reason to view the lapsing of an initiative bill in second reading differently from the lapsing of a government bill?
Ziet de regering reden om anders tegen de wijze waarop een initiatiefwetsvoorstel in tweede lezing komt te vervallen aan te kijken, dan het vervallen van een wetsvoorstel van de regering?
Asks whether the Eerste Kamer could still postpone the second reading indefinitely and what 'zodra' means as a deadline, and questions the Raad van State's role in second reading.

To what extent is it possible under the present proposal that the Eerste Kamer still decides to postpone the second reading of the constitutional amendment until a moment when a two-thirds majority is expected?

In hoeverre is het op basis van het voorliggende voorstel mogelijk dat de Eerste Kamer alsnog besluit tot het «verdagen» van de tweede lezing van de Grondwetswijziging tot een moment waarop er wel een tweederde meerderheid wordt verwacht?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on a bill declaring grounds to revise the Constitution's amendment procedure, accepting the proposed removal of the mandatory dissolution after a first reading and the lapse of second-reading bills, but noting that the explanatory memorandum should better justify abolishing advisory review of second-reading bills. In its reply, the government accepts the need to clarify the matter, arguing that advice can be sought before elections and that the Reglement van Orde should ensure timely submission, so no need to reconsider mandatory advice.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum better substantiate the proposal to abolish mandatory advisory review of second-reading constitutional bills, which the government addressed by supplementing the memorandum but kept mandatory advice in place.

35428.s: The bill amends Book 1 of the Civil Code to let municipalities advise the court, within four weeks after receiving the trustee's asset description and plan, on whether a less intrusive arrangement than continued debt administration (schuldenbewind) would protect the person adequately. It also makes debt-based administration time-limited and lets the court order trustees to send the documents to the municipality.
35428.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal advisory role by the evaluation finding that debt administration lasts too long and that less intrusive alternatives are often overlooked.
q: According to surveyed judges and professional representatives, municipalities have so far hardly used their power to request debt-based protective administration.

Gemeenten blijken naar de ervaring van de ondervraagde rechters en professionele vertegenwoordigers (nog) niet of nauwelijks gebruik te maken van hun bevoegdheid om in geval van problematische schulden te verzoeken tot instelling van beschermingsbewind.
p: Municipal advice can lead the court to end debt administration, while the municipality itself cannot appeal the court's decision.

parties: Asks how municipalities can help residents regain financial control and whether pilots and alternatives remain possible within the law.
They believe that providing an advisory right gives the municipality a steering role over debt assistance and the associated involvement in debt administration.
Zij zijn van mening dat het voorzien van een adviesrecht de gemeente een regierol geeft over de schuldhulpverlening en de daarmee gepaarde betrokkenheid bij het schuldenbewind.
Questions why the municipality only advises after the administration is already imposed and whether financial gain by administrators can be prevented; asks about monitoring financial feasibility.
These members believe it is important that the administrator is focused on improving the situation of the person under administration.
Voornoemde leden menen dat het belangrijk is dat de bewindvoerder gericht is op het verbeteren van de situatie van de onderbewindgestelde.
Asks why an opt-in system was chosen and whether it discourages municipalities with complex debt problems from giving intensive guidance.
Does this system not contain a kind of incentive for municipalities with many complex debt problems not to provide that more intensive guidance?
Bevat deze systematiek niet een soort prikkel voor gemeenten met veel complexe schuldenproblematiek om die nadrukkelijkere begeleiding niet te gaan geven?
Notes the Council of State's view that the goals could be achieved differently and asks whether the law will be amended if pilot results warrant it.
Can the government commit that the law will be amended again if the outcomes of ongoing experiments give cause to do so?
Kan de regering toezeggen dat de wet opnieuw zal worden gewijzigd als de uitkomsten van lopende experimenten daar aanleiding toe zouden geven?
Questions whether the Council of State's doubts about the proportionality of the procedure are addressed and asks the government to await pilot results.
The Council of State advises waiting for the results of the pilots before taking further steps.
De Afdeling adviseert de resultaten van de pilots af te wachten voordat verdere stappen worden gezet.
Considers the advisory right too voluntary, asks for a mandatory advisory step and financial support for municipalities, and questions market incentives in the sector.
These members ask whether the government fears that municipalities may, for budgetary reasons, advise debt administration instead of debt assistance.
Voornoemde leden vragen of de regering mogelijk vreest dat gemeenten om budgettaire redenen schuldenbewind adviseren in plaats van schuldhulpverlening.
Welcomes limiting the duration of administration and asks for faster progression through debt-relief stages and monitoring of feasibility.
Therefore the members consider it important that there is also a swift move to statutory debt rescheduling.
Daarom achten de aan het woord zijnde leden het van belang dat er ook snel wordt doorgestapt naar de wettelijke schuldsanering.
Asks what safeguards ensure the administration is temporary and how a non-binding municipal advice is guaranteed to be taken seriously.
Is a period of, for example, ten or twenty years still 'temporary'?
Is een periode van bijvoorbeeld tien of twintig jaar nog steeds «tijdelijk»?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill giving municipalities an advisory right in debt administration (schuldenbewind) proceedings and limiting such administration to a fixed term, concluding the measure was premature and disproportionate and advising against submission unless revised. The Minister's reply defends the advisory right and fixed-term rule, adds a notification duty and a platform for cooperation, but does not accept the call to await pilot results in full.
concerns: The advisory right at a late stage in the process may be disproportionate given the costs and the limited target group; the government disagrees that the efforts are wasted but adds notification and evaluation measures.

Cooperation between courts, administrators and municipalities may be the real problem; the government argues the statutory framework is needed and adds a national platform, while still noting pilot results are not yet available.

The fixed-term rule for debt administration is not clearly necessary given that courts already tend to impose it temporarily; the government replies it is needed to secure the temporary nature in law.

35437.s: The bill amends multiple tax laws for 2021, including extending customs powers to inspect cash, valuable goods and documents with a notification duty and fines, and tightening the ANBI integrity test. It also creates a statutory basis for ministerial regulations granting compensation to parents harmed by institutional bias in childcare allowance administration.
35437.j: The memorandum justifies the cash and document powers by the need to combat money laundering and terrorism financing, and the compensation delegation by the Advisory Committee's recommendations.
q: From the perspective of countering money laundering and terrorism financing, it is therefore important to be able to check and request information on the non-cross-border transport, including possession, of valuable goods and documents.

Vanuit het perspectief van het tegengaan van witwassen en terrorismefinanciering, is het daarom van belang om ook bij het niet-grensoverschrijdend vervoer, het voorhanden hebben daaronder begrepen, van waardevolle goederen en documenten, te kunnen controleren en daarover informatie op te vragen
d: compensation for parents harmed by childcare allowance bias
exchange rates and valuation rules for cash and goods
designation of valuable goods subject to notification
further rules on ANBI integrity screening and VOG
p: Inspectors may demand notifications and seize cash, valuable goods and private financial documents on request within thirty days, including in domestic traffic, with fines for non-compliance.
The inspector may refuse or withdraw ANBI status where integrity doubts exist and a certificate of conduct is not provided.
The tax authority may grant compensation by ministerial regulation, with decisions open to administrative appeal.

parties: Asks why the standard donation form is not mandatory for checking foreign and unfree-country donations, and questions the vague 'algemeen nut' definition and the discretion inspectors have over 'gerede twijfel' for integrity checks.
These members have previously stated they favour mandatory use of the standard form so that compliance with minimum requirements can be checked.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben eerder aangegeven voorstander te zijn van een verplicht gebruik van het standaardformulier zodat kan worden gecontroleerd of aan de minimumeisen wordt voldaan.
Asks how the government will prevent arbitrariness by individual inspectors when requesting certificates of conduct (VOG) and how non-obtained VOGs are recorded and protected from misuse.
How does the government intend to rule out arbitrariness when inspectors request the certificate of conduct?
Hoe is de regering voornemens willekeur uit te sluiten bij het bij het opvragen van de VOG door inspecteurs?

Supports banning cash donations as fraud-sensitive but asks the government about the rules for two-life periodic gifts and the Tax Authority's practice, and asks when further measures on unfree-country money flows will follow.
The CDA members therefore understand the change so that cash gifts no longer qualify for deduction, because a receipt for a cash gift is much more prone to fraud.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben daarom begrip voor de wijziging om contante giften niet langer in aftrek te laten komen, omdat een kwitantie van een contante gift veel fraudegevoeliger is.

Welcomes the compensation step but asks for detail on the risk-based supervision of about 43,000 ANBIs, the criteria for 'gerede twijfel', and the proportionality of privacy intrusion in the cash-movement rules, including the briefgeheim.
The D66 members ask how it will be prevented that the privacy of correspondence is violated in practice.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat het briefgeheim in de praktijk niet wordt geschonden.

Argues the integrity check has been ineffective since it never led to revocation despite large-scale fraud, calls for large-scale control of ANBIs and donors, and questions the Raad van State's acceptance of the compensation scheme's reliance on administrative remedies.

The SP members note that the integrity check mainly looks at the past conduct of ANBI directors, yet the current integrity check has never led to revocation of ANBI status while large-scale fraud evidently occurred.

De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat de integriteitstoets hoofdzakelijk ziet op het verleden van de bestuurders van een anbi, maar dat de huidige integriteitstoets nooit heeft geleid tot intrekking van de anbi-status terwijl klaarblijkelijk wél sprake is geweest van (grootschalige) fraude.
Asks how the review of institutional bias in the compensation scheme will work and which criteria the ministerial regulation will contain to determine group-wise institutional bias.
The GroenLinks members ask the government which criteria it intends to include in the ministerial regulation to determine whether there is group-wise institutionally biased treatment.

De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen de regering welke criteria zij voornemens is in de ministeriële regeling op te nemen om te bepalen of er sprake is van een groepsgewijze institutioneel vooringenomen behandeling.

Asks whether ANBIs will be carefully assessed to avoid wrongful accusation and who bears the cost of obtaining VOGs, and asks how the restriction on cash-movement rules squares with the justification for interference with the free movement of goods.
The ChristenUnie members ask whether, with the tightened integrity check, it is sufficiently ensured that ANBIs are also carefully assessed so they are not wrongly accused or suspected.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen of er bij de aanscherping van de integriteitstoets anbi’s voldoende geborgd is dat anbi’s ook zorgvuldig worden getoetst om te voorkomen dat deze ten onrechte beschuldigd dan wel verdacht worden.
Has taken note of the bill and has no further remarks.
The PvdA members have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further remarks.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met interesse kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben daarbij geen verdere opmerkingen.
Asks why the three measures are taken separately rather than as a package and how the government prevents accumulation of regulation for ANBIs, and asks for the 'redelijke termijn' to be specified.
The SGP members ask what the government understands by a 'reasonable period'?
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen wat de regering verstaat onder een «redelijke termijn»?
Is disappointed that the abolition of the caregiver allowance in inheritance tax is included, and asks about the cleanup of existing ANBI status and the budget and capacity implications.
but these members are disappointed that the abolition of the caregiver allowance (in inheritance tax law) has been included in this omnibus act.
maar deze leden zijn teleurgesteld dat de afschaffing van het mantelzorgcompliment (in de successiewet) in deze verzamelwet is opgenomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Fiscale verzamelwet 2021, raising major concerns about the open delegation basis for a compensation scheme for CAF 11 parents (legal certainty, retroactivity), and minor points on ANBI integrity checks and the national supplement to the liquid assets regulation. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, narrowing the delegation scope, dropping retroactivity, clarifying ANBI guidance and justifying the national controls.
concerns: The open-ended delegation basis for the compensation scheme raises legal certainty and spill-over concerns and needs clearer core elements and scope, which the government addressed by limiting it to childcare allowance matters and clarifying criteria.
Retroactive effect of the delegation basis to 6 December 2019 cannot be granted, so retroactivity was dropped and only permitted for the beneficial regulation to be adopted later.

Requiring ANBI integrity certificates (VOG) may lead to practice where all persons hold them, and institutions need enough time to respond; the government disagreed with the expectation but added a reasonable term to the explanatory memorandum.

The national supplement to the liquid assets regulation, extending controls to domestic transport and valuable goods, needs justification under free movement of goods and capital; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

35450-X.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, raising total spending authorisations by about 456.6 million euro and expenditure by roughly 6 million. It also makes the amendment retroactive to 1 May 2020 and lists the main budget mutations, such as extra ammunition funding and wage and price adjustments.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and agreed ... the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence for 2020 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35455.s: The bill creates a ten-year legal basis for experiments with new, smaller ballot papers that can display party logos in polling stations, allowing the Minister of the Interior to designate municipalities (or provinces for Senate elections) and to deviate from listed articles of the Kieswet via general administrative order. It also sets a procedure for registering party logos with the central electoral board, aligned with the existing experiment law for overseas voters.
35455.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary experiment power by the need to test new ballots in practice before any permanent change, and by limiting experiments to listed articles and a ten-year duration.
d: designating municipalities or provinces for ballot experiments
rules on experiments, deviating from listed Kieswet articles
designating voting aids and further rules on them by amvb
rules on how a logo is submitted
p: The executive may temporarily depart from specified Kieswet provisions on voting procedure and vote counting by general administrative order, limited to listed articles and a ten-year sunset, with a four-week parliamentary pre-submission period.
The minister may designate municipalities for experiments, conditional on council consent, with provincial consent required for Senate elections.
Decisions by the minister to hold an experiment and to designate voting aids are excluded from objection and appeal under the General Administrative Law Act.

parties: Asks why the experiment runs ten years, why electronic counting is excluded, how municipalities are selected, and what happens if voters tick only a party under model 2.
First, they note that they regard the secrecy of the vote as a great good.
Allereerst merken zij op dat zij het stemgeheim een groot goed vinden.
Objects in principle to model 2 because candidate names are absent, and asks about the quality of counting and the software problems.
These members find it undesirable, even fundamentally incorrect, that the candidates' names do not appear on the ballot paper.
Deze leden vinden het ongewenst, zelfs principieel onjuist, dat op het stembiljet de namen van de kandidaten niet voorkomen.
Questions whether the experiment with two systems is needed and demands a protocol to protect the secrecy of the vote when ballot stacks are refilled.

The D66 members are not yet convinced that the government has identified these problems sharply enough and ask the government to draw up a more factual protocol to safeguard the secrecy of the vote when model 1 is used.

De leden van de D66-fractie zijn nog niet overtuigd dat de regering deze problemen scherp genoeg heeft en vragen de regering om een meer feitelijk weergegeven protocol op te stellen om het stemgeheim te waarborgen bij het gebruik van model 1.
Asks how the experiment law will be applied to national and local elections, requests an overview of related bills, and asks for the evaluation criteria set by general administrative order.
In article 15 of the Act, the GroenLinks members read that criteria for evaluating the experiments will be set by general administrative order.
In artikel 15 van de Wet lezen de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie dat bij AMvB criteria worden geregeld voor de evaluatie van de experimenten.
Worries that running two methods at once harms equality and legal certainty, and raises fraud risks and extra work for polling station staff.
The SP members share the concern that experimenting with two different methods at the same time may undermine the principles of equality and legal certainty.
De leden van de SP-fractie delen de zorgen dat het experimenteren met twee verschillende methodes tegelijkertijd, afbreuk kan doen aan het gelijkheids- en rechtszekerheidsbeginsel.
Asks how to prevent voters seeing running totals, ballot shortages or tampering, how blank votes will be cast, and how voters are informed during corona measures.
They further ask how it can be prevented that ballots of one party run out, particularly at busy polling stations or because of malicious intent by a visitor to the polling place.
Voorts vragen zij hoe kan worden voorkomen dat stembiljetten van één partij opraken, met name op drukbezochte stembureaus of vanwege kwade intenties van een bezoeker van het stemlokaal.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no substantive objections to the draft temporary act on experiments with new ballot papers and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply states that the proposal gave no reason for substantive remarks and that only clarifying sentences in the explanatory memorandum and minor drafting changes were made.

35464.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by adding about 1.3 billion euros in expenditure obligations and outlays for student compensation and COVID-19 education support measures. It also provides for extra funding for early childhood, primary, secondary and vocational education and for keeping internships and work-learning places available.
35464.j: The memorandum justifies the budget amendment by pointing to study delay caused by COVID-19 that cannot always be avoided or made up, and to the risk of increased social inequality.
q: Study delay in the final year cannot always be prevented or made up given COVID-19.
Studievertraging in het laatste jaar is gegeven COVID-19 niet altijd te voorkomen of in te halen.

parties: Asks how many students will use the compensation, how overruns are financed, and how schools and municipalities will locate children who are out of view.
What happens if more students than expected use the scheme and how is this financed?
Wat gebeurt er als er meer studenten dan verwacht gebruik gaan maken van de regeling en hoe wordt dit gefinancierd?
Asks how allocation keys were set, whether schools must apply for subsidies, and whether spending and results will be monitored.
Will it also be monitored how schools spend the funds received and how efficiently and with what results these funds are used?
Voornoemde leden vragen of er ook wordt gemonitord op welke wijze de scholen de ontvangen gelden besteden en hoe efficiënt en met welk resultaat deze gelden worden ingezet?
Seeks clarification on eligibility of international students and whether students must apply actively or are compensated automatically.
Must they actively report to the educational institution or DUO, or does DUO carry this out automatically, these members ask.
Moeten zij zich actief melden bij de onderwijsinstelling of DUO, of voert DUO dit automatisch uit, zo vragen deze leden.
Criticises compensation limited to the final study year and asks about students who lost jobs, and whether structural SBB cuts will be reconsidered.
However, the members ask why it was chosen to compensate study delay only in the final year.
Wel vragen de leden waarom er alleen gekozen is om studievertraging in het laatste jaar te compenseren?
Objects that only final-phase students are compensated and asks for a generic measure covering all students with delay, including those caught between schemes.
These members ask why a generic measure was not chosen to compensate all students with study delay due to the coronavirus.
Deze leden vragen waarom er niet is gekozen voor een generieke maatregel om alle studenten met studievertraging vanwege het coronavirus te compenseren.
Welcomes the measures but asks about mental health support, the basis for the amounts, and whether unused funds return to the treasury.
The government writes that for both measures any remaining funds not spent flow back to the state treasury.
De regering schrijft dat voor beide maatregelen geldt dat eventuele resterende middelen die niet zijn uitgeput, terugvloeien naar 's Rijks kas.
Asks how groups of students needing an extra year but not in their final year are treated.

35470-V.s: This bill is a slotwet (closing budget law) that adjusts the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, setting the final realised figures in thousands of euros and making the budget changes effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were provided.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35473.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment through a third supplementary budget, mainly adjusting appropriations for the Tozo self-employed support scheme and emergency childcare. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 26 May 2020 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
35473.j: The memorandum justifies the budget adjustments by lower expected Tozo demand and the need to place costs in the correct cash-flow years, without any delegation of power.
q: These costs will be placed in the correct budgetary cash-flow pattern for the years 2020–2022 at a different moment.
Deze kosten worden op een ander moment budgettair in het juiste kasritme geplaatst voor de jaren 2020–2022.

35482.s: The bill amends the Dutch Civil Code so that claims arising from a trade or business (named claims) can no longer be made non-transferable or non-pledgeable by agreement, and such clauses are void, with listed exceptions for certain accounts, syndicated loans, clearing bodies and tax payment accounts. It adds written-notice requirements for assignment and pledge of such claims and a transitional rule making the nullity apply to existing clauses three months after the law takes effect.
35482.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the need to ease credit provision to businesses and small firms, and explains that arbitrary refusals would otherwise force costly court action.
q: Exclusion of transferability or pledgeability is not possible if the claim is a named monetary claim arising from the exercise of a profession or business.
Uitsluiting van de overdraagbaarheid of verpandbaarheid is niet mogelijk als het een geldvordering op naam betreft die voortkomt uit de uitoefening van een beroep of bedrijf.
d: commencement date by royal decree, possibly varying by article

parties: Asks whether the bill unnecessarily undermines contractual freedom and about administrative burden and the transitional regime's fairness and length.
Can the government confirm that the bill does not unnecessarily detract from the principle of contractual freedom?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat het wetsvoorstel niet onnodig afbreuk doet aan het uitgangspunt van contractvrijheid?
Asks about consequences for SMEs and debtors' legal certainty, and whether the bill's benefits are demonstrated; warns contractual freedom should not be restricted lightly.
They believe this, especially for a relatively small SME, could cause considerable uncertainty.
Zij menen dat dit – zeker bij een relatief kleine MKB-onderneming – voor veel onzekerheid kan zorgen.

Asks for evidence on the bill's problem and benefits, the risk of fraud and erroneous notices, the reflex effect in bankruptcy, and a directional vision on bankruptcy law before further consideration.
In the view of these members, this reflex effect in bankruptcy is still somewhat underexposed.
Deze reflexwerking in faillissement is naar mening van voornoemde leden nog wat onderbelicht.

Argues the bill strengthens banks' position in bankruptcy and expands debt, questions the unsubstantiated credit-release estimates, and says the bill conflicts with the adopted WHOA motion on fairer distribution.
The bill now before us seems to make these relations even more lopsided.
Het nu voorliggende wetsvoorstel lijkt deze verhoudingen nóg schever te maken.
Questions whether the bill truly benefits SMEs, its evidence base, its relation to the Nijboer motion and separate track, and legal certainty for debtors over whom to pay and fraud risk.
These members, however, find this premise still insufficiently substantiated, including numerically, and would like further justification of the government's assumption.
Voornoemde leden vinden dit uitgangspunt echter nog onvoldoende onderbouwd, ook cijfermatig, en zien graag een nadere onderbouwing van deze veronderstelling van de regering.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the draft bill abolishing contractual bans on assignment and pledging of receivables (Wet opheffing verpandingsverboden) needs better justification and a transitional period for existing contracts, and it cited doubts about the proposed nullity sanction. The minister's reply largely accepts the transitional-period suggestion (three months after entry into force) and clarifies the motivation, while defending nullity as the sanction and not accepting the alternative drawn from the Algemene Rijksinkoopvoorwaarden.
concerns: The Afdeling found the motivation for the bill's economic necessity and effectiveness, including the estimated 1 billion euro extra credit, insufficiently substantiated, and the minister added clarification but did not quantify it precisely.

The Afdeling questioned whether nullity is a proportionate sanction and whether less far-reaching alternatives from comparative law were considered, and the minister rejected alternatives in favour of nullity.
The Afdeling advised a transitional regime so that contracts concluded before entry into force are not immediately affected, and the minister accepted this with a three-month period.

The Afdeling noted the bill's possible reflex effect on bankruptcy estates and the regulatory burden of the written notice requirement, and the minister added clarifications without quantifying the effects.

35491.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (Article XII) through a second incidental supplementary budget, mainly for availability payments for public transport. It sets budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 March 2020.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35518.s: The bill widens rent-increase possibilities for mid-income tenants in social rental housing by tying allowable increases to household income brackets and removing certain exemptions for households with AOW recipients or four or more persons. It also differentiates allocation income limits for social housing and lets housing corporations allocate a larger share of vacancies to households above the income limit.
35518.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the ministerial power to adjust rent amounts annually and set exempt groups by the need for flexibility to keep rents aligned with income and quality.
q: By ministerial regulation the percentage or amount of the maximum rent increase is determined.
Bij ministeriële regeling wordt het percentage dan wel het bedrag van de maximale huurverhoging vastgesteld.
d: Boek 7 BW art. 252a lid 6 onder a (regeling)
groups exempt from income-dependent rent increase
maximum rent increase percentage or amount and income bracket amounts
p: The minister may set by ministerial regulation the maximum rent increase amounts and income thresholds that determine tenant protection, with the statute providing only a general framework.

parties: Asks the government for detailed figures on household eligibility, waiting lists and the effects of the differentiated income limits and asset tests.
Is it correct that with this law the government better balances the affordability of social rental housing for different household types?
Klopt het dat de regering met deze wet de betaalbaarheid van sociale huurwoningen beter in balans brengt voor verschillende type huishoudens?
Opposes excluding about 135,000 single-person households from affordable rental housing and asks whether the bill can be split and the income limit raised instead.
The PvdA members believe the maximum income limit for social rental housing should instead be raised to, for example, 50,000 or 60,000 euro.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn van mening dat de maximale inkomensgrens voor sociale huurwoningen juist verhoogd zou moeten worden tot bijvoorbeeld 50.000 of 60.000 euro.
Argues the bill sets tenant groups against each other, raises rents, and asks why the government does not expand the stock of affordable housing or provide alternatives.
Why are groups of tenants being played off against each other instead of being actively helped to their right to an affordable rental home, the SP members ask.
Waarom worden groepen huurders tegen elkaar uitgespeeld in plaats van actief geholpen met hun recht op een betaalbare huurwoning, willen de leden van de SP-fractie weten.

Has fundamental objections to lowering the single-person income limit and asks the government to reconsider given the lack of alternative affordable homes and broken expectations of waiting-list applicants.
On this point, the GroenLinks members finally ask the government to reconsider this proposal.
Op dit punt willen de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks de regering tot slot vragen dit voorstel te heroverwegen.
Welcomes more families becoming eligible but asks how single-person households with higher incomes will be prevented from falling between two stools and what alternatives exist.
How will the Minister prevent single-person households with such an income from falling between two stools in the free rental sector, they ask.
Hoe gaat de Minister voorkomen dat eenpersoonshuishoudens met een dergelijk inkomen niet tussen wal en schip vallen in de vrije huursector, zo vragen zij.
Supports fairer distribution of scarcity but asks about accessibility safeguards the Council of State requires and how municipalities use the sociale koop category and free allocation room.
In this light, these members ask to what extent municipalities are sufficiently aware of the social purchase category through which affordable homes can be built.
Deze leden vragen in dit licht in hoeverre gemeenten voldoende op de hoogte zijn van de bestemmingscategorie sociale koop waarmee betaalbare woningen kunnen worden gerealiseerd.
Asks about the bill's purpose, fairness for long-waiting applicants, a transition arrangement, and whether a real alternative exists for those excluded.
The said members ask the cabinet to propose a transitional arrangement.
Genoemde leden vragen het kabinet voorstellen te doen voor een overgangsregeling.
Questions why differentiation uses only two household categories and warns that excluding older single tenants may block access to suitable senior housing.
They fear this measure could have a huge impact on the availability of suitable senior housing.
Zij vrezen dat deze maatregel een enorme impact kan hebben op de beschikbaarheid van geschikte seniorenwoningen.
Asks how the single-person income limit was set and how the government plans to address applicants already on waiting lists, and whether changes could be phased.
These members ask whether the government considered changing the income limits more gradually, in smaller annual steps?
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of de regering overwogen heeft om de inkomensgrenzen meer geleidelijk (in kleinere stappen per jaar) te wijzigen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill differentiating the DAEB income limit by household size, adjusting income-dependent rent increases, and expanding free allocation space in social housing, raising concerns about effectiveness in the housing market, coherence of measures, and EU state aid compliance. The government's reply accepted the need for more attention to effectiveness and coherence, added explanation on state aid and guidance from the Commission, and split off a separate temporary rent discount bill.
concerns: The expected effectiveness of the incentive for households to move out of the social rental sector should be explained further, including the availability of alternatives in the private market.
The coherence between the DAEB income limit differentiation, the structural increase in free allocation space, and recent middle-segment regulation should be explained.

The bill's changes to the DAEB income limit and free allocation space must be verified against the 2009 Commission decision, and consultation with the Commission should precede submission, with the bill not entering into force before agreement.

35527.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT act (Wet OB 1968) to implement EU directives 2017/2455 and 2019/1995 on distance sales and e-commerce, abolishing the €22 import VAT exemption and making online platforms liable for certain sales. It adds new special VAT schemes (non-Union, Union, import and post/courier regimes), registration, filing, record-keeping and recovery rules.
35527.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and record-keeping duties as necessary to implement the EU directives, to create a level playing field, and to protect tax revenue.
q: Abolishing the exemption under Directive 2009/132/EC is important for creating a level playing field for the businesses concerned and for protecting member states' tax revenue.

Het vervallen van de vrijstelling van Richtlijn 2009/132/EG is van belang voor het creëren van gelijke concurrentievoorwaarden voor de betrokken bedrijven en daarnaast voor het beschermen van de belastinginkomsten van de lidstaten.
d: definitions of third-country territories by reference to BTW-richtlijn
Artikel I, onderdeel G/Artikel 6k, vierde lid
further rules on the notification for the small-business threshold scheme
Artikel I, onderdeel N/Artikel 28tb, vierde lid
rules on intermediaries for the import scheme to ensure collection of tax
p: The inspector may impose additional assessments for under-collected VAT with extraterritorial effect on non-Union businesses, applying the general assessment powers of the AWR.
Artikel I, onderdeel P/Artikel 34, vijfde tot en met zevende lid
Electronic interfaces must keep records available to member-state tax authorities on request for ten years.

parties: Supports the bill's content but worries about the late implementation date by the Belastingdienst and asks how fraud risks and enforcement will be controlled.
The VVD members ask what fraud risks the proposed changes carry.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen welke frauderisico's er aan de voorgestelde wijzigingen zitten?
Welcomes the reform but sees significant implementation challenges, fraud risks and supervision problems, and asks detailed questions about enforcement responsibilities across member states.
These members see significant implementation challenges on several points, with possible fraud risk and possible problems with supervision of payments.
Deze leden zien op enkele punten significante uitdagingen bij de uitvoering van deze wet, waarbij mogelijk risico op fraude ontstaat en ook problemen kunnen ontstaan met het toezicht op afdrachten.
Supports modernising VAT collection but asks questions about enforcement, anti-abuse measures, the one-stop-shop and the Brexit and COVID effects on the bill.
These members ask whether the Belastingdienst will actively supervise compliance with VAT payment by entrepreneurs outside the European Union.
Deze leden vragen of door de Belastingdienst actief toezicht zal worden gehouden op naleving van het afdragen van btw door ondernemers buiten de Europese Unie.
Finds removing the VAT exemption logical and asks about trade volumes, consumer obligations to pay VAT to postal carriers, and Brexit-related delays.
The SP members say they find removing the VAT exemption on small shipments from outside the European Union logical.
De leden van de SP-fractie geven aan het schrappen van de btw-vrijstelling op kleine zendingen van buiten de Europese Unie logisch te vinden.
Supports the bill's aims but asks how collection will be ensured, how the one-stop-shop and information exchange will work, and how entrepreneurs can stay informed without costly advisers.
The PvdA members support the bill's goals, namely protecting tax revenue and equal competition between sellers inside and outside the European Union.
De doelen van de wet worden gesteund door de leden van de PvdA-fractie, namelijk het beschermen van belastinginkomsten en gelijke concurrentie tussen verkopers binnen en buiten de Europese Unie.
Asks for detailed information on the emergency track's risks, costs, IT capacity decisions and past choices, and wants the BIT and ADR involved in oversight.
The VVD members ask the government to respond to points 1 to 7 mentioned.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering op de genoemde punten 1 tot 7 in te gaan.
Objects to being presented with a fait accompli on the emergency track without a formal implementation impact assessment, and asks for full risk, cost and capacity overviews.
These members find it a strange state of affairs that they are being presented with a fait accompli in this way.
Deze leden voelen het als een vreemde gang van zaken dat zij op deze manier voor een voldongen feit worden gesteld.
Asks the government to respond to the Algemene Rekenkamer's concerns and to share the Belastingdienst's research on readiness for 1 July 2021.
The D66 members ask the government to respond to the Algemene Rekenkamer's concerns about implementing the new VAT rules.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen de regering om een reactie op de zorgen van de Algemene Rekenkamer met betrekking tot de implementatie van de nieuwe btw-regelgeving.
Supports the substantive bill but asks about the handling of the emergency track, the transition to permanent infrastructure, and the risks of rising volumes.
They consider the bill a good step in substance, but like the Algemene Rekenkamer and the government itself have concerns about implementation.
Zij vinden het wetsvoorstel inhoudelijk een goede stap, maar hebben net als de Algemene Rekenkamer en de regering zelf zorgen over de uitvoering.
Asks the government for its assessment of the consequences of late entry into force and how other EU member states are implementing.
The SP members ask the government for its view on the consequences of the law not entering into force on time.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering naar haar oordeel over de gevolgen van het niet tijdig in werking treden van de wet.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division raised no substantive objections to the draft VAT bill implementing the e-commerce directives, but warned that the Tax Administration cannot implement the rules by 1 January 2021 and asked for analysis of practical effects and consultation with the Commission. The State Secretary's reply accepts the requests, adds a new section on implementation and entry into force, makes the entry-into-force date a matter for royal decree, and adopts the drafting corrections except two.
concerns: The Tax Administration's test shows the required automation cannot be realised by 1 January 2021, so the advisory division asked for a description of the practical consequences and mitigation measures.

The advisory division asked the government to consult the European Commission on the implementation problems and on possible infringement or liability risks, and to report the state of affairs in the explanatory memorandum.

Drafting corrections were proposed: the reference in the Wet op de omzetbelasting to third-country definitions was not adapted, a cross-reference was corrected, and a transposition table was requested for an EU implementing regulation; two of the three were not adopted.

35545.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties and the BES-fund, adding funds for food aid and compensation for lost income in the Caribbean Netherlands in response to the COVID-19 crisis. It also sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 10 July 2020.
35545.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget increase by the COVID-19 crisis and the request of Aruba, Sint Maarten and Curaçao for solidarity under Article 36 of the Charter.
q: The countries have, under Article 36 of the Charter for the Kingdom of the Netherlands, appealed to solidarity within the Kingdom.
De landen hebben op grond van artikel 36 van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden een beroep gedaan op de solidariteit binnen het Koninkrijk.

35554.s: The bill amends the Mediawet 2008 to strengthen the national public broadcaster's programming flexibility and pluralism, reduce advertising (halving the maximum ad share in phases from 2022), and reorganise governance by giving the college of broadcasters stronger advisory rights and a consent role for the supervisory board. It also shifts supervision of the NPO's code of conduct to the Commissariaat and expands regional broadcasting content and funding rules.
35554.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for flexible, efficient broadcasting governance and phased advertising reduction, subject to a voorhang procedure for the advertising percentage.
q: For the amendment of the Mediabesluit 2008 providing for the phased reduction, a voorhang procedure will apply.
Voor de wijziging van het Mediabesluit 2008 die ziet op de stapsgewijze verlaging zal een voorhangprocedure gelden.
d: maximum percentage of advertising per TV channel 2022-2025
maximum advertising percentage for national, regional and local public media services
further description of sober, efficient and balanced organisation of broadcasters
percentage of budget for independent productions (within 10-25% band)
p: ARTIKEL I, B en CC (artikelen 2.3 en 7.11)
Supervision of the NPO code of conduct is moved from the NPO's own commission to the formal regulator, the Commissariaat, which gains enforcement instruments.
Introduces consultation and a consent procedure in which the supervisory board can overrule the college of broadcasters, with the board of management getting room to proceed despite advice.

parties: Asks how the Chamber will be involved in the annual review of broadcasters and questions the basis for membership thresholds.
In what way will the Chamber also be involved in this process?
Op welke manier wordt ook de Kamer bij dit proces betrokken?
Asks how the annual review of broadcasters will work and what consequences a failure to contribute to pluriformity would have, including early withdrawal of recognition.
What will the consequences be if the review shows that insufficient contribution to pluriformity has been made.
Wat zullen de consequenties zijn indien uit de toets blijkt dat onvoldoende is bijgedragen aan de pluriformiteit.

Supports an open system but questions safeguarding distinctiveness of new broadcasters and the removal of content criteria, and asks about the independence of the Commissariaat and CIPO integrity oversight.
Although these members see the Division's criticism, they do not understand the government's choice to simply scrap the proposal altogether.
Hoewel deze leden de kritiek van de Afdeling zien, begrijpen zij niet de keuze van de regering om het voorstel dan maar helemaal te schrappen.
Worries that mandatory affiliation with existing broadcasters undermines external pluriformity and asks why recognition is not given per broadcaster; criticises the higher membership contribution.

The Council of State warns that mandatory affiliation with existing stand-alone broadcasting associations or cooperative broadcasters is at odds with the desired external pluriformity of the broadcasting system.

De Raad van State waarschuwt dat de verplichte aansluiting bij bestaande « stand alone » omroepverenigingen of samenwerkingsomroepen op gespannen voet staat met de gewenste externe pluriformiteit van het omroepbestel.

Doubts the bill strengthens the public broadcaster given the unclear NPO-broadcaster relationship and the dismissed Council of State criticism; fears vague social-rootedness criteria and subjectivity.
How is an excessive degree of subjectivity prevented?
Hoe wordt een te grote mate van subjectiviteit voorkomen?

Supports strengthening public broadcasting but asks how Parliament will be involved in the new social-rootedness assessment and what consequences follow if rootedness is insufficient; flags the hybrid governance structure raised by the Council of State.
These members ask whether the government can elaborate on this and to what extent such a fundamental consideration has been made.
Deze leden vragen of de regering hier nader op kan ingaan en in hoeverre een dergelijke fundamentele afweging is gemaakt.
Questions the durability of the association form as the legitimacy basis and asks for justification of governance changes and the role of the supervisory board versus the college of broadcasters.
Does the explanatory memorandum not point out that mainly the attitude of those involved is problematic?
Wijst de toelichting er niet op dat vooral de houding van betrokkenen problematisch is?

Asks how strengthened advisory rights of the college of broadcasters relate to individual broadcasters' reporting and what happens with a split advice; raises financial guarantees and the Minister's commitment on minimum budget.
Can the government repeat that publicly and also make good on it?
Kan de regering dat in het openbaar herhalen en ook waarmaken?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft amendment to the Mediawet 2008 aimed at strengthening the public broadcaster, raising fundamental objections to the membership-based legitimacy criteria, the external producers budget, the two-channel cut, the reclame-free broadcasting, Ster revenue transfer and supervision of the code of conduct. The government's reply largely accepts the objections, dropping the legitimacy criteria, the Ster revenue transfer and the daytime advertising ban while adjusting others.
concerns: Objective legitimacy criteria for public broadcasting associations must be set in the statute itself rather than left to later administrative rules, so the proposal removing membership-based criteria was dropped.
Leaving the content of the new maatschappelijke legitimatie criteria to the Commissariaat and broadcasters was considered too risky, and the provision was struck.
The proposal's contradictory measures undermine effectiveness and the hybrid structure is not resolved, with reclame-reduction and channel changes only partly reconsidered.
Insufficient justification for the full advertising ban and the financial impact, leading to a gradual halving of advertising minutes instead of a daytime ban.
Direct transfer of Ster revenues to the NPO was dropped due to unclear stabilisation effects and commercial incentive risks.
Explanatory memorandum clarified on the College van Omroepen advisory role, external producers and supervision of the code of conduct, while substantive objections were partly rebutted.

35572.s: The bill amends several tax laws (income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, bank tax, motor vehicle tax, environmental taxes) for 2021 and later years, adjusting tax brackets, tax credits, and rates, and introducing transitional and technical rules. The explanatory memorandum justifies these changes mainly as implementing purchasing-power policy, simplifying the tax system, and improving enforcement on parallel import of used cars.
35572.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations for shore-power conditions by EU state-aid rules and practical enforcement needs, and the BPM changes by fairness between domestic and parallel-import trade and simpler enforcement.
q: Through the delegation powers, an general administrative order together with a ministerial regulation will regulate, as with the reduced tariff for charging installations for electric vehicles, that the consumer must submit a declaration.

Middels de delegatiebevoegdheden zal per algemene maatregel van bestuur in samenhang met een ministeriële regeling, net als bij het verlaagd tarief voor oplaadinstallaties voor elektrische voertuigen, worden geregeld dat de verbruiker
d: technical correction of cross-reference errors arising from law conflicts
ARTIKEL XXXI, onderdeel F (artikel 60b, derde en vierde lid, Wbm)
conditions and proof for reduced electricity tariff for shore-power installations
ARTIKEL XXXI, onderdeel F (artikel 60b, vierde lid, Wbm)
further rules for shore-power tariff implementation
ARTIKEL XXIX, onderdeel K (artikel 13 Wet BPM 1992 / artikel 10 tiende lid)
rules on where and when declarations with valuation requests must be filed
p: ARTIKEL XXIX, onderdeel H (artikel 10 Wet BPM 1992)
Allows further conditions by ministerial regulation on where and when declarations with valuation requests must be submitted, shifting procedural discretion to the executive.

parties: Asks detailed questions on income policy effects, the zelfstandigenaftrek phase-out and the tax-rate mutations, and requests information the Kamer can use for oversight.
The VVD members ask for a breakdown of all policy changes to the income tax rate for the coming year.
De leden vragen naar een uitsplitsing van alle beleidsmutaties in het inkomstenbelasting (IB)-tarief voor het aankomende jaar.
Objects that the BIK nota van wijziging was submitted late as a nota van wijziging instead of a separate bill, which they say undermines the Kamer's controlling role.
These members regard this as a direct affront to the Kamer and to the Nijboer motion that asked for tax legislation to be sent to the Kamer in a spread-out manner.
Deze leden beschouwen het als een regelrechte schoffering van de Kamer, diens motie-Nijboer die verzocht om belastingwetgeving gespreid naar de Kamer te sturen.
Opposes the BIK as poorly justified and producing no proven jobs or investment, and asks for the 2 billion euro to be spent elsewhere.
The need for this is poorly substantiated, and it is now clear that this scheme produces neither jobs nor investment.
De noodzaak hiertoe is slecht onderbouwd, en inmiddels staat wel vast dat deze regeling banen noch investeringen oplevert.
Raises serious implementation concerns from the Belastingdienst about the box 3 and transfer tax changes and questions why complexity is not reduced.
The CDA members are also very concerned about the feasibility of several bills in this legislative package.
De leden van de CDA-fractie maken zich verder grote zorgen over de uitvoerbaarheid van een aantal wetsvoorstellen uit dit wetgevingspakket.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Belastingplan 2021 bill and raised no substantive objections, only drafting remarks and a request to explain the timing of the car-tax (BPM) changes given RDW implementation, and whether a zero electricity rate for shore-power installations constitutes State aid. The government's nader rapport adopts the drafting remarks, explains that the BPM provisions will enter into force by royal decree around mid-2021 to January 2022, and clarifies in the explanatory memorandum the EU State-aid aspects covered by the GBER notification.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to explain the consequences of the RDW only being able to implement the car-tax changes in the first half of 2021, and the government now provides for entry into force by royal decree around mid-2021 to January 2022.

The Afdeling asked whether the zero energy-surcharge rate for shore-power installations is a State aid measure under Article 107 TFEU and whether notification under Article 108(3) TFEU is needed, and the explanatory memorandum was amended to clarify the EU aspects and the GBER notification.
The Afdeling made several drafting corrections (wording of articles XXXII and XLV, including the correct name of the Wet op de loonbelasting 1964), which the government adopted.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a government amendment (nota van wijziging) to the Belastingplan 2021 that limits loss offsetting for corporate tax above €1 million to 50% of taxable profit while making carry-forward unlimited. The Afdeling raised concerns about consistency with prior loss-offset changes, feasibility for the Belastingdienst, timing amid the COVID-19 crisis, and the explanation of the structural revenue estimate, and the government's nader rapport responded to each point, partly accepting them by adding explanation and committing to an implementation test.
concerns: The Afdeling criticised the frequent and short-interval changes to loss-offset rules and the lack of consistency and stability in policy.

The Afdeling asked why the income tax (box 1 and box 2) loss rules were not changed and why the box 2 coupling was dropped, and the government added explanation that few income-tax losses exceed €1 million.

The Afdeling noted that no implementation test (uitvoeringstoets) was available and that the impact analysis showed significant complexity and system changes for the Belastingdienst; the government promised a test by January 2021.

The Afdeling questioned whether the timing was right given the corona crisis and reduced liquidity for companies with large losses; the government pointed to corona reserve and unlimited carry-forward as mitigation.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the €555 million structural revenue estimate, which implied losses never being offset; the government explained the CPB certification, the 25% rate change, and the mechanism of structural revenue.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft nota van wijziging introducing the temporary baangerelateerde investeringskorting (BIK), a payroll-tax discount for business investments in response to COVID-19, raising concerns about its fiscal form versus a subsidy, possible state aid, budgeting, and the need for a separate bill. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport rejects most points, keeps the fiscal design, declines to contact the European Commission, and adopts only some drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling argued the generic fiscal investment discount is poorly targeted and that a subsidy would be a more suitable instrument, which the government rejected by defending the fiscal design.
The Afdeling saw real doubt whether the scheme is state aid and advised contacting the European Commission, which the government declined, arguing the scheme is general and not selective.
The Afdeling noted that budgeting a tax facility sits uneasily with the fiscal system, which the government countered with the WBSO precedent and the option to adjust the percentage.

The Afdeling advised including the scheme in a separate bill given its size, complexity and political sensitivity, which the government rejected because the crisis measure needs speedy entry into force.
The Afdeling made several drafting comments on the bill text, of which most were followed while the term 'baangerelateerd' was retained.

35590.s: This temporary act deviates from and supplements the Kieswet to protect public health during Dutch elections amid COVID-19, allowing restricted-access polling stations, relocated stations, reduced staffing requirements, health checks, and hygiene rules set by ministerial regulation. It also extends signature-collection deadlines, expands proxy voting limits and electronic proxy applications, and expires on 1 July 2021 unless extended by royal decree.
35590.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need to protect public health and ensure a smooth electoral process during the COVID-19 crisis, and by the need to adapt rules quickly as the virus situation changes.
q: This bill aims to ensure these measures have a legal basis, as Article 59 of the Constitution requires, and can be enforced in polling stations on election day.

Dit wetsvoorstel beoogt te verzekeren dat deze maatregelen een wettelijke grondslag hebben, zoals artikel 59 van de Grondwet vereist, en kunnen worden gehandhaafd in de stemlokalen op de dag van de stemming.
d: health check model, safe distance and hygiene rules in polling stations
further rules on observers at restricted-access polling stations and report model
electronic proxy application, notification and verification procedures
rules on transport and handover of ballot box and election documents
royal decree setting entry into force and extending the expiry date of the act
p: Municipal executives may relocate or add polling stations up to the day before the election when COVID-19 circumstances require, with public notice required.
Polling staff may bar voters failing a health check from entering and may order voters to leave, with entry rules and conduct left largely to ministerial regulation.
Building owners are barred from imposing additional health rules on voters, limiting private gatekeeping but also shifting discretion away from local actors.
Municipalities may designate mobile polling stations with restricted access limited to residents of the locations served.
Municipalities may designate special polling stations with restricted access limited to residents of the locations served.
Municipal executives decide which polling board members perform which tasks, reducing the statutory division of duties.

parties: Asks whether RIVM will be consulted closer to the election, whether polling stations stay open to voters without restricted access, and how the mask rule and queues will be handled.
First, the VVD members wonder whether the RIVM will also be consulted closer to the elections.
Allereerst vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie zich af of het RIVM ook nog dichter op de verkiezingen geconsulteerd zal worden.

Asks how municipalities can spread voter flows, what the government is doing about the 2019 disinformation campaign, and asks for clarity on which voters are admitted to restricted-access polling stations.
Stresses that safe voting must not undermine the open character of the ballot; asks who is responsible for sufficient polling stations and observers and how much discretion municipalities have.
These members ask the government how much room municipalities have to deviate from this obligation and decide themselves whether to appoint an observer at a polling station with restricted access.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoeveel ruimte de gemeente hebben om af te wijken van deze verplichting en zelf te bepalen of zij een waarnemer instellen bij een stembureau met beperkte toegang.

Asks how conflicts between covid measures and Kieswet rules are resolved, contingency scenarios if restrictions change days before the vote, criteria for restricted-access stations and observers, and why multi-day voting was not chosen.
Fears low turnout with fewer polling stations, asks why outdoor and home-visit options were rejected, and cautions that the proxy vote expansion is fraud-prone as GRECO warned.
The SP members fear low turnout if fewer polling stations are available.
De leden van de SP-fractie vrezen een lage opkomst bij de verkiezingen als er minder stemlokalen beschikbaar zullen zijn.

Questions the proportionality of refusing entry to voters who fail the health check, the risk of false answers, the vulnerability of the enlarged proxy vote to coercion, and the risk of escalation toward poll workers.
Asks for a clearer framework and support for poll workers who must enforce rules that may provoke hostile reactions, and asks whether enough poll workers will be available.
Should there therefore not be a clearer framework and support for the members of the polling station?
Zouden daarom niet een duidelijker kader en ondersteuning moeten bestaan ten behoeve van de leden van het stembureau?
Asks whether the health check is sufficient, whether poll workers should be tested, and whether poll workers should be expected to enforce rules in heated confrontations.
The chance therefore exists that poll workers end up in heated discussions, and possibly worse.
De kans bestaat dus dat stembureauleden in hoogoplopende discussies, en mogelijk erger, terechtkomen.
