v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Tijdelijke wet verkiezingen covid-19, raising concerns about the legal basis for the health check that bars voters from polling stations, unclear authority for polling staff to refuse entry, location-bound rules, voter-arrival rules, the meaning of an identity copy, the independence of observers, and phased entry into force. The government's nader rapport accepts nearly all points, amending the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: Restricting the right to vote requires a statutory basis under Article 4 of the Constitution, so the health check's content must be set out in the law itself rather than only by reference to a RIVM framework.
Voters must know in advance when they may vote in person and what consequences follow, requiring clear and timely information.

The bill gives polling staff insufficient clarity on whether they may refuse entry to voters who answered the health check dishonestly, leaving the balance between public health and voting rights unresolved.
Location-bound hygiene rules imposed by building owners outside the polling room are unclear and should be clarified in the law and explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked that the law expressly allow voters already in line at closing time to vote, but the government holds that existing Kieswet article J 30 already covers this.
The meaning of a copy of an identity document for proxy voting, including digital copies, should be settled and explained.
Observers at polling stations with restricted access must be independent, and this should be written into the law itself rather than only in a ministerial regulation.
Phased entry into force should be clarified so that municipalities, parties and voters know which rules apply to the November and March elections.

35617.s: The bill simplifies the procedure for applying for a replacement or new driving licence after theft or loss by allowing a digital notification via the municipality and the RDW register instead of a police report, and adds measures against licence fraud, including duties to surrender found licences and new penalties for false statements. It amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 and related provisions, shifting several licence procedures to ministerial and general administrative order (AMvB) rules.
35617.j: The memorandum justifies the simplification and fraud-prevention measures by the findings of a pilot evaluation and the need to verify applicants' identity, with monitoring planned after introduction.
q: The police report of notification is replaced by a notification via the municipality, which may also be made together with the application for a driving licence.
Proces-verbaal van aangifte wordt vervangen door melding via gemeente en die kan desgewenst ook tegelijk met aanvraag rijbewijs worden gedaan.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel E (art. 119, eerste lid)
cases in which a new driving licence is issued
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel G (art. 123, eerste lid, onderdeel i, and 123b reference)
conditions for applying for a new licence after invalidation
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel B (art. 9, tweede lid, reference to art. 123b, derde lid)
requirements for new licence applicants whose licence has lapsed
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel J (art. 132, zevende lid) and K (art. 134, achtste lid)
manner in which the register entry requires applicants to meet invalidation conditions
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel G (art. 123, eerste lid, onderdeel h)
manner of registering loss or theft notifications in the licence register
ARTIKEL III, onderdeel M (art. 151ic) and N (art. 151id)
cases for issuing new and replacement driver qualification cards
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel G (art. 123, eerste lid, onderdeel h, and tweede lid)
Replaces police reports with a notification to the register, and makes false statements in the notification a prohibited act, expanding executive control over licence procedures.
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel G (art. 123, derde en vierde lid) and onderdeel Q (art. 180)
Imposes duties to surrender licences to the Dienst Wegverkeer or the mayor, and allows the police and public prosecutor to seize licences under these new duties.
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel D (art. 115) and M (art. 161)
Extends the authority of licensing bodies and police to take possession of licences subject to the new surrender duties.

parties: Asks how monitoring will prevent fraud or misuse of the digital reporting option, while welcoming faster procedures.
These members ask what exactly will be monitored and how this monitoring will prevent fraud or misuse of the reporting option from still occurring.
Deze leden vragen wat er precies gemonitord gaat worden en hoe deze monitoring gaat voorkomen dat alsnog fraude wordt gepleegd en/of misbruik wordt gemaakt van de meldingsmogelijkheid.
Asks the government to explain the background, the practice of municipal reports replacing police reports, and whether vulnerable groups keep a physical reporting option.
These members read that in practice the police report has already been replaced by a report to the municipality, so practice deviates from formal regulation.
Deze leden lezen dat het proces-verbaal in de praktijk al is vervangen door een melding bij de gemeente, waardoor de praktijk afwijkt van de formele regelgeving.
Has no further questions on the bill.
The members of the D66 faction have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to abolish the obligation to file a police report for theft or loss of a driving licence, and made no substantive remarks, recommending the bill be submitted to parliament. The minister's nader rapport reports only that references to a separately submitted bill were updated, with no substantive changes.

35626.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer to implement EU Renewable Energy Directive 2018/2001 and the Klimaatakkoord, extending the renewable energy obligation to all transport fuel destinations and adding a greenhouse gas reduction unit (BKE) system. It broadens public supervision by the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit over supply chain links and certification bodies, and adds numerous delegations to ministerial and general administrative measures.
35626.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the need to implement the Renewable Energy Directive, the Integrale Ketenanalyse findings of fraud, and the need for technical detail and proportionate risk-based supervision.
q: This extension of supervision mainly enables fact-finding in the company's business records.
Deze uitbreiding van toezicht maakt met name waarheidsvinding op de bedrijfsadministratie mogelijk.
d: excluding aviation and maritime supplies from renewable energy booking
rules on entering data into EU databank
requirements for electricity supplied for transport
energy content multiplier for designated fuels
multiplier factor for aviation and maritime fuels
further rules on producer checks and record keeping
rules on mass balance for certified undertakings
rules on booking electricity and recycled-carbon fuels
how booker proves recycled-carbon fuel origin and data to record
emission authority may apply minimum values from directive
rules on suspending or refusing credit allocation
ex officio determination of quantities and credits
category of undertakings eligible for transfer accounts
rules on savings of greenhouse gas reduction units
p: The emission authority may suspend or refuse credit allocation on suspicion of fraud or other reasons, without a specified standard beyond the general rules.
The emission authority may retroactively determine quantities and claw back credits up to five years after booking.
The emission authority may deviate from the standard booking ratio for aviation and maritime fuels using ministerial multipliers.
The emission authority may impose administrative fines and bar booking after three or more violations, broadening enforcement powers over fuel suppliers.
The emission authority may choose to apply directive minimum values when setting greenhouse gas reduction, at its own discretion.

parties: Asks whether expanded Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit powers create an unequal playing field in Europe and whether new systems are fraud-resistant.
Objects to Brussels dictates eroding Dutch sovereignty and questions why further regulation is imposed on businesses.
Does the government agree that this erodes Dutch sovereignty?
Is de regering het ermee eens dat hierdoor de Nederlandse soevereiniteit wordt uitgehold?
Asks whether the government intends additional sustainability criteria beyond the EU framework and what the effects on companies would be.
Does the government intend to apply additional criteria on top of the European criteria?
Is de regering van zins om additionele criteria te hanteren boven op de Europese criteria?
Asks how the motion on high-ILUC biofuels was implemented and why the government chose the BKE instrument after the Adviescollege regeldruk findings.
Fears fraud and weak enforcement, with oversight abroad falling outside Dutch jurisdiction, and calls for limiting imports of used cooking oils.
Many necessary instruments, such as oversight in other countries, fall outside Dutch jurisdiction.
Veel noodzakelijke middelen, zoals het toezicht in andere landen, vallen buiten de Nederlandse jurisdictie.
Argues sustainability cannot be guaranteed due to lack of oversight and enforcement abroad and questions the criteria used for ILUC risk.
Sustainability also cannot be sufficiently guaranteed due to lack of oversight and compliance elsewhere in the world.
Ook kan de duurzaamheid niet voldoende geborgd worden door gebrek aan toezicht en naleving elders ter wereld.
Asks why the option to restrict food-based biofuels beyond the EU limit is not used and how compliance with the Klimaatakkoord agreement is monitored.
How is it checked and ensured that this agreement is actually implemented?
Hoe wordt gecontroleerd en geborgd dat er daadwerkelijk uitvoering gegeven wordt aan die afspraak?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised objections to the draft amendment to the Wet milieubeheer on renewable energy in transport, specifically the failure to exclude soy-based biofuels given high indirect land-use change risk and the unjustified introduction of the BKE instrument. The government's nader rapport responds by largely adopting the advice on soy biofuel and the BKE timing, while maintaining its regulatory approach and adding amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to justify not using the option to exclude soy-based biofuels under the Klimaatakkoord, or else to exclude them; the government explained its approach via Delegated Regulation 2019/807 and added explanatory text but did not exclude soy biofuel outright.

The Afdeling found the added value of the BKE instrument insufficiently motivated given existing high reduction percentages and fraud and burden risks; the government postponed its entry into force and added a more concrete justification.
Other amendments were added, including heavy fuel oil in the annual obligation, shortened overdraft periods, and deletion of an outdated cross-reference, with explanatory text adjusted accordingly.

35635.s: The bill amends the Erfgoedwet and the Wet op de economische delicten to implement EU Regulation 2019/880 on bringing in and importing cultural goods. It prohibits bringing certain cultural goods into the EU customs territory, and makes import of listed categories conditional on import licences or importer statements issued by the Minister or competent authorities.
35635.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the obligations flowing from the EU regulation and the need to protect cultural heritage against illegal trade.
q: In the regular statutory evaluation of the Erfgoedwet, the articles now proposed will also be included.
Bij de reguliere wetsevaluatie van de Ew zullen ook de nu voorgestelde artikelen worden betrokken.
d: import licence for listed cultural goods issued by the Minister
p: The Minister or competent authority gains discretion to grant import licences, and importers must hold a licence or declaration before importing listed cultural goods.

parties: Asks how the evaluation after three years would address SME obstacles earlier and what the European Parliament could actually change, questioning the value of the report.
What can the European Parliament actually do with such a report? Can they amend parts of it?
Wat kan het Europees Parlement precies met een dergelijk verslag? Kunnen zij dan onderdelen aanpassen?

Supports the aim of stopping illegal export of heritage but questions effectiveness, freeport concealment from authorities, and whether documents from a foreign government can mask illegally obtained goods.
In what way does the proposed bill contribute to better oversight of trade flows, these members ask.
Op welke wijze draagt het voorliggende wetsvoorstel bij aan beter zicht op de handelsstromen, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks about the impact on regular museum loans and temporary storage for customs checks, and why no consultation was held with stakeholders, while supporting ongoing dialogue.
Furthermore, these members believe it is always important that stakeholders are properly involved and informed about new regulations.
Voorts zijn deze leden van mening dat het altijd belangrijk is dat betrokkenen en belanghebbenden goed betrokken en geïnformeerd worden over nieuwe regelgeving.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill implementing EU Regulation 2019/880 on importing cultural goods, raising sanctioning gaps for false declarations, the EU overwriting prohibition, vague 'appropriate measures', and lack of stakeholder consultation. The minister's reply accepts clarifying the explanatory memorandum and sanctioning via the Economic Offences Act, but declines to consult stakeholders now.
concerns: Sanctioning must cover all infringements of the EU regulation, including false declarations and false information in the derogation cases; the minister argues existing customs rules and the Economic Offences Act already cover this and clarified the memorandum.
The bill repeats or paraphrases the directly applicable EU regulation, which is prohibited; the minister kept references to articles 4 and 5 for knowability and a precedent in the Erfgoedwet.
The meaning of 'passende maatregelen' taken by customs and the Inspectie is unclear; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to clarify it.

Affected stakeholders should be consulted now or when EU implementing acts are operationalised; the minister declined, arguing little discretion remains for the national legislator and stakeholders will be involved in implementation.

35650-V.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by raising total expenditure by about 230 million euros in the second supplementary budget, with changes across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that a change to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2020 has proven necessary
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2020

35671.s: The bill replaces the Centrale Eindtoets with a market of recognised end-of-primary-school test providers, sets rules for school advice and the definitive school advice in primary and secondary education (including special and Caribbean Netherlands schools), and transfers recognition of tests to the College voor toetsen en examens. It also creates new delegations to general administrative orders (AMvB) on test timing, administration and recognition criteria, with parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang) for some of them.
35671.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that technical detail on test dates, administration and norming is a further elaboration of what the statute already regulates, and that a voorhang procedure gives Parliament a say.
q: The definitive school advice is a decision about the pupil's knowledge and abilities. Under article 7:1 of the General Administrative Law Act no objection can be lodged against this decision either.
Het definitieve schooladvies is immers een beslissing over het «kennen en kunnen» van de leerling. Gelet op artikel 7:1 Awb kan tegen dit besluit ook geen bezwaar worden ingediend.
d: Art. 42 WPO (as amended), Art. 43 WEC (as amended)
rules on the school-leaving onderwijskundig rapport
timing of test results and definitive advice; test administration, irregularities and unforeseen circumstances
timing and administration rules for doorstroomtoets in special education
timing and administration rules for doorstroomtoets on Bonaire
how learning results are measured, normed and assessed for zeer zwak onderwijs
validity, reliability and norming requirements for recognised tests
CvTE regulation on the norming procedure and assessment framework, subject to ministerial approval
p: Recognition of end-of-primary tests is transferred to an independent CvTE under ministerial approval of its framework, shifting test-quality power from the state to market providers and an advisory body under executive oversight.
The definitive school advice is excluded from administrative appeal (no bezwaar or beroep under the Awb) and parents are directed to the civil court instead."}],

parties: Asks whether a higher test score always forces a higher advice and why the government dismisses advice from PO-Raad, Onderwijsraad and CPB to keep the test before the advice.
They ask why the government sets these recommendations aside so easily.
Zij vragen waarom de regering deze adviezen zo gemakkelijk naast zich neer legt.

Supports the single definitive advice and enrolment moment but worries about concentration of tasks at the CvTE and the position of Stichting Cito and Cito bv, asking for safeguards against conflicts of interest.
These members do have concerns about the concentration of tasks at the CvTE and the position of Stichting Cito and Cito bv.
Deze leden hebben wel zorgen over de concentratie van taken bij het CvTE 1 en de positie van stichting Cito en Cito bv.
Argues the bill does not address early selection and inequality and wants a broad brugklas instead, focusing on child welfare.
These members find the discussion on the order, timing, name and form of the final test too focused on the system and hardly on the child's interest.
Deze leden vinden de discussie over de volgordelijkheid, de timing, de naam en de vorm van de eindtoets te veel gericht op het systeem en nauwelijks gericht op het belang van het kind.
Supports the equality goal but questions whether renaming and earlier testing truly reduce inequality, and asks about workload and effects of moving the test earlier.
The renaming to doorstroomtoets is nice, but is this not more a logistical change than a real step toward the ambition of equal opportunity?
De naamswijziging naar doorstroomtoets is mooi, maar is dit niet meer een logistieke verandering dan een echte stap naar de ambitie naar kansengelijkheid?
Criticises the marketisation of testing, asks for the government's record on equal opportunity and whether the state should rely on private parties and publish school rankings.
These members share the AOb's view that privatising final tests fits a broader trend of marketising education.
Deze leden delen de mening van de AOb 8 dat de privatisering van eindtoetsen past binnen een bredere ontwikkeling waarin het onderwijs wordt «vermarkt».

Asks about the government's view on late selection (a 'tienerschool'), notes the government depends on private test providers despite its constitutional responsibility, and asks about costs and comparability.

The General Education Union points out that the government makes itself partly dependent on private parties, while that same government bears a constitutional responsibility for good-quality education.

De Algemene Onderwijsbond wijst erop dat de overheid zich met de rol van private partijen mede afhankelijk maakt van private partijen, terwijl diezelfde overheid een grondwettelijke verantwoordelijkheid draagt voor kwalitatief goed onderwijs.

Questions the government's disregard of the Onderwijsraad, PO-Raad and CPB views, the sequencing of test and advice, the government's guarantee role (calamity test, Braille version) and unclear status of observation instruments.
The SGP members are concerned that the government disregards the views of organisations such as the Onderwijsraad, PO-Raad and CPB.
De leden van de SGP-fractie tonen zich bezorgd dat de regering voorbijgaat aan de opvatting van organisaties en instanties als de Onderwijsraad, de PO-Raad en het CPB.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against proceeding with the bill to change primary-to-secondary school transition rules and abolish the central end-of-primary test, finding that the measures' effect on educational inequality is unproven, the delegation is excessive, and the test abolition premature. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted the advice on fixing key dates in law and on the Cito advisory role, but kept abolition of the central test and most of the reform, arguing the market now offers comparable tests.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the measures will actually reduce educational inequality, and the government concedes the effect is indirect and not always unambiguous while reframing the bill's main aim.
Essential timing elements were delegated to lower regulation, making the bill's practical effects and feasibility unclear; the government moved the key dates into the law itself.
The Afdeling advised against delegating the school advice, test and registration dates; the government accepted and fixed these three moments in the statute.
The Afdeling advised postponing abolition of the central end-of-primary test until private tests are demonstrably comparable over time; the government rejected this and proceeds with abolition.

Concentrating regulatory powers in the CvTE, an independent agency, limits parliamentary and ministerial control; the government clarified the powers and added ministerial approval for the assessment norms.
Regulatory powers granted to the CvTE should be narrowly limited to organisational or technical matters and regulations should be set by government or ministers.
The Afdeling advised keeping the term 'eindtoets' rather than renaming the test 'doorstroomtoets', seeing no substantive change warranting the rename; the government did not follow this.

35680.s: The bill amends the Dutch Foreign Workers Act to extend the maximum duration of work permits from one to three years, adds grounds for refusal such as failure to pay wages monthly or lack of economic activity, and requires wages to be paid by bank transfer. It also removes a provision of the Aliens Act 2000 and sets transitional rules for pending applications.
35680.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules by saying the ministerial regulation sets detail on wage-payment periods and the amvb sets exceptions for certain work categories, aiming at more worker protection and future-proof policy.
q: In cases to be designated by or pursuant to a general administrative order, the permit may be issued for less than three years.
In bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur aan te wijzen gevallen kan worden bepaald dat de vergunning voor minder dan drie jaar wordt afgegeven.
d: rules on application of the refusal ground
categories of work with permits shorter than three years
requirements for collective agreements on priority labour
p: I, C (art. 9, new subsections h and i)
Adds discretionary grounds allowing the employment agency to refuse permits when wages were not paid monthly or when the employer has no economic activity.
Extends the default permit duration to three years, reducing how often employers and workers face renewed administrative review of labour market conditions.

parties: Asks how the facultative refusal ground on priority labour supply will work, the criteria in the implementing regulation, and how security checks coordinate with intelligence services to prevent espionage misuse of labour migration.
In which cases does the government want applications to be approved that would have been rejected under the current framework?
In welke gevallen wil de regering dat aanvragen worden goedgekeurd, die onder het huidige kader zouden zijn afgekeurd?

Asks about the scale of exemptions from the work-permit obligation, what happens to permits after bankruptcy or takeover, and whether the advisory committee ACVZ's recommendations were rightly set aside.
Can the government further substantiate this position?
Kan de regering dit standpunt nader onderbouwen?

Welcomes the UWV's room for tailored decisions and the three-year permit duration, but asks which situations justify shorter permits, whether a prior-consultation (voorhang) applies, and how enforcement and fraud risk are divided between UWV and IND.
These members also ask whether a prior-consultation procedure (voorhang) applies to this limitation on the possibility of issuing the twv for three years.
Deze leden vragen ook of er een voorhang geldt voor deze beperking van de mogelijkheid om de twv voor drie jaar af te geven.

Finds the expansion of UWV discretion a substantial loosening and asks which criteria officials will use, questions whether indirect permits and posting abuse will decline, and asks whether asylum-seeker work restrictions conflict with EU law.
The proposed change is however a considerable expansion.
Voorgestelde wijziging is wel een flinke verruiming.
Questions the need for the bill and asks for data on applications, rejections, source countries and sectors, and whether longer permit duration fits a flexible scheme.
They ask why there is a need to relax the currently applicable rules for granting a work permit.
Zij vragen waarom er een noodzaak is tot versoepeling van de nu geldende regels voor het verschaffen van een tewerkstellingsvergunning.

Opposes a substantial increase in migrant workers, questions converting the mandatory refusal ground for insufficient recruitment efforts into a facultative one as encouraging complacency, and asks why a three-year duration and two-yearly UWV review were chosen.
Does this not encourage complacency, especially where the employer has made insufficient efforts?
Werkt dit geen gemakzucht in de hand, zeker als het gaat om de situatie waarin de werkgever onvoldoende inspanningen heeft verricht?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill amending the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen but asks the government to substantively respond to three points raised by the Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken rather than dismissing them. The government's nader rapport responds to each point, rejecting the ACVZ recommendations on the definition of the combined permit, the UWV's availability test, and asylum seekers' work access, and revises the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must give a substantive response to each recommendation of the ACVZ instead of merely stating it will not address the advice.
The ACVZ recommended aligning the definition of the combined residence and work permit with Directive 2011/98/EU, which the government declined as unnecessary.
The ACVZ recommended restoring the UWV's burden of proof by testing availability rather than presence of priority candidates, which the government declined.
The ACVZ argued the 24-week work limit for asylum seekers conflicts with the Reception Directive, which the government rejected as compliant.

35716.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by a third supplementary budget, adding extra funds for rapid COVID-19 testing in secondary, vocational and higher education. The changes take effect from 27 January 2021 and are set out in a budget table with amounts in thousands of euros.
35716.j: The memorandum justifies acting before parliamentary authorisation by arguing that urgent rapid-testing measures to restore in-person teaching cannot wait for formal approval by both chambers.
q: However, the implementation of the urgent measures included in this Supplementary Budget, namely rapid testing in secondary education, vocational education and higher education in connection with COVID-19, cannot wait for formal authorisation by both chambers of the States General.

Echter, de uitvoering van de spoedeisende maatregelen die in deze Incidentele Suppletoire Begroting zijn opgenomen, te weten sneltesten in het voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs in verband met COVID-19, kan niet wachten tot formele autorisatie van beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal.

35725.s: The bill makes a bundle of mainly technical and editorial amendments across education, higher education and related laws, chiefly replacing 'burgemeester en wethouders' with 'het college van burgemeester en wethouders' and fixing cross-references. It also adds a few substantive provisions, such as a school-attendance certificate (mbo-verklaring), an expanded list of valid absence grounds, and a new basis for schools to pass monitoring results to the inspectorate.
35725.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as technical clarification of existing practice and of the scope of the existing legal basis, without extensive reasoning.
q: With the amendment proposed here, existing practice is clarified and an explicit legal basis is provided for the obligation of active delivery.
Met de hier beoogde wetswijziging wordt de bestaande praktijk verduidelijkt en wordt voor de verplichting van een actieve levering alsnog een expliciete grondslag geregeld.
d: ARTIKEL VII (Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs BES, art. 7.4.8a lid 3-4)
content and model of the mbo certificate, categories of students
ARTIKEL XIII (Wet voortgezet onderwijs, art. 27a1 lid 10)
school board may extend the period of pregnancy-related absence
ARTIKEL XVII (Wet studiefinanciering BES, art. 2.9 lid 1 onder c)
criteria for comparable vocational or higher education
ARTIKEL IV (Leerplichtwet BES, art. 1 onder f sub 2 and art. 2 onder c)
p: Replaces an automatic repayment obligation on student loans with a discretionary possibility of waiving supplementary grants on request for debtors with insufficient income.
ARTIKEL XIII (Wet voortgezet onderwijs, art. 27a1 lid 10)
Gives the school board discretion to extend the statutory period of pregnancy-related absence if it deems this appropriate.

parties: Asks how many schools do not yet deliver safety monitor data to the Inspectorate and how results are made visible to parents and pupils.
How many schools are not yet doing this at the moment?
Hoeveel scholen doen dit momenteel nog niet?
Welcomes the clarified duty to deliver safety data but asks how the Inspectorate checked safety without this data and whether the bill adds tools against unsafe schools.
How has the Inspectorate checked social safety without these data?
Hoe heeft de Inspectie gecontroleerd op sociale veiligheid zonder deze gegevens?
Asks what the right to diploma recognition entails and the role of municipalities, including effects of tender procedures on small municipalities.
The CDA members ask what the right to diploma recognition entails and what the role of municipalities is in this.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen wat het recht op diplomaerkenning behelst en wat de rol van de gemeenten is in deze.
Objects that the merger change is reinstated through this bill after the Senate rejected the bill containing it, calling this unsuitable for a demissionary cabinet.
The members find this approach not suitable for a demissionary cabinet.
De leden vinden deze werkwijze niet passend voor een demissionair kabinet.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Verzamelwet OCW 20## (a collection bill of minor technical amendments in education, culture and media), raising three points: Papiamentu in mbo on Bonaire should be a separate bill, the evaluation clause for speciaal basisonderwijs should not be dropped without justification, and EU directive implementation should be split into a separate bill. The minister's nader rapport accepts all three points by removing the relevant parts from the collection bill and splitting off the EU implementation into separate bills.
concerns: Changing language-of-instruction rules for the public bodies through a collection bill is not the right instrument; a separate bill with a substantive analysis is needed, and the government removed this part.

Dropping the evaluation clause for speciaal basisonderwijs without a separate evaluation is not adequately justified, since results for regular primary education cannot simply be transferred; the government removed this change from the bill.
Implementing binding EU directives within a broader amendment bill conflicts with legislative policy; the government split the EU implementation into two separate bills.
Redactional remarks were incorporated and some cross-reference provisions were added to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35734.s: The bill implements EU Directives 2019/770 (digital content and services) and 2019/771 (sale of goods) into Dutch civil law, amending Book 7 of the Civil Code and the Consumer Protection Enforcement Act. It strengthens consumer rights on conformity, updates, commercial guarantees and remedies, and assigns enforcement to the ACM and AFM.
35734.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as required EU implementation and maximum harmonisation, with ACM feasibility testing noted, rather than as new executive powers.
q: The starting point of the directive is maximum harmonisation.
Het uitgangspunt van de richtlijn is maximumharmonisatie.
d: exclusions for digital content under other consumer rules
p: Assigns enforcement of consumer conformity rules to the ACM and AFM, creating a supervisory role for regulators protecting consumers rather than the executive.

parties: Asks whether the open EU update norm and the no-usage-fee rule could lead to unreasonable outcomes and whether Burgerlijk Wetboek remedies like error could undermine maximum harmonisation.
These members understand that this open norm will ultimately have to be filled in by the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) in concrete cases.
Deze leden begrijpen dat deze open norm ultimo door het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie (HvJEU) in concrete gevallen moet worden ingevuld.
Asks for stronger safeguards for consumers paying with personal data, such as a statutory cooling-off period and clearer price disclosure.
Should we not include better safeguards for this in the law, such as a statutory cooling-off period for products purchased with personal data?
Zouden we hier niet betere waarborgen voor moeten opnemen in de wet, zoals het ook laten gelden van een wettelijke bedenktijd voor producten die aangeschaft worden met persoonsgegevens?

Asks why the maximum harmonisation approach was chosen, whether the double explicitness test for waiving updates really protects consumers, and whether certain forms of paying with personal data could be deemed unreasonably burdensome.

These members share with VNO-NCW/MKB Nederland, Detailhandel Nederland, Techniek Nederland, the Raad Nederlandse Detailhandel (RND) and INRETAIL that this double explicitness test would benefit from further elaboration.

Deze leden delen met VNO-NCW/MKB Nederland, Detailhandel Nederland, Techniek Nederland, de Raad Nederlandse Detailhandel (RND) en INRETAIL dat deze dubbele uitdrukkelijkheidstoets gebaat zou zijn bij een verdere invulling.

Criticises the choice of a one-year rather than two-year burden-of-proof period, questions regulatory capacity of the data protection and consumer authorities, and urges national regulation of paying with personal data ahead of EU action.
The aforementioned members are very curious how the government intends to inform the public about these new rights.Ö
Voornoemde leden zijn erg benieuwd hoe de regering het publiek wil gaan informeren over deze nieuwe rechten.
Worries that consumers paying with personal data lack understanding of its value and privacy risks and may share data with third parties; asks whether additional consumer protection is possible.
These members would however point out that consumers who provide their personal data as 'payment' likely have no good idea of its value nor of the risks to their privacy that they thereby run.

Deze leden zouden er echter op willen wijzen dat de consumenten die zijn persoonsgegevens als «betaling» verschaft waarschijnlijk geen goed idee heeft wat de waarde daarvan is en ook niet welke risico’s tot aantasting van de persoonlijke levenssfeer hij daarmee loopt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the Dutch bill implementing EU Directives 2019/771 (sale of goods) and 2019/770 (digital content) raises concerns about personal data as counter-performance and the unclear relation between the tiered remedy system and the new immediate termination right for serious non-conformity. The government's reply accepts the clarification of the remedy relationship in the bill and explanatory memorandum, and explains it will explore further national measures on personal data while preferring an EU-level solution.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clarification of how the new immediate termination right in article 7:22 lid 5 BW relates to the tiered remedy system in lid 2, and the government amended the text and explanatory notes accordingly.

The Afdeling asked for the explanatory memorandum to address the regulation of personal data given as counter-performance, and the government agreed to further explore additional national measures while preferring EU-level regulation.
The Afdeling's redactional annex comments were largely adopted, though the suggested change to the text of article 7:18 lid 4 BW was not followed.

35770.s: The bill amends the Dutch Competition Act to explicitly exclude from the cartel prohibition certain conduct by farmers and fishers under the common agricultural and fisheries policies, and makes technical changes to merger control. It also extends the private enforcement rules of Book 6 of the Civil Code to purely national competition infringements.
35770.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementing the coalition agreement and clarifying an unclear EU-based exemption for agriculture, and it drops a contested one-year deadline after consultation criticism.
q: Our Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality shall announce in the Government Gazette the cases referred to in the first paragraph.
Onze Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit doet mededeling in de Staatscourant van de gevallen, bedoeld in het eerste lid.
d: minister announces by Staatscourant which cases are covered by the agricultural exemption

parties: Asks about the legal weight of the Staatscourant declaration and when the handreiking will be published.
This announcement has a purely declaratory character and no legal effects.
Deze mededeling heeft een zuiver declaratoir karakter geen rechtsgevolgen.
Asks why the exemption must be spelled out separately and how the government will address gaps in digital competition law raised in the earlier initiative note and motions.
These members ask the government to explain, motion by motion, how it is implementing the motions adopted during the treatment of the initiative note.
Tevens vragen deze leden de regering per motie uiteen te zetten hoe zij uitvoering geeft aan de moties die zijn aangenomen bij de behandeling van de initiatiefnota.
Welcomes the bill and the handreiking but asks how the list of agricultural products is kept accurate and updated with stakeholders.
Does the government expect discussion about this annex, and is the list sufficiently aligned with stakeholders for completeness?
Verwacht de regering discussie over deze bijlage en/of is de lijst voldoende afgestemd met stakeholders op volledigheid?
Questions whether the bill will actually strengthen primary producers' negotiating position and whether they will share in the benefits of sustainability and welfare standards.
How is the negotiating position of primary producers effectively strengthened?
Hoe wordt de onderhandelingspositie van primaire producenten effectief versterkt?
Asks whether temporary exemptions can be extended and notes the government's restraint on national legislation given EU law constraints.
The national legislator may not make decisions on points where EU law creates uncertainty, as that could render the national rules in conflict with EU law.

De nationale wetgever mag geen knopen doorhakken op de punten waarop het recht van de Europese Unie onduidelijkheden geeft om dat daarmee de betreffende nationale regelgeving strijdig met het unierecht zou kunnen zijn.
Supports the bill's aim of removing legal obstacles to cooperation and has no further questions at this stage.
These members support the aim of this bill.
Deze leden onderschrijven het doel van dit wetsvoorstel.

The fractie asks whether the designation of exempted cases under the Mededingingswet fits EU law, whether cases not named by the minister can still be subjected to competition review, and whether an ex ante exemption and court access are available to reduce risk-averse behaviour.
How can the government rule out that cases not named by the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality in the Staatscourant will nevertheless have to be subjected to a competition law review?

Hoe kan de regering uitsluiten dat gevallen die niet door de Minister van Landbouw- Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit in de Staatscourant genoemd worden alsnog aan een mededingingsrechtelijke toets onderworpen moeten worden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Mededingingswet (competition act) and Book 6 of the Civil Code to clarify the exclusion of agricultural and fisheries common policy conduct from the cartel ban and to enable private enforcement of competition law. The Afdeling raised no substantive remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, so no government reply was needed.

35806.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by adding a ninth supplementary budget for extra COVID-19 self-test funding in secondary vocational (mbo) and higher education. It takes effect from 13 April 2021 and makes the funding available for students and staff in recognised institutions.
35806.j: The memorandum justifies immediate implementation of the self-test measures because they cannot wait for formal authorisation by both chambers of the States General, given the need to keep higher education in person.
q: However, the implementation of the urgent measures included in this Supplementary Budget, namely self-tests in secondary vocational and higher education in connection with COVID-19, cannot wait for formal authorisation by both chambers of the States General.

Echter, de uitvoering van de spoedeisende maatregelen die in deze Incidentele Suppletoire Begroting zijn opgenomen, te weten zelftesten in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs in verband met COVID-19, kan niet wachten tot formele autorisatie van beide kamers der Staten-Generaal.

35815.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget (departmental budget statement) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding a sixth supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures totalling roughly EUR 700 million in additional spending. It takes effect retroactively from 23 April 2021 and is a budgetary adjustment with no new delegated rule-making powers.
35815.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by the continuing COVID-19 crisis and related staffing problems, with no delegation of powers.
q: Matching sometimes takes more time, and the crisis and related staffing problems still play a role.
Het matchen kost soms meer tijd en de crisis en bijbehorende personele problematiek speelt nog steeds een rol.

35824.s: The bill establishes a legal framework requiring healthcare providers to exchange designated patient data between care professionals via an electronic infrastructure, with interoperability standards and mandatory certification of IT products. It empowers the Minister to designate data exchanges, set requirements by general administrative order, appoint certifying bodies, and enforce compliance through instructions, penalties and fines.
35824.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for interoperable, timely data exchange in care that cannot be achieved by market parties alone, and says the Minister must keep stewardship oversight of the certification system.
q: Without government intervention, which keeps sight of the public interest in integrity, the risk remains that necessary information cannot be exchanged between care providers in a timely, uniform, understandable or complete manner.

Zonder interventie van de overheid, die zicht houdt op het (publieke) belang van de integraliteit, blijft het risico bestaan dat noodzakelijke informatie niet actueel, uniform, begrijpelijk of compleet tussen zorgverleners kan worden uitgewisseld.
d: designating data exchanges subject to obligations
requirements for functional, technical, organisational or interoperable data exchange
which parts of standards require IT product certification
deviating from the act for prison, youth and forensic institutions
deviating from the act for private forensic care where necessary
deviating from the act for military healthcare for operational reasons
temporarily waiving accreditation requirement for certifying bodies
rules on certifying bodies' applications, designation and certificates
rules on information processing for statutory tasks and policy
p: Designated officials may enter a dwelling without the occupant's consent where it forms part of a care facility.
Inspectors may access and take health data and override professional secrecy vis-a-vis the supervisory officials.
Minister may issue binding instructions, enforce by administrative coercion and impose penalty payments on providers.
Minister may impose administrative fines up to sixth-category fine or 10% of turnover on IT providers.
Minister may issue certificates directly, bypassing private certifying bodies, when continuity requires it.
Minister may allow continued use of products whose certificate was suspended or withdrawn beyond six months.
General rules on information processing for statutory tasks and policy-making may be set by general administrative order.
Act may be set aside by order in council for prisons, forensic care and military health care.

parties: Asks for an overview of lower-level regulation, parliamentary involvement via voorhang/nahang, and clarity on scope and timelines.

The VVD members want from the government an overview of the AMvBs, ministerial regulations and other lower-level regulation accompanying this law, including how the House is involved (e.g. voorhang or nahang procedure).
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen verder allereerst graag van de regering een overzicht van de met deze wet annex zijnde AMvB’s, ministeriële regelingen en eventuele andere lagere regelgeving.

Raises critical questions on whether full interoperability will be achieved, on the relation to patient-controlled health environments, and on the phased approach, and asks for scenarios and international comparison.

They nonetheless have several critical questions for the government, especially since many care parties regrettably find that full interoperability promised by this bill will not be achieved in the proposed way.

Zij hebben wel meerdere kritische vragen richting de regering, temeer omdat een groot aantal partijen in de zorg helaas constateren dat: «de volledige interoperabiliteit ... op de voorgestelde wijze niet gerealiseerd wordt.»

Finds mandatory electronic exchange goes too far, wants non-electronic exchange to remain possible, and raises concerns about data accuracy and the AP's objections about breaching professional secrecy.
These members support electronic data exchange but find the obligation goes quite far.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van elektronische gegevensuitwisseling, maar vinden verplichting wel erg ver gaan.
Supports faster exchange but questions the lack of binding infrastructure agreements, the pace of the timeline, enforcement by the Zorginstituut, and vendor pricing.
Why is the government not clearer in setting goals and timelines and why does it not sooner let the Zorginstituut use its power to enforce?
Waarom is de regering niet duidelijker in het stellen van doelen en tijdspaden en laat zij niet eerder het Zorginstituut doorzettingsmacht gebruiken?
Asks about patient consent, access limits to shared data, misuse safeguards, the involvement of care parties, and patients' GDPR rights to access, rectify and erase data.
How can the rights of patients under the GDPR, such as the right of access, rectification or erasure, be given effect within the system proposed by the government?
Hoe kan er binnen het door de regering voorgestelde systeem invulling worden gegeven aan de rechten van patiënten onder de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG)
Asks how European comparisons and the forthcoming EU health data proposal relate, and how patients' privacy and protection against misuse are guaranteed.
How is it ensured that patients know which care providers exchange and view which data? And how are patients protected against misuse?
Hoe wordt geborgd dat patiënten weten welke zorgverleners welke gegevens uitwisselen en inzien? En hoe worden patiënten beschermd tegen misbruik?

Opposes compulsion to work electronically with medical data, seeing it as a restriction on medical practice and pressure on patients, and asks why interoperability is not pursued through various channels.
These members are however not satisfied with the fact that electronic working is required in the exchange of data.
Deze leden zijn echter niet tevreden met het feit dat er gedwongen elektronisch gewerkt moet worden bij het uitwisselen van gegevens.

Supports the goal but doubts the feasibility of the long normalisation and certification track, and asks for the government's reflection on the Raad van State warning that the minister's regulatory role is constrained by stakeholder cooperation.
Has the government considered alternatives to achieve the desired interoperability?
Heeft de regering alternatieven overwogen om de gewenste interoperabiliteit te realiseren?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet elektronische gegevensuitwisseling in de zorg, which would let the minister require electronic exchange of designated health data and set interoperability standards, raising concerns about patient impact, the limits on ministerial steering, NEN-norm alignment, desinvestment risk and exclusive reliance on NEN norms. The minister's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adding patient-impact text, certificate and evaluation provisions, a broader norm-reference clause and MedMij alignment, while defending the single-norm approach and the phased track.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for explicit treatment of patient impact, information and the AVG safeguards; the government added text on rights and privacy by design but left concrete patient information to the AMvB notes.
The Afdeling flagged that the minister's steering role is limited by stakeholder cooperation and draagvlak, risking full interoperability; the government defended the phased, bottom-up approach.

The Afdeling asked that criteria for designating track 1 or track 2 and transition deadlines be placed in the statute; the government replaced 'criteria' with invalshoeken and set a one-year target in the explanatory memorandum without a statutory deadline.

The Afdeling asked that normative richtinggevende kaders be placed in the statute for parliamentary involvement; the government clarified them as non-binding guidance and pointed to a voorhang procedure.
The Afdeling objected to exclusive, binding reference to NEN norms restricting free movement and foreign norms; the government added a clause allowing other European and international norms.
The Afdeling warned of desinvestment risk for providers investing under track 1 not aligned with track 2; the government added explanation and stakeholder involvement but no firm safeguard.
The Afdeling noted the relation to MedMij agreements and the need to explain it; the government added explanatory text and the richtinggevend kader on MedMij.

35830-V.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting obligations, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2020

35833.s: The bill amends the Dutch Youth Act and related laws to allow foster care to be extended by default up to age 21, and removes the requirement to submit a verleningsbeschikking (grant decision) when requesting court orders for out-of-home placement or closed youth care. It also adds a procedure for young people to end foster care at 18, and lets certified institutions request certain court orders.
35833.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies removing the grant decision by reducing administrative burden for municipalities and applicants, while stating that the judicial review of placement orders is retained.
q: With this bill the government does not affect the judicial review of orders for out-of-home placement and closed youth care.
Met dit wetsvoorstel toornt de regering niet aan de rechterlijke toets bij machtigingen tot uithuisplaatsing en gesloten jeugdhulp.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel D/F (artikel 6.1.2 and 6.1.4 Jw)

Removes the requirement for a municipal grant decision before a court can issue an out-of-home placement or closed youth care order, streamlining the route to judicial authorisation while the court review remains in place.

parties: Asks about financial consequences and whether the age limit and reflection moments should be fixed more concretely in law, mainly to avoid abrupt endings.
These members do ask, however, what the financial consequences are of changing the age limit to 23 years.
Genoemde leden vragen echter wel wat de financiële gevolgen zijn van de wijziging van de leeftijdsgrens naar 23 jaar.
Asks about the rights of young people up to 21, the pressure of decision moments, and the effect of continued foster care on later independence.
The D66 members emphasise the legal position of young people, also up to 21 years of age.
De leden van de D66-fractie benadrukken de rechtspositie van jeugdigen, ook tot 21 jaar.
Asks for justification that removing the extension decision for placement orders has no added value, given the serious nature of out-of-home placement.
These members would welcome further explanation showing that this decision really has no added value, because it concerns a very far-reaching decision, namely out-of-home placement.

Genoemde leden ontvangen graag een nadere toelichting waaruit blijkt dat deze beschikking werkelijk geen toegevoegde waarde heeft, omdat het hier om een zeer ingrijpende beslissing gaat, namelijk een uithuisplaatsing.
Welcomes greater certainty but regrets that the legal position of the young person in extended foster care is not clarified and asks why the age was not raised to 23.
Can the government explain why it did not follow this advice?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom zij dit advies niet heeft opgevolgd?

Worries that removing the extension decision and lacking an appeal against extended placement weakens review of necessity and proportionality, and asks about benefit consequences and objectivity of assessments.
These members ask the government how it can better guarantee that the children's judge can weigh all objections against the decision to place a child in closed youth care or out of home.
Deze leden vragen de regering op welke wijze beter gewaarborgd kan worden dat de kinderrechter alle bezwaren kan wegen tegen het besluit om een kind in gesloten jeugdhulp of uit huis te plaatsen.
Supports the extension but asks whether removing the extension decision could weaken the young person's and parents' right to object and review necessity and proportionality.
Can the government guarantee that deleting this extension decision does not diminish the legal position of the young person and parents and their ability to object?
Kan de regering garanderen dat het schrappen van deze verleningsbeschikking niets afdoet aan de rechtspositie van de jeugdige en de ouders en de mogelijkheid om in bezwaar te gaan?
Supports the extension but argues the age limit should be abolished or raised to 23 as the norm, that young people should decide when to stop, and that financial penalties deter foster parents.
As far as this member is concerned, the possibility of foster care up to age 23 should therefore not be an exception but the norm, since the human brain is still fully developing in those years.

Wat genoemd lid betreft zou de mogelijkheid van pleegzorg tot het 23e jaar dan ook geen uitzondering maar de norm moeten zijn, aangezien het menselijk brein ook in die jaren nog volop in ontwikkeling is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, without any remarks, that the bill extending foster care duration and abolishing the admission order for compulsory placement and closed youth care be submitted to parliament. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes that the samenloop provisions with the Wetsvoorstel rechtspositie gesloten jeugdhulp were removed and will be regulated in that later bill.

35842.s: The bill amends the earlier merger bill for Boxmeer, Cuijk, Mill en Sint Hubert and Sint Anthonis so that the municipality of Grave is added to the new municipality, updating the name, preamble, articles and map accordingly. It enters into force together with the original merger bill and contains no new executive powers.
35842.j: The memorandum justifies adding Grave by arguing that its later accession removes the earlier concern about the durability of the merger, and that Grave's financial supervision is manageable.
q: Now that Grave has nevertheless decided to join this merger, the government's reservation about the durability of this merger lapses.
Nu Grave alsnog heeft besloten zich bij deze herindeling aan te sluiten, vervalt de kanttekening van de regering over de duurzaamheid van deze herindeling.

parties: Asks how Grave's worsened finances, under provincial preventive financial supervision, and the bankruptcy of a shipyard will affect the new municipality's finances.
The VVD members ask the government to elaborate on the consequences of the deteriorated financial situation of the municipality of Grave for the new municipality Land van Cuijk.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de gevolgen van de verslechterde financiële situatie van de gemeente Grave voor de nieuw te vormen gemeenten Land van Cuijk
Welcomes the step as a democratic process with support among residents and recalls the parliamentary motion requiring preparation in cooperation with the province.
The D66 members are pleased that this step is being taken, based on a democratic process and with support among residents.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn blij dat deze stap wordt gezet, op basis van een democratisch proces en met draagvlak onder de inwoners.
Views merger as a choice from below and finds it sensible given Grave's financial and administrative problems, citing the resident poll results.
The CDA members are of the view that a merger should in principle be a choice from below.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn van mening dat herindeling in principe een keuze van onderop moet zijn.
Advocates mergers from below in which residents are asked their opinion, and sees that happening here, so has no further questions.
The said members always advocate mergers from below, in which residents must be asked their opinion.
De genoemde leden pleiten altijd voor herindelingen van onderop, waarbij de inwoners moet worden gevraagd om hun mening.

Asks whether novelles have occurred before and what lessons apply, and how the partner municipalities will safeguard Grave residents' interests and whether a framework exists for shared administrative services.
Can the government specify exactly what will happen to safeguard these interests as well as possible?
Kan de regering concretiseren wat er precies gaat gebeuren om deze belangen zo goed mogelijk te borgen?

35850-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget (first supplementary budget) for the other high state bodies, the governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, raising expenditure and commitments by about EUR 10.5 million for the Raad van State and smaller amounts for the Ombudsman and other bodies. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2021, and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
35850-IIB.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the increased budget of the Raad van State by professionalisation of advisory work and new tasks under the Climate Act and the Open Government Act.
q: The Raad van State incurs structurally higher advisory costs due to the professionalisation that has taken place.
De Raad van State maakt structureel meer kosten voor advisering door de professionalisering die plaats heeft gevonden.

35851.s: The bill amends the Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders to implement EU Directive 2019/1937 on whistleblower protection, extending reporting channels, confidentiality duties, and protection measures to reports of EU-law violations. It designates several supervisory authorities as external reporting channels and adds protections such as a burden-shifting presumption of retaliation and immunity from liability.
35851.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated designation and the discretion to decline reports by pointing to the directive's requirements and the need for proportionate handling given limited capacity.
d: designating additional competent authorities as external reporting channels
further requirements for the internal whistleblower register
requirements for training of designated staff of competent authorities
p: Authorities may decline to follow up reports of minor significance or repeated reports without new facts, while informing the reporter of reasons.
Competent authorities may be designated by general administrative order or ministerial regulation, extending the reach of the reporting regime.

parties: Asks whether the Directive is adequately and clearly transposed and what protection level whistleblowers should have.
First, they ask the government to state whether it itself considers the Directive adequately, sufficiently and clearly transposed.
Allereerst vragen zij de regering om aan te geven of zij zelf de mening is toegedaan dat voornoemde Richtlijn adequaat, voldoende en duidelijk is omgezet?
Worried about the bill's content and timing; asks whether amendment is needed before parliamentary treatment and whether protection is sufficient.
They ask the government to respond and consider whether amending the bill is not desirable before the House of Representatives continues its treatment.
Zij verzoeken de regering hier op te reageren en te overwegen of aanpassing van het wetsvoorstel niet wenselijk is alvorens het door de Tweede Kamer verder te laten behandelen.
Regrets decoupling from the Huis evaluation and the complexity created by two regimes; asks whether the implementation deadline can be extended.
Is the government willing to request an extension of the implementation deadline so the evaluation of the Huis voor klokkenluiders can be included in this bill?
Is de regering bereid verruiming te verzoeken van de implementatietermijn, zodat de evaluatie van het Huis voor klokkenluiders kan worden betrokken bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel?
Says the bill weakens whistleblower protection and wants withdrawal; objects to unequal protection between EU-law breaches and national misconduct.
With the present proposal, in which the government makes incomprehensible choices, protection for whistleblowers is weakened rather than strengthened.
Met het voorliggende voorstel, waarbij de regering onnavolgbare keuzes maakt, wordt de bescherming voor klokkenluiders eerder verzwakt, dan versterkt.
Welcomes the Directive but worries about rushed implementation, legal uncertainty from the two definitions, and the requirement of major public interest.
They think more time should be taken and the recommendations from the evaluation of the Huis voor klokkenluiders should be weighed in implementation.
Zij vinden dat er meer tijd moet worden genomen en dat de aanbevelingen uit de «Evaluatie Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders» moeten worden gewogen bij de implementatie.
Doubts the bill provides adequate safeguards, fears juridification and fragmented external channels, and asks for a broader integral revision.
They seriously doubt whether this bill provides the necessary safeguards.
Zij betwijfelen ten zeerste of dit wetsvoorstel in de benodigde borging voorziet.
Asks why the bill does not harmonise definitions of breaches of EU law and national misconduct and why the public-interest requirement is kept.
Why did the government not choose harmonisation here?
Waarom heeft de regering hier niet gekozen voor harmonisatie?
Asks about protection scope, the burden of proof for whistleblowers, and whether support and legal aid are adequate.
Says the law is not written from the whistleblower's perspective, is hard to read because it constantly refers to the Directive, and needs clearer channels and oversight of internal channels.
The legislation is not written from the perspective of the whistleblower.
De wetgeving is niet geschreven vanuit het perspectief van de klokkenluider.
Asks whether the bill complies with the EU Directive and whether the criteria for 'maatschappelijk belang' should be fixed in the statute, following the Council of State's advice.
The VVD members ask whether the bill as it now stands, after the two amendment notes, complies with the European Directive.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of het wetsvoorstel zoals het er nu ligt, na de twee nota's van wijziging, aan de Richtlijn vanuit Europa voldoet.
Argues that whistleblowers lack financial, legal and psychosocial support and that the 'maatschappelijk belang' criterion deters reporting; asks for these protections to be anchored in the law.
Asks why the limits described in the explanatory memorandum on internal rules are not written into the statute and why the Directive's wider list of reprisals is not fully reflected.
They ask why the limits indicated in the explanatory memorandum are not included in the statutory text.
Zij vragen waarom de in de toelichting aangegeven grenzen niet in de wettekst zijn opgenomen.
Criticises the requirement of a public interest in the definition of misstand and the absence of sanction powers for the Huis voor Klokkenluiders, and calls for a support fund.
These members ask the government how it sees this.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe zij dit ziet.
Asks whether a set of criteria defining 'public interest', as in the UK, could be included in the bill.
Can the government elaborate on this and indicate to what extent those criteria could also find a place in your bill?
Kan de regering hier nader op ingaan en aangeven in hoeverre die criteria ook in uw wetsvoorstel een plaats zouden kunnen krijgen?
Asks for a clearer statutory definition of misstand, questions the scope of the Huis's preventive task, and asks why anonymous reporting is still allowed.
Member Omtzigt asks the government not to postpone establishing a fund for whistleblowers any longer.
Hij verzoekt de regering om het instellen van een fonds voor klokkenluiders niet langer uit te stellen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the bill implementing EU Directive 2019/1937 on whistleblower protection, raising concerns about the loss of mandatory internal reporting, unclear external reporting regimes, the list of competent authorities, the legal basis of bejegeningsonderzoek, and the prohibition on gag clauses. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted several points, such as the open-culture discussion, the reporting-motivation issue, the bejegeningsonderzoek clarification and gag clause analysis, but rejected others, notably the uniform external reporting regime and the motivation requirement for direct external reports.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that the divergent external reporting regimes for EU-law infringements and national-law misstanden make the law harder to apply, recommending a uniform regime; the government rejected this but added clarifications to the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling asked for more attention in the explanatory memorandum to how an open, safe organisational culture, especially in government, can keep internal reporting the practical starting point; the government added text and a new section 3.4.3.

The Afdeling asked for clarity on the statutory basis of the bejegeningsonderzoek and whether external channel requirements and the burden-of-proof presumption apply to it; the government clarified it is not support under Article 20 and fixed the reference via Article 4a.

The Afdeling suggested that reporters who report directly externally should be asked to motivate this; the government rejected a motivation requirement as incompatible with supervisory and enforcement roles, but pointed to the Huis's role in encouraging internal reporting.

The Afdeling asked that more authorities, such as the Inspectie SZW, NVWA and ILT, be designated as competent authorities; the government designated the Autoriteit Nucleaire Veiligheid en Stralingsbescherming and explained why others are designated at ministry level.

The Afdeling noted that the general civil-law provision (art. 3:40 BW) may not be sufficiently clear for the directive's ban on gag clauses and asked for more explanation of monitoring; the government added reference to art. 6:248(2) BW and an evaluation provision.

35905.s: The bill extends the freeze of the mandatory health insurance deductible (verplicht eigen risico) for 2022 by changing the year list in article 19(7) of the Health Insurance Act. It also repeals an earlier transitional article so that the freeze provision does not lapse on 1 January 2022, and enters into force the day after publication.
35905.j: The memorandum justifies the change as keeping the deductible unchanged for 2022 and avoiding a legal gap, without new executive powers.
q: In article 19(7) of the Health Insurance Act, 'the years 2019, 2020 and 2021' is replaced by 'the years 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022'.
In artikel 19, zevende lid, van de Zorgverzekeringswet wordt «de jaren 2019, 2020 en 2021» vervangen door «de jaren 2019, 2020, 2021 en 2022».

parties: Satisfied with the implementation of the motion to freeze the deductible and has no further questions.
They are satisfied with the implementation of the motion, adopted by unanimous vote, to freeze the mandatory deductible for health insurance for 2022, and have no further questions.

Zij zijn tevreden over de uitwerking van de motie, die met algemene stemmen is aangenomen, over bevriezen van het verplicht eigen risico voor de zorgverzekering voor het jaar 2022, en hebben geen verdere vragen.
Asks clarifying questions on whether intake and treatment in GGZ trigger two deductibles and whether the problems can be fixed before 2022.
They wonder whether someone who has an intake in one year and treatment in another must pay the deductible twice.](Nevertheless)
Zij vragen zich af of iemand die een intake heeft in het ene jaar en een behandeling in het andere jaar, twee keer eigen risico moeten betalen.
Supports the bill and asks how much extra the new GGZ payment model costs patients.
These members support the bill and believe choices about further adjustments to the deductible are for a new cabinet.
Deze leden steunen het wetsvoorstel en zijn van mening dat keuzes over verdere aanpassingen van het eigen risico aan een nieuw kabinet is.
Supports the freeze but wants the deductible abolished entirely and asks about the effects on chronic psychiatric patients avoiding care.
Said members have noted with concern the report that chronic psychiatric patients will have to pay the annual deductible.
Genoemde leden hebben met verontrusting kennisgenomen van het bericht dat chronisch psychiatrische patiënten jaarlijks eigen risico moeten gaan betalen.
Opposes deductibles for low and middle incomes, warns of care avoidance, and asks for compensation for GGZ patients who must pay more.
Is it correct that about 100,000 GGZ patients will have to pay more deductible?
Klopt het dat circa 100.000 patiënten in de GGZ straks meer eigen risico moeten betalen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill freezing the mandatory health insurance deductible for 2022 needed a fuller motivation, since it adds to collective care costs, may weaken the deductible's effectiveness in curbing care use, and leaves unclear how structural policy and targeted support for vulnerable groups will be handled. The government's reply accepted that the explanatory memorandum needed supplementing, added points on compensation schemes and the 2022 compensation, but declined to set out a long-term vision given its caretaker status, calling the bill a bridging law.
concerns: The Afdeling said a freeze shifts costs to premium payers, weakens the deductible's steering effect, and that a fuller justification in the explanatory memorandum was missing; the government added a note on the cost effects but gave no separate motivation beyond the parliamentary motion.

The Afdeling asked whether targeted support for the small group facing unavoidable high care costs would work better than a general freeze; the government pointed to existing compensation schemes and added a paragraph on them.

The Afdeling noted that stacking incidental measures leaves no clear structural policy on co-payments and protecting vulnerable groups; the government declined to present a long-term vision given its caretaker status.

35923.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security by a supplementary budget of 45 million euros to support enforcement of COVID-19 entry certificates (coronatoegangsbewijzen), with retroactive effect to 24 September 2021. Funds are channelled through the Veiligheidsregio to municipalities to hire security staff and hosts for checks.
35923.j: The memorandum justifies the early disbursement of funds by the need to support enforcement on time, before formal parliamentary authorisation by both Houses.
q: The government considers it desirable, in anticipation of formal authorisation by both Houses, to provide the contribution so that support for compliance with the control of the measures takes place in good time.

De regering acht het wenselijk om – vooruitlopend op formele autorisatie door beide Kamers – de bijdrage te verstrekken ten einde de ondersteuning van de naleving op de controle van de maatregelen tijdig te laten plaatsvinden.

35932.s: The bill lowers the tariff of the rental housing levy (verhuurderheffing) from 0.527 to 0.485 in response to the rent freeze. It also changes the date rule so that levy reductions can be adjusted on the first day of any month rather than only quarterly.
q: Article 1.7 is amended by replacing 0.527 with 0.485.
A In artikel 1.7 wordt «0,527» vervangen door «0,485».

parties: Asks how the motion to cut the levy by 500 million will be implemented and whether rising WOZ values will erode the 180 million relief.
Doesn't the 180 million relief evaporate because the levy base rises through the WOZ valuation increase?
Verdampt de 180 miljoen tegemoetkoming niet doordat de grondslag voor de verhuurderheffing stijgt door de Waardering Onroerende Zaken (WOZ)-stijging?
Asks to what extent all housing corporations are assured their financial position is maintained by the reduction.
These members ask to what extent this provides for all corporations so that their financial position is maintained through this reduction.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre hiermee voor alle corporaties wordt voorzien dat hun financiële positie door middel van deze verlaging op peil wordt gehouden.
Asks how the 500 million cut from the motion will be realised and whether it affects this bill.
Can the government explain to these members how this reduction will be realised and whether it also has consequences for the present bill?
Kan de regering aan deze leden aangeven hoe deze verlaging gerealiseerd zal worden gerealiseerd en of die verlaging mede gevolgen heeft voor onderhavig wetsvoorstel?
Welcomes the cut as a step in the right direction, preferring full abolition, and asks whether the 180 million is structural while the 500 million is one-off.
Although these members would prefer to abolish the levy entirely, for now a reduction is also a step in the right direction.
Hoewel deze leden de verhuurderheffing liever in zijn geheel zouden willen afschaffen is voor nu ook een verlaging een stap in de goede richting
Asks for data on rent freezes, rent increases despite the freeze, the financial effects on landlords, and how the WOZ value could be frozen to avoid overshooting the 900 million target.
These members further want to know how the WOZ value for corporations can be frozen and whether the government is willing to implement this measure.
Deze leden willen voorts weten op welke manier de WOZ-waarde voor corporaties kan worden bevroren en of de regering bereid is om deze maatregel door te voeren.
Says the cut is a drop in the ocean and insufficient for the housing shortage, asking why full abolition is not chosen.
The PvdA members note that the rate reduction is merely a drop in the ocean and insufficient to remedy the large housing shortage.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie stellen vast dat de tariefsverlaging maar een druppel op een gloeiende plaat is en ontoereikend is om het grote tekort aan woningen te verhelpen.
Asks about the political majority favouring full abolition and how the motion relates to the structural 180 million cut.
The GroenLinks members also ask how the adopted Hermans motion relates to the structural 180 million euro from the submitted bill.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen voorts hoe de aangenomen motie-Hermans zich verhoudt tot de structurele 180 miljoen euro uit het ingediende wetsvoorstel.
Sees the bill as a first step and asks whether further reduction or abolition is needed and by when.
These members see this as an important first step and stress the importance of reducing or abolishing the rental levy even further.
