Deze leden zien dit als een belangrijke eerste stap en benadrukken het belang van het nog verder verlagen dan wel afschaffen van de verhuurderheffing
Welcomes any reduction but argues the levy has no right to exist and should be fully abolished, given its effects on social rental housing.
The BIJ1 member welcomes every reduction of the unsustainable and indefensible rental levy.
Het lid van de BIJ1-fractie staat positief tegenover elke afname van de onhoudbare en onverdedigbare verhuurderheffing.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, without any remarks, that the bill amending the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II (lowering the verhuurderheffing rate and annual adjustment of tax-reduction amounts) be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) was not needed as the advice raised no points, and the minister merely forwarded the bill with minor editorial improvements to the explanatory memorandum.

35941.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget schedule (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adding an eleventh incidental supplementary budget for compensation of unplaced cultural activities, effective from 13 October 2021. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget schedule of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the corresponding schedule attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35950.s: The bill amends several Dutch financial supervision laws, mainly to allow certain financial firms to hold client funds in a separate ring-fenced account, to create a reserve and multi-year spreading of supervisor fee shortfalls, to require audits of payment and e-money institutions' financial statements, and to restore publication powers for non-compliance with information duties. It also makes numerous technical and cross-reference corrections.
35950.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and reserve mechanism by the need to avoid large fluctuations in supervisory fees caused by incidental costs, with ministerial approval as a safeguard.
q: To absorb large fluctuations in the fees caused by incidental costs, this bill introduces two instruments.
Om grote schommelingen in de heffingen door incidentele kosten op te vangen, introduceert dit wetsvoorstel twee instrumenten.
d: maximum size of supervisor fee reserve
rules on structure, administration and management of separate-assets account
conditions attached to central bank separate-assets accounts
designating other categories of financial firms subject to separate-assets rules
information to report and conditions for changes by data reporting providers
approval to spread supervisor fee surplus over several years
ministerial approval for use of the fee reserve
p: Creates separate-assets accounts that ring-fence client funds from the firm's insolvency estate, strengthening client protection against the firm's creditors.
Gives supervisors discretion to build a reserve and allows ministers to approve spreading fee surpluses over several years, with ministerial approval required for use of the reserve.</description_en

parties: Asks how the reserve maximum of 5 million euro was set, the criteria for using it, and whether foreign licensing criteria are equivalent, raising oversight of cross-border licensing.
Can the government specifically state what the maximum of 5 million euro is based on and how this amount was arrived at?
Kan de regering specifiek benoemen waar het maximum van 5 miljoen euro op gebaseerd is en hoe dit bedrag tot stand is gekomen?
Asks how supervision of licensing quality in other member states is ensured and how fraudulent use of cross-border funds is prevented.
How is supervision arranged over the quality of licensing in other member states?
Hoe is het toezicht geregeld op de kwaliteit van de vergunningsverlening in andere lidstaten?
Asks how it is ensured that client money is used only for client purposes and how limited supervisory control over foreign fund managers is.
to what extent sufficient control by the Dutch supervisors is possible over these foreign managers
in hoeverre voldoende controle door de Nederlandse toezichthouden mogelijk is op deze buitenlandse beheerders
Asks whether the bill amounts to loosening of financial markets and whether the separate-assets arrangement weakens bankruptcy protection.
These members ask the government to confirm that this amending bill does not mean loosening financial markets.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering om een bevestiging dat deze wijzigingswet niet het versoepelen betekent van financiële markten.
Asks for numbers of client-money foundations and expected uptake, and the bill's contribution to combating money laundering.
What does the government expect the contribution of the proposed amendment to be to combating money laundering or terrorism?
Wat verwacht de regering dat de bijdrage zal zijn van de voorgestelde wijziging aan de bestrijding van witwassen of terrorismebestrijding?
Asks whether the implementation is correct in practice, whether the reserve has conditions, and whether the measures reduce or increase regulatory burden.
This member asks whether the government can explain whether this implementation leads to more or less regulatory burden.
Het lid van de BBB-fractie vraagt of de regering nader kan toelichten of deze implementatie voor meer of minder regeldruk zorgt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises proceeding with the Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2022 but asks for clarification in the explanatory memorandum on how the separate-asset account (rekening met afgescheiden vermogen) works, especially when held with a foreign bank. The minister's reply, dated 19 October 2021, narrows the bank location requirement back to banks seated in the Netherlands, explains the choice, and makes the requested drafting corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for clarity on how the exception to ordinary Civil Code creditor recovery rules works, particularly when the account is held with a bank in another EU member state where Dutch law may not apply.
The Afdeling notes a redactional point on article III, and the government amends it to keep article 3.9a rather than 3.10(3) of the Wwft BES.

36067.s: The bill replaces the defined-benefit and capital-based pension arrangements in the Pensioenwet with three types of defined-contribution agreements (solidaire premieovereenkomst, flexibele premieovereenkomst, premie-uitkeringsovereenkomst), introduces collective risk-sharing reserves and a transition framework with milestones, and standardises survivor's pensions. It also amends the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling and adds experiment provisions for self-employed pension saving and a shorter waiting period for temporary agency workers.
36067.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical detail on scenarios, tariffs and transition, and the experiment by the aim of stimulating pension saving among self-employed workers.
q: Further rules on this article, including on the scenario analysis and allocation rules, are set by or pursuant to a general administrative order.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot dit artikel over onder meer de scenario-analyse en de toedelingsregels.
d: rules on scenario analysis and allocation rules for solidaire premieovereenkomst
rules on tariffs for fixed benefits in flexibele premieovereenkomst
Artikel I, Art. 16 lid 7 / Art. 2a lid 7
further rules on joint household and partner definitions
experiment deviating from specified articles for self-employed pension scheme
rules on conduct of pension experiment and unforeseen cases
risk-adjusted economic scenarios for transition effects and collective value transfer
further rules on calculation of transition effects
rules on periodic fixed decrease and projection return
rules on determining risk appetite per age cohort
which actuarial statements are provided and their content and periodicity
approval requirements and rules for solidarity and risk-sharing reserves set by pension fund
p: Transition rules allow temporary deviation from the regular financial assessment framework and let employers and social partners shift participants' accrued rights, with limited individual objection rights replaced by advisory and internal-supervision safeguards.
An AMvB may depart from several Pensioenwet articles for up to five years to test pension schemes for self-employed, with a report to parliament before expiry.
Option for partial exchange of old-age pension for partner pension and a dispute body requirement with a sunset date, weakening some prior protections while adding a complaints route.

parties: Asks how transparency and understanding for members can be ensured given the complexity of the reform, and about per-cohort effects and costs of running two systems in parallel.
How will the government ensure that this fundamental system change does not hinder transparency and understanding, especially among members?
Hoe gaat zij ervoor zorgen dat deze fundamentele stelselwijziging de transparantie en het begrip van met name deelnemers niet in de weg staat?
Asks how youth and other member groups are represented in negotiations and whether representation and trust in social partners are actually realised for all groups.
These members therefore ask the government to explain how representativeness of and trust in social partners is actually achieved for all groups of members.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarom aan te geven hoe representativiteit van en vertrouwen in sociale partners voor alle groepen deelnemers ook daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd wordt.
Objects that the bill is being rushed through parliament, that experts cannot yet assess its consequences, and that members are insufficiently informed, calling for more time for careful scrutiny.
Every opposition proposal in procedural meetings for a thorough treatment has been effectively blocked.
Ieder voorstel vanuit de oppositie tijdens procedurevergaderingen voor een gedegen behandeling is vakkundig geblokkeerd.
Asks about the effects of the new system on seniors versus staying in the old system, inflation protection, and consequences for the first pillar (AOW).
can the government explain the advantages and/or disadvantages for this group (e.g. 70/75+) of invaren compared with remaining in the current system?
kan de regering toelichten wat de voor- en/of nadelen zijn voor deze groep (bv. 70/75+) van invaren ten opzichte van achterblijven in het huidige stelsel?
Condemns the rushed treatment, claims key information, data and models are missing or withheld, and says the minister refuses to provide openness, hindering parliament's controlling role.
Underlying information, data, models, statements and related legislation are missing because they are not finished, studies are ongoing, or they are simply being withheld.
Onderliggende informatie, data, modellen, uitspraken en samenhangende wetgeving missen omdat zij nog niet af zijn, onderzoeken lopen of deze simpelweg achtergehouden worden.
Asks for a mapping of the reform's measures against the problems of the current system and for data on the pension landscape and on self-employed and flexworkers' accrual.
These members ask the government to present in a concise overview how the measures in the bill can be linked to the problems of the current system.
Deze leden vragen de regering om in een beknopt overzicht weer te geven hoe de maatregelen uit het wetsvoorstel gelinkt kunnen worden aan de problemen met het huidige stelsel.
Asks about macroeconomic effects of Dutch pension saving, procyclicality of variable benefits, and the lack of measures for flexworkers' pension accrual.
These members ask the government to reflect on these problems.
Deze leden vragen de regering op deze problemen te reflecteren.
Supports the pension agreement and the stated goals, and asks for clarification on the scope, contractor and goals of monitoring the transition.
These members are curious whether the government can provide further explanation on the content, contractor and goals of the monitoring.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd of de regering een nadere toelichting kan geven op de inhoud, opdrachtnemerschap en doelen van de monitoring.
Questions the economic foundations and modelling assumptions of the bill and the valuation methods used by DNB, asking the government to respond to critiques.
request the government to respond to the claim that valuing a pension benefit can only be done correctly in one way
verzoeken de regering te reageren op de stelling dat het waarderen van een pensioenuitkering slechts op één manier correct kan geschieden

Argues that invaren of accrued rights without explicit member consent is a major legal and constitutional risk, asks for a consent vote and a plain-language guide, and says the timeline prevents parliament's controlling role.
Member Omtzigt asks the government to reconsider this and to submit the invaren decision explicitly to participants for consent.
Het lid Omtzigt vraagt de regering dit te heroverwegen en het invaarbesluit expliciet voor te leggen aan de deelnemers voor instemming.
Asks whether transition rules fairly distribute collective reserve filling between pension scheme types and whether arrangements are balanced across objectives.
These members ask whether participants in premium schemes thereby unfairly benefit from contributions from defined-benefit schemes.
Deze leden vragen of hierdoor de deelnemers van premieregelingen niet op oneerlijke wijze profiteren van de storting vanuit uitkeringsregelingen.
Asks for transparency, youth involvement, communication about causes of underindexation and how interests of all participants are safeguarded.
These members understand that the pension system debate should not be conducted on the basis of current or expected economic factors.
Deze leden begrijpen dat de discussie over het pensioenstelsel niet gevoerd moet worden op basis van de huidige of verwachte economische factoren.
Criticises the government's refusal to engage with expert concerns and its rushed timetable, and asks for measures to prevent cuts during the transition.
The government does not seriously engage at all with the concerns held by pension experts and these members about the Wet toekomst pensioenen.
De regering gaat op geen enkele wijze serieus in op de zorgen die leven bij pensioenexperts en deze leden over de Wet toekomst pensioenen.
Asks how the government will monitor whether Pensioenakkoord goals are actually achieved and how it will steer on bottlenecks.
How does the government intend to keep track of whether the goals, preconditions and intended results of the Pensioenakkoord are actually realised?
Hoe denkt de regering zicht te houden of de doelen, de randvoorwaarden en de beoogde resultaat vanuit het Pensioenakkoord daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd?
Argues the bill is full of open ends and unanswered questions, so the Chamber cannot properly assess it, eroding parliamentary control.
These members therefore consider it impossible for anyone at present to assess the law in its entirety and thereby observe an erosion of the Chamber's position and of democracy as a whole.

Deze leden achten het dan ook voor niemand mogelijk om op dit moment de wet in haar totaliteit te beoordelen en constateren daarmee een uitholling van de positie van de Kamer in het specifiek en de democratie als geheel.
Asks macroeconomic questions about capital funding, savings, procyclicality and self-employed pension coverage.
These members ask whether it is known how many self-employed people are currently building up pension, separately from accrued pension entitlements.
Deze leden vragen of bekend is hoeveel zelfstandigen op dit moment pensioen opbouwen, los van al opgebouwde pensioenaanspraken.

Warns that economic scenario sets used by the Commissie Parameters and DNB, not designed for policy, will effectively drive pension fund investment policy and redistribution, and asks for justification of model uncertainty.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on the Wet toekomst pensioenen, which replaces defined-benefit schemes with premium schemes, stresses the need for clear transition rules, supervision and communication, and raises objections on the flexible premium scheme's compatibility with EU competition law, the solidarity reserve, the transition funding test, the two valuation methods and the net pension and net annuity tax arrangements. The government reply largely accepts the advice on transparency, DNB supervision, the flexible premium scheme's solidarity elements and the solidarity reserve, while rejecting abolition of the net pension schemes and maintaining both valuation methods.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the flexible premium scheme's limited shop right incompatible with mandatory participation under EU competition law and advises adapting it, which the government accepted by making the risk-sharing reserve and micro longevity pooling mandatory.

The Afdeling questions whether the solidarity reserve adds value beyond existing instruments and asks for better justification; the government added statutory purpose and conditions but kept the reserve.
The Afdeling asks for a fuller explanation of DNB's review of the balanced interest assessment during transition, which the government adopted in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks for clarity on redistribution effects of the transition funding framework; the government added information duties and a net-benefit analysis.
The Afdeling advises abolishing the net pension and net annuity schemes given low uptake and complexity; the government did not adopt this advice.
The Afdeling advises on composition of the Transitiecommissie and involvement of pension administrators; the government committed to expertise requirements in lower regulation.
The Afdeling advises mandating one of the two valuation methods to avoid duplication and conflict; the government kept both methods.

The Afdeling considers the new system probably not indirectly discriminatory against women, and that any indirect effects would be justified; no compensation is needed, though effects should be monitored.

The Afdeling asks whether a hearing right for pensioners and former participants should be extended to other representative groups such as young workers; the government declined a special right for youth.

36076.s: The bill amends the Nature Conservation Act and the Environment and Planning Act to create a nature compensation bank, a register of nitrogen-deposition compensation measures that can be reserved and allocated to public projects of major public interest such as infrastructure and defence. It also gives the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen and provincial authorities powers to protect registered compensation areas, including access restrictions and a duty to tolerate maatregelen on private land.
36076.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility and technical detail in implementing the compensation bank, and it says that provincial assignment via algemene maatregel van bestuur would respect the Financial Relations Act and be subject to voorhang.
d: designation of other authorities and decisions for reservation and allocation
transfer of protection powers to provincial authorities
detailed rules on register, reservation, allocation and measurement
provincial tasks for nature compensation areas
instruction rules on registration and allocation of compensation measures
purposes for which instruction rules may be set
transfer of access restriction power to provincial authorities
designation of authorities and decisions for reserving and allocating measures
transfer of duty-to-tolerate power to provincial authorities
p: The Minister may impose on owners and users of land a duty to tolerate measures needed for compensation nature, a significant intrusion on property rights, decided by individual decision and open to appeal.

Provisional protection powers (individual restriction orders, access restrictions, duty to tolerate) are applied to compensation areas before formal designation, with appeal available against individual decisions.
The Minister may restrict or prohibit access to compensation areas in addition to special national nature areas, a limited extension of an existing access power.
Reservation and allocation of compensation measures may be assigned by ministerial regulation to other authorities, reducing the fixed allocation of competences.

parties: Asks how the bank relates to internal and external netting, who verifies that ecological compensation is adequate, and whether independent review is guaranteed.
Can the government guarantee that there is at all times an independent review here?
Kan de regering garanderen dat hier te allen tijde sprake is van een onafhankelijke toetsing?
Finds unclear which project types qualify and says the Chamber would have little control over which projects can use the bank.
Is the government of the view that this offers the Chamber little control over which types of projects will qualify for this scheme?
Is de regering van mening dat dit de Kamer weinig controle biedt over welk type projecten in aanmerking zal komen voor deze regeling?
Questions whether the assessment of compensation is independent, since provinces are often both permit authority and initiator.
Warns that compensation must actually produce results before use and that the Council of State and case law set strict requirements that the bill may not meet.
measures may only serve as nature compensation if and to the extent that they have actually produced results.
maatregelen alleen als natuurcompensatie mogen dienen als en in zoverre ze daadwerkelijk tot resultaten hebben geleid.
Argues nature destruction is irreversible, compensation often fails in practice, and compensation must not conflict with Habitats Directive obligations.
Disturbing animals and destroying their habitat is always unacceptable to them.
Het verstoren van dieren en het vernietigen van hun leefgebied is voor hen altijd onacceptabel.
Asks about nitrogen permitting for grazing and manuring and how compensation budgets and overcompensation are handled.
In what way does the government intend to prevent a permit requirement for grazing and manuring as far as possible?
Op welke wijze wil zij een vergunningplicht voor beweiden en bemesten zo veel mogelijk voorkomen?
Asks about over-compensation practice and forecasts of future compensation needs.
The BBB member would like a forecast with justification of how much compensation is expected for future projects.
Graag zou het lid van de BBB-fractie een prognose ontvangen met onderbouwing hoeveel compensatie er voor toekomstige projecten verwacht wordt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill creating a nature compensation register for projects of major public interest affecting Natura 2000 areas, raising concerns about the missing no-alternatives requirement, the registration of measures not yet effective, the lack of appropriate assessment before compensation, and the timing of realisation. The minister's reply adopts the definition change and partly addresses the other points while defending the bank's benefits, with no full acceptance of the advisory division's core doubts.
concerns: The definition of adc-project must include the requirement that no alternative solutions exist, as Article 6(4) of the Habitats Directive requires; the minister adopted this by referring to Wnb article 2.8(4).

Compensatory measures should only be applied once their intended result is achieved; the minister maintains registration is allowed when execution is sufficiently certain and clarifies the distinction with the competent authority's assessment.

Advance compensation without an appropriate assessment for unspecified projects raises doubts about whether measures can be sufficiently tailored, as required by the Habitats Directive; the reply relies on inventory and monitoring rather than a substantive justification.
The bill's contribution to speeding up compensation nature is unclear given the natural timescales of habitat development; the reply argues benefits remain even if early projects cannot use the bank.

36085.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/1151 by allowing online notarial incorporation of private limited companies (BV) under a new article 2:175a of the Civil Code and a new Title Va of the Notaries Act. It creates a KNB-managed electronic notarial deed system, sets identity verification at high assurance level, and lets the KNB issue binding regulations (verordening) on technical details.
36085.j: The memorandum justifies the KNB role by the public-office character of the notary, the need for legal certainty and fraud prevention, and the statutory tasks of a public-law professional body.
q: With this proposal it has been chosen to place this electronic environment centrally, by government, with the professional organisation rather than outsourcing it to the market.
Met dit voorstel is ervoor gekozen om deze elektronische omgeving centraal van overheidswege te beleggen bij de beroepsorganisatie en niet uit te besteden aan de markt.
d: KNB rules on electronic deed processing system requirements
KNB rules on document standards, conversion and storage of electronic deeds
p: Operation of the central electronic deed system is placed with the professional body KNB rather than the market, with technical requirements left to KNB regulation.
The notary may individually require physical presence of parties in cases of suspected identity fraud or capacity problems, a discretionary power with stated general-interest grounds.
Deviation from the usual protocol storage rules moves custody of electronic deeds to the KNB, with a stated bar on KNB inspection of deed contents.

parties: Asks how the digital incorporation route safeguards against criminal misuse, identity fraud and deepfakes, and whether notarial safeguards under the temporary COVID-19 law carry over.
The said members would welcome a response from the government on this.
Voornoemde leden ontvangen graag een reactie van de regering hierop.
Asks how the legislator safeguards the accuracy and lawfulness of personal data verification, citing the Data Protection Authority's warnings.
Can the government explain why, in view of the foregoing, it considers it necessary to provide additional safeguards to ensure the accuracy of personal data?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom zij het nodig acht, met het oog op het voorgaande, aanvullende waarborgen te bieden om de juistheid van persoonsgegevens te waarborgen?
Supports the bill but proposes an amendment allowing English-language articles to be amended in English to avoid practical translation problems.
In the view of the CDA members, this will in practice mean that English-language articles will always have to be wholly amended.
Naar het oordeel van de leden van de CDA-fractie zal dit voor de praktijk met zich brengen dat de Engelstalige statuten steeds geheel zullen moeten worden gewijzigd.
Worried that digitalisation of notarial processes lets criminals hide, and asks how electronic identification can prevent fraud and how capacity checks are done.
Can the government guarantee that the electronic identification method cannot be defrauded?
Kan de regering de garantie geven dat met de elektronische identificatiemethode niet gefraudeerd kan worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill partially implementing EU Directive 2019/1151 on digital company formation, raising concerns about extending online BV incorporation to third-country nationals and about the grounds for disqualifying directors with bans imposed in other member states. The minister's reply accepted the scope objection by limiting the bill to EU nationals and added explanation and amendments on the director-ban grounds.
concerns: Extending online incorporation of BVs to third-country nationals lacked reasoned justification and ignored fraud risks; the government restricted the scope to EU nationals.

Director-ban grounds may create a stricter regime for Dutch directors than for foreign ones; the government explained the choice and supplemented the explanatory memorandum but did not change the grounds.
Verification of foreign director bans by notaries is difficult; the government addressed this by clarifying the declaration requirement.

36094.s: The bill amends the Temporary Groningen Act to let owners carry out building safety assessments and design of reinforcement measures in their own management, with the Minister checking and deciding on reinforcement. It also adds legal aid and expert advice coverage for owners in objection and appeal procedures, and makes several technical changes replacing ministerial references.
36094.j: The memorandum justifies the technical delegations and changes mainly by improving the feasibility of the reinforcement process and aligning legal aid with the Wrb.
q: Support for residents (legal aid, article I, part D): the amendment also contains a revised scheme for legal, financial and structural assistance for owners to improve its feasibility.

Ondersteuning voor bewoners (juridische bijstand, artikel I, onderdeel D) De novelle bevat tevens een gewijzigde regeling voor de juridische, financiële en bouwkundige bijstand voor eigenaren om de uitvoerbaarheid ervan te verbeteren.
d: replacing 'regeling van Onze Minister' with 'ministeriële regeling'
rules on compensation for owner-led assessment costs
rules on compensation for owner-led measures overview costs
data to be submitted with reinforcement application
p: Owners may carry out building safety assessments themselves, with the Minister still reviewing and deciding on the result within set deadlines.
The Minister must decide on reinforcement applications within twelve weeks and may refuse them on stated grounds.

parties: Asks how affected parties will be informed of the changes and whether owners pursuing civil-law routes should get equal legal aid compensation.
These members wonder how stakeholders will be informed about the consequences of the amendment.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af hoe belanghebbenden geïnformeerd zullen worden over de consequenties van de wijziging.
Asks what steps have been taken to implement earlier amendments on enforcement power and discretion of the National Coordinator Groningen.
They ask the government what steps have since been taken to implement these amendments when the law enters into force.
Zij vragen de regering welke stappen er sindsdien zijn gezet om deze amendementen tot uitvoering te brengen op het moment dat de wet in werking treedt.
Objects that the government undermined two Parliament-adopted amendments via this novelle and questions the delay and the restrictions on self-managed reinforcement and legal aid.
The SP members therefore have many questions about the government's choices in this novelle, by which the amendments are undermined.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben daarom ook vele vragen over de keuzes, door de regering gemaakt in deze novelle, waarmee de amendementen worden ondermijnd.
Question the government's disregard of Parliament's right of amendment, its constitutional role, and the status of adopted amendments, and ask for a State Council addendum on constitutional aspects.
To what extent does the government see room for itself to set aside amendments adopted by a majority of the House of Representatives?
In hoeverre ziet de regering ruimte voor zichzelf om amendementen die door een meerderheid van de Tweede Kamer zijn aangenomen naast zich neer te leggen?
Asks about the practical consequences for legal aid compared with the adopted amendment and conditions set by the Legal Aid Board, seeking assurance that access to justice does not worsen.
Can the government guarantee that access to justice for affected Groningers does not worsen compared with the previously adopted amendment?
Kan de regering garanderen dat de toegang tot het recht van de getroffen Groningers ten opzichte van het eerder aangenomen amendement niet verslechterd?
Supports owners' position but asks how the government can influence and supervise the independent IMG, and calls for deadlines and enforceable processing time limits.
How can the government guarantee influence over the functioning of these institutions, and does it plan to supervise them more tightly?
Hoe kan de regering invloedgarantie geven op het functioneren van deze instituties en is de regering van plan hier strakker op toe te zien?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a novelle amending the Tijdelijke wet Groningen to make self-managed strengthening by owners workable and to regulate support and cost reimbursement; the Afdeling raised concerns about unclear scope of self-managed preparation, priority over NCG assessment, the breadth of support schemes, and the grounds for charging costs to NAM. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport accepted many points, clarified the self-managed process in new articles 13ia, 13ib and 13ja, granted priority for owner-initiated assessments, narrowed the legal aid route, and provided a fuller justification for charging costs to NAM while largely maintaining the Tweede Kamer amendments.
concerns: Unclear what preparation of self-managed strengthening entails, its relation to NCG assessment, and when owners may choose it; the novelle now specifies the steps in new articles 13ia, 13ib and 13ja.

Owner-initiated self-managed assessments need priority NCG processing to be meaningful; the government accepted priority outside municipal programmes but with NCG checking against safety standards and notifying municipalities.

The support scheme for owners lacks any financial limit and goes beyond existing legal aid; the government kept the scope close to the amendments but narrowed the legal aid route and expanded Stut-en-Steun subsidy instead of an NCG scheme.
The grounds for charging costs of legal and technical assistance to NAM require substantive justification under the fair balance test; the memorie van toelichting was supplemented accordingly.
Articles 13ia and 13ib were given a delegation basis so that compensation for self-commissioned assessments and measure overviews can be set by ministerial regulation.

The Raad voor rechtsbijstand lacks competence to design a scheme for expert costs outside legal aid; the government clarified that the subsidy is for legal aid with a bijzonder doeleinde and adjusted article 37c references.

Equal treatment of administrative and civil law routes was requested; the government declined to extend the scheme to civil proceedings since the Tijdelijke wet regulates only the administrative route.

36100-IV.s: This bill is a slotwet that sets the final, realised 2021 budget figures for the Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and BES-fonds (H) budgets, amending the adopted budgets after the first and second supplementary budgets. It records the differences between the estimated and realised amounts, such as the unspent liquidity support for Aruba's seventh tranche.
q: In line with the advice of the Colleges financieel toezicht (Cft) and the College Aruba financieel toezicht (CAft), the funds (about € 146.5 million) reserved for the seventh tranche of liquidity support were not fully spent.

Conform het advies van de Colleges financieel toezicht (Cft) en het College Aruba financieel toezicht (CAft) zijn de middelen (circa € 146,5 mln.) die gereserveerd waren voor de zevende tranche liquiditeitssteun niet geheel besteed.

36100-VI.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statements (departmental and agency) of the Ministry of Justice and Security through a final supplementary budget law, shifting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force and the amounts to be recorded, without delegating rule-making power to the executive.
q: So it is that We, in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed, as We hereby resolve and decree
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

36157.s: The bill transfers the legal basis for implementing EU Directive 2021/2101 on disclosure of income tax information from specific articles of Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code into a new general article 391a, which lets general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations set detailed disclosure, audit and enforcement rules. It also updates cross-references in related acts and existing implementing decrees, with a four-week parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang) before any AMvB.
36157.j: The memorandum justifies the broader delegation by the need for faster, less delayed implementation of EU directives, since most directives leave little policy room and a technical, one-to-one implementation is expected.
q: Because of the broader wording of the legal basis proposed in this bill, it will be possible to implement future directives such as this one more quickly.
Door de in dit wetsvoorstel voorgestelde ruimere formulering van de rechtsgrondslag zal het mogelijk zijn om in de toekomst richtlijnen zoals de onderhavige sneller te implementeren.
d: detailed rules on content of the directors' report
disclosure, separate annual reports, declarations, audit and enforcement of EU-based reporting duties
list of non-EU jurisdictions (black and grey EU tax lists) for country-by-country tax reporting
p: Broad open-ended delegation lets future EU-implementing reporting rules be set by AMvB rather than by statute, with only a four-week parliamentary pre-consultation and no reporting or sunset safeguards.
The Financial Markets Authority (AFM) is excluded from the Enterprise Chamber procedure for the income tax report, reducing an oversight body's role.

parties: Worries the delegation basis lets directives be implemented without a prior bill, reducing parliamentary control, and asks how the House can keep oversight.
The VVD members note that this bill creates a delegation basis to implement directives without the need to submit a prior bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat dit wetsvoorstel een delegatiegrondslag creëert om richtlijnen te implementeren zonder de noodzaak een voorafgaand wetsvoorstel in te dienen.
Asks about consequences for non-compliant companies, whether the information will be analysed, and whether misuse of the confidentiality exception is checked afterwards.
Asks when the Council of State advice will be received during the four-week pre-consultation and whether the House can see it before the period ends.
Is it correct then that the House can already view the advice before the pre-consultation period expires?
Klopt het dan dat de Kamer het advies al wel kan inzien alvorens de termijn van de voorhang verstrijkt?
Disappointed that non-EU country information is aggregated rather than published per country, limiting transparency on tax paid.

The SP members are disappointed that information on non-member states is presented in aggregate, so even the largest multinationals need not provide full per-country transparency on their tax payments.

De leden van de SP-fractie zijn teleurgesteld over het feit dat informatie over niet-lidstaten geaggregeerd wordt weergegeven en hierdoor zelfs de grootste multinationals geen volledige transparantie over hun belastingafdracht per land hoeven te betrachten.
Asks whether the June 2023 implementation deadline is feasible and how the government will ensure timely implementation.
In that light these members ask the government whether it considers this implementation deadline feasible and how it intends to ensure implementation within the set period.
Deze leden vragen de regering in dat licht of zij deze implementatiedeadline haalbaar acht en op welke wijze zij ervoor wil zorgen dat de implementatie binnen de gestelde termijn plaatsvindt.
Asks whether the government accepts that institutional investors use non-financial tax information and how AFM enforcement, including administrative fines, will work.

Finally, the VVD members ask the government to explain further how enforcement will be organised by the Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and whether the AFM can impose an administrative fine for non-compliance.

Tot slot vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie of de regering nader kan toelichten hoe de handhaving wordt vormgegeven door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) en of de AFM een bestuurlijke boete kan opleggen voor het niet naleven.
Asks about Zucman's tax-collector-of-last-resort proposal, the aggregated reporting of non-member state data, and whether the directive is effective given accounting tricks.
These members are curious whether the ministers have taken note of professor Zucman's visit to the Netherlands and to the House of Representatives.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd of de bewindspersonen kennis hebben genomen van het bezoek van professor Zucman aan Nederland en aan de Kamer.

Questions why the bill uses a delegation provision for a ministerial regulation instead of a full legislative procedure, and asks for data on late implementation and the list of regularly amended EU acts.

The PVV members ask the government to explain further why a delegation provision was chosen rather than a full legislative procedure, given that the government in principle only agrees to directive proposals when there is a realistic implementation period.

De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering om nader toe te lichten waarom er gekozen wordt voor een delegatiebepaling en niet voor een volwaardig wetgevingstraject als de regering (in beginsel) slechts akkoord gaat met richtlijnvoorstellen als er een realistische implementatietermijn is.
Has no further questions on the bill after reviewing the government's responses.
These members, after consulting the memorandum in reply to the report and the amendment memorandum, have no additional questions for the government on the present bill.
Deze leden hebben na raadpleging van de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag en de nota van wijziging geen aanvullende vragen voor de regering over het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill's expansion of criminal liability under the WED to all AMvBs on the board report was not justified, since the explanatory memorandum wrongly assumed such liability already existed, and advised justifying it or reconsidering. The government reply accepted the point, narrowing the WED reference to the EU-implementing AMvB basis only, and added a ministerial regulation basis for the EU tax lists.
concerns: Expansion of criminal liability under the WED to all AMvBs on board reports was not justified and needed reconsideration or proper reasoning.
The explanatory memorandum wrongly assumed the broader WED criminal provision already existed, requiring correction.
Technical and redactional improvements were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36166.s: The bill amends the Dutch Act on Working Conditions of Posted Workers in the EU and the Act on generally binding collective agreements to implement EU Directive 2020/1057 on posting of drivers in road transport, adding a new chapter with definitions, posting rules, administrative duties (IMI posting declarations, documents to carry and produce, post-posting document requests) and enforcement sanctions. It also extends certain provisions to UK-based operators under the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement and to third-country carriers, while the explanatory memorandum notes enforcement concerns raised by the Labour Inspectorate.
36166.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the directive's harmonised, exhaustive list of administrative and control measures, and as necessary for effective enforcement and fair competition.
q: Secondly, specific administrative requirements and control measures have been established to harmonise the monitoring of compliance with the Posting of Workers Directive and to avoid disproportionate burdens on transport undertakings.

Ten tweede zijn specifieke administratieve voorschriften en controlemaatregelen vastgesteld om de controle op de naleving van de Detacheringsrichtlijn te harmoniseren en onevenredige lasten voor vervoersondernemingen te voorkomen.
d: designating additional states treated as member states
p: Labour inspectors may request, within eight weeks, a broad set of posted-driver pay and employment documents from employers via IMI, with the inspectorate having discretion over which data are necessary.

Shippers, forwarders and contractors are deemed to have committed the carrier's offence if they knew or should have known the transport would breach the rules, extending liability to additional actors.
The Minister may share IMI data on posted drivers with social partners and joint enforcement bodies to check compliance with generally binding collective agreement provisions.

parties: Asks whether the NLA's workload is too high and how enforcement uncertainty over identifying shippers and subcontractors will be resolved.
The VVD members are very concerned about the enforceability of the law.
De leden van de VVD-fractie maken zich grote zorgen over de handhaafbaarheid van de wet.
Supports harmonisation for drivers but asks for monitoring of impacts on Dutch drivers and the supply-demand balance.
These members think it is important that this impact is monitored so that any adverse effects can be detected in time.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat deze impact gemonitord wordt om eventueel nadelige gevolgen tijdig te kunnen bemerken.
Asks whether the NLA has enough capacity and expertise to enforce the directive and whether consultation was wrongly skipped.
The CDA members ask whether the NLA has enough capacity (staff and knowledge) to enforce this directive.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of er bij de NLA genoeg mogelijkheden (denk hierbij aan personeel en kennis) zijn om op deze richtlijn te handhaven.
Asks the government to submit its response to the NLA's enforcement test back to the NLA and guarantee the Dutch minimum wage can still be enforced.
Can the government guarantee that enforcing the Dutch minimum wage will in no case be jeopardised?
Kan de regering verzekeren dat in geen geval het handhaven van de Nederlandse Wml in het geding komt?
Asks how the government will address concerns about enforcement, free budget and staff for the NLA and ILT, and build their expertise.
These members ask whether the government can free up budget and manpower so that the NLA and ILT can enforce the rules.
Deze leden vragen daarnaast of de regering budget en mankracht vrij kan maken om ervoor te zorgen dat er door de NLA en ILT gehandhaafd kan worden.
Shares GroenLinks' questions on enforcement capacity and an integral enforcement plan.
These members further ask whether the government can draw up an integrated plan of action to ensure enforcement is possible.
Deze leden vragen voorts of de regering een integraal plan van aanpak kan maken om te zorgen dat er gehandhaafd kan worden.
Asks whether the NLA has sufficient existing powers to detect offenders and impose fines, and how foreign employers will be informed.
Asks whether the NLA, with its current administrative-law instruments and powers, is sufficiently able to detect offenders and fine those responsible.
Vragen of de NLA met de huidige bestuursrechtelijke middelen en bevoegdheden die hen nu ter beschikking staan voldoende in staat overtreders op te sporen en de verantwoordelijken te beboeten.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Dutch bill implementing EU Directive 2020/1057 on posting of drivers in road transport, raising concerns about two co-existing posting regimes, enforcement powers of the labour inspectorate, the timing of posting start/end, and insufficient stakeholder consultation. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most points, clarifies inspection powers and reporting, adds stakeholder communication, monitoring and an implementation review, and makes some technical amendments.
concerns: The two co-existing posting regimes (general posting directive and road-transport mobility directive) create complications for administration, IMI reporting and enforcement that must be clarified.

Doubt whether the labour inspectorate retains sufficient powers to establish employment relationships and applicable regime under the limitative directive regime; government clarifies via Awb powers and Wml documentation.
Start and end of posting (border crossing versus loading/unloading) are not unambiguously recorded in the tachograph, requiring clearer explanation and fallback rules in the explanatory memorandum.
Advice to involve enforcement and implementing bodies earlier in preparing EU legislation, including in Brussels negotiations.
Absence of internet consultation; government declined citing short implementation deadline but consulted social partners, and the Council asks for stakeholder communication and monitoring.
Advice for a post-implementation review (invoeringstoets) to assess how the regulation works for undertakings and drivers, and for active monitoring and communication with the sector.

36175.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security through a fourth incidental supplementary budget, adding spending and reallocating funds across police, legal aid, the judiciary-related items, migration and the ministry's own apparatus. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 10 June 2022, with retroactive effect if the bulletin is published later.
36175.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to policy priorities such as the interception desk, the coalition agreement funds for the justice chain, and the approach to confused persons, without framing them as new powers.
q: From the coalition agreement funds, resources are made available for strengthening the justice chain.
Vanuit de Coalitieakkoordmiddelen worden middelen beschikbaar gesteld voor de versterking van de justitiële keten

36184.s: The bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) through an eighth incidental supplementary budget to fund further filling of the Bergermeer gas storage. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect from 31 August of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2022

36193.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, adding supplementary and incidental budget amounts across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the budget unit in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has emerged to amend the departmental budget statement
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

36229.s: The bill reintroduces the basic grant for higher education students, adjusts student finance rules for vocational and higher education, and extends the 1-February rule to a 1-September rule for certain vocational graduates. It also gives a one-off compensation (tegemoetkoming) to students who studied under the loan system and harmonises repayment rules for vocational and higher education loans.
36229.j: The memorandum justifies the statutory changes by the goal of restoring financial accessibility and fairness to students who studied under the loan system, and leaves operational details to executive regulation for administrative reasons.
q: The cabinet chooses not to use the funds for training for specific shortage occupations, precisely because steering through a financial measure has not had the desired effect for those shortage occupations.

Het kabinet kiest er voor om de middelen niet aan te wenden voor scholing richting specifieke tekortberoepen, juist omdat sturing via een financiële maatregel niet het gewenste effect voor die tekortberoepen heeft gehad.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel X (artikel 12.15, vierde lid)
detailed rules on implementing the compensation and how it is paid
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 3.18a) / Artikel I, onderdeel Y (artikel 12.30, vijfde lid)
detailed rules on compensation for cohorts under the studievoorschot system
Artikel I, onderdeel Y (artikel 12.32, vijfde lid)
application procedure for transitional repayment regime
Artikel IV, onderdeel A en B (WHW artikel 7.45, vijfde lid; 7.45a, vijfde lid)
designation of student groups eligible for reduced statutory tuition fee
p: Artikel I, onderdeel G/H (artikel 3.17 vervalt; 3.18 overzicht normbedragen)
Removes the income limit for vocational students and updates statutory amounts in an overview; largely technical adjustments to benefit levels.
Adjusts which amounts are indexed by ministerial/administrative means, shifting indexation mechanics without parliamentary vote on each change.
Artikel I, onderdeel X and Y (artikel 12.15 and 12.30)
Sets the compensation amounts in the statute but leaves implementation, payment method and eligibility details to lower regulation.

parties: Asks whether the effect of the law on student wellbeing will be monitored, given the Council of State's doubt about a clear causal link.
These members ask whether the effect of the legal amendment on student wellbeing will also be monitored.
Deze leden vragen of het effect van de wetswijziging op het studentenwelzijn ook gemonitord gaat worden.
Welcomes reintroduction of the basic grant but questions timing of collegegeld halving abolition and the role of the Kamer's budget right.
Welcomes end of the debt system but calls the grant and compensation for loan students seriously inadequate.
At the same time, these members find it regrettable and reprehensible that the basic grant and the accompanying compensation for loan-system students fall seriously short.
Tegelijkertijd vinden de leden het betreurenswaardig en laakbaar dat de basisbeurs en de bijbehorende tegemoetkoming voor leenstelselstudenten ernstig tekortschiet.
Demands compensation for the generation without a basic grant and asks the government to specify its positions on key points.
The PvdA members want compensation for the generation that did not receive a basic grant.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie willen dat er compensatie komt voor de generatie die geen basisbeurs heeft gekregen.
Notes promised investments in higher education under the loan system were empty promises and asks how the government now assesses those earlier commitments.
These members must however conclude that the agreements made at introduction have proven to be empty promises in practice.
Deze leden moeten echter concluderen dat de afspraken die zijn gemaakt bij de invoering in de praktijk loze beloftes zijn gebleken.
Questions whether promised investments in education quality materialised and whether earlier commitments were kept.
However, these members ask whether the promised investments at the introduction of the loan system actually materialised.
Echter vragen de leden of de beloofde investeringen bij invoering van het leenstelsel wel tot hun recht zijn gekomen.
Asks why no income ceiling or profit-based repayment is used, and questions the reasoning behind the grant design.
These members ask why the government does not consider it desirable to apply a maximum income for entitlement to the basic grant.
De leden vragen waarom de regering het niet wenselijk acht om een maximuminkomen te hanteren voor het recht op basisbeurs.
Strongly supports abolishing the loan system and reintroducing the basic grant, citing reduced debt and performance pressure on young people.
These members are glad that this commitment has now landed in the bill reintroducing the basic grant.
Deze leden zijn blij dat die inzet nu is geland in het wetsvoorstel Wet herinvoering basisbeurs hoger onderwijs.
Finds the grant level for home and independent students too low given rising living and tuition costs.
Argues the grant is too low per SER and Nibud research and asks the government to make the temporary increase structural and to help students who used up their grant years.
This member asks the government to structurally raise the basic grant so that students with a 12-hour-per-week part-time job can graduate debt-free.
Dit lid verzoekt de regering de basisbeurs dusdanig structureel te verhogen, zodat studenten, met een bijbaan van 12 uur per week, schuldenvrij kunnen afstuderen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the bill reintroducing the basic grant in higher education, asking for a sustained justification of the structural reform and for a justification or abandonment of the one-off compensation to students who studied under the loan system. The minister's reply explains the reasoning on goals, durability, the compensation as a political gesture, and the abolition of the earnings limit and harmonisation of repayment terms, and adjusts the bill accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a reasoned justification of reintroducing the basic grant, based on the goals of student finance and its durability, given the short period since abolition.
The Afdeling asks for a durability justification of the chosen amounts, indexation and financial sustainability, given expected rising student numbers.

The Afdeling requires a sufficient justification, showing special circumstances, for the non-obligatory one-off compensation to students who studied under the loan system, or else advises dropping it.
The Afdeling asks for a reasoned motivation for abolishing the earnings limit in vocational education and not reintroducing it in higher education.
The Afdeling asks for explanation of why the more lenient repayment terms of higher education should also apply to vocational students, given the longer repayment period and higher interest costs.

36274.s: The bill establishes a temporary Climate Fund (Klimaatfonds) managed by the Minister for Climate and Energy, to finance measures reducing greenhouse gas emissions through transfers to departmental budgets, with a horizon of 1 January 2031 for new receipts. It requires an annual multi-year programme to be submitted to parliament, allows independent advice, and mandates an evaluation within four years.
36274.j: The memorandum justifies the minister's sole management role by noting that the Finance Minister already supervises the fund under the Comptabiliteitswet, and justifies transfers to departmental budgets by the need for efficient execution.
q: The fund is, under this proposal, used only to transfer resources to departmental budgets.
Het fonds wordt met dit voorstel enkel gebruikt om middelen over te hevelen naar departementale begrotingen.
d: entry into force and repeal of the act by royal decree
annual multi-year programme drawn up by the minister
p: The minister alone manages the fund and assesses which measures may be financed, with criteria listed in the act but broad discretion over their application.
The minister may seek independent advice on the programme and on expenditure, but is not obliged to do so.

parties: Asks where the 4.12 billion euro difference went, for what it was used, and how it fits the fund's spending goals.
These members ask where the other 4.12 billion euro has gone.
Deze leden vragen waar de andere 4,12 miljard euro naartoe is gegaan.
Asks whether measures reducing emissions abroad (scope 3, shipping, aviation) may be financed from the fund and how the criteria apply.
These members ask the government to clarify to what extent measures focused on reducing CO2 emissions in the chain (scope 3 emissions) may qualify for fund resources.

Deze leden vragen de regering om te verduidelijken in hoeverre ook maatregelen die meer zien op het reduceren van CO 2 -uitstoot in de keten (scope 3 emissies) in aanmerkingen kunnen komen voor middelen uit het Klimaatfonds.
Criticises the grant-based design, asks for loans and clear, uniformly applied criteria, and warns about conflicts in applying for funds and possible stranded assets.
The SP members strongly request the government to formulate clear and testable goals and criteria that the different ministries interpret identically.
De leden van de SP-fractie willen de regering met klem verzoeken om heldere en toetsbare doelen en criteria te formuleren die door de verschillende ministeries identiek worden geïnterpreteerd.
Welcomes the fund but stresses the need for an instellingswet to protect budget rights, asks for earmarking and oversight, and questions the minister's dual role as applicant and fund manager.

Moreover, these members emphasise the importance of an establishing act to give this budget fund a formal character and so also safeguard the parliamentary legislative process, sound financial management and the budget rights of the House of Representatives.

Bovendien benadrukken deze leden het belang van een instellingswet om dit begrotingsfonds een formeel karakter te geven en zo ook het parlementaire wetgevingsproces, een gedegen financieel beheer en het budgetrecht van de Tweede Kamer te borgen.
Asks whether lower and middle incomes will get a fair share of the fund and whether labour-market links can be financed.

The BBB member asks, regarding effectiveness, whether the government takes into account that many facilities financed from the climate fund are in fact accessible and available to people with higher incomes.

Het lid van de BBB-fractie vraagt ten aanzien van doeltreffendheid of de regering rekening houdt met het feit dat veel voorzieningen gefinancierd vanuit het klimaatfonds juist voor mensen met hogere inkomens bereikbaar en beschikbaar zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the government to explain in the explanatory memorandum how the choice of financing instrument for the Climate Fund takes account of investments that private parties make or are expected to make in emissions reduction. The minister's reply reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on this point, including lessons from the FES and Nationaal Groeifonds and more concrete fund-management criteria.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify which financing instrument is most effective under which circumstances and how private investment is taken into account, and the government supplemented the memorandum accordingly.
The Afdeling noted that the memorandum should make clear which criteria the fund manager applies, and the government made these criteria more concrete.

36283.s: The bill changes the Les- en cursusgeldwet so that the amounts of lesgeld and cursusgeld are set by general administrative order (AMvB) rather than in the statute, with annual indexation to the consumer price index under rules set by or pursuant to an AMvB. It also removes the parliamentary nahang requirement for the cursusgeld rules and drops the exceptions to the hardship clause in the WSF 2000 and WTOS so DUO can apply more case-by-case discretion.
36283.j: The memorandum justifies moving amounts to AMvB by aligning with the existing collegegeld regime and the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving, and says the change allows faster adjustment if needed.
q: This means that after this proposal takes effect, the amount of lesgeld and cursusgeld will be set by AMvB.
Dit bekent dat, na inwerkingtreding van dit voorstel, de hoogte van het lesgeld en cursusgeld bij AMvB worden vastgesteld.
d: Artikel I A.1 (art. 5, lid 2 Les- en cursusgeldwet)
Artikel I A.2 (art. 5, lid 3 Les- en cursusgeldwet)
indexation method for lesgeld and definition of consumer price index
Artikel I B.1 (art. 6, lid 4 Les- en cursusgeldwet)
setting cursusgeld amount and rules on levying, payment and enrolment
Artikel I B.2 (art. 6, lid 7 Les- en cursusgeldwet)
indexation method for cursusgeld and definition of consumer price index
definition of consumer price index for collegegeld indexation
p: Artikel I B (art. 6, lid 7 and removal of nahang in former lid 7)
Removes the parliamentary nahang requirement for the cursusgeld implementing rules, so the indexation method can be changed faster by AMvB without parliamentary review.
Artikel I A and B (indexation provisions)
Moves the setting of lesgeld and cursusgeld amounts from statute to AMvB, while the statute retains indexation to the consumer price index as a principle.},{

parties: Asks the government to explain the choice of one-year indexation and to describe possible cases where excluding partner, income and foreign-national concepts from the hardship clause would produce disproportionate outcomes.
Can the government elaborate on this and explain why it ultimately chose indexation based on one year?
Kan de regering hier verder op ingaan en uiteenzetten waarom er uiteindelijk is gekozen voor een indexering op basis van één jaar?
Welcomes the broader room for case-by-case discretion in the hardship clause and asks whether the government will compensate students who were affected in the past.
The members are of the view that legislation and regulations should leave room for tailored solutions and the human dimension.
De leden zijn van mening dat wet- en regelgeving ruimte dient te geven aan maatwerk en de menselijke maat.
Asks whether a change to the indexation AMvB must be submitted to the House of Representatives beforehand and asks the government to reflect on the House's budget right.
Furthermore, these members ask why the lesgeld and cursusgeld must be set by 30 September of the year before the study year in which they apply.](Note: question reflects the text as written.)

Voorts vragen deze leden wat de reden is dat het les- en cursusgeld uiterlijk 30 september van het jaar voorafgaand aan het studiejaar waarin het les- en cursusgeld zal gelden, vastgesteld moet worden.

Welcomes the more stable indexation and the wider hardship discretion but questions the large percentage rise for mbo students and asks what alternatives were examined and why the change came so late.
A high percentage increase in lesgeld for mbo students for the 2023–2024 study year, however, cannot be avoided.](Note: as written in the report.)
Een hoge percentuele stijging van het lesgeld voor studiejaar 2023–2024 voor mbo-studenten valt echter niet te voorkomen.

Supports the more future-proof indexation but asks how DUO will in practice use the hardship clause, whether it will be evaluated, and whether DUO was involved in litigation that could have been avoided.
The GroenLinks members wish to know what the government concretely will do to ensure in practice that DUO uses the hardship clause in cases for which it is intended.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie willen graag weten wat de regering concreet gaat doen om in de praktijk te zorgen dat DUO gebruik maakt van de hardheidsclausule bij gevallen waarvoor het in de praktijk is bedoeld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on a bill amending the Les- en cursusgeldwet on indexation of tuition fees and the hardship clause, and advised submission to parliament. The minister's nader rapport accepts the opinion and reports only minor textual clarifications, including that full-time publicly funded vavo students also pay tuition.

36337.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) through an incidental supplementary budget of €170 million, mainly for support to Ukraine. It sets the effective date as 3 April 2023 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

36350-X.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) through a first supplementary budget, changing appropriations across policy and non-policy articles in thousands of euros with retroactive effect from 1 June 2023. The explanatory memorandum explains the budget transfers mainly as inter-departmental allocations for embassy security, border control and other items, with no new delegation of rule-making power.
36350-X.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as inter-departmental budget transfers and minor adjustments, not as a grant of new powers.
q: The personnel budget increases on balance by €48.2 million, mainly as a result of inter-departmental budget transfers.
Het budget voor de personele uitgaven neemt per saldo toe met € 48,2 miljoen, voornamelijk als gevolg van interdepartementale budgetoverhevelingen

36364.s: The bill amends Article 377a(1) of Book 1 of the Dutch Civil Code so that a grandparent related by family law to a child is presumed to have a close personal relationship with the child, lowering the threshold for grandparents to seek contact orders in court. The presumption is rebuttable, leaving the judge to assess in each case whether contact serves the child's interest.
36364.j: The memorandum justifies the change by citing research showing the Dutch threshold for grandparents is high compared to neighbouring countries and that the presumption secures court access and legal certainty while preserving case-by-case judgment.
q: To this end, a rebuttable presumption of the existence of a close personal relationship is included in Article 377a(1) of Book 1 of the Civil Code.
Daartoe wordt in artikel 377a, eerste lid, van Boek 1 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek een bewijsvermoeden van de aanwezigheid van een nauwe persoonlijke betrekking opgenomen.
p: Grandparents gain easier access to the courts through a rebuttable presumption of close personal relationship, while the judge keeps the final decision on the child's interest.

parties: Asks whether the bill's benefits outweigh possible conflict-generating downsides and asks for the government's assumptions behind caseload estimates.
These members are not yet convinced in advance that the benefits of the bill outweigh the possible disadvantages.
Deze leden zijn nog niet op voorhand overtuigd dat de voordelen van het wetsvoorstel opwegen tegen de mogelijke nadelen.
Welcomes that the child's interest will be weighed substantively more often, but asks about the burden on the child and whether the rebuttable presumption strikes the right balance.
These members do draw attention to the fact that a substantive assessment, regardless of outcome, could be burdensome for the child concerned.
Deze leden vragen er wel aandacht voor dat een inhoudelijke beoordeling, ongeacht de uitkomst daarvan, belastend zou kunnen zijn voor het betrokken kind.
Asks why the bill does not define 'close personal relationship' more specifically, which could reduce legal uncertainty and keep pace with European Court case law.
The CDA members ask why the bill refrains from a specific definition of 'close personal relationship', since that would contribute to a different application in legal practice.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom in het wetsvoorstel wordt afgezien van een specifieke invulling van het begrip «nauwe persoonlijke betrekking», aangezien dit juist bij zou dragen aan een andere invulling in de rechtspraktijk.
Worries that lowering the threshold increases juridification of family conflicts and loyalty conflicts for children, and asks how this will be limited.
By lowering this threshold, the legal route can more easily be taken.
Door het verlagen van deze drempel kan makkelijker deze juridische weg worden ingeslagen.

Questions whether the government should have a far-reaching role in enforcing contact, whether a rebuttable presumption is appropriate, and why the child's wish and review criteria are not more explicit.
To what extent does the government consider that the state should restrain itself out of caution in offering legal possibilities, even if discomfort remains in practice?
In hoeverre is de regering van oordeel dat de overheid zich uit voorzorg zal moeten beperken in het bieden van juridische mogelijkheden, hoezeer daarmee ook ongemak blijft bestaan in de praktijk?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill lowering the threshold for grandparents to request contact (omgang) under Book 1 of the Civil Code, and found no remarks to make. The Minister for Legal Protection submitted a reply forwarding the bill to the Tweede Kamer without further substantive changes.

36373.s: The bill creates temporary newcomer facilities (tijdelijke nieuwkomersvoorzieningen) in primary and secondary education for non-Dutch-speaking migrant children, allowing deviation from parts of the WPO and WVO 2020 where schools lack places. It lets the Minister permit or, unilaterally, order schools in a municipality to set up such facilities, and requires municipalities to hold annual consultations and coordinate.
36373.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the strain of rising newcomer numbers and the municipality's constitutional duty to ensure places for all pupils, and says the facilities are an absolute emergency measure.
q: Temporary newcomer facilities offer an emergency solution and can therefore only be set up when there are truly no other options left to provide education to newcomers in a municipality.

Tijdelijke nieuwkomersvoorzieningen bieden een noodvoorziening en kunnen dus alleen worden opgericht wanneer er echt geen andere mogelijkheden meer zijn om de nieuwkomers in een gemeente onderwijs te bieden.
d: minister grants permission to set up temporary newcomer facilities
minister orders schools in a municipality to set up temporary newcomer facilities
rules on notification and implementation plan for temporary facilities
minimum teaching hours in the programme, deviating from articles 8-9 WPO and chapter 2 WVO
rules on school plan, school guide, placement and development perspective, possibly deviating from statute
rules on how temporary newcomer facilities are closed
schools may let unqualified staff teach for a limited time under written arrangements
p: The Minister may unilaterally order school boards in a municipality to set up temporary facilities, after only consulting the municipal executive, with departure from the regular school law allowed.
Content of the teaching programme may depart from the statutory curriculum rules, with minimum norms set out in the act and hours to be set by general administrative order.
Unqualified staff may teach for as long as strictly necessary, deviating from teacher qualification requirements.
The Minister must report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness of the act.

parties: Asks about the ambtshalve (ex officio) ministerial decision, its urgency, appeal options for schools, and how the Minister's intervention powers relate to existing law.
These members agree with the government that this should only be used in exceptional cases.
Deze leden zijn het met de regering eens dat dit alleen in uitzonderingsgevallen ingezet moet worden.
Worries that permanent rules allowing unqualified teachers become structural and asks for limits, monitoring and time bounds on their deployment.
With the permanent character of this law, it remains a structural possibility to deploy unqualified staff in a temporary newcomer facility.
Met het permanente karakter van deze wet blijft het een structurele mogelijkheid om onbevoegden in te zetten op een tijdelijke nieuwkomersvoorziening.

Questions why a binding ministerial instruction and sanction replace the notification system used for Ukrainian refugees, and the Raad van State criticism that existing local cooperation is undermined.
The CDA members ask why a power to enforce and impose obligations on schools, and in extreme cases a funding sanction, was chosen.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom is gekozen voor een doorzettingsmacht en de mogelijkheid scholen een verplichting op te leggen en in het uiterste geval zelfs een bekostigingssanctie.
Warns of a sliding scale in which emergency measures become the norm and quality requirements erode; asks how standards will be safeguarded.
When does an emergency measure become the new normal?
Wanneer wordt een noodmaatregel het nieuwe normaal?
Asks why the government dismisses the Raad van State critique that a binding instruction has not been shown necessary, and calls for truly temporary measures compatible with children's rights.

These members urge the government that these measures must truly be temporary, because newcomers are in some cases disadvantaged in receiving full education, which conflicts with the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

Deze leden proberen er wel op aan te dringen bij de regering dat deze maatregelen echt tijdelijk van aard moeten zijn, omdat nieuwkomers in sommige gevallen achtergesteld worden in het volgen van volwaardig onderwijs, wat in strijd is met het Verdrag inzake de rechten van het kind.
Doubts the necessity of the binding ministerial instruction power, notes the Raad van State's objections, and fears structural use of unqualified teachers.
The Council of State was very critical on this point and objected that this among other things disrupts existing cooperation between schools, municipalities and the national government.
De Raad van State was zeer kritisch op dit punt en uitte bezwaren dat dit onder meer de bestaande samenwerking tussen scholen, gemeente en Rijk doorkruist.
Accepts the emergency rationale but fears a two-tier system if structural quality improvements are not pursued, and asks why no sunset clause is included.
These members understand the emergency measure to prevent compulsory-schooling children from getting no education at all, but they also fear a two-tier system.
Deze leden hebben begrip voor de noodgreep om te voorkomen dat leerplichtige kinderen helemaal geen onderwijs krijgen, maar zij vrezen ook een tweedeling.

Objects to the centralist character and possible conflict with the Constitution (article 23), arguing the municipal compulsion power overrides the freedom of special education and the Minister can bypass the municipality.
These members support strengthening the municipalities' steering role, but note that the bill's enforcement power for municipalities apparently conflicts with the Constitution.

Deze leden steunen de inzet om de regierol van de gemeenten te versterken, maar zij constateren dat het wetsvoorstel wat betreft de doorzettingsmacht van gemeenten kennelijk in strijd is met de Grondwet.
Asks for the necessity of ex officio ministerial intervention given Raad van State doubts, and for timelines so the field can plan.
The member asks how the government can justify the usefulness and/or necessity of this intervention.
Het lid vraagt hoe de regering het nut en/of de noodzaak van dit ingrijpen kan verantwoorden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet tijdelijke nieuwkomersvoorzieningen, objecting to the Minister's binding designation power and recommending a temporary character, clearer limits on the two-year rule, delegation limits, and financial analysis.
