The government's nader rapport accepts many points (consultation duty, municipal initiative, evaluation clause, removal of subdelegation and sanction powers) but retains the ministerial designation power as an ultimum remedium.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the necessity of the Minister's binding designation power; the government keeps it as ultimum remedium, adding conditions and a consultation requirement.

The Afdeling objects to unclear allocation of responsibility between municipalities and school boards and the Minister's intervention; the government clarifies roles and makes municipal request the primary route.

The Afdeling advises against subdelegation to ministerial regulation and urges statutory anchoring; the government drops subdelegation for teacher qualifications and narrows the delegation for the curriculum.
The Afdeling questions permitting unlimited extension beyond two years in temporary facilities; the government adds conditions and a notification duty for such extensions.

The Afdeling notes the bill does not address structural long-term capacity and quality problems and advises a temporary character pending evaluation; the government responds only partly and keeps a permanent instrument.
The Afdeling asks for explanation of how schools and municipalities will get timely multi-year pupil forecasts; the government adds explanation on the consultation's use of indicators.

The Afdeling asks for analysis of financial consequences and possible additional funding; the government says funding follows the regular system and it is in talks with stakeholders, without new funding.

36382.s: The bill amends the Dutch Open Government Information Reuse Act to implement EU Directive 2019/1024 on open data, extending its scope to public undertakings and publicly funded research data and setting rules on free availability, licensing and fees for reuse. It also makes conforming amendments to the Archives Act 1995, the Trade Register Act, the Land Registry Act, the Road Traffic Act and the Open Government Act.
36382.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical detail and flexibility to implement the EU directive and future digital standards.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, specific formal open standards may be designated to which the second paragraph applies.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen specifieke formele open standaarden worden aangewezen waarop het tweede lid van toepassing is.
d: Artikel I, B, art. 5, derde lid
designation of specific open formal standards
Artikel I, B, art. 5, vierde lid
obligation to make reusable information accessible via designated portal sites
Artikel I, B, art. 5, vijfde lid
rules on charging costs for portal accessibility
Artikel I, B, art. 9b, tweede lid, onderdeel c
temporary exemption from free availability of high-value datasets
Artikel I, B, art. 9d, vierde lid
Artikel I, B, art. 9d, zesde lid
publication of list of organisations allowed to charge higher fees
p: Artikel I, B, art. 2, eerste lid, onderdeel j en art. 2a
Public undertakings may choose whether to make data available for reuse, a discretionary exemption from the Act's obligations.
Artikel I, B, art. 9b, tweede lid, onderdeel c
Ministers may by ministerial regulation temporarily exempt certain bodies from free reuse of high-value datasets for up to two years, allowing cost recovery.
Archive custodians may charge marginal costs for reuse, subject to an obligation to publish how costs are calculated.

parties: Asks how the ban on reuse of personal data fits the directive's economic goals and how registers will separate personal from non-personal data.
These members ask how the ban on reuse of personal data relates to this objective and what consequences this ban has for the development of the data economy and artificial intelligence.

Deze leden vragen of de regering kan aangeven hoe het verbod op hergebruik van persoonsgegevens zich verhoudt tot deze doelstelling en welke gevolgen dit verbod heeft voor de ontwikkeling van de data-economie en kunstmatige intelligentie?
Asks about sharing of personal data between authorities, correction of wrong data, and reasons for not applying the changes to the BES islands.
Can the government give a substantive reason why it chooses not to apply these regulatory changes to the BES islands?
Kan de regering een inhoudelijke reden geven waarom er wordt gekozen om deze wijzigingen in regelgeving niet in de BES-eilanden in te voeren

Asks whether the new ban on personal data in public registers is a national gold-plating beyond the EU directive and whether it disproportionately favours privacy over other rights; also asks about the discretion of public undertakings to refuse data.
These members specifically ask whether this provision creates a national add-on to EU regulation.
Deze leden vragen specifiek of met deze bepaling een nationale kop op EU-regelgeving wordt gecreëerd.
Critical of the commercial and economic orientation of reuse, of public money subsidising companies, and of the discretion of institutions to decide whether to share data without democratic control.
What democratic control exists over the choice of institutions to share their data or not?
Welke democratische controle bestaat er op de keuze van instanties om hun data wel of niet te delen?
Worries that the bill is unclear about when personal data may be reused and that public research could be privatised; criticises use of the Woo refusal grounds for reuse requests.
Yet the law remains unclear about the exceptions when personal data may be made available for reuse.
Toch blijft de wet onduidelijk over de uitzonderingen wanneer persoonsgegevens wel voor hergebruik beschikbaar zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Dutch bill implementing the EU Open Data Directive, raising major concerns about an unmotivated mandatory open-access requirement for research data, unclear handling of personal data in public registers, anonymisation risks, lack of impact analysis, and delegation of key elements to lower regulation. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the advice, deleting the research-data provisions and revising the bill and explanatory memorandum, while partly maintaining other provisions.
concerns: Mandatory open access to publicly funded research data restricts intellectual property without adequate justification and was removed by the government.
Key elements of the research-data regime were left to a general administrative order; the government deleted these provisions.
Unclear relationship between the Who and special laws on personal data in public registers; government clarified but maintained exclusion in principle.
Obligations to prevent re-identification of anonymised data are unclear in scope and cost; government added conditions and revised the explanatory memorandum.
Explanatory memorandum lacks analysis of current reuse levels and expected effects of the bill.
Implementing delegation for Commission implementing acts was replaced by a fixed mechanism, and the bill's structure was criticised as hard to use; government made limited changes.
Advice to restructure the Who by separate chapters for public research organisations and public undertakings was considered but not followed.

36410-III.s: This bill sets the 2024 budgets (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of General Affairs including the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency, the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD). It contains only budget appropriations and standard entry-into-force provisions, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement for the year 2024 attached to this act is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2024 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Commission for Oversight of Intelligence and Security Services, and had no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The text is a transmittal note listing the Council's advisory opinions across all ministries and funds, with no separate government reply on substantive points.

36418.s: The bill implements the 2024 tax measures agreed in the purchasing-power decision, changing income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, dividend tax, transfer tax, car and motor vehicle taxes, excise and energy tax, and collection rules. It adjusts box 3 wealth tax, tax brackets, the energy tax first gas band, co-parenting rules for child-related benefits, and extends several tax horizon provisions to 2029.
36418.j: The memorandum justifies the new hardship clause by the need for flexibility in unforeseen, unjust cases that the legislator could not anticipate.
q: The proposed hardship clause in the IW 1990 gives the Minister of Finance the power to address certain cases or groups of cases where application of the IW 1990 leads to unfair outcomes of overriding nature.

Voorgestelde regeling De voorgestelde introductie van een hardheidsclausule in de IW 1990 geeft de Minister van Financiën de bevoegdheid om tegemoet te komen aan bepaalde gevallen of groepen van gevallen waarin de toepassing van de IW 1990 leidt tot onbillijkheden van overwegende aard.
d: Artikel XLII / Artikel XXIV (inwerkingtreding bij koninklijk besluit)
commencement of energy tax blended-heating changes by royal decree
adjusting tax bracket amounts by ministerial regulation after indexation
correcting cross-reference errors arising from overlapping laws
Artikel XXVIII B (Invorderingswet, Article 27 para 3 Awir)
setting interest percentage for tax-related interest by general administrative order
discretionary hardship clause allowing relief from collection rules
Artikel XXIII C (Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag, Article 60 para 6-9)
reporting formats and data obligations for state-aid beneficiaries
p: Gives the Minister of Finance discretion to grant relief for hardship cases, while excluding ordinary administrative appeal against refusals.
Artikel XXIII C (Article 60 para 8-9) and Artikel XXIV
Authorises ministers to impose penalty payments and receive taxpayer data for monitoring state aid compliance.

parties: Asks the government to quantify the narrowing of tax burden differences between income types and to list the measures contributing to it.
They therefore ask whether the government can map and, where possible, quantify the narrowing of these differences and show how they have developed in recent years (since 2017).

Zij vragen daarom of de regering de verkleining van deze verschillen in kaart kan brengen en zo mogelijk kwantificeren en daarbij kan laten zien hoe deze verschillen zich in de afgelopen jaren (vanaf 2017) hebben ontwikkeld.
Asks how the simplification aim and broad-welfare indicators were taken into account in designing the tax measures.
The D66 members ask how account was taken of broad welfare indicators when drafting the Belastingplan measures.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen op welke wijze rekening is gehouden met de indicatoren van brede welvaart bij het opstellen van de Belastingplanmaatregelen.
Argues that bundling 15 bills for expedited treatment frustrates proper legislative process.
Can the government reflect further on this observation and explain whether and how expedited treatment of such an extensive Belastingplan frustrates a sound legislative process?
Kan de regering op deze constatering nader reflecteren en aangeven hoe een spoedbehandeling van een dergelijk omvangrijk Belastingplan een deugdelijk wetgevingsproces al dan niet frustreert?
Questions the necessity of many measures in the package given the short treatment schedule and asks for the Raad van State's comments to be addressed.

They therefore ask whether it was really necessary to include all measures in the Belastingplan, for which the already limited treatment schedule is even shorter this year, and why this was not taken into account more.

Zij vragen daarom of het echt nodig was alle maatregelen in het Belastingplan op te nemen, waarvoor het ieder jaar toch al beperkte behandelschema dit jaar zelfs nog korter is, en waarom hier niet meer rekening mee gehouden is.
Questions why an income-side measure was used to close a budget gap instead of a separate justified assessment under the Comptabiliteitswet.
Does such a choice in the income domain not require a separate assessment as described in Article 3.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet?
Vergt een dergelijke keuze in de inkomenssfeer niet een eigenstandige afweging zoals beschreven in artikel 3.1 van de Comptabiliteitswet?
Asks whether the government would consider higher contributions from high incomes and large assets to fund positive purchasing-power development for lower-income households.

Does the government agree with these members that a higher contribution from people with higher incomes or large assets could be used for positive purchasing-power development for less affluent households, and thus to combat poverty?

Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat een hogere bijdrage van mensen met hogere inkomens of grote vermogens juist benut kan worden voor een positieve koopkrachtontwikkeling voor minder draagkrachtige huishoudens, en dus voor het tegengaan van armoede?
Raises the box 3 massaalbezwaar issue, noting the Hoge Raad advocate-general's advice and the claim that parliament was misled, and asks the government to reflect on it.

These members ask the government to reflect on whether the WFR article adequately reflects the parliamentary history of the legislative process underlying the change to the rules for mass objection procedures.

Deze leden vragen de regering te reflecteren op de vraag of het WFR-artikel een adequate reflectie is van de parlementaire historie bij het beschrijven van het wetgevingsproces dat ten grondslag ligt aan het wijzigen van de «spelregels» voor massaalbezwaarprocedures
Asks whether the box 3 transitional scheme and unindexed allowance remain legally sustainable given pending Hoge Raad rulings on property rights, and what the fiscal impact would be if not.
If it turns out this is not sustainable, what financial impact will this have (broken down per year)?
Indien mocht blijken dat deze niet houdbaar is, welke financiële impact zal dit hebben (per jaar uitgesplitst)?
Asks whether the refined box 3 measures meet the Hoge Raad's Kerst criteria for a legally sustainable system and why alternatives such as a counter-evidence scheme were not pursued.

Member Omtzigt asks the government whether the refined and clarified measures (notary third-party funds) in the box 3 bridging scheme sufficiently meet the Hoge Raad's Kerst-ruling criteria for a legally sustainable system.

Het lid Omtzigt vraagt de regering of de verfijnde en verduidelijkte maatregelen (derdengeld notaris) op het gebied van de overbruggingsregeling box 3 naar het oordeel van de regering voldoende recht doen aan de criteria volgens de Hoge Raad in het Kerstarrest voor een juridisch houdbaar systeem.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on the Belastingplan 2024 package, questioning whether all fifteen bills belong in the package and raising remarks on the herinvesteringsreserve, overdrachtsbelasting, motor vehicle tax reliefs, toeslagen interest and the payment discount. The government's nader rapport responds point by point, largely defending its choices while making some clarifications and additions to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling questions the criteria for including bills in the Belastingplan package and advises limiting them to budgetary links with next year's budget; the government acknowledges the concern but keeps most measures in the package.
The Afdeling finds the wording of article 3.54aa Wet IB 2001 on the herinvesteringsreserve unclear and asks for a worked example; the government added an example but states the text need not change.
The Afdeling asks for an integrated future vision on the tariff structure and growing complexity of the overdrachtsbelasting, which the government addresses only by pointing to a 2024 evaluation.

The Afdeling asks for justification of why the camper van tax reduction is reduced to a half rate while the horse transport rate is abolished, and questions its climate-policy consistency; the government added motivation but kept the half rate.

The Afdeling questions whether the oldtimer exemption for vehicles built before 1988 is justified without further conditions or a heritage-based approach; the government defends the measure as a balance but does not adopt the advice.

The Afdeling asks for justification of charging interest on toeslagen and of the 4% rate, and for an integrated vision on interest rules; the government added an explanation of the anchor and principles for future rates.

The Afdeling asks that the abolition of the early-payment discount on voorlopige aanslag income tax be reviewed in light of the interest system; the government explains the rationale and notes the broader rente review but does not rework the measure.

36427.s: The bill reduces the reimbursement of professional legal costs in appeals against WOZ property valuations, BPM car-tax assessments and related decisions by multiplying the standard fee by 0.25 when the decision is annulled or changed and by 0.10 otherwise. It also fixes damages for exceeding the reasonable time limit at 50 euro per half year and requires payouts to go only to the claimant's own bank account.
36427.j: The memorandum justifies the reduced fees by the overcompensation of no-cure-no-pay representatives and the strain on the courts and tax administration, and notes that court discretion in special circumstances is preserved.
q: The cabinet therefore proposes to lower the reimbursement for the costs of professional legal assistance in proceedings against a WOZ decision, BPM declaration or BPM supplementary assessment in order to remove the existing overcompensation.

Het kabinet stelt daarom voor de hoogte van de vergoeding voor de kosten van door een derde beroepsmatig verleende rechtsbijstand in het kader van procedures tegen een WOZ-beschikking, bpm-aangifte of bpm-naheffingsaanslag te verlagen om de bestaande overcompensatie weg te nemen.
p: Artikel I (art. 30a WOZ) and Artikel II (art. 19a BPM)

Reduces the legal-cost reimbursement and fixes compensation for delay for citizens and their representatives, while keeping judicial hardship clauses that allow courts to depart from the fixed amounts.

parties: Asks how the balance is struck so that the reform does not hinder citizens' access to justice or create barriers to objecting to property tax assessments.
These members find it important that this must not harm citizens' access to the judiciary or create thresholds for citizens to object to an allegedly unjust property tax assessment.

Deze leden vinden het van belang dat dit geen afbreuk mag doen aan de toegankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht voor burgers of drempels opwerpt voor burgers om tegen een in hun ogen onterechte aanslag onroerendezaakbelasting (OZB) in bezwaar te gaan.

Values low-threshold legal protection while supporting urgent measures against overburdening; asks about the legal basis for the reduced factors, uitvoerbaarheid and the effect on citizens' capacity to act.
These members attach great importance to low-threshold and accessible legal protection.
Deze leden hechten groot belang aan laagdrempelige en toegankelijke rechtsbescherming.
Has no further questions at this stage.
have no further questions about it at this time.
hebben daar op dit moment geen verdere vragen over.
Sees value in lowering reimbursements to stop objection procedures becoming a business model; has no additional questions.
These members see the usefulness of lowering the procedural cost reimbursements so that objection procedures do not become a business model and to counter no-cure-no-pay procedures.
Deze leden zien het nut in van het verlagen van de proceskostenvergoedingen om zo geen verdienmodel te maken van de bezwaarprocedures en het tegengaan van «no-cure-no-pay»-procedures.
Questions whether the measure raises a barrier to filing objections, whether it fits the aim of a low-threshold administrative law, and whether unintended effects of direct payment were studied.
Is the government aware of the barrier-raising effect the present bill may have on filing an objection?
Is de regering zich ervan bewust dat de barrière verhogende werking die het onderhavige wetsvoorstel kan hebben om een bezwaarschrift in te dienen?
Accepts the need to tackle costs but warns that the reduction also hits good-faith claimants, weakening legal protection of citizens.
At the same time, this also affects claimants who act in good faith and are not solely aimed at obtaining high procedural cost reimbursements.
Tegelijkertijd worden hiermee ook belanghebbenden geraakt die te goeder trouw handelen en die niet enkel gericht zijn op het behalen van hoge proceskostenvergoedingen.
Asks whether the problem is quantified, whether WOZ assessments are too high, whether the measure creates barriers, and why a delegation provision in the Bpb was not chosen.
Does this not expose a deeper problem, namely that WOZ assessments are apparently often set too high?
Legt dit niet een dieper probleem bloot; namelijk kennelijk zijn WOZ-beschikkingen vaak te hoog vastgesteld?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advises on the Wet herwaardering proceskostenvergoedingen WOZ en BPM, which lowers procedural cost compensation weighting factors and immaterial damages for excessive procedure length, and asks for stronger justification of the equal treatment and effectiveness principles and why the bill is included in the Belastingplan 2024 package. The government's reply explains the urgency, justifies the lower weighting under the Bpb framework, and clarifies its choice to include the bill in the Belastingplan package while partly adding redactional changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for more specific justification of the reasonable and objective justification for differential treatment under Article 17 Grondwet, Article 6 and 13 EVRM and Article 47 of the EU Charter, given the lower mandatory weighting factor, and the government replies with a detailed justification but no substantive change.

The Afdeling asks for an analysis of compatibility with the EU effectiveness principle (doeltreffendheidsbeginsel), which the government addresses by arguing that a lump-sum system is not itself contrary to it and that courts can deviate in special circumstances.

The Afdeling asks for a fuller substantive explanation of why the bill anticipates the outcomes of the broader ongoing exploration of solutions for overburdened administrative law procedures, and the government reports expert meetings and a WODC study without fully reconciling the timing.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to justify why the bill was placed in the Belastingplan 2024 package rather than submitted separately, and the government explains its urgency and the demissionary situation while indicating some measures were split into separate bills.
The government made some redactional changes to the bill and explanatory memorandum in response to the advice.

36435-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, with a supplementary Prinsjesdag adjustment across the listed articles. The explanatory memorandum explains budget transfers and wage-cost adjustments without delegating rule-making powers.
q: This concerns a one-off budget transfer from the Administrative Jurisdiction division to the Common Services of € 5 million.
Dit betreft een eenmalige budgetoverheveling van de afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak naar Gemeenschappelijke diensten van € 5 mln.

36454.s: The bill deletes the statutory basis in the Higher Education and Research Act that allowed the minister to grant quality-linked funding (kwaliteitsbekostiging) to institutions, and removes the related subsection provisions. The Uitvoeringsbesluit WHW 2008 definitions and chapter 4 section 5 on quality funding are also repealed, so study-advance funds flow into the general lump-sum allocation from 2025.
36454.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the government's wish to make study-advance funds available through the lump sum to bring more calm and space to the funding system, avoiding uncertainty about conditions from 2025.
q: To give effect to the government's wish to make the study-advance funds available to institutions by adding them to the lump sum, it is necessary to remove the power to grant quality funding from the WHW.

Om gevolg te geven aan de wens van de regering om de studievoorschotmiddelen door toevoeging aan de lumpsum ter beschikking te laten komen van de instellingen, is het nodig om de bevoegdheid om kwaliteitsbekostiging toe te kennen uit de WHW te schrappen.
p: Removes the minister's statutory power to allocate additional quality-linked funding to institutions, shifting discretion over such funding from the minister to general lump-sum allocation rules.

parties: Asks whether effective participation of students and staff in spending decisions is guaranteed once the quality agreements are removed, and whether the medezeggenschap compensation dispute will be resolved.
It raises the question, in the members' view, whether careful decision-making can still be adequately ensured once the system of quality agreements and quality funding falls away.

Het roept echter naar het oordeel van de leden de vraag op of, bij het wegvallen van het systeem van kwaliteitsafspraken en kwaliteitsbekostiging, onder de nieuwe omstandigheden afdoende ingestaan kan worden voor zorgvuldige besluitvorming.
Asks what fallback options the government has if institutions fail to meet quality standards, without having to reverse the whole act, and questions the claimed reduction in administrative burden.
If institutions are unable to meet this quality in future, these members ask what fallback options the government has to intervene without having to reverse the entire act.

Indien onverhoopt in de toekomst instellingen niet meer kunnen voldoen aan deze kwaliteit, vragen deze leden welke terugvalopties de regering paraat heeft om in te kunnen grijpen, zonder de hele wet te moeten terugdraaien.
Wants accreditation of programmes to remain in place and quality not to be assessed by institutions themselves, and asks whether oversight can be improved through sampling audits.
In that context these members consider it important that programme accreditations remain in place and that the quality of programmes is not assessed by the institutions themselves.
In dat kader vinden deze leden het belangrijk dat de opleidingsaccreditaties in stand blijven en de kwaliteit van opleidingen niet door instellingen zelf worden beoordeeld.
Supports the bill for budget certainty but asks about the timeline and the effects of not proceeding, and asks about the definition of budget headlines for medezeggenschap consent.
These members consider it important that more fixed funding comes in universities of applied sciences and research universities.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat er meer vaste bekostiging komt in het hbo en het wo.
Asks how Parliament will be involved in shaping the evaluation of the quality funding instrument and what timeline is envisaged.
These members ask the government how the House will be involved in shaping the evaluation of the quality funding instrument.
Deze leden vragen de regering op welke wijze de Kamer betrokken wordt bij het vormgeven van de evaluatie van het instrument kwaliteitsbekostiging.

Asks how the government will guarantee that quality funds are actually invested in education quality and whether a share will be reserved for student initiatives, and how medezeggenschap will stay involved.
How will the government guarantee that the quality funds now being added to the lump sum are actually invested in the quality of education?
Hoe gaat de regering waarborgen dat de kwaliteitsgelden die nu worden toegevoegd aan de lumpsum, daadwerkelijk worden geïnvesteerd in de kwaliteit van het onderwijs?
Supports abolishing the quality agreements scheme to reduce administrative burden, asks about the stability of legislation, and questions whether further evaluation is still needed.
These members have been very critical from the outset of the system of quality agreements, partly in view of the expected red tape.
Deze leden zijn van meet af aan zeer kritisch geweest over de systematiek van kwaliteitsafspraken, mede met het oog op de te verwachten rompslomp.
Supports the bill as it brings more calm and space to the funding system, especially for institutions in shrinking regions, and has no further questions.
These members endorse the need for the bill, as it brings more calm and space to the funding system.
Deze leden onderschrijven de noodzaak voor het wetsvoorstel, aangezien deze zorgt voor meer rust en ruimte in het stelsel van bekostiging.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on a bill abolishing the statutory basis for quality funding in higher education, asking for evaluation of the instrument and clarity on works council and stakeholder involvement in quality investments. The government reply accepts the advice, commits to an evaluation, clarifies the role of the works council from 2025, and makes technical amendments.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacks an assessment of the necessity and usefulness of the quality funding instrument and no final evaluation is planned; the government agrees to evaluate the instrument.

Clarity is needed on the role of the works council and of internal and external stakeholders in quality investments after the funding is moved into the lump sum; the government adds this to the explanatory memorandum and agreed the 2025 works council role.
The explanatory memorandum is updated with the revoked implementing provisions, corrected price-level figures, and the 2025 allocation mechanism.

36463.s: The bill criminalises equipping or keeping vehicles with concealed compartments meant to obstruct criminal investigation, with heavier penalties for professional or habitual conduct, and adds disqualification from professions for certain offences. It also amends the Penal Code, Code of Criminal Procedure, Opium Act, General Administrative Law Act and Civil Procedure Code on case transfers, recusal (wraking) handling by a multi-judge chamber, and joint liability for confiscation orders, plus minor changes to anti-money-laundering rules allowing the FIU to order bank transaction holds.
36463.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the growth of vehicles with concealed compartments and the need for effective deterrence against undermining organised crime, and notes that existing confiscation and customs rules are insufficient.
q: This concerns a change to the rules on relative jurisdiction in the Code of Criminal Procedure, consisting of two elements.
Dit betreft een wijziging van de regeling van de relatieve competentie in het Wetboek van Strafvordering (Sv) voorgesteld, die bestaat uit twee elementen
p: The Financial Intelligence Unit may order banks to hold client transactions for up to five working days on suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing, without prior judicial authorisation.
Allows confiscation orders for illicit gains to be imposed jointly on co-convicted persons forming an economic unit, subject to judicial findings.
Lets the trial court transfer an ongoing case to another competent court after the hearing has begun, on prosecution request or defendant request, after hearing the parties.
Artikel II I, VII B, VIII B (multi-judge chamber recusal)
Allows a multi-judge chamber to dispose of manifestly inadmissible or unfounded recusal requests without a hearing, while the recused judge may still take urgent decisions.

parties: Questions whether joint liability for unexplained assets of co-convicted persons turns the confiscation into a punishment and conflicts with the presumption of innocence.
In the view of these members, also following the Rvdr and the NOvA, it is therefore difficult to understand why one convicted person should also be liable for unexplained assets of the other.

Naar de mening van de aan het woord zijnde leden, mede in navolging van de Rvdr en de NOvA, is het daarom moeilijk te begrijpen waarom een van de veroordeelden ook voor onverklaarbaar vermogen van de ander aangesproken zou moeten kunnen worden.
Asks whether the amended joint-liability rule adequately protects persons who committed no offence and did not enjoy the proceeds, given evidentiary burdens on the convicted person.

These members ask the government whether it considers it sufficiently guaranteed that people who themselves committed no criminal offence are not confronted with a confiscation measure while they did not enjoy the unlawfully obtained benefit.

Deze leden vragen de regering of zij voldoende gewaarborgd acht dat mensen die zelf geen strafbaar feit hebben gepleegd, niet worden geconfronteerd met een ontnemingsmaatregel terwijl zij zelf het wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel niet hebben genoten.
Asks about the effectiveness of the FIU's temporary transaction-freezing power and what information affected persons receive when it is applied.
These members ask what information the person concerned receives when this power is applied.
Deze leden vragen welke informatie de betrokkene krijgt als deze bevoegdheid wordt toegepast.
Supports tougher penalties and stronger recusal rules against abusive challenges, while asking about the scope of disqualification from professions and the duration limits.
The VVD members support the proposed amendment of the recusal arrangements.
De leden van de VVD-fractie steunen de voorliggende wijziging van de wrakingsregelingen.
Welcomes the measures but warns of legal error and unfair labelling of innocent citizens, and of the quality of legislation around the new non-conviction confiscation.
Through various channels, the BBB members already receive reports that people are wrongly labelled as fraudsters or criminals because they cannot always prove to the bank where their money came from.

Via verschillende kanalen krijgen de leden van de fractie-BBB al berichten dat mensen onterecht als fraudeur of crimineel worden bestempeld omdat zij niet altijd precies bij de bank kunnen aantonen waar zij het geld vandaan hebben.
Argues that the temporary blocking of transactions should not be limited to banks since criminal transactions do not stay within banks.
These members agree with several organisations in the consultation that this should not be limited to banks.
Deze leden zijn het wel eens met de mening van meerdere organisaties in de consultatie dat dit zich niet zou moeten beperken tot banken.
Asks for motivation of the higher fine category and whether preparatory acts for hidden compartments are punishable.
These members ask the government for a justification of why specifically the fine category for these two offences is raised.
Deze leden vragen de regering om een motivering waarom specifiek de boetecategorie voor deze twee misdrijven wordt verhoogd.
Asks how the new offence's elements (intended concealment, possession) will be proven and what the impact on the prison service will be.
They first ask how it will be demonstrated that 'that is evidently intended to prevent or hinder the investigation of criminal offences'.
Zij vragen allereerst hoe «die kennelijk is bestemd om de opsporing van strafbare feiten te beletten of te bemoeilijken» zal worden aangetoond.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill strengthening criminal law against undermining crime, raising concerns about the added value and evidentiary burden of joint confiscation liability, the scope of deprivation of rights, the legal basis for data sharing, weak links between components, and applicability to the Caribbean Netherlands. The government's reply reports that the advice was followed, with amendments to the bill and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Joint liability for confiscation under the third paragraph of article 36e Sr risks burdening co-accused with unexplained wealth they did not enjoy, given the civil burden of proof; the government limited application to cases where an economic unit enjoyed the proceeds.

Expanded deprivation of rights raises data-protection concerns, as the basis for disclosing criminal data to organisations was asserted without specification; the explanatory memorandum now sets out the legal bases.
Several components of the bill (wraking rules, functional prosecutor's remit) lack clear connection to the stated aim; the explanatory memorandum and preamble were clarified.

Applicability to the Caribbean Netherlands must be applied or explained under the apply-or-explain principle; the government describes a component-by-component assessment and a separate track for later extension.

36481.s: This omnibus bill (Verzamelwet BZK) makes many technical corrections across laws under the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations, including pension and reintegration rules for political office holders, local and provincial rules, electoral law, and transparency laws. It also updates ministerial references and sets commencement and retroactivity rules.
36481.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical corrections of errors and outdated references, not as new executive powers.
q: The proposed changes do not substantively affect the financial provisions of members of parliament and are merely technical in nature.
De voorgestelde wijzigingen raken niet inhoudelijk aan de geldelijke voorzieningen van Kamerleden en zijn slechts technisch van aard
d: rules on reintegration support cost allowance
reintegration plan components and cost rules
model for minutes of briefstembureau public session
model for proces-verbaal of public sitting
p: Artikel XXI, B (art. 12a Wet herstel voorzieningen Sint Eustatius)
The Rijksvertegenwoordiger regains the powers of the island governor during the appointment procedure for Sint Eustatius, bypassing the local executive.
Artikel XXV, C/F and Artikel XXVI (Wet open overheid, ACM)
Transparency rules are narrowed, for example by allowing the ACM to withhold information in certain cases and removing an information-claim power.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to a planned one-off withdrawal of ten percent of pension capital before final decision-making, and asks for clarification of references to art. 52b in the Appa amendments.
These members object to this and point out that final decision-making on withdrawing this amount in one go has yet to take place.
Deze leden hebben hier bezwaar tegen en wijzen erop dat definitieve besluitvorming over het in één keer opnemen van dit bedrag nog moet plaatsvinden.

Questions the Kieswet timing of membership of the Tweede Kamer and the continuity of parliament, and questions the legality of changing 'moeder' in the Wet BRP via an omnibus bill without a proper debate, arguing delegation grounds do not allow departure from the formal law.
Does this not deserve an open and substantive debate instead of being slipped into a package of seemingly technical measures?
Verdient dit niet een open en inhoudelijk debat in plaats van dit weg te schuiven in een pakket van naar het lijkt technische maatregelen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Verzamelwet BZK 20XX, a technical omnibus bill, and asked that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented to state that Article 63 of the Constitution (two-thirds majority for MPs' financial provisions) does not apply to the technical amendments to the Appa. The minister's reply accepted the advice, added the clarification to the general part of the explanatory memorandum, and made several further technical corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented to make explicit that Article 63 of the Constitution does not apply to the technical amendments of the Appa, and the minister added this clarification.

36490.s: The bill amends article 3 of the Nuclear Energy Act to remove policy preparation and policy evaluation from the mandate of the ANVS, keeping only an advisory role on nuclear safety policy and regulation linked to its other statutory tasks. It also adds a new task for the ANVS to participate in drafting nuclear safety rules under Euratom Directive 2009/71.
36490.j: The memorandum justifies the change by arguing that policy preparation and evaluation are activities tied to the minister's responsibility and should not sit with the ANVS.
q: These are activities connected with the Minister of IenW's responsibility for policy and regulation in nuclear safety and radiation protection, and therefore should not be assigned to the ANVS statutory body.

Dit zijn activiteiten die samenhangen met de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van IenW voor het beleid en de regelgeving op het terrein van Nucleaire Veiligheid en Stralingsbescherming en dienen derhalve niet bij het zbo ANVS te zijn belegd.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel 1 (art. 3 lid 3 sub c Kernenergiewet)
Policy and regulation preparation and evaluation are moved from the ANVS back to the minister, reducing the independent agency's role while keeping an advisory function.

parties: Asks whether the ministry's policy directorate and the ANVS as regulator are properly separated, how this will be safeguarded, and how the evaluation's nine recommendations are being implemented.
These members consider it desirable that a better demarcation remains between the ANVS as supervisor and licensing authority and the ministry as policy directorate.
Deze leden vinden het wenselijk dat een betere afbakening blijft tussen de ANVS als toezichthouder en vergunningverlener en het ministerie als beleidsdirectie.
Has read the bill with interest and has no further questions.
The members of the NSC group have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions.
De leden van de NSC-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.
Has taken note of the bill and waives further contribution.
The members of the D66 group have taken note of the bill and refrain from further input.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en zien af van een verdere inbreng.
Welcomes the better demarcation of the ANVS's tasks and powers relative to the minister's, with no further comments for now.

They consider it positive that there will be a better demarcation of the ANVS's tasks and powers in relation to those of the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat, and have no further comments for now.

Zij achten het positief dat er een betere afbakening komt van de taken en bevoegdheden van de ANVS in verhouding tot die van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, en hebben voor nu geen verdere opmerkingen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Nuclear Energy Act concerning the task of the Autoriteit Nucleaire Veiligheid en Stralingsbescherming for policy preparation and evaluation, and found no remarks on the proposal. The government's reply notes that the Afdeling raised no substantive points and that only some textual additions were made to the explanatory memorandum.

36526.s: The bill amends the Dutch anti-money laundering act (Wwft) and Sanctions Act 1977 to implement EU Regulation 2023/1113 on crypto-asset transfer information and align with MiCA. It moves supervision of crypto-asset service providers to the AFM, removes the national registration regime with a transitional period until 30 June 2025 or MiCA licensing, and adds risk-mitigation and contact-point obligations.
36526.j: The memorandum justifies the transition and supervisory shift by the need to avoid two parallel regimes that would confuse consumers and weaken incentives to comply with MiCA.
q: During the transitional period two regimes for crypto-service provision would exist side by side, which is undesirable unless strictly necessary.
Gedurende de overgangstermijn zullen er twee stelsels voor cryptodienstverlening naast elkaar bestaan, hetgeen niet wenselijk is zo lang het niet uiterst noodzakelijk is.
p: Transitional rules let existing crypto providers keep operating under the old regime until 30 June 2025 or until a MiCA licence is granted or refused, with supervision shifting from DNB to the AFM.

parties: Asks how the balance between effective anti-money-laundering enforcement and protection of personal privacy is safeguarded, and what measures ensure effective supervision and enforcement.

First, these members ask, regarding transparency and privacy, how the balance between effective anti-money-laundering enforcement and protection of the privacy of those involved is safeguarded within the new regulation.

Ten eerste vragen deze leden met betrekking tot transparantie en privacy hoe de balans tussen effectieve witwasbestrijding en de bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen wordt gewaarborgd binnen de nieuwe regelgeving.
Asks how the removal of the de minimis threshold counters smurfing and whether transfers to third jurisdictions are identified, and seeks clarity on supervision of self-hosted wallets.

The members of the GroenLinks-PvdA group ask whether the government can again explain how removing the de minimis rule counters smurfing (staying below a monitoring threshold by splitting transactions into small parts) and contributes to effectively countering anonymity.

De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie vragen of de regering nog eens kan toelichten hoe met het wegnemen van de de minimis-regel smurfing (het onder een grenswaarde van toezicht op transacties blijven door deze transacties in brokjes op te knippen) wordt tegengegaan en dit bijdraagt aan de effectiviteit van het tegengaan van anonimiteit.

Asks how enforcement and compliance will be arranged, the consequences for DNB and AFM supervisory capacity, whether the Raad van State-type advice (ATR) and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens have advised, and whether monitoring will occur.
The members of the NSC group ask how enforcement and compliance with the TFR regulation will be arranged.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen hoe de handhaving en naleving van de TFR-verordening geregeld gaat worden.
Has no further questions on the bill.

The members of the D66 group have taken note with interest of the Implementation Act on the regulation on information accompanying transfers of funds and crypto-assets and have no further questions on it.

De leden van de D66-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van de Uitvoeringswet verordening bij geldovermakingen en overdrachten van cryptoactiva te voegen informatie en hebben hierover geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on the bill implementing EU Regulation 2023/1113 on crypto-asset transfers, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport confirms clarifications on supervisory scope (DNB and AFM), transitional law, anticipated supervisory costs and implementation tables.

36535.s: The bill creates a legal basis in the Wet inburgering 2021 for a mid-year revision of the preliminary municipal integration grant based on general administrative order data, and for a specific grant for the education route with the minister setting detailed rules by ministerial regulation. It also gives the existing ministerial regulations a statutory footing and sets an expiry date for the new specific grant article.
36535.j: The memorandum justifies the mid-year revision by the difficulty municipalities face in anticipating end-of-year settlements when inflows change sharply, and says the education route grant rests on a ministerial regulation pending statutory basis.
q: To solve this problem, the proposed amendment provides for a further provisional decision moment during and no later than mid-way through implementation year t, with the grant revised on the basis of current data to be set by general administrative order.

Om dit knelpunt op te lossen voorziet de voorliggende wijziging in een nader voorlopig beschikkingsmoment gedurende en uiterlijk halverwege het uitvoeringsjaar t, waarbij de uitkering wordt herzien op basis van bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te bepalen actuele gegevens.
d: data basis for mid-year revision of grant total
spending requirements, advances, grant amount and municipal allocation for education route grant
p: The minister may award and detail a specific grant for the education route by ministerial regulation, with accountability via the municipal reporting duty and an expiry date set by royal decree.

parties: Asks which rules will be set by AMvB, how updated data will be used, and how legal certainty is guaranteed.
Furthermore, these members ask for further explanation of legal certainty.
Verder vragen deze leden om een nadere toelichting op de rechtszekerheid.
Asks whether the AMvB will be submitted to the Tweede Kamer and which current data will inform it.
These members ask whether the mentioned general administrative order (AMvB) will also be submitted to the House of Representatives.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de genoemde algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) ook voorgehangen wordt aan de Tweede Kamer.
Asks which rules will be set by AMvB, whether it concerns data or calculation method, and why a statutory basis came so late.
The SGP members ask whether rules will be set by AMvB on which updated data are used.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of bij AMvB regels zullen worden gesteld over welke geactualiseerde gegevens gebruikt worden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill allowing a provisional supplementary grant to municipalities for civic integration costs and creating a legal basis for a specific education-route grant. The Council had no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, so the government's reply merely confirms this without further changes.

36544.s: The bill amends the Wet basisregistratie ondergrond so that drinking water companies become source holders obliged to supply relevant subsurface documents to the BRO via the source holder portal. It sets a five-year transition period for historical documents and lets an AMvB set detailed delivery rules, including distinctions between public bodies and water companies.
36544.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegation by saying the technical and process-related detail is best left to regulation, with water companies best placed to judge which data count as process data.
q: Because of the process-related nature of this data, it is assumed that the drinking water companies are best placed to judge when data must be classed as process data, and that no detailed regulation is needed for this.

Vanwege het procesinhoudelijke karakter van deze gegevens wordt verondersteld dat de drinkwaterbedrijven zelf het beste kunnen beoordelen wanneer data als procesdata moeten worden aangemerkt, en dat hiervoor geen gedetailleerde regelgeving voor nodig is.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 9, tweede lid)
detailed rules on delivery of source documents, distinguishing public bodies and water companies
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 9, vijfde lid, nieuw)
technical manner of delivering source documents
Artikel I, onderdeel B and C (artikelen 6, eerste lid, en 7, derde lid)
rules on registration objects and source documents, formerly by regulation of the Minister

parties: Asks why the obligation was softened to a discretionary provision, whether the burden on companies is proportionate, and whether the regulatory-burden advisory body will review the amended proposal.
Has the government considered asking the ATR to issue an advice on the amended proposal?
Heeft de regering overwogen om het ATR te verzoeken een advies uit te brengen over het gewijzigde voorstel?
Questions the access rights of drinking water companies to all data, the validation of models without traceable underlying sources, and whether the scope goes beyond EU requirements.
Can the government explain why these models are nonetheless validated and used?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom deze modellen dan toch gevalideerd en gebruikt worden?
Has no further questions and thanks the government for a useful amendment.
These members thank the government for this useful and good amendment of the law.
Deze leden bedanken de regering voor deze nuttige en goede wetswijziging.
Asks whether all data holders should get full access to source documents given digital security risks for critical infrastructure data, and about cost pass-through to consumers.
To what extent have conflicting conclusions been drawn in the past five years, and what is the exact number?
In hoeverre is er sprake van dat er strijdige conclusies zijn getrokken in de afgelopen vijf jaar, wat is het exacte aantal daarvan?
Has no further questions on the bill.
These members have no further questions about it.
Deze leden hebben daar geen verdere vragen over.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on the bill amending the Wet basisregistratie ondergrond to designate drinking water companies as source holders, and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. The minister's reply (nader rapport) reports only two clarifications added to the explanatory memorandum: the public nature of drinking water companies' tasks and a definition of 'procesdata'.

36550-V.s: This first supplementary budget for 2024 amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by changing commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles and non-policy articles. It also sets the unit of account in thousands of euros and makes the act effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2024.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2024
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2024

36571.s: The bill tightens the Electoral Act's rules on proxy voting by requiring that a principal appoint the proxy holder personally and by making it a crime to deliberately approach someone to sign a proxy form or submit a proxy request, punishable by up to six months' imprisonment or a category-three fine. It also extends related provisions so the new offence is covered by the existing penal framework and enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
36571.j: The memorandum justifies the stricter rules by the aim of fair and reliable elections and explains that proxy voting is meant for voters unable to attend in person, not for groups to take over voting rights.
q: The proxy scheme is not intended to give groups the opportunity to take over the voting power of eligible voters ...
De volmachtregeling is niet bedoeld om groeperingen de gelegenheid te bieden de stembevoegdheid van kiesgerechtigden ... over te nemen

parties: Asks how the boundary between lawful information and punishable recruitment will work in practice, and whether the new offence will lead to more prosecutions.
To what extent does the bill mainly have a normative effect, and to what extent does the government think tightening the law will lead to more prosecutions?
In hoeverre heeft het voorliggend wetsvoorstel met name een normatieve werking en in hoeverre meent de regering dat de aanscherping van de wet tot meer vervolgingen zal gaan leiden?
Welcomes the stronger offence but questions its effectiveness, asks how family pressure and assistance in the polling booth can be addressed, and seeks clarification of the intent standard.
A point of concern in recruiting votes is pressure or coercion exercised within the family, which is hard to tackle.
Een punt van zorg bij het ronselen van stemmen is drang dan wel dwang, uitgeoefend in de familiesfeer.
Questions whether political parties should act as intermediaries, whether the 'own disposal' criterion is clear enough for prosecution, and how well the offence fits legitimate family help.
These members note that the criterion of making the proxy vote one's own disposal is unclear or difficult to establish.
Deze leden constateren echter dat het criterium «tot eigen beschikking maken» niet duidelijk is of niet duidelijk vast te stellen zal zijn.
Supports the aim of countering vote recruitment but asks why the number of proxies per person is not reduced from two to one.
These members support the aim of countering the recruitment of votes through proxies.
Deze leden ondersteunen de inzet om het ronselen van stemmen middels volmachten tegen te gaan.

Questions the proportionality of raising the maximum penalty from one to six months and the evidence that a heavier sentence will deter, and raises the risk of disproportionate punishment for well-meaning relatives.
What shows that a substantial increase in the penalty will have an effect, and on what is that expectation based?
Waaruit blijkt dat een forse verzwaring van de straf effect zal hebben, waarop is die verwachting gebaseerd?

Asks for clarity on whether family members acting with good intentions could fall under the offence, supports an explicit family exception as proposed by the NOvA, and asks whether giving arguments for proxies should be punishable given freedom of expression.
Even family members with good intentions, acting in line with the purpose of a proxy, can meet the offence description if they deliberately approach a relative to persuade them to grant the proxy.

Ook familieleden met goede bedoelingen, die handelen naar de bedoeling van een volmacht, kunnen voldoen aan de delictsomschrijving als zij opzettelijk hun familielid benaderen om hen ertoe te bewegen de volmacht te verstrekken.
Agrees with the government that voters must decide freely and has no further questions at this stage.
At this point they have no further questions about the government's proposal to tighten the relevant provisions of the Kieswet.
Zij hebben op dit moment geen nadere vragen bij het voorstel van de regering om de betreffende bepalingen in de Kieswet aan te scherpen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill tightening the criminal offence of recruiting postal votes and restricting seat allocation, noting limited enforceability in private settings and the need to justify the electoral threshold. The government's reply accepts the points on voorlichting and the postal-vote instruction, rejects the need for a statutory steminstructie, and splits off the seat-allocation part, which will be submitted separately.
concerns: Enforcement of the criminal offence against recruitment in the private sphere is limited by awareness and evidence problems, so non-criminal voorlichting is needed; the government agrees and adds it to the explanation.

The explanation should address whether recruiting several persons with one act constitutes multiple offences; the government explains this via single or multiple qualification in prosecution and sentencing rather than amending the text.
The Council asked why a postal-vote instruction duty is not in the Kieswet; the government sees no added value in a statutory rule and will instead stress it in voter information.

The Council found the seat-allocation electoral threshold insufficiently motivated, given its different effect on smaller bodies, representativeness and alternatives; this part was split off and not answered in this text.

36607.s: The bill freezes the phase-out of the double general tax credit in the reference minimum wage for 2025, 2026 and 2027 by postponing the end date of the phase-out in the Algemene nabestaandenwet and the Participatiewet from 1 January 2025 to 1 January 2028. It is intended to support the purchasing power of people on minimum benefits.
36607.j: The memorandum justifies the postponement by the government's duty to ensure livelihood security and the purchasing-power support for people on minimum benefits, with no delegation of powers.
q: Ensuring livelihood security is a constitutional task of the government.
Zorg dragen voor bestaanszekerheid is een grondwettelijk taak van de overheid.

parties: Supports the bill's contribution to financial security and asks for calculations of effects and whether automatic toeslag entitlement is possible.
These members are very aware of the problems of financial security and think the bill contributes to addressing them.
Deze leden zijn zich zeer bewust van de problemen in bestaanszekerheid en denken dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel daaraan een bijdrage levert.
Asks whether the phase-out should be accelerated after 2027, the budgetary trade-offs, and employment and work-incentive effects.
Has consideration been given to accelerating the phase-out after 2027 to compensate for the delay and thus stimulate long-term labour participation?
Is overwogen om de afbouw in de jaren na 2027 te versnellen om de vertraging te compenseren en zo de lange termijn arbeidsparticipatie te stimuleren?
Asks whether the measure prolongs the single-earner problem.
Is it correct that this measure prolongs the duration of the single-earner problem?
Klopt het dat deze maatregel de duur van de eenverdienersproblematiek verlengt?
Questions the short-term nature of the fix, which defers key challenges to a next government, and the work incentives of higher benefits.
These members ask whether the government does not see this as short-term thinking, shifting important challenges to a next government through temporary measures.
Deze leden vragen of de regering dit niet ziet als korte-termijn denken, waarbij met tijdelijke maatregelen belangrijke opgaven naar een volgende regering worden verschoven.
Asks how the government reflects on the earlier phase-out's negative income effects for single earners and benefit recipients, and on the number of affected households.
How does the government look back on the phase-out of the double AHK in both categories?
Hoe blikt de regering terug op de afbouw van de dubbele AHK in beide categorieën?
Criticises the temporary nature and the contradictory combination with a lower AHK, and asks about the long-term social minimum policy and income effects.
These members characterise this as mopping the floor with the tap running.
Deze leden typeren dit als dweilen met de kraan open.
Asks why a temporary pause rather than a structural solution is chosen and why unequal treatment across single earners, benefit recipients and AOW recipients persists.
These members therefore ask the government why a one-off pause is chosen rather than a structural solution.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarom waarom wordt gekozen voor een eenmalige pauzering, en niet voor een structurele oplossing.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that pausing the reduction of the double general tax credit in the social assistance minimum wage for three years is not a structural solution and creates significant side effects, so a fundamental revision of benefit foundations should be considered, with a timeline. The minister agreed the pause is not structural, pointed to higher housing and child benefits and planned reforms, and added a timeline-related clarification to the explanatory memorandum without giving a fixed timeline.
concerns: The pause is not a structural solution for an inadequate social minimum, but the government points to other income measures and reform agendas as the broader response.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to explain how and when a fundamental solution for the inadequate social minimum will be provided; the government adds a broader reform ambition but gives no fixed timeline.
The pause worsens the single-earner problem and makes the tax and benefit system more complex for citizens, a side effect the government acknowledges.

36613-V.s: The bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting expenditure and commitment figures across policy and non-policy articles, including a 295 million euro supplementary increase and a September supplementary budget reduction. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 17 September 2024.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2024
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken voor het jaar 2024

36616.s: The bill makes numerous technical and minor policy amendments to Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment legislation, including extending limitation periods for unpaid child benefit and survivors' benefits from three months to two years, clarifying health-data processing for reporting workplace accidents under the Working Conditions Act, adjusting child-labour rules, and updating income thresholds and references. It also amends the Warenwet to clarify the Minister of SZW's responsibility for personal protective equipment and machinery, and makes several cross-referencing corrections.
36616.j: The memorandum justifies the health-data processing exception by the need for legal certainty for employers reporting accidents to the inspectorate, and the Warenwet change by removing uncertainty over enforcement responsibility.
q: To leave no misunderstanding about whether employers may process health data when reporting notifiable workplace accidents and reporting on them, it is proposed to add a new paragraph to article 9.

Om geen enkel misverstand te laten bestaan over de toelaatbaarheid voor werkgevers om gegevens over de gezondheid te verwerken bij het melden en rapporteren van meldingsplichtige arbeidsongevallen, wordt voorgesteld om aan artikel 9 een nieuw lid toe te voegen.
d: Artikel IV, onderdeel A (Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, art. 1, bij algemene maatregel van bestuur)
designation of cases in which a person is treated as employer
Artikel V (Arbeidswet BES 2000, art. 19, lid 2, bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur)
permitted light work for children aged 13 or 14, with conditions
Artikel XV, onderdeel B (Wet langdurige zorg, art. 9.1.3a, lid 5)
further rules on ambtshalve data sharing and processing for child benefit
p: Artikel XV, onderdeel B (Wet langdurige zorg, art. 9.1.3a, lid 1-4)
The CIZ may share personal and health-related data ex officio with the SVB to trigger child benefit doubling, after giving the representative a two-week chance to object.

parties: Asks whether the government's reading of the CRvB ruling on WAZ benefit reviews is the least favourable one for benefit recipients, a due-process and legal-protection concern.
Can the government confirm that its interpretation of the aforementioned ruling is the least favourable explanation for benefit recipients?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat de uitleg die de regering geeft aan voornoemde uitspraak voor uitkeringsgerechtigden de minst gunstige uitleg is?
Asks for clarification of the rules on working children aged 13 and 14 and the WGA premium effects, without raising a check concern.
What specifically is understood by work that does not place high physical or mental demands?
Wat wordt specifiek verstaan onder werkzaamheden die lichamelijk of geestelijk geen hoge eisen stellen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Verzamelwet SZW 2025, a bill with various technical and minor policy amendments to social affairs laws, and raised no remarks. The Minister's reply (nader rapport) notes that the proposal gave no reason for substantive comments and asks the King to send the bill to the Tweede Kamer.

36625-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the States General (Staten-Generaal) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and revenue figures for the Senate, House of Representatives and joint parliamentary items. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The budget statement of the States General for the year 2024 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd

36634.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Comprehensive Air Transport Agreement concluded at Bali on 17 October 2022 between ASEAN member states and the European Union and its member states. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: is approved for the European part of the Netherlands
wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese deel van Nederland

parties: Asks how safety, environmental and working-time standards of non-EU airlines are ensured and whether complete information on regulatory differences is available.

The PVV members want to know to what extent aviation agreements such as the one with ASEAN ensure that foreign airlines meet comparable European standards on safety, environment and working conditions.

Inleiding De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten in hoeverre er in luchtvaartovereenkomsten, zoals die met ASEAN (Associatie van Zuidoost-Aziatische Naties), geborgd wordt dat buitenlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen voldoen aan vergelijkbare Europese normen op het gebied van veiligheid, milieu en arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Argues the agreement's aims of growth and market access are outdated, that it does nothing for climate and that it may undermine worker protection and safety; asks whether EU standards can be enforced.
As is well known, many countries outside the EU have considerably weaker employee protection and rules on working and rest times.
Zoals bekend, kennen veel landen buiten de EU aanmerkelijk slechtere werknemersbescherming en regelingen rond werk- en rusttijden.

Asks about consequences if the Netherlands does not ratify, whether the agreement can still be amended, and whether a level playing field on cabin crew rest periods and sustainable fuel obligations exists.
The NSC members ask whether the consequences and follow-up process can be outlined should the Netherlands decide not to ratify the agreement.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen of de gevolgen en het vervolgproces geschetst kunnen worden, mocht Nederland besluiten het verdrag niet te ratificeren.

Asks whether the agreement is binding on citizens as the Council of State suggests, how conflicts with existing bilateral treaties are resolved, and how fair competition and sovereignty over Dutch interests are guaranteed.
However, the Council of State's advisory division notes that the agreement contains several provisions that in earlier aviation treaties were designated as binding on everyone.
De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State merkt echter op dat de Overeenkomst verschillende bepalingen bevat die in eerdere luchtvaartverdragen wel als eenieder verbindend zijn aangeduid.

Argues the agreement favours the aviation industry over residents, workers and climate goals, asks whether it limits Dutch environmental measures, taxes on kerosene and tickets, and whether the government will enforce emission and noise commitments.
These treaties mainly promote the aviation industry and the 'consumer', while the interests of residents, workers and a liveable future are of secondary importance.
Deze verdragen bevorderen voornamelijk de luchtvaartindustrie en de «consument», terwijl de belangen van omwonenden, werknemers en een leefbare toekomst van ondergeschikt belang zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the ASEAN-EU air transport agreement's provisions may not be directly enforceable in the Dutch legal order, unlike similar bilateral aviation treaties, and asked the government to clarify this difference in the explanatory note and compare it with the Qatar agreement. The government's reply states that the bill is submitted to Parliament following the tacit approval procedure, having the Afdeling's advice already, and asks that the bill and explanatory memorandum be sent directly to the Tweede Kamer.
concerns: The explanatory note does not address how the agreement's lack of directly applicable (ieder verbindende) provisions compares with earlier bilateral aviation treaties, affecting airlines' legal protection in Dutch courts.
The Afdeling asks the government to adapt the explanatory note to clarify the difference with the Qatar air transport agreement on directly applicable provisions.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in December 2023 that the ASEAN-EU air transport agreement's claim to contain no provisions binding on individuals, under articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution, is in tension with comparable earlier air agreements, and asked for clarification in the explanatory note. The minister's reply in October 2024 concedes that the agreement does contain limited directly binding provisions via the preserved more favourable bilateral terms, and commits to amending the explanatory note.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the government's conclusion that the agreement has no provisions binding on individuals, given that similar earlier air agreements do, and the government conceded limited binding provisions and revised the explanatory note.

The Afdeling asked for clarity on how the ASEAN agreement differs from the bilateral agreements and the Qatar agreement regarding provisions binding on individuals, and the government explained the difference and revised the note.

36670.s: The bill amends the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs to loosen hour norms in vocational education, allow shortened vocational programmes for students with prior experience, detach elective modules from qualifications, and let non-state-funded providers offer parts of vocational programmes, while tightening some related regulation and reorganising chapters. It also adjusts related laws (kinderbijslag, toezicht, register, etc.) to match the new terminology and procedures.
36670.j: The memorandum justifies the new flexibility by labour-market needs and the wish to reduce administrative burden and the hour-norm drop-out problems, while retaining inspectorate oversight.
q: With this bill the statutory room to offer a shortened programme is clarified and on one point relaxed.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt de wettelijke ruimte voor het aanbieden van een verkorte opleiding verduidelijkt en op een enkel punt versoepeld.
d: entry requirements for shortened vocational programmes
limits on shortened programmes, caps and eligible students
rules on content of admission-criteria regulation
designating electives as remedial for learning delay
procedure and documents for recognition applications
p: The Minister may suspend examination or diploma rights of a non-state-funded provider for up to six months on a reasonable suspicion that diploma value is at stake, without prior court involvement.
The Minister may withdraw examination rights or recognition of a non-state-funded programme on quality grounds, subject to a prior warning and time limits.
The Minister may withdraw recognition of a programme with no enrolments for two years, including by linking it to warnings given for other programmes.
The Minister may end an examining institution's registration ex officio if no extraneï have enrolled for a year and the inspectorate sees reason, a shift of administrative discretion.
An AMvB may restrict which programmes qualify for shortening, cap the number of shortened programmes and define eligible students, in a limited but open-ended way.

parties: Asks how the individual proposals together improve labour-market alignment and whether the flexibility in hours applies to programmes or individual students.
These members ask whether this is actually desirable, since frequently heard criticism of retraining is that there is a tangle of trajectories so people cannot see the wood for the trees.
Zij vragen of dat nu eigenlijk wenselijk is, omdat veelgehoorde kritiek over om- of bijscholen is dat er een wirwar aan trajecten is waardoor mensen door de bomen het bos niet meer zien.
Asks whether support exists among institutions, teachers and parents, and whether fewer lessons by qualified teachers will reduce quality.
These members ask whether this will not lead to a decline in education quality, given that fewer lessons will be given by qualified teachers.
Deze leden vragen of dit niet zal leiden tot een daling van de onderwijskwaliteit, gezien het feit dat er minder lessen worden gegeven door bevoegde docenten.
Opposes loosening the 2014 lesson-hours norm, questions the thinness of the justification and the removal of studentenraad consent, and asks for stronger motivation for legislation.
Does the government agree that legislation is a heavy instrument that therefore requires strong justification, and acknowledge that a small number of signals is clearly not sufficient for this?

Is de regering ermee eens dat wetgeving een zwaar instrument is, juist daarom om een forse rechtvaardiging vraagt, en erkent zij dat een gering aantal signalen vanzelfsprekend hiervoor niet toereikend is?
Worries that reducing mandatory guided hours to 500 per year and allowing up to a quarter of contact time without qualified teachers will harm education quality.
As a result, up to a quarter of current guided teaching time can be filled with activities and assignments without a qualified teacher.
Hierdoor kan tot een kwart van de huidige begeleide onderwijstijd ingevuld worden met activiteiten en opdrachten zonder een bevoegde docent.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill improving the alignment of vocational education with the labour market, raising remarks on shortened courses, the role of examination committees in elective modules, the hour norm, and feasibility. The minister's reply accepted the advice on shortened courses and clarified the other points, partly adopting and partly explaining why other changes were not made.
concerns: Shortened vocational courses were summarily regulated; the Council asked for admission groups and procedures to be specified, which the government adopted by adding criteria, a ministerial regulation basis and quality review duties.
The ministerial regulation delegation for shortened course admission was not suited to ministerial regulation; the government replaced it with a general administrative order (AMvB) basis.

The Council asked for attention to the reduced role of examination committees in elective modules and for procedural safeguards; the government clarified the committee's role and suggested process agreements but did not change the decoupling.

The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to weigh students', teachers' and institutions' perspectives on the revised hour norm and explain how quality is safeguarded; the government added explanation but kept the change.
Uncertainty about feasibility for DUO and institutions before 1 August 2025 was addressed by adding DUO's feasibility findings and cost addendum to the memorandum.
