36706.s: The bill introduces a counter-evidence scheme in Dutch box 3 taxation, allowing taxpayers to have savings and investment income taxed on their actual return instead of the statutory flat-rate return, with new rules on deduction, owner-occupied housing benefits, and foreign-tax relief. It implements court rulings requiring such a scheme, retroactively to 2017 or 2023, with its entry into force set by royal decree.
36706.j: The memorandum justifies the scheme by Supreme Court rulings requiring taxpayers be given the opportunity to prove actual return, and the royal-decree timing by implementation needs.
q: Based on the Supreme Court rulings, taxpayers with an actual return lower than the flat-rate return must be given the opportunity to state this and, if disputed, to substantiate it.

Op basis van de arresten van de HR moeten belastingplichtigen met een lager werkelijk rendement dan het forfaitaire rendement de gelegenheid krijgen om dit te stellen en, in geval van betwisting, aannemelijk te maken.
d: entry into force of the act by royal decree
Artikel IV, Artikel 6, zesde lid onderdeel a
applicable version of tegenbewijs provisions set by royal decree
p: The inspector may grant ex officio reduction of allocation of extra deductions between partners, leaving discretion to the tax administration.

parties: Asks about implementation problems in distinguishing investments from maintenance costs and the budgetary and procedural consequences of the massaalbezwaarplus outcome.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members have read the bill on the counter-evidence scheme for box 3 carefully.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie hebben het wetsvoorstel Wet tegenbewijsregeling box 3 aandachtig gelezen.
Asks for clarification of unclear rules on negative regular benefits and on imputed value of owner-occupied second homes, including practical cases.
The VVD members attach importance to taxpayers and tax advisers being able to determine the actual box 3 return correctly.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hechten eraan dat belastingplichtigen en fiscaal dienstverleners op een juiste wijze het werkelijk rendement box 3 kunnen bepalen.
Supports rights restoration but warns the scheme is complex and burdens citizens' capacity to comply, and asks about monitoring who actually benefits.
At the same time these members note that the proposed counter-evidence scheme is complex and places heavy pressure on citizens' ability to comply.
Tegelijkertijd signaleren deze leden dat de voorgestelde tegenbewijsregeling complex is en grote druk legt op het doenvermogen van burgers.
Supports rightful taxation and redress but has concerns about implementability, legal certainty and budgetary effects.
At the same time these members have some concerns about the feasibility, legal certainty and budgetary effects of the bill.
Tegelijkertijd hebben deze leden enkele zorgen over de uitvoerbaarheid, de rechtszekerheid en de budgettaire gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel
Argues the bill does not bring a fair box 3 system closer, criticises the exclusion of non-objectors and the absence of cost deduction, and warns of litigation risk.
In the view of these members, the bill as it now stands does not bring a fairer box 3 system closer.
Het wetsvoorstel zoals het nu voorligt brengt een rechtvaardiger box 3-stelsel in de ogen van deze leden niet dichterbij
Warns of undesirable effects on the rental market and of legal risks and a flood of objections that put implementation and the legal system under pressure.
Secondly, these members fear legal risks and once again an enormous number of objections resulting from the design of the counter-evidence scheme.
Ten tweede vrezen deze leden juridische risico's en opnieuw een enorme hoeveelheid bezwaren als gevolg van de inrichting van de tegenbewijsregeling
Fears both the Tax Administration and individual taxpayers are overburdened without achieving the aim of restoring rights, and asks why obvious elements such as tenant costs are missing.
These members fear that both the Tax Administration and individual taxpayers are being overburdened without the intended goals of restoring rights being achieved.
Deze leden vrezen dat de zowel de Belastingdienst als individuele belastingplichtigen overvraagd worden, zonder dat de beoogde doelen van rechtsherstel worden behaald.
Asks whether taxpayers can still meet the deadline for ambtshalve vermindering given the timing of adoption, and about the legal risks of making the OWR form mandatory.
The longer it takes for the bill to be adopted, the less time taxpayers have to submit a request for ambtshalve vermindering.
Hoe langer het duurt voor het wetsvoorstel wordt aangenomen, hoe minder tijd belastingplichtigen hebben om een verzoek tot ambtshalve vermindering te doen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises that the box 3 counter-evidence scheme, implementing the Supreme Court's 2024 rulings, is legally sound but nearly unimplementable, urging mitigating measures and simplification of contested valuations such as owner-occupied property. The government's reply accepts some points (owner-occupied property rules adjusted, approach to proceedings and time limits), rejects mandatory use of the form and extension of assessment periods, and explains its choices on scope.
concerns: The Belastingdienst's implementation assessment shows red flags on all five aspects and near-impossible staffing; the Council asks for mitigating measures, which the government only partly adopts.
The Council advises extending the assessment period and mandatory use of the form to reduce workload; the government rejects both as undesirable or legally vulnerable.

The Council advises simplifying contested valuations, such as owner-occupied property, and considering excluding that benefit; the government adjusts the scheme for 2017-2025 and adds guidance for 2026 onward.
The Council asks the government to explain why the eligible group for the second restoration round differs from the first and the government explains its reasoning on scope.
The Council advises proactively identifying risks of missed statutory decision deadlines and adjusting them in time, and the government commits to communication and capacity measures.

36733.s: The bill implements the EU Data Act in Dutch law by designating the Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) as the main competent authority and data coordinator, and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) for personal-data aspects. It also sets up certification of dispute settlement bodies, sanction powers including administrative fines up to 10% of turnover, and amendments to the Databankenwet, Algemene wet bestuursrecht and consumer protection rules.
36733.j: The memorandum justifies the designation of ACM and AP by their existing expertise and by the need for uniform EU-level supervision of the Data Act.
d: rules on data exchange between ACM and other competent authorities
p: Gives ACM and AP power to impose administrative fines up to 10% of annual turnover and enforcement orders without prior judicial authorisation.
ACM certifies and may withdraw certification of dispute settlement bodies that the Data Act assigns a role in resolving data access disputes.
ACM and AP must share data needed for enforcement with each other on request.

parties: Worries that data-access powers for public bodies in emergencies may be too far-reaching and harm legal protection, and asks how this will be prevented.
how these potentially undesirable and far-reaching consequences will be prevented and how the system for requesting data will be arranged so that legal protection is not undermined.

hoe deze potentieel onwenselijke en verstrekkende gevolgen voorkomen gaan worden en hoe de systematiek voor het opvragen van gegevens dusdanig ingericht gaat worden dat voorkomen wordt dat deze de rechtsbescherming aantast.

Supports the bill in broad lines but asks for strict parliamentary and protocol-based control of emergency data powers, clear enforcement and legal recourse for users, and independent oversight of foreign government access.
Such far-reaching powers should, according to these members, be well monitored by parliament.
Zulke verstrekkende bevoegdheden dienen volgens deze leden goed gecontroleerd te worden door het parlement.
Asks how mandatory data sharing with governments and third parties avoids unintended privacy infringements and whether privacy-enhancing safeguards are applied and checked.
How is it checked whether these are actually applied?
Hoe wordt gecontroleerd of deze ook daadwerkelijk worden toegepast?

Asks why the Dutch Data Protection Authority's objections were not weighed more fully and whether the lack of a prior-consultation duty between the two regulators creates a risk of conflicting rulings.
Does the government share the view that with mixed datasets the risk of conflicting rulings by the AP and the ACM is real?
Deelt de regering de opvatting dat bij gemengde datasets het risico op conflicterende oordelen van de AP en de ACM reëel is?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the explanatory memorandum to the Uitvoeringswet dataverordening insufficiently justifies assigning supervision of Chapter V of the Data Act to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens rather than the ACM. The government's reply defends the AP choice with additional reasoning in the memorandum and makes several ex officio amendments, but does not change the allocation.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum omits reasons for designating the AP rather than the ACM as supervisor for Chapter V, and the advice asks for these to be added.

The Afdeling questions whether the AP's existing role and the assumption that requests mostly concern non-personal data justify the allocation; the government agrees to expand the justification but keeps the AP as supervisor.

36742.s: The bill consolidates rules on financing of political parties, internal transparency and finances of parties, and supervision and prohibition of parties into one law. It establishes an independent Dutch Authority for Political Parties (Napp) to grant subsidies, maintain registers, and supervise compliance, and gives courts a dedicated power to prohibit parties threatening the democratic constitutional order.
36742.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies delegation of technical indexation and reporting details to ministerial regulation as practical and as a means to keep the law workable.
q: Further requirements may be set by ministerial regulation for what political parties must submit to the supervisor.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere eisen worden gesteld aan hetgeen politieke partijen moeten aanleveren bij de toezichthouder.
d: further rules on registration of debts
requirements for financial reporting and audit scope
p: Creates an independent Authority to supervise and subsidise parties, shifting supervision away from the Minister of Interior Affairs toward an independent body.
Subsidy amounts and indexation are set through ministerial regulation with limited parliamentary involvement.

parties: Questions whether transparency alone without membership or internal democracy requirements is sufficient to protect democratic legitimacy and prevent closed elite parties receiving public funds.
Het wetsvoorstel schrijft alleen transparantie voor.
Asks on what grounds a party ban could be imposed, how arbitrariness is prevented, and whether an emergency procedure exists.
They also ask how the government intends to prevent arbitrariness in this process, given there is no clear line that must be crossed before a party ban is pursued.
Daarnaast vragen zij hoe de regering willekeur in dit proces wil voorkomen, gezien er geen duidelijke lijn is die kan worden overschreden tot overgegaan wordt tot een partijverbod.
Considers the choice for transparency rules only undermines the basis for membership requirements in subsidy rules and proposes substantive minimum internal-democracy criteria.
Argues party law should require internal democratic organisation and questions the government's rejection of an independent appointment committee for the supervisory authority Napp.
These members believe political parties should be organised internally in a democratic way.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat politieke partijen intern democratisch georganiseerd zouden moeten zijn.

Supports strengthening democracy but asks how transparency duties relate to freedom of association and whether small parties can comply, and what risks a party-ban procedure poses for political misuse.
They ask how this requirement relates to freedom of association and the room for parties to organise their internal structure independently.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe dit voorschrift zich verhoudt tot de vrijheid van vereniging en de ruimte voor partijen om hun interne organisatie zelfstandig in te richten.
Stresses a party ban must be an ultimate remedy and asks whether an explicit escalation ladder of lighter interventions should precede it, and questions the open-ended grounds in article 139.
It is therefore very important that this instrument is used only as an ultimate remedy and only if the democratic constitutional state cannot be protected in another way.
Het is daarom van groot belang dat dit middel alleen wordt ingezet als ultieme remedie en enkel als de democratische rechtsstaat niet op een andere manier beschermd kan worden.
Asks what added value the new party-ban article offers over article 2:20 BW and warns the open-ended formulation of principles is diffuse and legally vulnerable.
Asks why the government did not set minimum norms for internal democracy despite Raad van State concerns, and how Napp supervision stays limited to procedural control.
These members ask whether the government can further explain how supervision of compliance with the transparency obligations by Napp is organised.
Deze leden vragen of de regering nader kan toelichten op welke wijze het toezicht op de naleving van de transparantieverplichtingen door de Napp wordt vormgegeven.
Argues the donation ceiling of 100,000 euro per donor is too high and asks why corporate donations are allowed, pushing for stricter limits on large money flows.
These members have long held that a donation ceiling of 100,000 euro per donor per year is too high.
Deze leden zijn al langere tijd de mening toegedaan dat een giftenplafond van 100.000 euro per donor per jaar te hoog is.
Asks how the government will verify donor nationality and UBO status and how candidates' private gifts will be checked, seeking tighter controls against loopholes.
These members wonder how the government justifies that a distinction is still made between EU citizens and persons with Dutch nationality.
Deze leden vragen zich in deze nieuwe situatie nog steeds af hoe de regering rechtvaardigt dat er nog steeds een verschil wordt gemaakt tussen EU-burgers en personen met de Nederlandse nationaliteit.
Supports tighter party rules and supervision to protect democracy, but questions whether platforms rather than parties should bear transparency duties for online campaigns.
In the view of these members, especially given current political developments, it is important that the rules for parties are tightened and the supervisory system further strengthened.

Naar het oordeel van deze leden is het, vooral gezien de huidige politieke ontwikkelingen, van belang dat de regels voor partijen worden aangescherpt en het stelsel van toezicht verder wordt versterkt.
Asks for proportionate, workable registration and reporting duties for volunteer-run local branches and how the Napp will supervise proportionately.
These members therefore call for careful and realistic introduction of the Wpp.
Deze leden vragen daarom aandacht voor een zorgvuldige en realistische invoering van de Wpp.
Questions why the bill relies on EU regulation, whether microtargeting should be banned, and whether a national advertising register should exist, and how donors evade disclosure by splitting gifts.
Is microtargeting not in fact a form of improper influence, whereby voters with less political knowledge are disproportionately affected?
Is microtargeting niet feitelijk een vorm van ongeoorloofde beïnvloeding, waarbij juist kiezers met minder politieke kennis onevenredig beïnvloed worden?
Supports clear rules but worries about administrative burden and falling membership, and asks how membership figures and subsidy eligibility will be verified and sanctioned.
These members consider it necessary that subsidies are granted on the basis of entirely correct membership administration.
Deze leden achten het noodzakelijk dat de subsidies verstrekt worden op basis van volstrekt correcte administratie van ledenaantallen.
Asks about the administrative burden on parties, the status of bequests under the donation rules, and the adequacy of the youth-organisation subsidy amount.
These members also ask whether the government wishes to address the importance of membership numbers in the subsidy for political youth organisations.
Deze leden vragen eveneens of de regering wil ingaan op het belang van het ledenaantal in de subsidie voor politieke jongerenorganisaties.
Asks for a comparison table of the bill, EU transparency regulation and advisory recommendations, and for certainty and predictability in local-party subsidy amounts.
Can the government therefore indicate, in a table per measure or theme, what the differences and similarities are
Kan de regering daarom – in een tabel – per maatregel of thema – aangeven wat de verschillen en overeenkomsten zijn
Had initial questions that were resolved by the explanatory memorandum and is awaiting the government's answers.
They need to consider the reasoning in the bill and look forward to the government's answers to the questions of the other factions.
Zij moeten zich beraden op de gemaakte overwegingen in het wetsvoorstel en kijken uit naar de beantwoording van de regering op de vragen van de overige fracties.
The committee asks how the new Autoriteit politieke partijen relates to existing supervision and whether it will create extra bureaucratic burden.
How does the creation of the new Autoriteit politieke partijen relate to the existing supervisory system, and what guarantees are there that this does not lead to extra bureaucratic burdens?
Hoe verhoudt de oprichting van de nieuwe Autoriteit politieke partijen zich tot het bestaande toezichtstelsel, en welke waarborgen zijn er dat dit niet leidt tot extra bureau cratische lasten?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the draft Wet op de politieke partijen, finding the government's case for regulating parties convincing but asking for stronger justification of transparency duties, the definition of parties, the party-ban criterion, EU-law fit and the advertising scope. The government's reply largely accepts these points, deleting the party-purpose article and the 'een of meer grondbeginselen' wording, and adding justification.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether transparency duties on internal organisation will achieve the aim; the government justifies its restraint but does not impose internal-democracy requirements.

The definition of political party tied to registration of a name with the central electoral board leaves room to evade regulation; the government defends the criterion and rejects alternative registration routes.
The party-ban criterion ('een of meer grondbeginselen') could be read too broadly; the government deletes 'een of meer' from the norm.
The statutory purpose of parties (article 10) departs from the existing system and lacks justification; the government deletes the article.
The relationship to the EU Transparency Regulation on political advertising needs explanation; the government added explanation on this point in the reply.
Constitutional anchoring of parties is not necessary now, but the justification for not doing so should not foreclose it in future; the government adapts the explanation.
Limits on donations from non-Dutch residents (EUR 250) must be justified as proportionate under free movement of capital; the reply adds reasoning.

36800-X.s: This bill fixes the 2026 Defence departmental budget (expenditure and income totals and per-article amounts) and the 2026 budget of the Paresto agency in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 January 2026. The explanatory memorandum describes Defence priorities for 2026, including scalable armed forces, reservist and service-year schemes, border surveillance and Caribbean coast guard tasks, and veterans' compensation and funding.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2026 is hereby adopted.
Artikel 1 De bĳ deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the 2026 Defence budget bill (begrotingsstaat X) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport confirms the blank advice and notes only a technical change adjusting NATO percentages in table 55 for 2029 and 2030 following the CPB MEV update, with no change to total expenditure.

36814.s: The bill keeps the reduced VAT rate on culture, media and sport and limits the overgangsrecht to accommodation. It also restricts the annual indexation of several income and wage tax amounts for 2026 by applying a fixed factor instead of the standard tabelcorrectiefactor.
36814.j: The memorandum justifies the fixed indexation factor as a way to keep the reduced VAT rate, without any delegation of power to the executive.
q: The limited application of the inflation correction has, among other things, consequences for the amounts of the tax credits and the amounts in the fourth column of the income tax tables.
De beperkte toepassing van de inflatiecorrectie heeft onder andere gevolgen voor de bedragen van de heffingskortingen en de bedragen in de vierde kolom van de tabellen voor de inkomstenbelasting.

parties: Asks whether the government deliberately used a trick that worsens inequality and requests distributional figures per income quintile before accepting the financing.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members note that the government has pulled a trick.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie constateren dat de regering een truc heeft uitgehaald.
Asks how it is ensured that the lower VAT rate actually improves access for citizens and whether periodic monitoring will take place.
Is the cabinet willing to periodically monitor whether the lower VAT rate actually leads to higher participation in culture and sport and better access to media?
Is het kabinet bereid om periodiek te monitoren of het lagere btw-tarief ook daadwerkelijk leidt tot hogere deelname aan cultuur en sport en betere toegankelijkheid van media?
Asks for quantification of effects across income deciles, not only the median, and for alternative financing that burdens purchasing power less.
They wonder what happens to the income groups that deviate from the median.
Ze vragen zich af wat er gebeurt met de inkomensgroepen die afwijken van de mediaan.
Welcomes dropping the VAT increase but questions why the financing does not simplify the tax system and whether more efficient instruments or targeted compensation were considered.
Welcomes the bill but asks for clarity on budgetary calculations, the parameters changed and the threshold effects of the financing.
There appears to be much uncertainty about the precise calculation of the yield of this abolition.
Er lijkt veel onduidelijkheid te zijn over de precieze berekening van de opbrengst van deze afschaffing.
Supports keeping the reduced rate but finds the generic financing source too blunt and asks for alternatives, including reconsidering the rise on accommodation.
They find that partially not indexing a number of parameters in income tax is too generic a source of financing and would have preferred a more targeted choice by the government.

Ze vinden dat het gedeeltelijk niet-indexeren van een aantal parameters in de inkomstenbelasting een te generieke dekkingsbron is en hadden graag gezien dat de regering een meer gerichte keuze had gemaakt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the bill extending the reduced VAT rate for culture, media and sport and limiting indexation of certain tax and benefit thresholds via a partial tabelcorrectiefactor. The government's reply extends the limited indexation to the asset limits for the huurtoeslag and the inkomstenbelasting, applying the full factor of 1.029 for consistency.

36820-V.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2025, adjusting commitment and expenditure appropriations across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the changes effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 16 September 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken voor het jaar 2025

36832.s: The bill amends the Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg to add two new protected professional titles, medisch hulpverlener acute zorg and klinisch fysicus, with registers and disciplinary jurisdiction, and to change the reference date for periodic registration and make disciplinary procedures explicitly digital. It also delegates to general administrative orders (AMvB) the training requirements, scope of competence and restrictions for the new professions.
36832.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to specify training requirements and the scope of the new professions in line with the experiment and the evaluation findings.
q: By general administrative order, restrictions are set on the acts referred to in the first paragraph.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden beperkingen gesteld aan de in het eerste lid bedoelde handelingen.
d: training requirements for medisch hulpverlener acute zorg
scope of competence and restrictions for medisch hulpverlener acute zorg
scope of competence and handelingen for klinisch fysicus
rules on electronic traffic with disciplinary colleges and digital systems
p: Scope of competence of the new profession is to be specified by general administrative order, with restrictions to be set by that order.

parties: Asks why the klinisch fysicus is not fully included in article 3 of the Wet BIG and whether the four-area division leaves room for innovation.
They ask the government whether the proposed division into four work areas is adequate for this purpose.
Zij vragen de regering of de voorgestelde indeling in vier werkvelden hiervoor toereikend is.
Doubts the legal framework for retrograde recognition, competence transfer and disciplinary accountability, and questions the rationale for the change.

Where it concerns retrograde recognition of a foreign diploma and an adaptation internship (what exactly is this) and a proof of competence has been taken (under which standards and assessed by whom), this rule raises much uncertainty.

Daar waar het gaat om (retrograde) erkenning van een buitenlands diploma en een aanpassingsstage (wat is dit precies) en een proeve van bekwaamheid is afgelegd (onder welke standaarden en door wie getoetst) roept deze regel veel onduidelijkheid op.
Asks why a professional title was not chosen for the klinisch fysicus instead of fixed differentiations.
Can the government explain why it was not chosen to allow a professional title within which the klinisch fysicus can practise?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom niet gekozen is om een beroepstitel mogelijk te maken, waarbinnen de klinisch fysicus zijn of haar beroep kan uitoefenen?
Supports regulation of the klinisch fysicus under article 3 but questions the audiology exception that conflicts with field practice and the Zorginstituut advice.

How does the government explain the differences of view between the Zorginstituut and the various field parties, who claim that the exclusion of the audiology klinisch fysicus rests on an incorrect finding by the Zorginstituut?

Hoe verklaart de regering de verschillen in opvatting tussen het Zorginstituut en de verschillende veldpartijen, die beweren dat de uitsluiting van de klinisch fysicus in de audiologie berust op een onjuiste constatering van het Zorginstituut dat deze groep niet over de nodige deskundigheid beschikt om te werken met straling?
Asks why the MHAZ is not given independent competence despite the evaluation committee's advice, and asks the government to respond to FMS concerns on the audiology exclusion.
They ask why this committee did reach this advice and why the government deviates from it.
Zij vragen waarom deze commissie wel tot dit advies is gekomen en waarom de regering hiervan afwijkt.
Supports inclusion but doubts whether detailed statutory fixing of work areas, unlike the usual route via lower regulation, is wise and respects professional autonomy.

By fixing the work areas of the klinisch fysicus in detail at statutory level, the legislator threatens to sit in the chair of the healthcare professional, whereas the Wet BIG is precisely meant to leave room for professional autonomy and further development of the profession.

Door de werkterreinen van de klinisch fysicus gedetailleerd op wetsniveau vast te leggen, dreigt de wetgever op de stoel van de zorgprofessional te gaan zitten, terwijl de Wet BIG juist bedoeld is om ruimte te bieden voor professionele autonomie en de verdere ontwikkeling van het vak.
Worries that fixed work areas and the lengthy AMvB procedure will delay adoption of new technologies and burden regional hospitals.
Adjustments are only possible via an algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) procedure that takes 1–2 years.
Aanpassingen zijn alleen mogelijk via een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) procedure die 1–2 jaar duurt.
Has no further questions or remarks.
They have no further questions or remarks for the government.
Zij hebben geen verdere vragen aan of opmerkingen voor de regering.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg to add medisch hulpverlener acute zorg and klinisch fysicus to the register professions list. The Afdeling had no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, so no government reply (nader rapport) was needed on substance.

36850-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the States General (Tweede suppletoire begroting), increasing commitment authority by about EUR 3.9 million and adjusting expenditure and revenue across the Eerste Kamer and Tweede Kamer budget articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, the changes being budgetary appropriations set by the legislature itself.
q: We ... have approved and resolved, with the joint consent of the States General ... The budget statement of the States General for the year 2025 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd

36904.s: The bill amends the Housing Act 2014 to align Dutch short-term rental rules with EU Regulation 2024/1028, adding a national registration-number framework, a central digital access point run by the Minister, and new municipal powers to suspend or withdraw registration numbers and order platforms to remove listings. It also assigns enforcement to municipalities, the ACM and the ILT, and raises the limitation period for certain sanctions from five to seven years.
36904.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to enforce the EU regulation and municipal housing and liveability rules, and to ensure effective supervision and enforcement.
q: With a registration obligation the college of mayor and aldermen has insight into where in the municipality, by whom, which dwelling is offered for tourist rental.
Met een registratieverplichting heeft het college van B&W inzicht in waar in de gemeente, door wie, welke woonruimte wordt aangeboden voor toeristische verhuur.
d: Artikel I, D (art. 23j, eerste lid, en nieuw art. 23j, vijfde lid)
design of central digital access point, data categories, data sharing and provision rules
form of municipal directions to platforms to remove or disable listings
data from the local registration system to be supplied to the central access point
p: Mayor and aldermen may suspend or withdraw registration numbers and direct platforms to remove listings, with suspension limited to four weeks and subject to general administrative law appeal.
The Minister collects and processes personal rental data in a central access point and may share it with municipalities, CBS and Eurostat, with use limited to specified purposes.
Enforcement and administrative fines are extended to new EU obligations, with fines capped by criminal-law categories and a proportionality requirement under general administrative law.

parties: No further questions; no check-related concern raised.
Positive about data sharing enabling municipal enforcement, but questions whether municipalities have enough enforcement capacity and whether platforms will cooperate.
It is good that there is now regulation forcing platforms to share data with municipalities, so that effective enforcement can take place.
Het is goed dat er nu regelgeving is die platformen dwingt om data te delen met gemeenten, zodat er effectieve handhaving kan plaatsvinden.
Asks how many municipalities have registration, permit and night-count requirements and how supervision of platforms is handled at EU level.
want to ask the government what percentage of all Dutch municipalities currently have a registration requirement, permit requirement and night criterion.
willen aan de regering vragen hoeveel procent van alle Nederlandse gemeenten momenteel een registratieplicht, vergunningplicht en nachtencriterium hebben ingesteld.
Stresses that municipalities need real steering and enforcement powers, not just data, and questions how much room the system gives them.
Insight alone is not enough. Data is only valuable if municipalities can also actually steer with it in practice.
Inzicht alleen is niet voldoende. Data is pas waardevol als gemeenten daar in de praktijk ook daadwerkelijk mee kunnen sturen.
Questions the privacy intrusion of sharing guest and residence data, the 'woonruimte' scope possibly catching rural B&Bs, and burdens on small hosts and platforms.
How does the government weigh this fundamental right to privacy of citizens against the enforcement objective?
Hoe weegt de regering dit fundamentele recht op privacy van burgers af tegen het doel van handhaving
These members currently have no questions.
Deze leden hebben op dit moment geen vragen.
Asks about administrative burden, proportionality for small hosts, privacy risks of public lists, cybersecurity and fallback if the access point is late.
ask how it is ensured that the proposed obligations do not lead to a disproportionate increase in administrative burdens.
vragen hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat de voorgestelde verplichtingen niet leiden tot een onevenredige toename van administratieve lasten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill implementing the EU short-term rental data regulation, raising concerns about the no-copy-out rule (overschrijfverbod), legal uncertainty over sampling obligations, and unclear division of supervision between ACM and ILT. The government's reply accepted the no-copy-out advice, clarified the supervisory split by moving platform-sampling oversight to ACM, and partly addressed sampling uncertainty via a possible ACM policy rule.
concerns: The bill paraphrases EU regulation provisions, conflicting with the no-copy-out rule, and must be adjusted (e.g., article 23j(3) now shares data only on request).
Open norms on sampling size and frequency create legal uncertainty given possible fines; the government pursues EU clarification and considers an ACM policy rule.
Overlapping and unclear supervisory tasks of ACM and ILT could hamper effective, uniform enforcement; the supervisory allocation was revised so ACM takes all sampling-related oversight.

36913.s: The bill amends the new Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure (Wetboek van Strafvordering) and related laws, including rules on procedural agreements (procesafspraken), transactions, strafbeschikking, DNA and body-related investigative powers, expert appointments, conditions and supervision, and data retention. It also introduces a new covert power for the public prosecutor to log in remotely with lawfully obtained data and expands strafvorderlijke gegevensverwerking rules.
36913.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for practical, technical rules and for effective, timely criminal procedure, while citing CJEU case law and Hoge Raad guidance to add safeguards.
q: Procedural agreements may only be made if, in the public prosecutor's view, it is beyond reasonable doubt that the suspect committed each of the facts in the charge.

Procesafspraken kunnen alleen worden gemaakt indien naar het oordeel van de officier van justitie buiten redelijke twijfel staat dat elk van de feiten waarop de tenlastelegging betrekking heeft door de verdachte is begaan
d: expert register criteria and competence tests
designation of technical research and laboratory standards
retention and destruction of investigation data
rules on physical examinations, processing of results and cost recovery
designation of medical experts for examinations
duration of seizure and destruction of traces-bearing objects
rules on imposing penalties and special conditions in strafbeschikking
p: Allows the public prosecutor, with a rechter-commissaris authorisation, to covertly log into a computer elsewhere using lawfully obtained credentials to copy data.
Permits examinations of unconscious persons when the investigation urgently requires it, with notification later once possible.
Formalises procedural agreements between prosecutor and suspect, with written records and limits, shifting case disposal toward prosecutorial negotiation.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the first supplementary bill to the new Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, raising overarching concerns about coherence, implementability, digitalisation and the shifting roles of actors, plus specific objections on data processing, process agreements, and out-of-court settlement. The government's nader rapport responds to the points, accepting several recommendations (e.g., adding a purpose section, lengthening retention to four months, changing the data-retention provision to a power) while not adopting others (e.g., excluding subdelegation).
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanation to address how the bill fits the shifting roles between the public prosecutor and the investigating judge (rechter-commissaris) and between prosecution and courts in the investigation and disposal phases.

The Afdeling argues a fragmented approach to strafvorderlijke gegevensverwerking lacks an integral view and critical reconsideration of the balance between investigation and privacy, and urges an integral reconsideration.

The Afdeling finds the proposed retention period for seized digital data not demonstrably necessary and proportionate and suggests a separate regime for the forensic copy, while the reuse rules and biometric data processing lack sufficient specificity for proportionality.

The Afdeling notes the retention period of two months after case closure does not align with the three-month beklag period and herziening, and asks for explanation or adjustment; the government lengthened it to four months.

The Afdeling advises making the delegation for rules on processing results of body and clothing examinations mandatory and excluding subdelegation for such data-processing rules; the delegation was made mandatory but subdelegation was not excluded.

The Afdeling finds the impact assessment on implementation, staffing capacity and digitalisation too summary, and asks for concrete estimates and communication to specific user groups, which the government has partly addressed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling raises concerns that out-of-court settlements and process agreements trade off truth-finding and legal protection for efficiency, and stresses the rights to information and (free) legal aid of suspects and the position of victims.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to set out how the bill's components serve the stated goals of the modernisation operation; the government added a section on these goals.

36922.s: The bill adds a supplementary allowance (aanvullende tegemoetkoming) for students who studied under the study-grant system and lost their basic grant, and extends eligibility to new groups. It also creates a legal basis for processing health data for these allowance decisions, with retention periods and access restricted to authorised persons set by ministerial regulation.
36922.j: The memorandum justifies the health-data processing as necessary for an important public interest under the GDPR and specifies retention and authorisation safeguards.
q: The Minister is authorised to process health data as referred to in Article 4(15) of the GDPR, insofar as necessary for decisions on the provisions referred to in paragraph 2.

Onze Minister is bevoegd om gegevens over gezondheid als bedoeld in artikel 4, onderdeel 15, van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming te verwerken, voor zover dit noodzakelijk is in het kader van besluiten over voorzieningen als bedoeld in het tweede lid.
d: authorisation rules for staff accessing health data
p: Gives the minister a statutory basis to process sensitive health data for allowance decisions, with defined retention periods and restricted access.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against adding a second, supplementary voluntary allowance for students who studied without a basic grant under the loan system, arguing the government gave no compelling justification and that the payments risk being seen as compensation rather than a closing gesture, and also raised data-processing concerns under the GDPR. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the GDPR points, adds legal bases and safeguards for health data, and maintains that the combined allowances are a definitive, politically justified gesture.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the substantive justification for a supplementary voluntary allowance insufficient and advises against it; the government maintains it is a politically justified gesture but added explanatory text to sections 2.1.1 and 2.1.2.

The Afdeling warns the allowances may be understood as compensation or a negotiable windfall rather than a definitive closing gesture; the government regards the combined sum as definitive and does not accept the objection.

The bill's processing of personal data for a different purpose and of health data lacked adequate GDPR analysis and safeguards; the government added compatibility reasoning, Article 9(2)(g) basis, retention periods, access restrictions and a delegation basis.
A technical clarification was made regarding indexation of the allowance amounts under article 11.1(1) WSF 2000.

36931.s: The bill implements the EU regulation, directive and amendment establishing the European single access point (ESAP) for financial, capital market and sustainability information by amending the Wft, Wta, Civil Code, Trade Register Act, Pensioenwet and Wvb. It obliges financial supervisors, the AFM, DNB, the Chamber of Commerce and pension bodies to transmit listed disclosures to the ESAP within prescribed timeframes, with sanctions for non-compliance.
36931.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation powers as a way to add information later if the ESAP evaluation requires it.
d: other information pension providers must supply and make accessible on ESAP
other information to supervisor and made accessible on ESAP

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advises that the bill implementing the EU European Single Access Point regulation, directive and regulation may proceed to parliament without remarks. The Minister of Finance's reply notes the AFM is designated to publish audit firms' transparency reports and given enforcement powers for non-compliance.

36940.s: The bill creates a permanent legal framework allowing employers hit by a crisis to use temporary reduced working hours (herplaatsing and verminderde loondoorbetaling) and wage subsidies administered by UWV, to retain staff. It sets conditions for crisis designation by ministerial regulation, procedures and timelines, subsidy calculation, sanctions, and amendments to the Civil Code and related laws.
36940.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for quick, uniform crisis response and the difficulty of specifying every crisis in advance, noting that ministerial designation allows timely decisions.
d: designating weather conditions and additional circumstances as crisis
designating crisis and its start date; council of ministers consent for certain designations
criteria for presuming an employer is affected by a crisis
data and documents required with initial application
employer cost factor and further rules on calculating wages
amounts of administrative fines for failure to provide information
p: The minister may designate new circumstances as crisis by ministerial regulation, with criteria stated in the bill but broad latitude for designation of sanctions and other events.
Employers may unilaterally impose reassignment or reduced pay on employees during a crisis, overriding contractual terms, with employees able to challenge in civil court.
UWV may impose administrative fines on employers, with statutory criteria for deciding on fines and possibility of waiver.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on 4 February 2026 that the draft Wet personeelsbehoud bij crisis needed further consideration, mainly because it doubted effectiveness in large-scale crises, questioned the undefined concept of 'levensvatbare' businesses, and found added complexity from advice requirements and the lack of broader labour-market measures. The minister's nader rapport of 24 April 2026 partly accepted these points by adding a two/four/six-month request option and simplifying wage subsidy calculations, but rejected the main objection on large-scale crises and the viability test and did not accept the advice to split off labour-law measures into a separate bill.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the regulation is sufficiently effective in large-scale crises because it offers no instruments tailored to the nature, severity and duration of such crises; the government disagrees, arguing the instruments are scalable and flexible.

The undefined term 'levensvatbare bedrijven' is insufficiently distinctive, leaving unclear which employers may use the scheme; the government did not add a viability test but clarified the explanatory memorandum and argued non-viable firms are deterred.

Waarborgen added for abuse prevention substantially increase complexity and administrative burden, including the mandatory works council advice and its appeal to the Ondernemingskamer; the government introduced a two/four/six-month request option but kept the advice requirement and shortened appeal periods to two weeks.

The arbeidsrechtelijke measures to increase contract flexibility should be regulated in a separate bill not limited to crises, since the crisis-limited scheme does not enhance labour-market flexibility and risks pressure to label ordinary market risks as crises; the government says broader measures are for later coalition work.

Technical changes were made, including simplifying the subsidy calculation, replacing 'groep' with 'categorie', raising the employer-cost compensation to 25 percent and deleting unnecessary electronic legislation provisions.
